pages.name: Ned Nobel
npc_lines: Hi fellow, do you need rockits for the upcoming turn of the year? Just let me know if you want to trade.
My name is Ned. Ned Nobel. Maybe you knew my father, his name was Alfred!
He laid the foundation for my invention.
I did plenty of testing and I can proudly say that they are much safer and better now. Nevertheless I can't tell you the formula. It's a secret.
No, I will not tell you and now stop bothering me I have to work. (termina a conversa)
I'm an inventor and a salesman. You know, without money no inventions.
Here, take a look. But don't light them here in my pocket! I wish you a Happy New Year!
I wish you a prosperous new year Jogador!
pages.title: Ned Nobel

pages.name: Rashid
npc_lines: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, Jogador!
I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
I am Rashid, son of the desert.
Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
Um... I don't think so.
I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
Um... I don't think so.
I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
Um... I don't think so.
I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
Um... I don't think so.
Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
It's almost time to journey on.
Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
Farewell, Jogador, may the winds guide your way.
pages.title: Rashid

pages.name: Aldo
npc_lines: Just great, another ... 'customer'. Hello, Jogador.
I am a salesman, I sell headgear ... uhm ... oh well, and shoes.
I'm Aldo. No one calls me 'lucky Aldo' though, guess why!
Is it time for lunch already? Hey, stop making fun of me!
One day I will sell the king a pair of shoes made by me and will get out of that stinky hole I live in and my family will never find me. HE, HE!
I doubt I will ever see much of it. It's like i am cursed to haunt this site here for the rest of my life.
So many feet ... so many ... a nightmare!
I heard that chicks wear some revealing pieces of armor!
Can't be worse than my wife.
I have other stuff to worry about, like paying my bills.
Yes, I have to pay o lot of bills, and some georges, and a john, and several steves.
A city ruled by women!? Could anything be worse?
I will never in my life make it there.
My boss, an evil slaver of good people like me.
<sigh> We sell leather boots and sandals.
Leave me alone with her while I am working at least. My only pleasure around here!
That's music in my ears.
Just great, another ... 'customer'. Hello, Jogador.
Yeah, get lost.
pages.title: Aldo

pages.name: Ebenizer
npc_lines: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
Yes? What may I do for you, Jogador? Bank business, perhaps?
We can change money for you. You can also access your bank account or your guild account options.
I am running this bank.
My name? Ebenizer!
I only care about financial news.
The riches of our isle are its mineral resources.
It is horas, precisely.
A true threat to wealth and trade.
This weapon, if real, might be worth a lot.
Hail to the king!
Soldiers have not that much money that I would care about.
We are in constant contact with the city of Thais.
There are countless ways of profit in this world.
It's underdeveloped and economically insignificant.
Have a nice day.
pages.title: Ebenizer

pages.name: Ahmet
npc_lines: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods.
My inventory of general goods and is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.
Of course, just browse through my wares.
I am the mourned Ahmet.
Are you interested in being my private security slave ...er...officer?
It would be foolish of me to tell you the time as you won't buy a watch then.
The vain cities of the Tibian continent think they are at the centre of the universe. Little do they know about the wisdom of the Pharaoh.
We rarely see a traveller of the small folk here.
Elves are a rare sight in our lands.
The world is nothing but a sigil of death, a monument of decay. We have to attune to death to become one with the world.
The foolishness of their ways will eventually spell their doom.
Life here is harsh, but only this way can we deny the temptations that might damage our Rah and our Uthun to our traitorous flesh.
I'm glad I don't require the help of anyone else than......ME.
Our city will endure the sands of the desert and the grinding teeth of time.
The Rah could be called our soul.
The Uthun is that what we learn and remember.
Blessed be the Pharaoh. He is our saviour. I hope that I will be chosen one day.
<Eeek> I think this is the guy who robbed me!!!! WAIT, no...false alarm!
May enlightenment be your path, Jogador.
pages.title: Ahmet

pages.name: Anerui
npc_lines: Ashari Jogador. Just came back from my hunt, look at that fine meat.
My name is Anerui Mourningleaf.
I'm the mistress of hunting. At this place you can buy food we get from our hunts.
Watch the sky, it will tell you.
He is our contact person to the Thaian kingdom and a necessary evil.
He'd love to be an elf but he is rather some kind of a pale orc.
Thais is too far away to pose a threat but it is also too far away to help us if problems should occur.
Venore profits greatly from the trade with Ab'Dendriel. In my eyes, those traders are leeches that exhaust our resources.
Carlin needs our protection and resources. Of course they will turn on us as soon as they feel strong enough.
The magic they wield is all that matters to them.
The Kuridai are too aggressive, not only against people but also against the environment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature.
The Abdaisim are our brothers and sisters in spirit. We stay in contact with them, exchanging news and items.
Hunters live a life of freedom, close to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bug herder.
Hunting is an art which is too often practised by amateurs. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
I'm the mistress of hunting. At this place you can buy food we get from our hunts.
Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunter's best friends. I heard somebody is selling such tools in the North-east of this town.
Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
A person who herds bugs, what else?
The bugs provide us with chitin for equipment, bug milk and bug meat.
It's delicious. Brasith sells it in his store.
The forests are the gardens of life. Nature provides enough for everyone's need, but not enough for everyone's greed.
Most lessons nature teaches are about life and death.
Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
The defiler. I'm not going to talk about him.
I believe it's a human god. I don't know much about this entity.
That is the race to which I belong.
I'll never understand these little people from the mountains.
Humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to orcs than to us.
I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
I sell meat and ham. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Asha Thrazi, Jogador.
pages.title: Anerui

pages.name: Allen
npc_lines: Welcome to the Plank and Treasurechest Market, Jogador!
My name is Allen Richardson. I am the owner of this market.
It is 0:00 am. Too bad we run out of cuckoo clocks.
I run this market and sell furniture.
At this counter you can buy chairs. What do you need?
I can offer you wooden chairs, rocking chairs, red cushioned chairs, green cushioned chairs and sofa chairs.
You want to buy a sofa chair for 55 gold?
Hmm, but I'm sure, it would fit nicely into your house.
Good bye.
pages.title: Allen

pages.name: Elvith
npc_lines: Ashari Jogador.
I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
I bet they were great musicians.
That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
Asha Thrazi.
pages.title: Elvith

pages.name: Briasol
npc_lines: Come and take a look at the finest gems in the lands of Tibia.
Ashari, Jogador and welcome to the Jewel Store of Ab'Dendriel.
I am a jeweller. I hope you are here for a trade.
I am Briasol Crithanath.
I don't know the time, sorry. I do not care for this concept. Watches are your master, they tell you what to do and when.
I sell the finest gems. Ask me for a trade if you're interested.
I have only little dealings with him.
I only talk to him when I send a parcel to one of my customers in a far away city. He seems friendly and is a bit eager to please.
Carlin is a quite lovely city, given that its a city of humans.
Thais has a high demand on the jewelry that I craft.
The tradesmen of Venore offer high prices for my wares.
They are the ones responsible for most of the magic and the like in this town.
Our caste are workers out of passion.
They hunt for us and patrol the woods.
I don't know much about them.
They are lost in time.
You can buy and sell small diamonds, sapphires, rubies, emeralds and amethysts or sell topazes.
There are white and black pearls you can buy or sell, as well as giant green and brown pearls which you can sell.
Currently you can purchase wedding rings, golden amulets, and ruby necklaces. We also buy gold ingots.
We don't trade with them.
It's a weapon of times long gone. It's lost for our time.
I know nothing of importance.
He will be gone sooner or later.
Gods are eternal. They learn so much in their existence.
Our lifespan is longer then that of other races. We should keep that in mind everytime.
They live that long and make not much out of it.
I mourn them. As soon as you get to know one he's dead.
We take care of them, give them shelter, and a reason to live.
Asha Thrazi.
pages.title: Briasol

pages.name: Alexander
npc_lines: Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look.
Hi there Jogador, and welcome to the magic store.
I trade with runes and other magical items.
I'm Alexander.
There are always rumors about the dangers in the far north of Edron.
It's horas right now.
A hero has to be well-prepared to face this threat.
Ah, I would trade a fortune for this fabulous item.
I'm selling runes, life rings, wands, rods and crystal balls. I also buy powerful spellbooks. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
The king is not very interested in magic items as far as I know.
The army uses weapons and armor rather then items of magic.
I'm glad the king founded this academy far away from the mundane troubles of Thais.
The world is filled with wondrous places and items.
I heard it's a druid city.
In our town, science and arts are thriving.
See you, Jogador.
pages.title: Alexander

pages.name: Benjamin
npc_lines: Hello. How may I help you Jogador? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the mail system.
Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the receiver in the first line and make sure you entered it correctly.
Well, the receiver - or addressee - is the person you want to send mail to. Always make sure to enter his or her name correctly.
With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trade.
If you want to buy a letter, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how letters work?

With a letter you can send a message to another Tibian's depot. If you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais, use the letter - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Write your message below that. ...
Then drag your letter on one of the blue mailboxes here to send it.

Each major city has at least one depot. Just step in front of one of the lockers and you can store items inside. Your mail will also arrive there. It doesn't matter which depot you stored it in - you can retrieve all your items from any depot in any city!
With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trade.
If you want to buy a parcel, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how parcels work?
If you want to buy a label, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how labels work?
The King? Oops,I... can't remember his name.
My Name is Benjamin.
That name sounds familiar... Who might that be...
This is the town you are currently in.
You can send letters and parcels to Carlin.
TO THE ARMS! MAN THE WALLS! FERUMBRAS IS NEAR
I know him because he always forgets to write the name of the recipient on his parcels and letters. The hardest part is to find out who he actually wanted to send it to.
Ham? No thanks, I already ate fish.
She's SO pretty!
The young sorcerer is a good businessman.
This Muriel has a lot of correspondence.
This naughty child, always stealing apples!
He hangs around here quite often. He says that I inspire him.
Oh, she lives next door.
NO! NO! NO! GO AWAY!.
Frodo... Frodo... ? Uhm... isn't that the guy that brings me food at lunchtime?
He sells equipment.
Never heard of him.
Oh, young Harkath will be a fine warrior some day.
That name sounds familiar... who might that be...
He's always talking about healing me even though I'm fine... I believe he is a bit nuts, poor man.
Ooooh, nice man, visits me often... I think.
I love his music! He's my best friend and I visit him as often as I can.
I don't drink alcohol while I'm on duty.
It was a pleasure to help you, Jogador.
pages.title: Benjamin

pages.name: Charlotta
npc_lines: Ah, welcome! Welcome Jogador! If you need druid spells, you’ve come to the right place. Otherwise it’s just nice to have a visitor.
Oh well, I cure this and that. People come to me to hear about the future or to buy lucky charms.
<laughs> No, your future is far beyond my abilities to see. I can divine only the future of ordinary lives of ordinary people. Your life is full of danger and excitement.
Trading with lucky charms is not overly liked by the authorities, so please don’t ask.
Chondur is a great man of great knowledge and wisdom. He understands the ancient ways and voodoo. You ask where you can find him? <laughs> You will find him when the time is right.
May they be cursed! They bring doom upon us all. Calling powers they can’t control. Whoever may be the dark master they are serving, he’d do better to devour them all.
Djinns are a rare sight here. Although it is rumoured that one of their kind lives on a remote island here.

She has the heart in the right place even though she is a Thaian. She is so pure. Not corrupted by politics or gold. Don’t forget to mention the secret word: peg leg. That will tell her we can trust you.
The dark one. He has some place of power on these isles. I wouldn’t advice to search this place. If you are clever, stay away from Ferumbras and everything that he represents.
He does what he has to do, I guess. We are all slaves of the cards that fates deals us. Still we don’t have to like the roles others are playing.
<chuckles>
What has a king in Thais to do with the people here in Liberty Bay? He should just leave us alone and everything would be fine.
The name has become a cruel joke of fate. Once it stood for freedom until selfish fightings led all dreams burst. But in the end, you can’t truly kill a dream.
Do you want to have the spell ‘Light Healing’ for free?
This man is the worst example of a selfish and greedy Venorean profiteer. He’s the long arm of the trade barons that hold us by the throat.
ou should probably talk with Chondur about this issue.
Well, there are pirates and then there are pirates.
Once there were only a few plantations on which free and happy men were working. Now the isle is full of plantations and the workers there are nothing else than slaves of foreigners.
Nobody knows where they come from and what’s on their agenda. They are even more alien than the Thaian invaders and obviously more destructive.
We both know that this man is a freedom fighter and not a pirate.
Rum is a fine medicine in some cases. But as with all medicines, it has to be handled with care.
Sorry, I don’t teach spells for your vocation.

The sugar was our blessing in the past. The money we gained trading it was enough to make a good living for everybody and even a little profit. But then it caught the attention of greedy people from other cities and now it has turned into our curse.
Thais and the Thaians should mind their own business.
For a Thaian he is not that bad.
<spits on the floor> The Venorean traders are the source of all evil here. It was them who convinced the king in Thais to intervene and to ‘rescue’ us by sending an occupational force.
There is some knowledge that is less accurate but yet more true than the knowledge that the sorcerer’s guild presents us as truth.
A thoroughgoing soldier. Efficient, yet without a thought of his own. He is only a pawn of the mighty ones.
Good bye my dear visitor.
pages.title: Charlotta

pages.name: Chatterbone
npc_lines: ... we hid it... so long ago... so long...
... we conquered them... held them so long... long ago...
pages.title: Chatterbone

pages.name: Duria
npc_lines: Hiho, fellow knight Jogador!
Iam the Highknight of the dwarfs.
I am Duria Steelbender, daughter of Fire, of the Dragoneaters.
Bah, to much plants and stuff, to few tunnels if you'd ask me.
Knights are proud of being dwarfs, jawoll.
Heroes are rare in this days, jawoll.
Was there once. Can't handle the crime overthere.
Can teach ye' spells for all mag levels up to 3. In what level do you want to learn a spell?
Goodbye.
Becarefull out there, jawoll!
pages.title: Duria

pages.name: Brodrosch
npc_lines: Welcome, Jogador! May Earth protect you, even whilst sailing! Need a passage or a ticket for the ore wagon system here?
I am Brodrosch Steamtrousers, son of the machine, of the Molten Rock.
Look at my blackened beard? I'm the steamship captain!
Sometimes being drunk means seeing two rivers. I survive by steering right between them.
Ah, my brother in Cormaya. He can take you back.
Deep inside, we're all dwarfs.
Tibia? Just don't ask.
Earth under your feet ... it's still better than lava.
pages.title: Brodrosch

pages.name: A Ghostly Guardian
npc_lines: Jogador, it is you. I knew you'd be coming someday. The guardian greets you.
Once I was a guardian in these halls. It was my duty to welcome those who braved the challenge. But the Brotherhood infiltrated this place using stolen knowledge and their evil seed took root.
The Brotherhood intruded these halls that are made of dreams. They defiled them to suit their needs. Beware of taking the wrong path ...
It will lead you to a powerful master of evil and I fear that he may try luring someone as powerful as you to his side. He will urge you to join his order of evil ...
Resist the temptation of power! Stick to the virtues and seek out the Dream Master for spiritual guidance.

The Dream Master is perhaps the last living member of the Nightmare Knights. He used to be a teacher of young aspiring knights. So mighty was his power that even the Bone Master did not dare to challenge him.
Once the Dream Challenge was a test to find out who was worthy to talk to the Dream Master. Worthy to become a Nightmare Knight. Now ... I am not sure ...
I don't know if there are any Dream Masters left. Perhaps you might find one of them like in the days of old. Before the evil came.
By using stolen secrets from our order as well as dark magic one of the last remaining bone masters found his way to this place ...
He did not dare to challenge the Dream Master in fair combat. Instead, he decided to hide here and to poison the minds of those who sought the Master's guidance, luring them to the side of evil.
I am guarding this place ... forever.
pages.title: A Ghostly Guardian

pages.name: Hjaern
npc_lines: Be greeted, Jogador. The spiritual world looks upon you and your deeds.
The spirits call me by the name of Hjaern and that is how I shall be known.
I would not consider this as a job. But one of my responsibilities is the training of young shamans. Even druids can learn a few new tricks from me.
We try to figure out the will of the spirits and ways to appease them.
The news I receive are from the spiritual world. They would be of little importance for you.
We had no contact with the people that passed Svargrond. Their arrival has caused some disturbance in the spirits' world though. ...
Ancient spirits are restless. It seems that some things that should have been left alone, have awoken from their slumber. I can't tell more yet.
Your foreign gods are concepts we don't really understand.
There should be no such thing like a human that is ruling over the lives of other humans.
The chakoyas are like a force of nature. It would be wrong to try to exterminate them. On the other hand, we can't allow their carnivorous nature to threaten our lives.
The yetis are real. They are elusive but dangerous. Some say they are rather residents of the spirits' world than ours. The spirits are silent about them which is an even greater enigma.
He is of no importance here.
The city was a necessity. Just like the spirit needs a haven of safety and retreat, so does the body need it.
That's something I only heard about in curious questions of people like you.
Months ago, many strange looking people passed Svargrond. The inhabitants tell stories about a cult they belong to. ...
It is rumoured that they are trying to awake unholy spirits in the mountains. Maybe other people know more about that cult.
Father north wind is the supreme ruler of the North. His ways are almost unpredictable to us humans since his thoughts span ages. ...

We can only do our best to interpret his will correctly and act accordingly. One has to move with the wind after all, else it will destroy you. This is the way things are here in the North and the way of our people.
Good bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Hjaern

pages.name: Cornelia
npc_lines: Quality armors for sale!
Welcome to the finest armor shop in the land, Jogador!
My name is Cornelia.
It's horas right now.
I run this armoury. If you want to protect your life, you better buy my wares.
I sell and buy armor, helmets, and shields. Only the dwarfs can make better ones.
The ancient dwarven clan halls are far to the east from here.
With my armor you don't need to fear any monsters!
While exploring the dungeons of the land you'll learn how important a good armor is.
Sewers are men's business.
You're welcome.
THE GHOSTLANDS??? Make sure to buy the best protection in store before you get even close there.
What do you need? I sell armor, helmets, shields, and trousers. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Good bye. Come back soon.
pages.title: Cornelia

pages.name: Dane
npc_lines: Have a nice warm milk, crystal clear water, or fresh lemonade in the Wave Cellar.
Welcome to the Wave Cellar, Jogador. Have a drink.
I'm Dane.
It's exactly horas.
I'm the owner of this place of relaxation.
It's pretty, isn't it?
I heard nothing interesting lately.
I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade. Ask me for a trade if you need refreshments.
Sorry, we just sell drinks.
Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
Well, apart from not selling alcohol, you mean? I guess another specialty of Carlin are evergreen flower bowls.
A sailor from Carlin told me that the natives of the Ice Islands pray to different gods. I think 'Chyll' is one of them or was that the name of the northern winds?? Well, doesn't matter! Primitives!
I heard something about the fauna of the Ice Islands. The people tattle about birds that don't fly but swim!!! Isn't that ridiculous?!?!
I heard it through the grapevine that the people on the Ice Islands eat fish all the time. But not only usual fish, no. They eat red and green fishes! ...
... The only green fish I know is the one you can buy at Permaret in Edron as a 'special offer' and that would be your last meal. Trust me!
I heard about one guy, that is living in the capital of the Ice Islands, who has become crazy after searching the mines there. He always mumbles things about ancient demons and the end of the world.
A friend of mine, Captain Ogden Brewboiler, travelled to the forgotten northern sea. He is an ambitious sailor but still I have a bad feeling about it. I hope he's doing well.
The people talk about a huge mountain of ice, several hundreds of metres thick located in the centre of the main Ice Island.
Have you heard about the natives of the Ice Islands? It sounds very confusing to me. ...
... I mean there are barbarians and barbarians, some are good, the others not. One call themselves 'Norsir' the others 'Raiders', but actually they are all the same.

Some old people tell stories about the creation war and these islands in the North ruled by snow and ice. They say it once was a fertile region. Mighty magicians used a huge crystal of ice to store all the coldness inside.
I heard about dozens of sea serpents terrorising the sea around the islands in the North. ...
... It seems that this was the reason why nobody has discovered the Ice Islands before. Something must have happened because at a moment's notice they disappeared.
A sailor told me a story about female raiders. He said they can talk to the beasts that live in the wilderness of the north. ...
... The wolves and bears protect them and tear their foes into pieces if they order them to. If you ask me, this is just gossip.
A week ago an old drunkard mumbled something about hairy elephants!! I wonder who's telling all that weird stuff. I never met someone who was in the North and returned to the main continent.

I heard something about the barbarian tribes, who live on the newly discovered Ice Islands, that are called 'raiders'. The mightiest of them is headed by a shaman witch. There are rumours that she is immortal.
I heard that the town is mostly built out of wood. The inhabitants nearly stubbed all their forests. ...
... That must be the reason why the Carlin traders are so interested in getting there. They sense gold in selling wood.
I heard something about a civil war going on in the North. It seems that there are different tribes of 'raiders' making the whole area an even rougher place than it is already.
I received a letter from a friend who works on the Ice Islands. ...
... He was writing strange things about suspicious inhabitants and something about a test to become one of them. It was very hard to read the letter, I think he was drunk as hell when he wrote it.
A guy told me that the Carlin Trading Syndicate sent out an employee to the new market in the North to open up a new branch of their company.
Some citizens from Venore settled on one of the islands in the North. I heard stories about exotic products they are gathering from their hunts.
The Carlin Trading Syndicate is sending expedition after expedition to the new discovered islands in the north. ...
... I heard that they dig for valuable ore which was found in an old mine. I wonder why nobody of them has returned yet.
I heard about some strange creatures that appeared on one of the smaller ice islands. Reportedly they have a human torso but the lower body of a white-furred goat! Can you imagine that? ...

Travellers told me that they recently moved into the caverns beneath the island. There, they are growing fresh grass and even flowers! How is that possible in a frozen cave? Some kind of magic has to be involved. ...
I'm just not sure whether it is of the benevolent or the malicious kind.
Please come back from time to time.
pages.title: Dane

pages.name: Nydala
npc_lines: Welcome to Carlin Furniture Store, Jogador.
My name is Nydala. I run this store.
It is 0:00 am. Do you need a clock for your house?
Good bye.
pages.title: Nydala

pages.name: Imalas
npc_lines: Hello Jogador! What do you need? If it's food, you've come to the right place.
My name is Imalas.
I'm a shopkeeper. You can buy food here.
I offer quite a lot of food. Ask me for a trade if you're hungry.
Good bye.
pages.title: Imalas

pages.name: Sarina
npc_lines: Oh, please come in, Jogador. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a trade.
I am Sarina. I am selling everything the adventurer needs.
I am selling equipment of all kinds. Do you need anything?
Good bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Sarina

pages.name: A Fluffy Squirrel
npc_lines: Chhchh?
Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
Chh? Chhh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>
Chh...
pages.title: A Fluffy Squirrel

pages.name: Bruno
npc_lines: Ahoi, Jogador. You want to buy some fresh fish?
My job is to catch fish and to sell them here.
Ah yes, my lovely wife. God forgive her, but she can't stop talking. So my work is a great rest for my poor ears. *laughs loudly*
I like this old salt. I learned much from him. Whatever. You like some fish? *grin*
Good bye and come again!
pages.title: Bruno

pages.name: Gamel
npc_lines: Pssst! Be silent. Do you wish to buy something?
I am selling some... things.
Names don't matter.
I sell maces, staffs, daggers, throwing stars, and brass helmets.
Oh, you know my name. Please don't tell it to the others.
Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
pages.title: Gamel

pages.name: Queen Eloise
npc_lines: I greet thee, my loyal subject.
I am Queen Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous city and the lands of the north.
I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
They dare to reject my reign over them!
The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
The paladins are great hunters.
It's my humble domain.
We honour the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender! (Para Homens)
I beg your pardon? A queen that sells things? Be serious! (Para Mulheres)
Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
A man's tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
He is the scourge of the whole continent!
The order that Crunor gives the world is essential for survival.
A disgusting organisation, which could be only created by men.
It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
Ask around about them.
Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
Ask one of the soldiers about that.
The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
They havn't troubled our city lately. I guess they fear the wrath of our druids.
Our city is rich and prospering.
If you want a reward, go and bring me something this silly King Tibianus wants dearly!
The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city down.
Farewell, Jogador
pages.title: Queen Eloise

pages.name: Gorn
npc_lines: Oh, please come in, Jogador. What do you need?
I am selling equipment of all kinds. Do you need anything?
The king supports Tibia's economy a lot.
Magic? Ask a sorcerer or druid about that.
I am Gorn. My goods are known all over Tibia.
It is exactly 3:30 pm. Maybe you want to buy a watch?
This druids are nice people, you will find them in the east of the town.
Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.
You can find him in the sorcerer guild.
She's the leader of the paladin guild.
Old Baxter was a rowdy, once. In our youth we shared some adventures and women.
Bah! Go away with this bozoguy.
Frodo is a jolly fellow.
We had a clash or two in the old days.
Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.
That's a pretty one.
I hardly know the McRonalds.
You can find him in the sorcerer guild.
This Oswald has not enough to work and too much time to spread rumours.
He advices newcomers to buy at my store. I love that guy!
Strong as an ox, could armwrestle a minotaur, I bet.
He owns the magic shop here. But be aware: The prices are enormous.
Good bye.
pages.title: Gorn

pages.name: Hardek
npc_lines: Hello Jogador! Do you need my services?
I am buying some weapons and armors.
I am Hardek, the forestaller.
It is 0:00 am.
Good bye. Visit me whenever you want to sell something.
pages.title: Hardek

pages.name: Lubo
npc_lines: Welcome to my adventurer shop, Jogador! What do you need?
I am selling equipment for adventurers. Do you need anything?
I sell torches, fishing rods, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
There's a lot of magic flowing in the mountain to the north.
I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
It is exactly 0:00 am.
If you want to buy weapons, you'll have to go to a town or city.
It is said that once there lived a great magician on the top of this mountain.
I don't remember his name, but it's said that his banner was the black eye.
Ah yes, I remember my grandfather talking about that name. This house used to be an inn a long time ago. My family bought it from some of these flower guys.
Oh, I mean druids of course. They sold the cottage to my family after some of them died in an accident or something like that.
As far as I can remember the story, a pet escaped its stable behind the inn. It got somehow involved with powerful magic at a ritual and was transformed in some way.
My grandpa told me, in the old days there were some behind this cottage. Nothing big though, just small ones, for chicken or rabbits.
pages.title: Lubo

pages.name: Timur
npc_lines: Equipment and general goods!
Selling ammunition and buying bows and crossbows!
Welcome to my little shop, adventurer Jogador! If you need general goods, just ask me for a trade.
I am Timur. Sorry, I have not much equipment for sale. The business is running low.
I am selling equipment. Do you want something?
I am sorry, I have no watch.
I sell torches, scrolls, documents, parchments, ropes, fishing rods, worms, arrows, bolts, and a nice helmet. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
At the moment I have no weapons to offer. Weapons are very rare on this isle, so I have to buy a few.
We have too few bows on this isle for our hunters.
We have too few crossbows on this isle for our hunters.
Nope, not here.
It's a very nice isle. But we don't have enough weapons to defeat the many wolves.
They are everywhere around the village.
The magic shops have a monopole on potions now... argl!
Bye, bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Timur

pages.name: Gamon
npc_lines: Nice to meet you, Mister Jogador! Looking for furniture? You've come to the right place!
Yes! Selling is a form of art! The elaborate combination of rhetoric and acting which serves to create a sublime longing for the infinite, embodied by second class furniture.
I am Thais's foremost furniture salesman.
I sell statues, tables, chairs, flowers, pillows, pottery, instruments, decoration, tapestries and containers.
Our furniture is produced by the finest carpenters on the continent using the rare wood of the Venorean marsh willow!
You can't get any better wood in this world. And it has got a nice smell to it, too. There is nothing nicer than a marsh willow campfire.
His Royal Highness will start to appreciate the superior quality of our stock soon enough!
My friends call me Gamon. My fans call me the incredible Gammy!
A quest?! Who needs quests when there is interior decorating!
Yes! Smiling! How a professional sales artist such as myself is supposed to work in such an atmosphere is beyond me!
Tibia is a wonderful place full of business opportunities.
Any time's a good time to buy some furniture.
Ah, those twins. Strange people they are (*sigh*). Oh, they are great work with, of course. Excellent quality, competetive prices! But well... (whispers) they give me creeps!
Yes! I can never figure out which is which. And they are always watching me!
Look! They are doing it again! And they are always smiling!
I heard rumours he has some special offers for customers who know to ask for the correct things.
Ecle- who? No... can't say I know him.
A thaian folklore tale.
He's incredibly slow. Just your average postman, I guess.
He sells stuff of inferior quality. Nothing compared to venores high quality goods.
That old monk has probably never left that overcrowded town here.
Bozo! Damn that clown! He keeps making fake orders. It isn't funny to deliver a wardrobe to an address that doesn't even exist, you know!
She's pretty, but I am the kind of man who enjoys a long and healthy life.
Druids are obsessed with trees and the bane of any carpenter.
Those knights know how to party. And after such parties there's always need for new furniture.
The sorcerers guild could really need someone with taste to redecorate it.
There are a few rumours about a rebellion, but that is all they are.
Well - a few paranoid souls think that Venore wants to gain independence from Thais. Nothing more than rumours.
Oh, silly me! Rugs are out of stock at the moment! But we expect a new shipment anytime. Just watch out for the next update!... Of our inventory I mean.
I've said it a thousand times! That place needs a complete refurbishing!
Thais is obsessed with its past. Everybody here is so proud of their history. Bah! Thais might have a long history, but it has no idea when it comes to interior decoration.
The place where it all happens. That town really rocks! Thais could learn a lot about interior decoration from Venore!
You'll come back. They all do.
pages.title: Gamon

pages.name: Quero
npc_lines: Welcome Jogador! Can I help you?
I make instruments and sometimes I'm wandering through the lands of Tibia as a bard.
They live in the northeast of Tibia..
You can buy a lyre, lute, drum, and simple fanfare.
Selling instruments isn't enough to live on and I love music. That's why I wander through the lands from time to time.
I love the music of the elves.
My name is Quero.
Sorry, I don't know what time it is.
He's nice.
That name rings a bell, wait... I've last seen him several days ago when he went to buy some bread at the farm.
He's nice.
Yes, I have a small daughter. Her room is upstairs.
Good bye.
pages.title: Quero

pages.name: Galuna
npc_lines: Oh, please come in, Jogador. What do you need? Distance weapons? I sell lots of them.
I am the local fletcher. I am selling bows, crossbows, and ammunition. Do you need anything?
I am Galuna, paladin and fletcher.
Tibia, a green island. Here it is wunderful to walk into the forests and to hunt with a bow.
Don't bother me. Go and buy a watch.
We are feared warriors and good marksmen. Ask Elane if want to know more about the guild.
It is rumored that they live in the northeast of Tibia. They are the best in archery.
We have visitors of all kind in Thais, only elves show up seldom.
She is the leader of all paladins.
I supplied him with my goods in the past, now I sell them myself.
My offers are bows, crossbows and ammunition. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I heard about him.
I don't buy used bows. If you want to buy one, just ask me for a trade.
I don't buy used crossbows. If you want to buy one, just ask me for a trade.
Good bye.
pages.title: Galuna

pages.name: Eddy
npc_lines: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
Welcome Jogador!
My name is Eddy. I sell furniture.
Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
It is horas. Do you need a clock for your house?
You mean my specials, don't you?
My offers are permanently extraordinary cheap.
Good bye.
pages.title: Eddy

pages.name: Frodo
npc_lines: Welcome to Frodo's Hut. You heard about the news?
Hehe. Great customers.
I hope you like it. Would you like some food?
Some travelers from Edron told about a great treasure guarded by cruel demons in the dungeons there.
I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also selling food.
I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.
Just call me Frodo.
It is exactly Horário dentro do jogo.
Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!
I heard it when I was a child.
He is a great bard. He often graced my hut with his presence, songs, and rhymes. I wonder what happened to him lately.
Nothing more than a tale for warriors.
Uhm, do not mention him. It may scare customers away.
I think some time ago a stranger from Fibula with that name stayed here for some nights.
Can you believe that she actually told her guildfellows that alcohol is a bad thing?
Come on! You know that our world is called Tibia.
Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this northern town.
Here in Thais is the center of Tibia.
He's able to drink a bottle or two.
I am trying to hire him for an evening or two.
The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.
She makes excellent arrows and bows.
Many of his customers visit my Hut, too.
The knights have sometimes parties here after some arena fights.
Too disciplined to enjoy life.
A sorceress, you can find her in her guild, poring over a book - always!
Just between you and me: What a babe! A shame that she is such a prude.
Muriel has never visited this place.
I hate him. Each of his visits here ends with a bar brawl.
He hardly visits my humble tavern.
A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.
I don't know where he gets these potions. If I could sell them here, the hut would be crowded.
No idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...
Oh, the Royal Archives are in Rain Castle!
The king's residence has been renovated lately.
I overheared some conversations about his evilness. That's enough to hope, that I never ever meet him.
That fellow is filthy rich. He rented a room upstairs for months in advance and always orders the best beer and wine I serve.
A guy told me that the Carlin Trading Syndicate sent out an employee to the new market in the North to open up a new branch of their company.
I heard something about the fauna of the Ice Islands. The people tattle about birds that don't fly but swim!!! Isn't that ridiculous?!?!

I heard something about the barbarian tribes, who live on the newly discovered Ice Islands, that are called 'raiders'. The mightiest of them is headed by a shaman witch. There are rumours that she is immortal.
A sailor told me a story about female raiders. He said they can talk to the beasts that live in the wilderness of the north. ...
... The wolves and bears protect them and tear their foes into pieces if they order them to. If you ask me, this is just gossip.

Some old people tell stories about the creation war and these islands in the North ruled by snow and ice. They say it once was a fertile region. Mighty magicians used a huge crystal of ice to store all the coldness inside.
A week ago an old drunkard mumbled something about hairy elephants!! I wonder who's telling all that weird stuff. I never met someone who was in the North and returned to the main continent.
The people talk about a huge mountain of ice, several hundreds of metres thick located in the centre of the main Ice Island.
I heard that the town is mostly built out of wood. The inhabitants nearly stubbed all their forests. ...
... That must be the reason why the Carlin traders are so interested in getting there. They sense gold in selling wood.
Have you heard about the natives of the Ice Islands? It sounds very confusing to me. ...
... I mean there are barbarians and barbarians, some are good, the others not. One call themselves 'Norsir' the others 'Raiders', but actually they are all the same.
I heard it through the grapevine that the people on the Ice Islands eat fish all the time. But not only usual fish, no. They eat red and green fishes! ...
... The only green fish I know is the one you can buy at Permaret in Edron as a 'special offer' and that would be your last meal. Trust me!
Some citizens from Venore settled on one of the islands in the North. I heard stories about exotic products they are gathering from their hunts.
I heard something about a civil war going on in the North. It seems that there are different tribes of 'raiders' making the whole area an even rougher place than it is already.
A sailor from Carlin told me that the natives of the Ice Islands pray to different gods. I think 'Chyll' is one of them or was that the name of the northern winds?? Well, doesn't matter! Primitives!
I heard about one guy, that is living in the capital of the Ice Islands, who has become crazy after searching the mines there. He always mumbles things about ancient demons and the end of the world.
I received a letter from a friend who works on the Ice Islands. ...
... He was writing strange things about suspicious inhabitants and something about a test to become one of them. It was very hard to read the letter, I think he was drunk as hell when he wrote it.
A friend of mine, Captain Ogden Brewboiler, travelled to the forgotten northern sea. He is an ambitious sailor but still I have a bad feeling about it. I hope he's doing well.
I heard about dozens of sea serpents terrorising the sea around the islands in the North. ...
... It seems that this was the reason why nobody has discovered the Ice Islands before. Something must have happened because at a moment's notice they disappeared.
The Carlin Trading Syndicate is sending expedition after expedition to the new discovered islands in the north. ...
... I heard that they dig for valuable ore which was found in an old mine. I wonder why nobody of them has returned yet.
Marvik seldom leaves his guildhall at all.
Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
He is a little shy. In his youth he dreamed to become a druid.
Hmm, I have heard of a 'satanic influence' theory by someone called Newton or something like that... Maybe there's more in the Royal Archives.
The sunset homes are a block of flats south of the harbour.
Yes, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.
Sorry, he spoke only very little. I know nothing more about him.
Please come back from time to time.
pages.title: Frodo

pages.name: Baxter
npc_lines: LONG LIVE KING TIBIANUS!
I am a proud member of the king's army. It is my duty to guard the castle.
King Tibianus III is our wise and just leader!
We have a rat problem in the sewers. In the name of our glorious king I am paying 1 blinking piece of gold for every freshly killed rat you bring to me.
Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
There is almost nothing known about that organization.
His Royal Highness ordered the castle to be open for all his subjects.
We all live under the benevolent guidance of our king.
Now that the king returned, we will clean the city from all scum.
To much scum roams our streets in our days, the red guards will take care of them.
They are our special forces. Some serve as cityguards, others as secret police.
Ask a higher offical about that.
Do you bring a freshly killed rat for a bounty of 1 gold?
Come on. Don't waste my time with your jests.
Gorn and I searched for this weapon in the darkest corners of each dungeon, but found nothing.
King Tibianus III is our wise and just leader!
He was one of the king's best generals, now he is a bit ...uhm... forgetful.
The royal jester. I dont think he is funny.
This man is paranoid, but I guess that is useful in his job.
An old friend of mine. He was once a great warrior and adventurer, now he is running a shop.
He is soldier in the silver guard.
He is a fine blacksmith. Almost all our weapons are made by him.
He is soldier in the silver guard.
He was wanted for a long time and got caught stealing some time ago.
What has this to do with this Partos guy?
Our brave army, which protects our city, consists of three battlegroups.
There are the dogs of war, the red guards, and the silver guards.
They are our main army.
They are our special forces. Some serve as cityguards, others as secret police.
The best sorcerers, paladins, knights, or druids of our forces are choosen to serve as silver guards. They are the bodyguards of the king.
We've got a rat problem in the sewers. In the name of our glorious king, I'm paying 1 blinking piece of gold for every freshly killed rat you bring me. ...
You seem strong! Do you want to help fighting the orcs? They prepare themselves for war! We need everyone who's capable of killing greenskins! Ask me about the orc war if you are interested.
I have already told you about your mission! Haven't you wrote down everything in your logbook? Look in there if you need to refresh your memory.
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Baxter

pages.name: Donald McRonald
npc_lines: Hmmm, well, hello Jogador. What brings you here?
I run a farm, what else?!
Donald McRonald.
I am Donald.
It is my farm, yes.
Who cares?
Sherry is my wife.
Weather is good enough to work on the fields.
It is hard to grow but worth the effort.
My fields are enchanted by the druids and the wheat grows very quickly.
The city is to the north.
I sometimes have to bring the wheat there.
I dont know.
I will give you 2 gold for every spider you bring me. But not a rotten spider that was already dead for some time. Do you have any with you?
Of course, just browse through my wares.
I can offer you wheat, cheese, carrots, and corncobs. If you’d like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
King Tibianus is our king.
Frodo? He is a friend of mine.
He ignores us and we ignore him.
A general in the army.
I don’t trust sorcerers like you. (se você for sorcerer)
I don’t trust sorcerers. (se você não for sorcerer)
Too noble to care about us.
Knights always feel superior to us farmers.
Druids are a great help for us, they know much about nature.
Hardly know him.
A blacksmith, eh?
A generous person.
She has a good soul.
He sometimes comes to shop our food.
Yes, bye!
pages.title: Donald McRonald

pages.name: Bambi Bonecrusher
npc_lines: Don't throw your litter on the streets of Carlin!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
It's Miss Bonecrusher to you!
I am healthy and vigilant.
It's my duty to protect our fair city.
Queen Eloise is our beloved sovereign!
Trisha is the leader of our knights guild. It is in the north of the town, near the gate.
Legola runs the local paladins guild, it's near the west gate.
Padreia is the greatest druid of the continent. You find the guild of the benevolent druids in the southwest of the city.
Lea is the head of the local sorcerers guild. You can find it south of the town centre at the magic shop of Rachel.
Rachel sells equipment for all magic users in her shop. There is also the sorcerer guild on the second floor.
Sarina is our provisioner. You can find her in the town centre, south of the weapon shops.
Dane runs the local tavern and hotel. You can find it at the southwest beach of Carlin.
Liane is a kind person. She runs the post office in the town centre.
My sister is in charge of our mighty army. If you want to talk to her, call her 'general' or she may be a little choleric.
We are Bonecrushers. Mess with one of us, and we all will come for you!
Fine warrioress, even if not of our family.
There once was an adventurer with this name in town, made some trouble, got kicked out. No big deal.
The bonecrusher family has been serving in the army of Carlin for generations. My sister Bunny is the general of our army.
The castle is in the northwest corner of the city.
In theory the ghostlands are off limits. But we don't enforce that. Anyone stupid enough to go there will meet his deserved fate.
Stay away from the graveyard, it's haunted!
Behave well while in the city, or we'll get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?
There's a smith, a provisioner, a tavern, a magic shop, and the royal post office, of course.
In the city you will find the guild houses of the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
You can find the weapon and armour shops just west of the town centre.
I am a guard and proud of it.
Of course, we guards are members of the army.
Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
WOOF! WOOF! Go away with these puny king's puppies.
Brave warriors, indeed.
Strange things happen in our graveyard, and sometimes there are ... noises.
I never heard them myself, but people one can trust did.
We will get rid of all scum.
Bah! Who cares about males? Let them do males' work, cleaning the sewers for example.
Sewers are filthy and disgusting. We let the men take care of them.
What a joke. The men have no guts for a rebellion.
Ask a higher official about that.
We have some depots in our town. You can't miss them.
Visit Carlin's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
Take this!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
pages.title: Bambi Bonecrusher

pages.name: Barbara
npc_lines: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! Address the queen with her title!
HAIL TO THE QUEEN!
Take this!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
pages.title: Barbara

pages.name: Bunny Bonecrusher
npc_lines: Address me with my title, commoner Bacca Chewie!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
We are in constant training and in perfect health.
I am the general of the queen's army. I don't have time to explain this concept to you.
HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE, OUR NOBLE LEADER!
Queen Eloise is a fine leader for our fair town, indeed!
I worship Banor, the first warrior!
He is the idol for all fighting women and a reminder of what a man could become if he jumps over his own shadow!
Join what?
Sorry, we don't recruit foreigners. Maybe you can join if you prove yourself in a mission for the queen.
Yeah. Entrusting a male with an important quest. Get serious!
Rowenna is responsible for our troops' supply of weapons.
She is a distant cousin of me and my sisters.
Cornelia forges the armor for our troops.
Believe it or not, I killed him two times with my own bow, but some unholy forces rise him again and again.
She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard.
She is one of the Green Ferrets and one of the queen's bodyguards.
Don't mention the dark one in the city of life!
Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
The castle was not built for defence but as a residence for the royal family.
Bah! Just men's tales! Who believes in such rubbish? Perhaps we should put some men there overnight and see what happens. Hehehe!
We cleared the woods around Carlin of most monsters. But lately, more and more show up again.
I'm sure only a woman has the courage and strength to wield this weapon of myth.
The army protects the defenceless males of our city. Our elite forces are the Green Ferrets.
Our reports are only for internal use.
They are rumoured to be skilled fighters. Then again, in the land of the blind...
Our elite forces are trained by rangers and druids. In the woods they come a close second to elves.
Our city blends in with the nature surrounding it. Our druids take care of that.
This is a men's club, mainly busy with bragging and drinking alcohol.
Our citizens are lucky to live under the wise rule of our beloved queen!
K.I.S.S.! Keep It Simple, Stupid! Complicated tactics are too easy to be crushed by a twist of fate.
Old man. I can't tell what's worse for the shape of Thais' army.
They are our main magic support and play a major role in our battle tactics.
Our tactic is to kiss.
It's just a rotten hideout for drunks and men too lazy to do some serious work.
Are you suggesting I am corruptible?
Take this!
You should be careful with your words!
Take this!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
pages.title: Bunny Bonecrusher

pages.name: Busty Bonecrusher
npc_lines: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
It's Miss Bonecrusher to you!
I am healthy and vigilant.
It's my duty to protect our fair city.
Queen Eloise is our beloved sovereign!
Trisha is the leader of our knights guild. It is in the north of the town, near the gate.
Legola runs the local paladins guild, it's near the west gate.
Padreia is the greatest druid of the continent. You find the guild of the benevolent druids in the southwest of the city.
Lea is the head of the local sorcerers guild. You can find it south of the town centre at the magic shop of Rachel.
Rachel sells equipment for all magic users in her shop. There is also the sorcerer guild on the second floor.
Sarina is our provisioner. You can find her in the town centre, south of the weapon shops.
Dane runs the local tavern and hotel. You can find it at the southwest beach of Carlin.
Liane is a kind person. She runs the post office in the town centre.
My sister is in charge of our mighty army. If you want to talk to her, call her 'general' or she may be a little choleric.
We are Bonecrushers. Mess with one of us, and we all will come for you!
Fine warrioress, even if not of our family.
There once was an adventurer with this name in town, made some trouble, got kicked out. No big deal.
The bonecrusher family has been serving in the army of Carlin for generations. My sister Bunny is the general of our army.
The castle is in the northwest corner of the city.
In theory the ghostlands are off limits. But we don't enforce that. Anyone stupid enough to go there will meet his deserved fate.
Stay away from the graveyard, it's haunted!
Behave well while in the city, or we'll get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?
There's a smith, a provisioner, a tavern, a magic shop, and the royal post office, of course.
In the city you will find the guild houses of the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
You can find the weapon and armour shops just west of the town centre.
I am a guard and proud of it.
Of course, we guards are members of the army.
Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
WOOF! WOOF! Go away with these puny king's puppies.
Brave warriors, indeed.
Strange things happen in our graveyard, and sometimes there are ... noises.
I never heard them myself, but people one can trust did.
We will get rid of all scum.
Bah! Who cares about males? Let them do males' work, cleaning the sewers for example.
Sewers are filthy and disgusting. We let the men take care of them.
What a joke. The men have no guts for a rebellion.
Ask a higher official about that.
We have some depots in our town. You can't miss them.
Visit Carlin's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
Take this!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
pages.title: Busty Bonecrusher

pages.name: Captain Greyhound
npc_lines: Passages to Thais, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Svargrond, Yalahar and Edron.
Welcome on board, Sir/Madam Jogador. Where can I sail you today?
My name is Captain Greyhound from the Royal Tibia Line.
I'm the captain of this sailing ship.
Where do you want to go? To Thais, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Svargrond, Yalahar or Edron? Or to Travora - a place between the worlds?
Do you seek a passage to cidade for valor gold?
Travora is the place for the character world transfer, so if you travel there make sure you actually do want to change worlds. Do you want to purchase a new daily ticket for 1000 gold?
This is Carlin. Where do you want to go?
The Royal Tibia Line connects all seaside towns of Tibia.
I'm sorry, but we don't serve the routes to Senja, Folda or Vega. I could bring you to Svargrond, though.
I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghost ship! However, I heard that Captain Fearless sails there from Venore.
Many people who sailed to Darashia never returned because they were attacked by a ghost ship! I'd never sail there!
We can transport everything you want.
We would like to welcome you on board.
Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
pages.title: Captain Greyhound

pages.name: Cerdras
npc_lines: What a lovely flower!
Ah! The beauty of nature!
Greetings, my friend! Is there anything I can do for you!
I am Cerdras of the Carlinian Druid Guild.
I’m merely a humble druid like so many others here. I may not be the most talented of healers, but I am gifted with a special attunement to the elements.
How can I explain my connection to the elements so that you can understand it? Hmmm, it is like a faint melody, a song, that is always there. …
I hear that melody shifting in time with the shifts in the elements. With so many years of listening, I have learned to interpret these shifts and so come to a deeper understanding of the elements. …
It was a natural step for me to become responsible for researching elemental lore. I try to learn as much as I can and share it with my fellow druids. …
Unfortunately, much of my understanding is instinctive, and our language just doesn’t contain the right words for me to adequately express the things I feel.
It is hard to explain. Of course, it’s not a real song as you would understand it. I don’t hear it with my ears, but rather, I feel it deep inside of me. …
Calling it a song or melody is the best I can do to describe it to those who don’t share this kind of perception. …
It also helps me to express and understand something for which our language has no appropriate expression. …
You know, we are so dependent on words that we can’t think about concepts when we don’t have words for them. …
I sometimes think words have become just as much of a hindrance as a help. …
Perhaps we would fare better if only we forgot words and dealt purely in feelings. Then perhaps all of us could hear the wonderful melody of nature.
For me, nature is the harmony of the elements. This harmony can be disturbed by certain events, but nature always finds its way back to harmony in the end.
<sigh> Druids are supposed to be healers and preservers of nature. And what have most of us become? Hunters and killers who are only interested in furthering their own cause.
The song of earth is always with me. As is the song of air. Both are often in some kind of harmony and sometimes it is hard to separate the one from the other. …
If I concentrate hard enough I can distinguish the many individual songs that make the melody. …
Each boulder, each stone, each grain of sand has its own voice in the symphony of the great melody.
I have heard little of the Yalahari. And the little that I know does not tempt me to learn more.
The city sounds like a urban nightmare to me.
The city has forgotten its original and true raison d’être. Harmony with our world has ceased to be important and slowly but surely Carlin’s people are losing their ability to empathise with nature.
The hunt can be part of the cycle of life and death. Nowadays that cycle has been broken. People take more than they give and greed dictates their actions.
Crunor has not forsaken us despite our failings. Crunor’s love for life is truly great.
I have indeed gathered some knowledge in the field of elemental golems. Particularly the secrets of the Earth element, which is involved in the process of their creation.
Ah, yes, dear Telas. It is a pity that he has closed his eyes to nature’s beauty, but I can’t reproach him for that.
Good bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Cerdras

pages.name: Alia
npc_lines: Welcome Jogador! Welcome to the temple of Carlin. If you need healing, I can help you.
I'm a nun, serving the gods of Tibia in this temple. I also heal wounded adventurers.
They created Tibia and all life on it.
That's where we are. Tibia is our world.
Crunor is one of the favoured gods in our city, especially the druids venerate him.
You do not need any healing right now.
Carlin is a place of peace and prosperity thanks to the guidance of our beloved queen.
Thais is a rough city with rough habits. It's a pity they don't learn from us.
The Venoreans are quite aggressive. They show only little interest in the teachings of the gods. Most people there only worship money.
My name is Alia.
Now, it is 0:00 pm. You should consider buying a watch.
The Zathroth cult is forbidden in our city.
The dwarfs are a strange race. Despite their odd religion and their somewhat rude manners, they are brave and honest people.
The nature-loving elves like to exchange knowledge with our druids. Still, it troubles me that they don't acknowledge the true gods.
Don't mention this name here.
Sorry, I can't help you with that.
Uh, don't ask. That's a place even the brave women of Carlin don't dare to explore!!!
May the gods be with you, Jogador!
pages.title: Alia

pages.name: Dalbrect
npc_lines: Be greeted, traveler. Welcome to my hut.
I am merely a humble fisher now that nothing is left of my noble legacy.
Once my family was once noble and wealthy, but fate turned against us and threw us into poverty.
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, my ancestors put their fortune in that project.
Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
What? You want me to examine a brooch?
Then stop being a fool. I am poor and I have to work the whole day through!
My name is Dalbrect Windtrouser, of the once proud windtrouser family.
To think my family used to belong to the local nobility! And now those arrogant women are in charge!
I have only sailed to the isle of the kings once or twice. I dare not anger the monks by bringing travellers there without their permission.
Good bye. You are welcome.
pages.title: Dalbrect

pages.name: Fenbala
npc_lines: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! Address the queen with her title!
HAIL TO THE QUEEN!
Take this!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
pages.title: Fenbala

pages.name: Lea
npc_lines: Greetings, Jogador.
I am the archsorcerer of Carlin. I keep the secrets of our order.
My name is Lea.
Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers.
Time is a force we sorcerers will master one day.
Any sorcerer dedicates his whole life to the study of the arcane arts.
We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
Take care on your journeys.
pages.title: Lea

pages.name: Padreia
npc_lines: Welcome to our humble guild, wanderer. May I be of any assistance to you?
I am the grand druid of Carlin. I am responsible for the guild, the fields, and our citizens' health.
Every druid is able to learn the numerous spells of our craft.
Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.
I am Padreia, grand druid of our fine city.
Time is just a crystal pillar - the centre of creation and life.
We are druids, preservers of life. Our magic is about defence, healing, and nature.
Sorcerers are destructive. Their power lies in destruction and pain.
Farewell.
pages.title: Padreia

pages.name: Hoaxette
npc_lines: Hiddeliho my friend Jogador!
I'm here to enrich your life and to sell little trinkets of fun and joy. Just ask about my goods if you like to learn more.
I sell special spellwands, pillows and presents that have ... funny effects. Where would be the fun if I told everything you about it? Ask me for a trade!
Have fun with all my ... funny stuff.
I'm the lovely, inimitable, and hilarious Hoaxette. I'll stay here for the whole month before I leave this country again.
Oh! <giggles> Have you found all six parts of a jester doll and would like me to assemble them?
I'm here to enrich your life and to sell little trinkets of fun and joy. Just ask about my goods if you like to learn more.
If it were up to me, the whole year would be prank time!
A prank in the morning and the day won't be boring <giggles>. I offer funny items for this purpose. Let me know if you are interested in my offers.
I'd love to play a prank on the king if he showed up here. <giggles>
I'm not specialised in telling jokes - I'm offering ITEMS that make people laugh. I can tell you something about my offers if you are interested.
I sell special spellwands, pillows and presents that have ... funny effects. Where would be the fun if I told everything you about it? Ask me for a trade!
See you, Jogador! Have fun playing pranks on your friends!
pages.title: Hoaxette

pages.name: Al Dee
npc_lines: Hello, hello, Jogador! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of tools. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers! You can also ask me for general hints about the game. ...
You can also ask me about each citizen of the isle.
I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
As an adventurer, you should always have at least a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield.
Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
Take a look in the trade window to your right.
Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit!
I am a merchant. What can I do for you?
Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's Obi's or Lee'Delle's business. I could offer you a pick in exchange for a small axe if you should happen to own one.
Armor and shields can be bought at Dixi's or at Lee'Delle's. Dixi runs that shop near Obi's.<br
Hmm, the best address to look for food might be Willie or Billy. Norma also has some snacks for sale.
Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit Lily for that.
I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a trade.
I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
No thanks. I don't like fish.
No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
I have enough worms myself and don't want any more. Use them for fishing.
You better put that bone back there where you dug it out.
If you need general equipment, just ask me for a trade. I can also provide you with some general hints about the game.
I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a trade?
It's about 0:00 am. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.
Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
Well, then don't.
Sorry, I am looking for a SMALL axe.
Splendid! Here, take your pick.
If you want to explore the dungeons such as the sewers, you have to equip yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's vital in the deepest sense of the word.
Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by rats. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a trade to see it!
Well, vital means - necessary for you to survive!
Rats plague our sewers. You can sell fresh rat corpses to Seymour or Tom the tanner.
If you want to challenge monsters in the dungeons, you need some weapons and armor from the local merchants.
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a trade. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
On the island of Rookgaard you can gather important experiences to prepare yourself for mainland.

Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the oracle. You can choose a profession afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the Island of Destiny.
The Island of Destiny can be reached via the oracle once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your profession!
Thais is a crowded town.
The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a bank and the room of the oracle. Seymour is the teacher there.
A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my wares!
The monk Cipfried takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
She's currently recovering from her travels in the academy. It's always nice to chat with her!
This is a local farmer. If you need fresh food to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers though.
He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
ome call him a hero. He protects the town from monsters.
She's Obi's granddaughter and deals with armors and shields. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
She sells health potions and antidote potions. Also, she buys blueberries and cookies in case you find any.
No idea who that is.
She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
He sells weapons. His shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
He's the local bank clerk.
He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
Seymour is a teacher running the academy. He has many important information about Tibia.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
This is a local farmer. If you need fresh food to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick blueberries.
Some call him a hero. He protects the town from monsters.
Poor old woman, her son Tom never visits her.
Bye, bye Jogador.
pages.title: Al Dee

pages.name: Phillip
npc_lines: Did the bell ring?
Go and be careful. Remember what you have learned!
I am fine, thank you very much.
My business is knowlegde and it is for free.
I am honored to be teacher in this school.
I run this school, there are other travelling teachers who we call Loremasters.
If you are lucky you'll meet one in your journeys.
My name is Phillip.
It is 12:14 am.
I will provide you with all knowledge I have.
Monsters come in different shape and power. It's said there is a zoo in the dwarfs' town.
Dungeons are places of danger and puzzles. In some of them a bright mind will serve you more then a blade.
You don't have to thank me, it's only my duty.
To learn about gods, visit the temples and talk to the priests.
The southern king is called Tibianus. He and our queen Eloise are in a constant struggle.
I don't like rumours.
To learn about weapons read appropriate books or talk to the smiths.
To learn about magic talk to the guild leaders.
Rebellion? What for? We are contend with our situation.
Tod will come and save us all. He will bring freedom and beer to the men of Carlin.
This servant of evil is protected by the dark gods and can't be harmed.
He is a follower of evil. His powers were boosted by a sinister force and he is beyond human restrictions now.
This weapon is said to be very powerful and unique. It was hidden in ancient times and now is thought to be lost.
pages.title: Phillip

pages.name: Shauna
npc_lines: Howdy, Jogador!
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
No news are good news.
HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE!
What do you think? I am the sheriff of Carlin.
Just fine.
Would you like to buy the general key to the town?
Yeah, I bet you'd like to do that! HO, HO, HO!
If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but dont waste my time.
The castle is one of the safest places in Carlin.
Our people are fine and peaceful.
I bet they spy on us... not my business, however.
I scared this bigmouth so much that he left the town by night. HO, HO, HO!
The city is is a peacful place, and it's up to me to keep it this way.
He is the guy responsible to keep the sewers working. Someone has to do such kind of jobs. I can't handle all the garbage of the city myself.
Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
She has the sharpest eye in the region, I'd say.
Her peacefulness is sometimes near stupidity.
I worship Banor of course.
For me, he's the god of justice.
His cult is forbidden in our town.
Wouldn't wonder if some males worship him secretly. HO, HO, HO!
I deal more with the human mosters, you know? HO, HO, HO!
Would certainly make a good butterknife. HO, HO, HO!
