The only thing that rebels here now and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!
For obvious reasons it's forbidden in our city.
Oh, there's a waterpipe in one of my cells? ...
I guess my last prisoner forgot it there.
my last prisoner? hmm. ...
I think he was some guy from darama. can't remember his name. ...
He was here just for one night, because he got drunk and annoyed our citizens. ...
Obviously he wasn't pleased with this place, because he headed for thais the next day. ...
Something tells me that he won't stay out of trouble for too long.
Take this!
pages.title: Shauna

pages.name: Tibra
npc_lines: Welcome: in the name of the gods, pilgrim Jogador!
I am a priest of the great pantheon.
The teachings of Crunor tell us to honor life and not to harm it.
It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are Jogador.
Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of Crunor.
The grace of the gods must be earned, it cannot be bought!
The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
Now, it is 11:51 pm.
There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for help if not the gods?
You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I need my powers for cases more severe than yours.
Remind: Not everything you call monster is evil to the core!
The mythical blade was hidden in ancient times. Its said that powerful wards protect it.
The fallen one should be mourned, not feared.
Only a man can fall as low as he did. His soul rotted away already.
Do you wish to confess your sins, my child?
So tell me, what shadows your soul, my child.
Meditate on that and pray for your soul.
Do you want to make a donation?
May the gods bless you!
The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Fardos is the creator. The great obsever. He is our caretaker.
Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.
Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
Toth, Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
The gods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deciver and the thief of souls.
Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
I dont want to talk about that subject!
Good bye, Jogador. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
pages.title: Tibra

pages.name: A Wrinkled Bonelord
npc_lines: What is this? An optically challenged entity called Jogador. How fascinating!
Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
I am the great librarian.
It's a fine library, isn't it?
I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
It's 1, not 'Tibia', silly.
Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
Only inferior species need weapons.
I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
Noisy pests.
Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
What's this? An optically challenged entity called Jogador. How fascinating!
It's 1, not 'Tibia', silly.
They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
Yes, yes, I'll kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigations about you.
It's a fine library, isn't it? All this knowledge! All those books!
Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
Our language is beyond comprehension by your lesser beings. It heavily relies on mathemagic ...
Your brain is not suited for the mathemagical processing necessary to understand our language ...
To decipher even our most basic texts, it would need a genius that can calculate numbers within seconds in his brain.
The world is full of inferior species. Once, our race ruled the whole world, but then the gods destroyed our empire ...
But our race is proficient in the return from death. One day we will rise again, that's for sure!
Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics, you are a master over life and death.
I'm 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died. So don't ... confuse your numbers, as my kind says.
I'm the great librarian of this library of a once great city.
So much knowledge was lost in the great wars when we had to retreat to hidden places beneath the surface ...
Most of our data storages are lost and so are the means to read or recreate some of them ...
We had to use the primitive storage form of books to recreate some of the lost knowledge. In the past, we used far more advanced forms of storage ...
Such as bound spirits but also means your puny brain would never be able to comprehend.
This city is nothing but a pale shadow compared to the cities of the past. Our race was forced to retreat to such insignificant underground outposts after the wars.
Our race has fought many wars in the past and has won most of them. Sometimes, though, it takes only one loss to bring a race down ...
All the more if the gods you are fighting for, turn out to be traitors.
Ugliness incarnated. Only one eye! Imagine that! How horrible!
These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
Only inferior species need weapons.
I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
Noisy pests.
Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer than they know and closer than it's good for them.
Good tools to work with ... once they are dead, that is.
Interesting how foolish you are. Take this and see how long you'll last.
Our race is very old. Over the time, we have been given many different names by other races ...
The term bonelord sticks to us for quite a while now ...
In our language the name of our race is not fixed but a complex formula, and as such it always changes for the subjective viewer.
Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
Wait right there. I'll eat you right after writing down what I found out.
pages.title: A Wrinkled Bonelord

pages.name: Amber
npc_lines: Oh hello, nice to see you Jogador.
I'm recovering from a sea passage.
I'm an explorer who seeks adventures.
I fought fierce monsters, climbed the highest mountains, explored the deepest dungeons and crossed the sea on a raft.
My voyage on the sea was exhausting. The weather was bad, the waves high and my raft quite simple. There's a certain excitement to it, though.
I've been almost everywhere in Tibia.
I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
Sorry, I lost my watch in a storm.
I had no time to explore the dungeons of this isle yet, but I've seen two big caves in the East, and there is a ruined tower to the north-west. Oh, and there're the sewers.
I like sewers. I made my very first battle experience in the sewers below Thais. The small sewer system of Rookgaard has some nasty rats to fight.
King Tibianus is the ruler of Thais. The island of Rookgaard belongs to his kingdom.
It's a nice little island on which you can learn how to fight. I can see it in your eyes - you want to become a famous adventurer and explorer just like me!
A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the king.
Well, I can give you general hints or tell you about my adventures and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small quest for you.
You will find your destiny. I'm sure it's something big and important.
A fine city, but the king has some problems enforcing the law.
You'll be surprised once you leave this island. The world outside there is gigantic.
If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvellous castle there.
Spells are only taught in the guildhalls of the mainland.
The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks, compared with the weapons warriors of the mainland wield.
Oh, I fought orcs, cyclopses, minotaurs, even dragons, and many other creatures.
Not the nicest guys you can encounter. I had some clashes with them and finally ended up being their prisoner for a few months.
I don't like the way they look at you. Their eye seems to pierce right through you. Creepy!
They are nasty monsters, particularly as they have distance fighters and mages in their clans. My backpack is handmade from minotaur leather.
Their breath is so hot! I had to cut my hair after my last encounter with a dragon because the ends were all burnt. That's what you gotta deal with as a female adventurer!
I wouldn't want to miss being a premium adventurer. Everything is so much easier!
I have almost no money with me anyway, so no need to deposit any at the bank.
I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like 'yes' and 'no'.
It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some food.
In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some food.
My favourite dish is salmon. Oh please, bring me some.
Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
Ok, then I won't tell you another Orcish word.
You don't have any salmon!
The most important tools you need are a rope, a shovel and maybe a torch.
One day I fell into a hole without having a rope. I was yelling for help for three whole days! Eventually a fisherman passed by and pulled me out with his own rope, lucky me.
Sometimes I have the strong urge to use it to knock someone out.
You know, on mainland you will be able to cast magic spells which provide you with light. You won't really need torches anymore.
The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks compared with the weapons warriors wield on the mainland.
I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private notebook on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
Do you bring me my notebook?
Too bad.
Mhm, whatever you have there, it is not my notebook.
I don't have much to say about him. I think he sells tools.
Did you know my name is also the name of a gem?
He brought me some of his famous rat stew. I really didn't want to insult him, but I simply can't eat something like that. So I told him I'm a vegetarian and I only eat fish. <gulps>
A gentle person. You should visit him if you have questions or need healing.
An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defence of Rookgaard.
I don't really know her, but she seems to be a nice girl.
Hyacinth is a great healer. He lives somewhere hidden on this isle.
Hm, I think I haven't met her yet.
Never seen him around.
She has changed a lot since I last saw her.
He's a funny little man.
No, I didn't go to the bank yet.
He promised to repair my raft.
I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the academy.
The oracle is said to show you your destiny once you are level 8.
To me he seems a bit rude, but maybe that's just my impression.
He's funny in his own way.
An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defence of Rookgaard.
She seriously asked me if she could have the remains of my raft as fire wood! Can you imagine that??
See you later, Jogador.
pages.title: Amber

pages.name: King Tibianus
npc_lines: I greet thee, my loyal subject.
Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
Honor the gods and pay your taxes.
I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III, and its my duty to provide justice and guidance for my subjects.
I am the king, so mind your words!
It's hard to believe that you don't know your own king!
I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again and then reward them appropriately.
Sell? Sell what? My kingdom isn't for sale!
This organisation is important in holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
It's a time for heroes, that's for sure!
The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
Rain Castle is my home.
Dungeons are no places for kings.
We need the druidic healing powers to fight evil.
The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
It's a time for heroes, that's for sure!
Go and hunt them! For king and country!
It's the sword of the kings. If you could return this weapon to me I would reward you beyond your dreams.
He is a follower of the evil god Zathroth and responsible for many attacks on us. Kill him on sight!
We need order to survive!
Please ask a priest about the gods.
They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses, and a modern sytem of sewers.
What a disgusting topic!
Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
Ask around about them.
Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious army.
Ask the soldiers about that topic.
We need all strength we can muster to smite evil!
Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
He has been lazy lately. I bet you have not payed any taxes at all.
Well, if you want a reward, go on a quest to bring me Excalibug!
He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile but we entrusted him with work for the Royal Tibia Mail.
He is my royal jester and cheers me up now and then.
A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.
He was once one of Tibia's greatest fighters. Now he is selling equipment.
The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
He is a skilled blacksmith and a loyal subject.

As a young prince I have heard high tales of the Order of the Falcon. It was a topic in history lessons as well. As far as I know, their significance faded after a dispute with my father King Xenom. ...
Their stronghold to the north is still largely intact and we left it alone for the most part. People tend to avoid it as the Order's disappearance was never truly solved.
Good bye, Jogador!
pages.title: King Tibianus

pages.name: Partos
npc_lines: Welcome to my little kingdom, Jogador.
My name is Partos, but you can call me Party.
Guess it! I’ll give you a hint: I am not in this cell to clean it up! …
I wish I had never left Ankrahmun…
Yes, I’ve lived in Ankrahmun for quite some time. Ahh, the good old times! …
Unfortunately I had to relocate. <sigh> …
Business reasons – you know.
Geee, someone stole my watch. Bad company down here.
I am great! Free food, free room, and now and then someone coming down here to ask me silly questions. Wouldn’t you love that, too?
I won’t talk about that.
Bah, the king’s pawns. I spit on them.
Gold got me in here. But I’d offer you some gold for keys.
I love the city. I just wish I could see some other part of it now and then.
You mean this is a JAIL? They told me it’s the finest hotel in town! THAT explains the lousy room service!
Rich enough to spare a little, don’t you agree? Well, they didn’t agree.
I sort of collect them. Broken key rings, that is. You never know. If you wanna trade, you know where to find me.
Bah, I did nothing serious. I just had a little fun. In Ankrahmun nobody would have cared about these kind of things…
Hey, most people I killed were even worse than me.
I bet one could get some fine ransom, if he dognaps this furball.
I would like to sell you a secret, but I’m out of business for too long.
At least I am safe from them down here.
I hardly hear any news down here.
By the gods, he visits us ‘criminals’ now and then to ‘save’ us. Who is going to save me from this boredom on two legs?
I collect broken key rings. Just an old habit of mine.
Yeah! Come in and let’s have a party.
Yeah, a king is a man that can rob people by law, and not by night like me.
The gods seldom show up down here, so don’t ask me.
Yeah sure, I go out with him all the time… NOT.
Good bye, visit me again, Jogador. I will be here, promised.
pages.title: Partos

pages.name: Todd
npc_lines: Uhm oh hello... not so loud please... my head...
I am... a traveler.
My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is Hugo.
Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.
Yes, that's my name of course.
I love that city.
I never was there. Now leave me alone.
Uhm, never heard about him... and you can't prove otherwise.
I don't know anything about money, missing or not.
Resistance is futile... uhm... I wonder where I picked that saying up. Oh my head...
Uhhh ohhhh one of the beers yesterday must have been bad.
I am a honest person and don't like to be insulted!
Thats a common name, perhaps I met a William, not sure about that.
He often comes here. But his constant confusion gives me a worse headache than Frodo's beer. I rather avoid him.
I'd really like to rebuild my reputation someday and maybe find a nice girl. If you come across scrolls of heroic deeds or addresses of lovely maidens... let me know! ...
Oh no, it doesn't matter what name is on the scrolls. I'm, uhm... flexible! And money - yes, I can pay. My, erm... uncle died recently and left me a pretty sum. Yes.
Oh, this headache, one of the beers Frodo served me must have been foul.
Yes, goodbye Jogador, just leave me alone.
pages.title: Todd

pages.name: Wally
npc_lines: Be greeted, traveller.
I am working here at the post office for Kevin.
Oh, our boss is upstairs. Better only disturb him with important issues though.
Ask Mr. Postner about your current missions.
I'm Wally the post officer.
Yes, thats me, Wally!
Elven volunteers for becoming a postofficer are quite rare. We had to rely on a human living there to ensure our postsystems function. Most elvish members of the guild prefer to work as courriers.
I gues Edron isn't the source of wealth and rescources as the thaians hoped. The defection of those knights did cause the expansion and exploitation there to an halt.
The city of the dwarfs is a bit hidden and new postoficers often get lost while looking for it. Just look for a hidden passage to a western valley in the mountaion called the big old one.
Its a huge Mountain, north of here, just across the river.
One of the oldest holdings of humanity that still exist and the heart of the biggest kingdom in the known world.
I think no longer is king Tibianus reigning this city, nor are the merchants ruling it, regardless what they might think. The true monarch before whom all there bow is the money.
If I would be looking for bones I'd inspect some skeletons ... If I weren't so affraid of them that is.
This minotaur is quite moody. Better make sure not to anger him. He's likely to call for his guards as soon as he notices a stranger, so you are on tough luck if you ever find him.
This dog is his majestys most priced possesion and heavily guarded. Anger the dog and you anger the king.
Old Ben lost some of his marbles in some battle long ago. He is still a quite capable postman though ... on second thought thats some disturbing fact.
Dove is as good as a dozend pigeons. He He He.
Although I never met her in person we became penpals over the time.
Dwarfs make quite good postmen. They are stubborn, strong and ... sturdy. Its a waste that he prefers a job behind the counter.

This Olrik was made postman only for convenience. He is quite aware that his attitude and affiliation with the thaian government makes it impossible for him to rise in rank. This leads only to him behaving even worse tough.
Waldo is an explorer. We always feared he might one day take a risk too great for him. I hope he is okay, though.
It was a pleasure to help you.
pages.title: Wally

pages.name: Ulrik
npc_lines: Weapons and armors for young knights. Come have a look.
Hello Jogador. If you need weapons or armor, ask me for a trade.
My name is Ulrik.
I am a smith. Do you need anything I make?
It is horas.
We live too far away from Thais to hear anything that truly is 'new'.
Sorry, I have no clue how to help you.
You are welcome.
What can a simple man as me say about a king?
Oh, I only heard frightening tales about him.
Every now and then an adventurer like you comes here looking for it.
Most monsters live far away, so you can feel safe here in Greenshore.
They say north of Thais is a deep dungeon.
Good bye for now, Jogador.
pages.title: Ulrik

pages.name: Tokel
npc_lines: Are you hungry? I offer bread, cheese, ham and meat. Perfect for a little snack.
Hi there, Jogador. You look quite hungry, maybe you should buy some food.
My name is Tokel.
I am a farmer, and proud of it.
I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I am fine, thank you.
I pray to Crunor to bless our harvests.
I wish I'd be as rich as him.
I know nothing but about such stuff.
I know nothing but about such stuff.
I know nothing but about such stuff.
Here are no dungeons as far as I know.
It's relatively peaceful here.
The soil is a bit dry and there are a lot of stones. It's very hard to work this soil.
I have not seen much of it yet. I am thinking about moving to Edron soon.
They say life is easy there, the soil is rich, the city save. One day I might move there.
The city is too lousy and crowded for my taste.
Oh, now that you mention it: I have much left to do, please excuse me.
Bye.
pages.title: Tokel

pages.name: A Frog
npc_lines: Hi, Jogador.
Sure, we can talk in that language too. Rrrribbit.
You’re his assistant now? Ha ha. Ribbit.
An overrated life form. Rrrrreally. Ribbit.
Who needs magic when you can be a frog? Ribbit!
I’ve grown quite fond of the old chap. Or then again, no I haven’t, really. All that anger can get on your nerves. Ribbit.
Ah, I don’t care about him anymore. Ribbit. Live and let live, that’s my motto.
Yeah! Ribbit all the way!
I love being a frog! Rrrribbit! Especially now! I just need to find me a frog girl and all will be well.
What do I need a job for? I’m a happy frog! Ribbit! Hehehehe!
Well… ribbit… my name is Turian. But that doesn’t really matter anymore. Frog will do.
Farewell, Jogador. Ribbit.
pages.title: A Frog

pages.name: Bozo
npc_lines: Sell? Hmm, I know a little about magic and by chance I can sell you a truly unusual weapon.
Do you want to buy a 'mace of the fury' for 250 gold?
And here it is, it suits you well!
I am the royal jes ... uhm ... the royal tax-collector! Do you want to pay your taxes?
Thank you very much. I will have a drink or two on your health! (if you have money he takes 50gp)
Come back, when you have enough money. (if you don't have money)
I actually know some spells! Do you want to learn how to 'lessen your load' for 200 gold?
Here you are, I already lessened your load.
Do you wish to join the fools' guild?
Sorry, you already are a member.
Do you wish to become a jester and join the fools guild?'
So you want to make a total fool of yourself? Fine with me, but note that becoming a real fool means moe than being just an ordinary fool ...
'You will have to master a whole series of challenging, lengthy and, above all, totally foolish quests ...'
Are you sure you want to waste a part of your limited lifetime on a quest that makes a fool of yourself and which might award you with the prestigious title of a grand fool in a far away future?
What a foolish decision! You are indeed a worthy candidate! But let's talk about business ...
Being a jester is not just about telling jokes. A 'good jester heavily relies on requisites ...
Getting some requisites will be your first job. First of all we need a good supply of water squirt flowers ...
I'm making them on my own in my spare time but I need the right material. South of Thais, next to the Whiteflower Temple, you will find the ideal flowers ...
Take a kitchen knife, cut the thickest and healthiest flower and bring it here. Then talk to me about your mission.
Wow, your stupidity would be pride and joy for every fool. You've already applied as a member. Let's rather talk about your current mission.'
If you are in Druidville, do as the rabbits do.
Did you notice that old knights have their scars just on their backs?
They are the king's favourites, because they know how to 'bow'.
The good thing about them is that they can't be at two places at the same time.
I wanted to become a your vocation here, too, but I was overqualified!
Hello, hello, hello, little lady your name here!
Has any man said to you that you're not only beautiful but also intelligent?
Well, think about it!
This is a world of fantasy and full of surprises!
Hi there, how's it hanging, Jogador!
Well, you don't behave ladylike just because you dress like one!
Why are bonelords so ugly? ... Because their mom and dad were bonelords, too!
How many eyes does a cyclops have? ... One for each IQ point of their opponents!
Why are the experienced heroes quicker than others? ... The demons love fast food!
Are we talking about Noodles?
Why do dragons breathe fire? ... They ate too many sorcerers in chili sauce!
What do all little minotaurs want to become when they are grown-ups? ... Cowboys, of course!
Why do orcs have green skin? ... They ate at Frodo's!
Why does the rat have a wooden leg? ... Because it is a former pirate!
Why do skeletons flee if wounded? ... They are so spineless!
Why did the spider cross the road? ... Because it ... oh you already know this one!?
Why do trolls live underground? ... Because on the ground there are so many PKs!
Why do the wolves howl? ... Hey, if you're online that long you can't help but behave that way!
He would make a fine jester, too.
She's pretty but has a kind of too burning affection for my taste.
Humourless old guy! Once turned me into a frog for painting his distasteful cave in pink.
Better don't mess with sorcerers!
Hey, the little one is almost as funny as me!
If you believe half the rumours he's spreading, you are going to get in a lot of trouble.
He's my baby brother. If you tell him I sent you, he will grant you an extra spell or two.
Did you know that he now sells a 'power axe of doom'? Run and buy it, he has only three in store.
He sells spell scrolls each day at midnight, but you have to address him that very second.
A man of steel, with a stomach of wax. Never offer him a beer!
Isn't he the author of the book 'fun with demons'?
He is kind of a father figure to me. Of course he denies all kinship to me.
He's a smart one. I heared he hid in a foreign country as the first bugs showed up.
I better make no jokes about THIS matter.
Nah, no jests about His Royal Highness.
Since the first guild showed up there's a great demand for jesters and fools to join them.
My name is Bozo. But it's more than a name, it's a lifestyle to me!
Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away!
pages.title: Bozo

pages.name: Chester Kahs
npc_lines: Salutations, stranger.
Are you saying that Gamel is a member of the rebellion?
Do you know what his plans are about?
That is terrible! Will you give me the crystal?
Thank you! Take this ring. If you ever need some healing, come here, bring me the ring and ask me to 'heal' you.
Take care out there!
Salutations, stranger.
I am the head of the TBI.
The Tibian Bureau of Investigation, the secret service of His Royal Highness.
We collect information about people and incidents.
There are things that must be kept secret.
We know much about the citizens and some other people.
I only can give you some official information about our citizens. About whom do you wish to talk?
Certain information is not for the eyes and ears of everyone. Please understand that.
King Tibianus III is our leader and my direct superior.
I report directly to the king himself.
My reports are confidential and for the ears and eyes of the king only.
The castle isn't safe! I warned them of the entrance to the dungeons, but no one is litstening. How many people have to die before they do something about that?
Monsters lurk in each corner of the dungeons, which spread beneath us, breeding in the shadows and plotting to destroy us all.
The city is open to almost everyone. That literally opens doors for all kinds of criminals and fiends.
There are so many murderers and thiefs out there that I wonder if there is some greater force of evil subtly encouraging that.
The people of the northern city, the minotaurs, the followers of Zathroth, the demons, and countless others!
Sorry, almost news that are a little interesting are confidential.
Danger is common like day and night for a Tibian, who keeps his eyes open.
It is said that druids are preservers of life and good aligned, but let me ask you if it's so 'good' to sell runes to the highest bidder, no matter who that might be? I hink you get the point!
It's too easy to become a knight. They take almost everyone. And if you look in the streets you can see what happens if you give training and a flashy title to almost veryone.
They should be noble warriors, but does it take bravery to shoot someone from a certain distance? The former paladins were virtuous heroes, the ones you meet today are just simple treasure hunters.
I don't know where they got their secret spells in the first place, nor did most of them know ... If I were a sorcerer that would be a fact to give me nightmares.
They say there are just two of them in the underground ruins! These damned fools! There are dozens of them! And the two they already saw are only some of the eakest of demonkind!
We have no clue what happened to the civilization that once dwelled underground, but their complete extinction should be a warning to us!
Something happened to him that snapped his mind. Can we be sure what more might have happened to him unnoticed?
He isn't the fool he pretends to be. So to what is he up to?
Have you noticed how easy it would be to poison his supplies and kill a great deal of people with ease?
A man too concerned about profit to be trustworthy. This kind of man sells his soul to the highest bidder. It's just a question if he has done it already or will do it soon.
She puts her trust in the help of beings she can't comprehend. Think by yourself if that's clever.
Have you ever wondered what these caves under their farm are good for? And have you noticed how many adventurers go down there and never return? Well, think about it!
This criminal was wanted for many crimes. At last he got caught and put to jail.
A peaceful man. But in our days peace is just an illusion. We are surrounded by enemies and dangers.
I say it's a mistake to rely on a single person for such vital services.
Some say he's the avatar of Zathroth himself, but perhaps the truth about him is even darker then the worst rumours can imagine.
He is one of the few people I can trust.
He is one of the few people I can trust.
I think we can't trust the guards anymore.
We know little about them. But even that gives me nightmares! But it's your lucky day, since this information is confidential, and so it can't bother you.
Take care out there!
pages.title: Chester Kahs

pages.name: Edowir
npc_lines: Oh, hello Player! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
I gather wisdom and knowledge. I am also an astrologer.
Learn about the gods to learn from the gods.
Kings are children adorned with crowns.
I believe that true love is stronger than all magic, don't you agree?
I am Edowir, but don't worry about remembering my name. I will forget your name as well.
If Tibia is a fallen god, does that makes us the maggots crawling on it?

The legendary banshee queen is incredibly old and likely next to invincible. She's rumoured to have her lair in the deepest caverns of the ghostlands. She seems to be more likely to talk than her sisters, but is certainly even more evil than them.
Time is a pillar and our lives wind around it like vine.
Those who live by the sword get shot by those who don't.
Man or monster, the difference is often just a matter of hides and scales.
A strong wall may protect from an assault, but what will protect you from the enemy within?
Dungeons are a place of danger, not of joy. Keep that in mind on your travels.
The Banshees are creatures that grief and despair turned into vengeful spirits after their death. Their wail is deadly, and they draw new strength from the pain and fear of others.

Cyclopses are seen as the smithes of blog, whom they call 'the ragehammer' or 'ragehammerer'. Indeed their skills create mostly crude and nasty looking weapons and armor which are incredibly effective nontheles.
Brog is the god of rage and fierce battle. He's also the patron of power, although a power to oppress and bully others around. He is the son of Zathroth and one of the Tibian suns.
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
A paladin is more than just a knight armed with a bow and some spells, though most seem to be unaware of that fact.
Knights could be artists, but tend to become sellswords.
Mages claim to be be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?
Mages claim to be be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?
Druids seek enlightenment in nature, but they often just find what they brought with them.
Growing old is mandatory, growing up is optional.

This chalice was a tool of the gods which they created to make their task to create life easier. Zathroth who lacked the knowledge of creation stole that chalice and used it to spawn his evil minions.

Uman is the light twin of Zathroth. Their unity and separation at once is a concept we cannot hope to grasp. He is the patron of light magic, the knowledge that benefits all and brings progress to the society.

Zathroth is the dark twin of Uman. They are one and they are two separate entities. We mortals can't really grasp this concept. He is the patron of dark magic and even darker secrets, the lust for dominance through cunning, and manipulation.
Demons are the servants of evil. More or less devoted servers of Zathroth they cause strife and havoc wherever they appear. Their masters are known as Demonlords, Demon Overlords and Archdemon.

The overlords of the demonkind are more powerful than even demonlords are. They are nearly indestructible. Armoured with layers of impenetrable hide and endowed with awesome magical power, demon overlords are true incarnation of death.

The archdemons are few, and they are extremely rare. And a good thing, too, for they are the rulers of the demonrace. They are vain and powerhungry creatures who tend to form only small cabals and fight each other instead of allying up against creation.
There are at least five demonic cabals of archdemons. The ruthless seven are the most prominent and powerful.
They are more than a myth, they are a horrible reality. It is possible that they still reside in the pits of inferno.
An infernal place in which the nightmare knights created a base to fight the minions of evil. It was lost when the Ruthless Seven conquered it.

The Triangle of Terror is a cabal of three archdemons that have put aside their quarrels to establish some power in the shadows of the Ruthless Seven. Although they are all very mighty demons, compared to one of the seven, they appear weak ...

So they try not to interfere much with the doings of the seven and look for power elsewhere. Their members are Morgaroth, the schemer, Ghazbaran, the lord of blades and Zoralurk, the demon with the thousand faces.

Morgaroth belongs to the cabal Triangle of Terror. He usually has minions to do his work rather than doing it himself. Although sometimes he enters our world in person to inspire the fear his cabal is built upon.
Ghazbaran is a member of the demonic cabal Triangle of Terror. He likes the physical challenge and combat as much as the pain and death he inflicts.
Zoralurk is said to be a member of the demon cabal called Triangle of Terror. She is rumoured to wander the lands in many disguises, poisoning the body and minds of people by word or deed.
Somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, where the Necromant King was defeated lies the secret entrance to the pits of inferno.
I think you are referring to the beast Hugo that is said to still haunt the Plains of Havoc. The legends which tell of this creature are ancient and almost forgotten.
The Nightmare Knights were an ancient order dedicated to fight evil. They were guided by prophetic dreams. The order ceased to exist after their war against the Brotherhood of Bones.
This brotherhood was an secret society of necromancers and followers of purest evil. They were vanquished long ago by their arch-enemies, the Nightmare Knights.

As far as we know, once a terrible beast roamed the lands we now call the Plains of Havoc. It was so fierce that no one dared to even dream about killing it. Finally it was tricked by the knight Endulos.
Endulos was not a great warrior, but a man of wit and genius. After many of his brethren of the Nightmare Knights had fallen prey to the beast, he came up with a cunning plan to end that threat.
He lured Hugo into a trap. Bound by roots and stones charged with powerful magic he could not move anymore. Now, the beast lies trapped in a hidden cave for eternity.
The legends tell us that the Nightmare Knights trapped it beneath one of their fortresses, or rather that they built a fortress on top of his eternal prison.
The Paradox Tower was home of a mighty but mad wizard. It is said that only the cunning and mad can brave the tests of that tower to gain its treasures.
As far as I can tell, this creature is not fond of cheaters and won't allow them to pass his tests.
Whatever the original meaning of that underground complex was, it is now like an open wound in the nearby lands, spreading madness and attracting all kinds of ghosts and apparitions.
The Necromant King. He is dead forever, and that is the nicest thing I can say about him. May he rot in his tomb.

Legend has it that the Djinn were created by Zathroth by using the stolen chalice of life. They roamed the world for Aeons causing strife and despair until Gabel, one of their lords met a very special human.
Gabel was the most powerful among the Djinn lords. He was cruel and merciless, until one day his minions brought a certain human to him whom they had captured and tortured.
This human showed no fear and did not yield under torture. They could bend him, but they never managed to break him. Impressed by this mortal, Gabel talked to him and learned about his philosophy.
The human whom the Djinn had caught was none other but Daraman. The mighty Gabel was intrigued by his philosophy an changed his ways according to Daramans teachings.

The teachings of asceticism, inner peace and ascension appealed to the Djinn, although in the beginning this was probably only because of his vanity and his greed for divinity. However, Malor and his followers opposed him.

Malor was second in power only to Gabel and his followers among the Djinn were many. It was not easy for the evil Djinn to change their ways, and many preferred to follow Malor instead of Gabel. In the end a civil war erupted.

In the war of the Djinn citys were levelled, lands were cursed and islands sunk. Finally, Malor was caught and imprisoned in an enchanted bottle. His followers fled this plane, while the good djinn laid to rest to recover their strength.

Daraman was a sage with ambition, that is for sure. His philosophy centred around the idea that by controlling yourself you could improve yourself. The closer you are coming to perfection, the closer you are to ascension to divinity.
The cenath favour magic above all other. They are the keeper of elven lore and wisdom. They are responsible for the astounding feats of druidic magic the elves are capable of.
One could call the Deraisim the scouts and rangers of elvenkind. Although all elves are formidable in that area, the Deraisim excel them all.

The Kuridai are the craftsmen and warriors of elvenkind. They are always moving, always scheming. They are the most aggressive elves and distrust outsiders. An outsider might be each non-Kuridai to them.

Its said that those elves were the masters of the dreams. Which many consider as a special brand of magic. However they seem to have vanished from the face of tibia ages ago and their fate is unknown.
Although lovely, the city of the elves lacks the grace and the vibrance of the elven cities of old. The elves are still working on improvement of their settlement.
A city in the far north. It separated from the Thaian kingdom about 100 years ago. Now it is ruled by a dynasty of queens.
The town of Darashia is built around one of the few sweet water supplies of Darama. It is famous for its sand wasp honey and its sandworm stew.
The desert lands of Darama are harsh and unforgiving. Therefore Daraman led his people there to found a new community based upon his teachings.
Edron is the latest colony of the Thaian kingdom. However, structures of an earlier colonisation have been found. We cannot tell if those inhabitants were human or of any other known race.
The dreaded town of Drefia was once a haven for heretics, necromancers and demon worshipper. Its was destroyed in the war of the Djinn.
The Ghostlands are haunted by their past. In bygone days some ancient race lived there. Deep beneath the earth some of their structures are still intact and defile the surrounding lands.
The ancient fortrescity of the dwarf was carved into the mountain known as 'the big old one'. Its quite hidden and heavily guarded to withstand any assault.
The underground city of the minotaurs can be reached through a dangerous passage from the old temple.
Behind the mountain lies a land of great danger.
In the old days the underground temple was built for the glory of Banor after a victory over the orcish hordes. It is now an abandoned and dreary place overrun by rotworms.
It was on rookgaard where the soul vortex appeared. The Thaian kingdom holds an outpost there to protect the vortex and to guide the newly arrived souls.
Thais is the capital of an ancient human kingdom. Once its rule was more or less undisputed. In the years the strength of the thaian kingdom eroded by different events.
Venore is a center of commerce and trade. Its ambitious trade-barons are nominally subjects of the thaian kingdom.
The swamp city is a centre of commerce, and know for it riches and its merchant barons. It is part of the Thaian Kingdom.
The ancient dwarven kings forged it using magic metal , which they took from cyclopses who found it in the heart of a fallen star.
There are several kinds of magic metals in our world, the best known are called Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon, and Zatragil.

The so-called singing steel causes a constant humming while it is forged. It is said this was a sign of its absorbing magic powers in the process, and it was presumably easy to enchant. Sadly, the secret where to mine or how to create this ore has been lost in the ourse of time.
This is the metal of 'evil', the hell-forged iron no ordinary flames can melt. It is rumoured to be harvested in hell from iron rocks in which damned souls were imprisoned.
This steel absorbs magic. While it is of inferior quality compared to ordinary steel, its absorbing qualities make it important though.
What makes this black steel exceptional is its lightness and peculiar property of lacking the common steel 'noise'. It is also called 'silent steel' or 'thief's steel' for this reason.
The luminescent brightsteel is used for artwork mainly. In ancient times, items of great magic power were crafted using brightsteel. Those crafts were lost with the races who held the secret to them.
The dwarfs call it heartiron and claim it is part of the heart of The Big Old One. Therefore, they hold it sacred and its use is limited and regulated.
The dwarven high steel is relatively common but expensive and still hard to come by. The elite dwarven weaponry and armours are made of Uth'Doon.
The so-called dreamsilver is a legendary metal. Almost everything we know about it are rumours only.

The small but strong dwarves are tireless workers and fierce warriors. They are familiar with several crafts and mastered most of them. In our days their smithing skills are rivalled only by those of the cyclopses.
The gods created the vortex to guide powerful souls to our world so they might join the battle for creation.
Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
pages.title: Edowir

pages.name: A Confused Frog
npc_lines: I don’t want to be an assistant anymore. Ribbit. I just want my dream pond.
Well… ribbit… my name is Turian. But that doesn’t really matter anymore.
Errr… I’d rather not. Don’t take it personally.
Magic, pah. Ribbit. I don’t need magic. I just want some flies, actually. Ribbit.
I used to be Eclesius’ assistant! Argh! Then – ribbit – one of his crazy experimental spells backfired and hit me. That’s when I lost my job I guess. Ribbit.
That demon is called ribbit. Erm, no, I mean Samael. He is one REALLY annoyed demon overlord, but we get along okay. Not sure if I’d let him out of there though. Ribbit.
Yep, he told me one day that that was his name. In the tone of voice that makes your ears almost explode and singes your hair.
You know… being a frog isn’t that bad. Ribbit. I don’t want to be a human again. I just wish I could get out of this cage and live by a lovely little pond.
Yeah, you said it. Ribbit. Told you, being a frog isn’t that bad, see.
That old fool! He should be locked up with his weird theories and ideas and forced to study some serious magic! Rrrribbit!
I like the pond north of Thais. It’s a really cosy place. Not just for humans, but especially for frogs. Ribbit.
Take care. Ribbit.
pages.title: A Confused Frog

pages.name: Gregor
npc_lines: Welcome home, Knight Jogador!
I am the first knight. I trained some of the greatest heroes of Tibia.
Of course, you heard of them. Knights are the best fighters in Tibia.
Hail to our King!
You are joking, eh? Of course, you know me. I am Gregor, the first knight.
A great name, isn't it?
I have spells for all magic levels up to level 3. In what level do you want to learn a spell?
Beautiful Tibia. And with our help everyone is save.
It is time to join the Knights!
Knights are the warriors of Tibia. Without us, no one would be safe. Every brave and strong man or woman can join us.
Some day someone will make something happen to him...
A bow might be a fine weapon for someone not strong enough to wield a REAL weapon.
I and my students often share a cask of beer or wine at Frodo's hut.
Always concerned with his profit. What a loss! He was adventuring with baxter in the old days.
He was an adventurer once.
Before she became a priest she won the Miss Tibia contest three times in a row.
Peaceful farmers.
A fine game to hunt. But be careful, he cheats!
Bah, go away with these sorcerer tricks. Only cowards use tricks.
What an idiot.
I will never understand this peaceful monks and priests.
He has the muscles, but lacks the guts.
Hail to our King!
Be careful on your journeys.
pages.title: Gregor

pages.name: Grof, The Guard
npc_lines: LONG LIVE THE KING!
It's my duty to protect the city.
I am a guard and proud of it.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
I am healthy and vigilant.
We of the red guard are the special forces.
The royal jester.
Sam is our blacksmith. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the left.
He is a soldier in the silver guard.
Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the north west of the city.
Gorn is our provisioner. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the right.
Frodo runs the local tavern. You'll find it at the main crossroads to the north-west.
The high knight of the knights' guild. It is in north-east of the town.
Marvik is the great druid of the local guild. You'll find him by climbing up the citywalls at the east.
Muriel is the head of the local sorcerers' guild. You'll find it in the south-west of the city.
Elane is responsible for the local paladins' guild. It's in the west of the town, directly south of the post office.
He is a role model for us.
Benjamin was a brave fighter. He runs the post office in the west of the city.
I only see him when he heads home in the wrong direction.
The royal general. A warrior worth Banor's blessings.
Behave while in the city or we get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?
There's a smith, a provisioner, and a tavern.
The castle is at the west of the city.
In the city you will find the guildhouses of the knights, paladins, druids, and sorcerers.
Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!
Of course we guards are members of the army.
Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.
Brave warriors, indeed.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
Take this! (burning effect, 5 turnos de 10 hitpoints)
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Grof, The Guard

pages.name: Billy
npc_lines: Howdy Jogador.
I am the god of cooking, indeed!
Can't help you, sorry. I'm a cook, not a priest.
I am farmer and a cook.
I came here to have some peace and leisure so leave me alone with 'time'.
The king and his tax collectors are far away. You'll meet them soon enough.
I can spell but know no spell.
I sell various kinds of food.
I buy food of most kind. Since I am a great cook I need much of it.
Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat.
Ask one of the shopkeepers. They make a fortune here with all those wannabe heroes.
You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around.
So you bring me a fresh rat for my famous stew?
Then not.
Have you found a pan for me?
Don't be afraid, in the town you should be save.
Shes pretty indeed! I wonder if she likes bearded men.
He never leaves this temple and only has time to care about those new arivals.
One of the kings best men, here to protect us.
I like him, we usualy have a drink or two once a week and share storys about Willie.
I don't like his headmaster behaviour. Then again, he IS a headmaster after all.
Don't listen to that old wannabe, I'm the best cook around.
I am the best cook around. You can sell me most types of food.
pages.title: Billy

pages.name: Carlos
npc_lines: Hey there, Jogador! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
pages.title: Carlos

pages.name: Cipfried
npc_lines: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
Come to me if you need healing!
Don't despair! Help is near!
Hello, Jogador! I'll heal you if you are injured or poisoned. Feel free to ask me for help or general hints.
Me? Oh, I'm just a humble monk. Ask me if you need help or healing.
My name is Cipfried.
I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of Tibia and to help newcomers in this world.
That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called Rookgaard, to be precise, with many monsters, quests and citizens around.
The gods have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The citizens will help you if you ask them.
They created Tibia and all life on it. Visit our academy and learn about them.
Only a few people live in our village, most of them are merchants. You can either ask them for a trade or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their job or Tibia in general.
The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from Seymour, if you wish to!
Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with rats in the sewers, then turning to spiders or wolves.
A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still kill you.
The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.
If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at Obi's shop.
To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at Dixi's shop.
You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a trade. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
You can buy equipment from the merchants in this village once you earned some gold. Some monsters also carry equipment pieces with them.
You aren't looking really bad, Jogador. I can only help in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating food.
Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a monster, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
How can I help you? I can tell you about specific citizens if you tell me their name. I can also give you general hints about Tibia.
Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local citizens and ask them for quests. You could also help us fight monsters.
You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Many citizens are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
Now it is horas, my child.
I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of Tibia - maybe even influence history!
Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?
Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
There are four vocations in Tibia: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
Your near destiny will be to choose a vocation once you are level 8. Whether you will become a knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid is a big decision!
Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat food to regain health, though.
If you face spiders, beware of the poisonous ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to Dallheim or Zerbrus at the bridges.
Of course.
As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by ship and get better deals from merchants.
Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to. ...
Travelling by ship will cost you some gold, though, so be sure to have money with you.
I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get killed. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.
I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the merchants, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.
Hey Jogador! We have rules here! You'll have a much easier life if you respect them.
A general rule is to be polite and kind towards fellow Tibians. This includes not to insult them or to steal their monsters. If you are friendly, you will quickly make friends.
Obi's shop is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells weapons, and his granddaughter Dixi sells armor and shields upstairs.
Seymour is a loyal follower of the king and a teacher in the academy.
Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin Billy. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell food there.
May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous monsters!
That's Obi's granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling armor and shields.
Yes? How can I help you?
He's a farmer, just like his cousin Willie. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
He came together with Vascalir. He seems like a powerful mage and investigates the disturbances in the magical atmosphere.
He has recently arrived from a far-away country to help us fight against the orcs.
In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as ropes, shovels and torches.
Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced explorer and adventurer. It's always interesting to chat with her.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8 to find your destiny.
You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells potions. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.
Seymour is a loyal follower of the king and a teacher in the academy.
Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.
Lee'Delle's shop is on the premium side of the village. You should visit her!
That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.
She recently opened a little bar north of this village.
He is the bank clerk, making sure your money remains safe.
Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of Rookgaard belongs to his kingdom.
Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can sell fresh corpses or even minotaur leather to him.
May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous monsters!
I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.
That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son Tom completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.
If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.

Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.
Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, 'CTRL' for use and 'ALT' for attack when clicking on an object or player.
If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.
To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right.
'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.
Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.
Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.
After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.
Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.

There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.
Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...
This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.
Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.
When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.
When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.
Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.

The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.
Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.
If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.
Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.
You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.
Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.
Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.
You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.
You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.
You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.
You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.

Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.
The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.
There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.
Farewell, Jogador!
pages.title: Cipfried

pages.name: Dixi
npc_lines: <CLEARS THROAT> GET YOUR ARMOR AND SHIELDS HEEEEEEERE! UPSTAIRS!
Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
Good day, Sir. How may I help you, Jogador? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
Good day, Mam. How may I help you, Jogador? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
I'm helping my grandfather Obi with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!
I'm Dixi.
Did I hear my name somewhere?
It's horas.
How can I help you? I can give you general hints, information about citizens or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!
Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.
Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather Obi doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
I'm sorry, we don't buy this.
Me and my grandfather Obi sell equipment of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a trade if you like to see our offers.
You should never embark on an adventure without it. Ask Al Dee or Lee'Delle for it!
YUCK!
If you need a torch, go see Al Dee's store.
Yes, I can sell that to you. Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.
As an adventurer, you should always have at least a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield.
If you want to fight monsters in dungeons, you definitely need some good equipment such as a weapon, an armor and a shield.
Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to mainland and choose a profession.
As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with Lee'Delle and much more.
Lily sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.
You can deposit your money there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.
King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of Rookgaard belongs to his kingdom.
The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a bank and the room of the oracle. Seymour is the teacher there.
The Island of Destiny can be reached via the oracle once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your profession!
Are you hungry? Then you should visit Willie or Billy in the West of town. Norma also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick blueberries or eat the food some monsters carry with them.
You need to make sure you have some basic equipment before you head into dungeons such as the sewers.
The main continent provides so many adventures! Once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the oracle. You can choose a profession and explore much more of Tibia.
You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the Island of Destiny.
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a trade.
I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit!
There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!
There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!
In Al Dee's shop you will find important general equipment such as ropes, shovels and torches.
One day, I want to become a brave adventurer like her and leave this town!
Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.
He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.
He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many monsters would roam the village of Rookgaard!
I think he's a bit strange, living alone outside this village. How can he dislike to chat with everybody here?
Lee'Delle's shop is on the premium side of the village. You should visit it!
I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she sells potions.
I never understand what he's talking about.
Norma used to sell equipment, but she finally earned enough money to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!
Obi is my beloved grandfather. He sells weapons, most of them forged by himself!
He is the local bank clerk.
Seymour is a loyal follower of the king and a teacher in the academy.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8 to find your destiny.
I wish he would talk to his mother Zirella again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can sell leather and fresh corpses to him.
Uncle Willie and Billy are farmers, which means they are a good place to sell and buy food.
Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many monsters would roam the village of Rookgaard!
If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.

Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.
Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, 'CTRL' for use and 'ALT' for attack when clicking on an object or player.
If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.
To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right.
'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.
Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.
Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.
After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.
Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.

There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.
Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...
This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.
Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.
When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.
When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.
Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.

The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.
Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.
If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.
Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.
You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.
Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.
Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.
You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.
You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.
You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.
You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.

Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.
The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.
There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.
Good bye, Sir.
Good bye, Mam.
pages.title: Dixi

pages.name: Hyacinth (NPC)
npc_lines: Greetings, traveller Jogador.
Teaching you about the gods would require too much time. But you can always read the books in the library.
I am a druid and healer, a follower of Crunor.
May Crunor bless you and protect you on your journeys!.
I am Hyacinth.
Time does not matter to me.
I don't care about kings, queens, and the like.
I am one of the few magic users on this isle. But I sense a follower of the dark path of magic hiding somewhere in the depths of the dungeons.
It is shaped by the will of the gods, so we don't have to question it.
I can't teach you magic. On the mainland you will learn your spells soon enough.
I don't care much about weapons.
The dungeons are dangerous for unexperienced adventurers.
I never talked to her longer.
His healing powers equal even mine.
A man of the sword.
A greedy and annoying person as most people are.
He has some inner devils that torture him.
I just sell some revitalizing life fluids.
May Crunor bless you.
pages.title: Hyacinth (NPC)

pages.name: Buddel
npc_lines: Hey big guys. *HICKS*
There was a time I was called Bejorn. But everyone calls me Buddel. ..... and you are?
Ahh, Jogador. And you?
You are also called Jogador?!?!? Your mother was not very inventive *HICKS* but very convenient. ...
She only needs to remember one name and when she calls one of you, both of you will come!!!
There was a time I was called Bejorn. But everyone calls me Buddel. ..... and you are?
Aha! And you?
Huhuhu,..... er..... shouldn't be offensive, but this is a funny name you have!
There was a time I was called Bejorn. But everyone calls me Buddel. ..... and you are?
Ahh, Jogador. And you?
Huhuhu,..... er..... shouldn't be offensive, but this is a funny name you have!
There was a time I was called Bejorn. But everyone calls me Buddel. ..... and you are?
Aha! And you?
You are also called Jogador?!?!? Your mother was not very inventive *HICKS* but very convenient. ...
She only needs to remember one name and when she calls one of you, both of you will come!!!
I am a fisher aaaaaaand maybe I can show you the other islands. Depends on how good I know you two. Just ask me for a passage!
I'M THE KING OF THIS SHIP AND ALL RUM FLASKS IN IT!!
I don't know and I don't wanna know how that stuff is made but it tastes good! Good, good, *HICKS* very good! I have it from Breezelda.
Druids are strange. Are you two druids? Er, not that you look strange!! No, no, no! *HICKS*
CAN'T YOU SEE I'M TALKING TO THAT GENTLEMAN BESIDE YOU?!?!? Okay, what did you ask?
Hey, who of you knows a story about that??? You or you? ...
You are twins, aren't you?
Teeheehee, I don't know but you two are funny!
Breezelda brought rum from Port *HICKS* er Hope.
I have to go there sometime to buy more rum!
She is a suuuuu*HICKS*uuuch a good captain! Sold me all her rum and not even ve'y expensive. *HICKS*
Good, good, good! *HICKS*
Hey, who of you knows a story about that??? You or you? ...
You are twins, aren't you?
They are the devil's dogsbodies! I heard they have rings which make you stone-cold sober when you wear them!
I saw one at the harbour! YES! It crawled up the bow of that battleship! *HICKS* Not very agile these beasts, it nearly didn't move at all.
I like them! Som'times when I fall asleep on my way home they warm me! Cute isn't it? *HICKS*
Bye.
Nooooo, you are no yeti. They are not that ugly! *HICKS* And they only have two eyes! OH MY GOD.... YOU ARE THAT BEHOLDER AGAIN!!! AHHHHHHHH
You know a town nicer than this? NICER DICER! Apropos, don't play dice when you are drunk ...
You wanna play a little bit? We three?? No? Ahhhhh, you are drunk! I see! *HICKS*
Sven? She's old and called young, er he. Sure he is! Got me? No? *HICKS* Doesn't matter.
They are fools. Other than us three, we are drunk er smart. *HICKS*
It is better to freeze a li'le than to paddle 'til your hands bri'le. That's what my gran' gran' gran' gran' pa' used to say all the time!
The shamans respect me. They like fish! I like fish too. *HICKS* Stupid question! Otherwise I wouldn't be a fisherman!
The serpents were bad. Bad, bad, bad!! BAD SERPENTS! BAD!! I don't want the serpents back. No!
I have a test for you! Go get me a flask of rum and both of you become barbaraba ... you know what I mean ...
...and if you have it ask me for the test again!
Mead is good. Good, good, good ........ but that rum I bought from Breezelda is a nice va'iation! *HICKS*
What is yours? Not that flask here that's mine!
Chyll bless you!
You wanna reestablish one?!?! Can I *HICKS* join?? Do we get enough to drink? Tell me if I can join!
Where are we at the moment? Is this Svargrond? Ahh yes!*HICKS* Where do you want to go?
*HICKS* Big, big island east of here. Venorian hunters settled there ..... I could bring you north of their camp.
T'at is a small island to the east.
Both of you look like you could defend yourself! If you want to go there, ask me for a passage.
It's nice there. Except of the ice dragons which are not very companionable.
pages.title: Buddel

pages.name: Lorek
npc_lines: Greetings, Jogador. If you want me to transport you to the other end of the city, feel free to ask me for a passage.
I can bring you either to the centre of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?
Do you seek a passage to the centre of Port Hope for 7 gold?
Do you seek a passage to the west end of Port Hope for 7 gold?

Ahh, you are a member of 'Paw and Fur'. I can bring you either to the centre of Port Hope, to the west end of the town, to Banuta, to Chor or to the mountain pass to Darama. Where would you like to go?
Do you seek a passage to Banuta for 30 gold?
Do you seek a passage to Chor for 30 gold?
