Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.

There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.
Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...
This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.
Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.
When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.
When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.
Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.

The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.
Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.
If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.
Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.
You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.
Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.
Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.
You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.
You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.
You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.
You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.

Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.
The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.
There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.
pages.title: Zirella

pages.name: Willie
npc_lines: Hiho Jogador.
I am a farmer, not a preacher.
Help yourself, I have not stolen my time.
I am a farmer and a cook.
I try out old and new recipes. You can sell me all food you have.
Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat.
I would love to try a banana-pie. But I lack the bananas. If you get me one, I will reward you.
Have you found a banana for me?
Too bad.
Willie.
Am I a clock or what?
I'm glad that we don't see many officials here.
I am magician in the kitchen.
If I were you, I would stay here.
I sell food of many kinds.
I buy food of any kind. Since I am a great cook I need much of it.
I know how to spell and i know how to spit, you little @!#&&. Wanna see?.
I'm not in the weapon business, but if you don't stop to harass me, I will put my hayfork in your &$&#$ and *$!&&*# it.
I have no time for your dungeon nonsense.
Are you afraid of monsters ... you baby?
Quite a babe.
Our little monkey.
Uhm, fine guy I think.
This little $&#@& has only #@$*# in his mind. One day I will put a #@$@ in his *@&&#@!
This joke of a man thinks he is sooo important.
Yeah, bye.
Hiho Jogador.
YOU RUDE $!@##&
pages.title: Willie

pages.name: Seymour
npc_lines: Hello, Jogador. What do you need?
You can learn much about Tibia's gods in our library.
I can assist you with my advice.
Read the blackboard for some hints and visit the training center in the cellar.
You can try some basic things down there, but don't challenge the monsters in our arena if you are inexperienced.
You can learn about Tibia's monsters in our library.
I am the master of this fine academy.
Our academy has a library, a training center in the cellars and the oracle upstairs.
Go and read our books. Ignorance may mean death, so be careful.
My name is Seymour, but to you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
It is 8:26 pm, so you are late. Hurry!
Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
The only magic-user on this isle is old Hyacinth.

Oh, how I miss the crowded streets of Thais. I know one day I will get promoted and get a job at the castle... I must get out of here! The faster the better! It is people like you who are driving me mad.
I sell the Key to Adventure for 5 gold! If you are interested, tell me that you want to buy the key.
Do you want to buy the Key to Adventure for 5 gold coins?
As you wish.
Well I would like to send our king a little present, but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
Do you have a suitable present box for me?
HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I will give some extra work!
You need fine weapons to fight the tougher beasts. Unfortunately only the most basic weapons and armor are available here. You will have to fight some monsters to get a better weapon.
The castle of Thais is the greatest achievement in Tibian history.
There are some dungeons on this isle. You should strong enough to explore them now, but make sure to take a rope with you.
You will find the oracle upstairs. Talk to the oracle as soon as you have made level 8. Choose a vocation and a new home town, and you will be sent off to the continent.
Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
Go and find some rats to kill!
Here on Rookgaard we have some people, a temple, some shops, a farm and an academy.
Well, there's me, Cipfried, Willie, Obi, Amber, Dallheim, Al Dee, Norma, and Hyacinth.
He is responsible for the temple in Thais.
He is a shop owner in the northwestern part of the village.
A traveller from the main land. I wonder what brought her here, since no one comes here of his own free will.
A humble monk with healing powers, and a pupil of the great Quentin himself.
Oh good Dallheim! What a fighter he is! Without him we would be doomed.
A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health potions just like Lily.
Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at Lily's shop. She also has antidote potions.
A cousin of Thais' smith Sam. He has a shop here where you can buy most stuff an adventurer needs.
Willie is a fine farmer, although he has short temper.
Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
Hello, Jogador. What do you need?
Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
pages.title: Seymour

pages.name: Harkath Bloodblade
npc_lines: Salutations, commoner Jogador!
Evil has many faces. The servants of evil cannot always be recognized as easily as Ferumbras, for instance.
I whorship Banor, the first warrior!
I am the general of the king's army.
HAIL TO KING TIBIANUS, OUR WISE LEADER!
Sometimes the king calls for heroes. Keep eyes and ears open! I also heared Baxter has some work for young adventurers.
Are you suggesting I am corruptible?
The Tibian Bureau of Investigation. Kind of secret police. I don't bother much about such things, I prefer my fights eye to eye.
Sam is responsible to supply our troops with weapons and armor.
The castle is prepared to withstand any direct assault.
The rapid growth of the city makes it hard to patrol and vulnerable to attacks.
They seldom dare to attack the city itself.
In the legends it is told, that this weapon made its wielder able to fight the mightiest demons hand to hand.
He is allied with evil itself! Each time we kill him he returns to take revenge.
He is the idol of all knights and paladins.
AH! WHAT A WOMAN!
He was the king's general before I was promoted. Poor guy, lost his mind in a battle against the evil Ferumbras.
I hardly know him.
I don't know much about him. He is a very secretive person.
He was an adventurer once. He was a fine fighter but lacked the discipline to serve in our army.
He is one of our best men and serves in the silver guard.
Sam is responsible to supply our troops with weapons and armor.
The army protects our city. I divided it into three battlegroups.
The battlegroups are the 'dogs of war', the 'red guards', and the 'silver guards'.
They are our main army.
They are our special forces. Some serve as city guards, others as secret police.
The best sorcerers, paladins, knights, and druids of our forces are chosen to serve as silver guards. They are the bodyguards of the king.
Are you suggesting I am corruptible?
Take this!
pages.title: Harkath Bloodblade

pages.name: Hoggle
npc_lines: Welcome to my humble home!
I am just a poor fisherman.
It's a very hard job, cause without a boat I have to swim and fish at the same time!
I think they can talk, but they are wise enough to be silent. Once I saw a mermaid.
I saw one! She had the body of a fish, and also the head of a fish. Amazing!
Yes, there is a mountain to the north, but it's of no interest. There isn't any fish on it.
If you go north-west you will find Lubo and his adventurer shop. I think he sells maps.
I am Hoggle. I live in this house.
No, it's not time now to go fishing.
There are stories about a city behind the mountain, but why should I go there? There is enough fish here.
I know this city. Sometimes I sell fish to Frodo.
He buys my fish.
Good bye.
pages.title: Hoggle

pages.name: Kevin
npc_lines: Greetings Jogador, what brings you here?
I am the head of the Tibian Postmaster's Guild.
We are a powerful organisation that is vital part of Tibian society. It's a honour and a privilege to be a member.
My name is Kevin. Kevin Postner, that is.
Good bye.
pages.title: Kevin

pages.name: Kulag, The Guard
npc_lines: LONG LIVE THE KING!
It's my duty to protect the city.
I am a guard and proud of it.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
I am healthy and vigilant.
We of the red guard are the special forces.
The royal jester.
Sam is our blacksmith. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the left.
He is a soldier in the silver guard.
Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the north west of the city.
Gorn is our provisioner. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the right.
Frodo runs the local tavern. You'll find it at the main crossroads to the north-west.
The high knight of the knights' guild. It is in north-east of the town.
Marvik is the great druid of the local guild. You'll find him by climbing up the citywalls at the east.
Muriel is the head of the local sorcerers' guild. You'll find it in the south-west of the city.
Elane is responsible for the local paladins' guild. It's in the west of the town, directly south of the post office.
He is a role model for us.
Benjamin was a brave fighter. He runs the post office in the west of the city.
I only see him when he heads home in the wrong direction.
The royal general. A warrior worth Banor's blessings.
Behave while in the city or we get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?
There's a smith, a provisioner, and a tavern.
The castle is at the west of the city.
In the city you will find the guildhouses of the knights, paladins, druids, and sorcerers.
Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!
Of course we guards are members of the army.
Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.
Brave warriors, indeed.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
Take this! (burning effect, 5 turnos de 10 hitpoints)
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Kulag, The Guard

pages.name: Loria
npc_lines: Welcome Jogador.
I am studying the power of magic all the time.
I could tell you much about all sorcerer spells, but you won't understand it. Anyway, feel free to ask me.
Time means nothing to me.
I am Loria, a former apprentice of Alatar, the Sage.
I hope you like it. It is named like my master, Alatar, the Sage.
Well, he was my great master. He taught me all these fantastic things about magic. I really miss him.
Although your attack spells get stronger with your usage of magic, real power is gained by finding strategies to properly use your magic abilities.
I heard from a mystic bone of the lich lord below the House of Necromant. Bring it to me, and you will receive a reward.
He lived in a lonely house in the south eastern part of Tibia beyond the mountains.
I'll teach you a very seldom spell.
I'll teach you 'exevo gran mas vis', but bring me this bone first!
Oh, I can tell you a lot about all sorcerer spells. Feel free to ask me about the spell name or the formula to cast it.
Which is the spell you need the formula to? (ao falar a o nome da magia, ela dirá como lançar. EX: Find Person > Exiva 'name')
Mana is the source of all magic. If you use spells, it will drain mana from your energy pool. This mana regenerates slowly, if you eat, or if you drink those mana potions you can buy at Xodet's.
He runs a magic shop in the main road.
He runs an equipment shop close to the north gate of the city.
He runs his magic shop in the southwest of the city. He sells runes and spells and helps you, if you want to become a sorcerer.
If you search someone, this spell will give you an idea of the direction you must head. You will not be able to see, whether he is below or above you.
A ray of light will emerge from your flat hand to illuminate your environment.
The paths to the next temple are long. Even in Tibia. So learn this spell, and be able to heal yourself during your travels. This spell will only cure small wounds, but it is pretty helpful.
You can activate this spell by pointing your index finger in the direction of your enemy, conjure the power of your rune and shoot the magic missiles in your enemy's body.
This spell sucks the venom out of your veins, that some enemy might have injected.
This spell will cure more wounds or greater ones at once. This is of course more 'mana intensive', but everybody will sooner or later get in a situation where mana is nothing - compared to life.
This spell will create a single field of poisonous gas. Cast it on a creature you were not able to arrange a peace treaty with. If it has no antidote, watch what could happen if you forget yours.
This spell acts similar to the 'poison field' spell, except that you create fire instead of poisonous gas. Don't enter it yourself or you will realize why it is said that 'fire eats everything'.
Remember the spell where you only got to wave your hand? Well, wave it twice and shoot a heavy magic missile at your enemy. This spell will create a rune with five charges.
I could tell you much about all sorcerer spells, but you won't understand it. Anyway, feel free to ask me.
A perfect symbiosis of fire and wind. More is not to be said about this spell. Use this fireball as a warning or as your defence, but don't burn your fingers.
This one will create a field of energy. Everyone stepping in will be struck from lightning. This field will not last as long as poison or fire fields, but it is more deadly.
Trapped again between fire, poison and energy fields? This spell will give you the ability to destruct the fields, so you can pass safely.
Turn to you opponent and release the forces of nature with a whisper of your voice. A triangle of fire will burn all persons in your view, so take care, in which direction you look!
This spell is able to cure almost every injury at a higher cost than the other healing spells.
Imagine scaling the normal fireball by two and raising the fire temperature.
With a snip of your finger you can cover the floor with a burning carpet that keeps on burning for a while.
With this one you can create a huge wall of poisonous gas. Many monsters will be too scared to pass the wall and if they do, they will choke from nausea.
A strong blast of fire wounds the opponent you point at, and the adjacent squares.
As the poison wall, this spell creates an even larger wall of fire, burning everyone who passes.
A lightning bolt strikes the point you look at.
This spell drains the colors out of you body, making yourself invisible for an hour or two.
This one gives you the ability to summon monsters that aid you in your battles.
Attracts lightning bolts from the sky, to form a giant wall, seriously damaging everyone who passes.
The best spell for deciding a battle within seconds. The spell tries to interrupt the opponents heart beat, leading to his instant death in most cases.
A strong blast of fire wounds the opponent you point at, and the adjacent squares.
The mystic crystal should be able to resurrect fresh corpses.
May the magic be with you, Jogador.
pages.title: Loria

pages.name: Lugri
npc_lines: What is it that you want, Jogador?
I am a priest of Zathroth, the bringer of dark secrets.
My name is Lugri.
This puny king is no threat for our master's plans.
Life is war. It's about survival of the fittest.
Aren't we all on a quest for survival and supremacy?
Life is an eternal fight!
If you cant help yourself you are not worth of my assistance.
The people of Tibia are sheep, so be smart and strong enough to become their wolf.
Who cares?
They are a challenge to sift the chaff from the wheat.
After the ruthless seven conquered it, it's again a holy place for the followers of the dark path.
It's existence is just a lie to inspire hope and bravery in the hearts of the followers of good.
That's none of your business!
What? Who are you to imply I need help from a worm like you? ...
Do you want to make a donation?
The gods of darkness give us the chance to reach our whole potentials, the gods of good want to capture us in eternal stasis!
The glorious gods of darkness are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons.
Zathroth represents the true and unbound power of magic. He is the keeper of great secrets.
Fafnar is the power of the sun. She burns the weak to ashes.
Brog, the raging one, the great destroyer, the berserk of darkness ... call him how you like, but fear his awesome power.
Urgith is the master of the undead. The bonemaster also takes care of the damned souls.
The demons are powerful followers of Zathroth. Their leaders are known as the ruthless seven.
Infernatil, Pumin, Verminor, Tafariel, Apocalypse, Bazir and Ashfalor.
The incendiary of hell.
He is the lord of despair.
Ah, the plaguelord.
She is the mistress of the damned! Rewarding or torturing, it is the same for her victims!
It is said even speaking its TRUE name will bring total destruction to you!
He is the great deciver, the lord of lies.
The right hand of Urgith. The general of the undead hordes.
The necromant king was only defeated by the nightmare knights due to a bad twist of fate.
The so-called Gods of Good are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Fardos is the creator. He is a helpless watcher whose 'creation' is far more then he bargained for.
Uman is a jealous keeper of magic. He shares only fragments of his knowledge with the mortals. To be strong one must take, not wait to be given, with Gods like that!.
The Elements are Tibia, Sula, Air and Fire.
Suon is one of the suns of our world. He gives his light mindlessly to the weak and the strong alike.
Crunor is the God of nature, of plants and trees ... and plants and trees are there to be stomped upon and burnt!
Nornur claims to be a God of Fate without even understanding the ways of fate at all.
Bastesh is so afraid that she hides in the depth of the seas.
Kirok, the mad one, is the patron of scientists and jesters, more a nuisance than a god.
Toth is just the undertaker for the other 'gods of good'.
Banor isn't a God at all, merely one of their tools. Is it not stupidity to worship a tool?
The world of Tibia is there to be taken by the strongest. When the time is right, it will fall like an overripe plum...
Sula is just the mindless elemental power of water.
Air is just a mindless elemental force.
Fire is just a mindless elemental force.
Leave now, Jogador. The gods of darkness will watch your soul!
pages.title: Lugri

pages.name: An Old Dragonlord
npc_lines: AHHH MUSHRRROOOMSSS! NOW MY PAIN WILL BE EASSSED FOR A WHILE! TAKE THISS AND LEAVE THE DRAGONSSS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!
LEAVE THE DRAGONS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!
You dare to approach me, tiny mortal?
You will find him in Yalahar. And now get lost!

He who you call the first is not unknown to me. He is still alive and at a remote place, far away from humanity. But I won't talk about him with the likes of you. Perhaps Tamoril will be more kind. ...
For my part I see no need to talk about him with unworthy humanlings. Or about anything else.
Spare me!
pages.title: An Old Dragonlord

pages.name: A Sweaty Cyclops
npc_lines: Hum Humm! Welcume here lil' Jogador.
I am smith.
Working steel is my profession.
Many kinds of. Some I forge. But not ancient steel.
Me can forge equipment back to steel. Like Za'Ralator, Uth'Kean, Uth'Lokr, Uth'Prta.
Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Li'l one want to trade?
Very noble. Shiny. Me like. But breaks so fast. Me can make from shiny armour. Li'l one want to trade?
Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Li'l one want to trade?
Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Li'l one want to trade?
Very old. Like Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon, and Zatragil.
Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
Li'l ones it thieves' steel call sometimes. It's dark and making not much noise.
Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Li'l li'l ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
It's high steel called. Only li'l li'l ones know how make.
Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
Big Ben no has it more! When you also no have it, you have lost mighty, mighty amulet! Stupid li'l one!
They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
Me not fight them, they not fight me.
Silly ones. Not talk much. Always screaming and hitting.
Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
One day I'll go and look.
Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their busisness.
I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
You shut up. Me not want to hear.
Good bye lil' one.
Do li'l one want to trade a warlord sword?
You not have stuff me want for.
Do li'l one want to trade a serpent sword?
You not have stuff me want for.
Do li'l one want to trade a fire sword?
You not have stuff me want for.
Mountain in south. Li'l li'l ones living there.
Me people not live here much. Most are far away.
Always asking me for stuff they can't afford.
Can melt gold ingot for li'l one. You want?
Li'l one has no gold ingot to melt.
pages.title: A Sweaty Cyclops

pages.name: Amarie
npc_lines: Please leave me alone... I have to study.
I really have to study, I’m sorry. Please leave me alone with my books.
Oh, those coarse barbarians!
I’m a scholar. I believe that the ultimate aim in life is the pursuit of perfect knowledge through study.
It’s pretty here with all these trees and flowers.
Mission? You should read more books. Take that as your mission.
Well… maybe there is a chance for me to find love, after all…
My name is Amarie Leafdancer.
Yes, interesting, isn’t it? I could read about them all day.
Do you like books, too? I really think there’s nothing better than a good book and a cup of bug milk to relax.
Oh, you’re interested in what I study? Really? <blushes> That’s unusual. Well, it’s about the… no wait. I don’t want to bore you. Are you really interested?
It’s really sweet and nutritious. You should try it while you’re in Ab’Dendriel.
Sigh… so caring, yes. <gets a dreamy look in her eyes> Sometimes I dream of…. ah .. forget what I said. <blushes>
What do I dream of? I think… no one has asked me that for a long time. In my favourite book it says… oh, but it isn’t really interesting.
My favourite book… is an erm… poetry book. Which I shouldn’t waste my study time on, but… poetry can also be meaningful.
Meaningful like… it really touches something deep inside your heart and that just makes perfect sense to you.
I… don’t know how I can explain that better.
No, no, that’s getting far too personal… <blushes>
I… don’t know how I can explain that better.
Would you like me to… re… recite some poetry? <blushes>
Love? Hah… you don’t know me. I’m really not good at this stuff. Or what is it you’re implying?
Well… maybe there is a chance for me to find love, after all…
Asha Thrazi.
pages.title: Amarie

pages.name: Guide Edna
npc_lines: Need some help finding your way through Yalahar? Let me assist you.
Talk to me if you need directions. Meow.
Yes, I'm the guide. Yes, I can talk. Trust me, cats usually know the way around best.
Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
Meow, is this your first visit to Yalahar? I can show you around!
Want to know the status of all the world changes? Ask me.
Meow, welcome to Yalahar, Jogador! Even though I might not look like it, I can give you information and a map guide. Need some?
Well, when I was still a human, I was called Eduania, the Great Witch - with capitals letters, mind you. But ever since my spell went wrong, I'm just Edna.

I'm the only feline guide in Tibia. I might not have fingers anymore, but with my paw I can still mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status.
Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers, the depot and the different quarters, as well as about the world status.
Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari.
The temple is just south west of here. Actually, it's a temple raft and the priestess is somewhat... meow... you'll see what I mean.
Our bank clerk Znozel is somewhat... special. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern.
You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here.
Hm, I would teach you, but I guess I should keep my paws off spells for a while. Try Tamoril, north east of the magician quarter. Remember, dragons that spit fire don't bite. Hehe.
The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there, but it's just north of here.
We are currently south of the inner city. Outside its walls, you can find eight city quarters, arranged like slices of a cake around the centre. ...
There is the former trade quarter, the foreigner quarter, the arena quarter, the alchemist quarter, the cemetery quarter, the magician quarter, the sunken quarter and the factory quarter.
If you'd like to know the status of this world just say the keyword for a world change.
We are so lucky that dwarfs are responsible for weapons and armors here. They are, as you probably know, the finest craftsmen you can imagine. The shop is just north of the post office.
General goods like ropes and shovels can be bought in Gree Dee's store in the shop tower, just north of the depot.
You can buy gems and jewellery on the lowest floor of the shop tower. Just north of the depot.
Chuckles sells magical equipment like runes and potions. I'm not sure if he is really as harmless as he claims, but well, he gets the job done. Shop tower, north of the depot.
Dorbin's furniture store is to the left of the shop tower, close to the depot.
Soilance, north of the depot, sells meat and the like. Serafin, whose shop is in the eastern part of the city, sells fruits and vegetables.
Meow, should I make some pawprints for locations like the depot, bank and shops on your map?
Yalahar employs many guards to keep watch in front of and in between the city quarters. None of the quarters is a safe zone, terrible things happen there.
They are basically the henchmen of the Yalahari. In case you are looking for work, you should look for an Augur.
Valid keywords are: Horestis, Mage Tower, Master's Voice, Swamp Fever, Thornfire, Twisted Waters, Awash, Steamship, Horses, Overhunting, Demon War, Sea Serpent, Deepling or Hive.
Meow, very funny. I try not to do it, but sometimes it just slips out of my mouth.
There's something suspicious about Vincent and his past, I tell you. You can find his distance weapon store on top of the shop tower, just north of the depot.
Blessings reduce the death penalty, meaning that if you should die, you will lose less experience, fewer skill points and fewer to no items, if you have all five blessings.
Meow, do I look like I have pockets? I could tell you about the shops in town though, or about the former trade quarter.
Meow, I think you can manage the way on your own, it's just to the north , down the stairs and to the left. If you need marks on your map, let me know.
That's where we are standing right now. Captain Karith of Yalahar might need to be convinced to sail to other cities, though, so don't be surprised.
Sorry, but right now you already received one or more blessings. In order to start this mission you shouldn't have received one. Please return if this is the case. Farewell.
Redward is our local postman. Meow... you will get used to him. Teehee. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern.
It's horas right now. But I can give you more valuable information than that!
General goods like ropes and shovels can be bought in Gree Dee's store in the shop tower, just north of the depot.
Are you looking for the training statues? They're just over the depot, up the stairs! I can mark them on your map.
Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari.
Ordinary people and cats like you and me hardly ever see one of them. They have sealed themselves off in their towers. There are a lot of guards and Augur, though.
The former trade quarter in the South was once the flourishing marketplace of Yalahar. Nowadays it is completely overrun by smugglers and criminals, although, ruled by some sort of kingpin.
That quarter is just left of here. It's a melting pot of different races. Don't expect to receive a warm welcome there.
Meow, ever since all the animals broke out of the zoo and the gladiators started to behave strangely, this is no place for recreation anymore. It's to the west.

The alchemists in the North-west experimented with dangerous and weird things, which eventually led to a gigantic explosion that ruined and contaminated the whole quarter. My fur always itches when I return from there.
Don't expect to see a holy place of peace. The large cathedral is used for forbidden rituals only, and the graveyard is overrun by undead. It's in the North.
The north-eastern quarter is home to many talented magicians. Some friendly, some... not so friendly. They try their best to keep their quarter intact and the academy running.
That's a tragedy... one of Yalahar's quarters, the one to the east, grew so big, that one day it just broke down and fell into the ocean. So many people died... ...
If you are interested in the whole story, you should go to the monument place to the east of the city and talk to Tarak. He's a great storyteller.
The old factory is to the south-east. All sorts of things used to be manufactured there, but nowadays most magic machines are destroyed.
Sorry, I don't have anything to tell you about that topic.
Enjoy your stay in Yalahar, Jogador. Meow.
pages.title: Guide Edna

pages.name: Zerbrus
npc_lines: Greetings young traveller.
I am a follower of Banor.
The heavenly warrior! Read books to learn about him.
I have to stay here, sorry, but I can heal you if you are wounded.
Zerbrus at your service.
I am the bridgeguard. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the wilderness and the dungeons!
There are wolves, bears, snakes, deers, and spiders. You can find some dungeon entrances there, too.
Dungeons are dangerous, be prepared.
My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
HAIL TO THE KING!
You will learn about magic soon enough.
In the world of tibia many challanges await the brave adventurers.
Ask the shopowners for their wares.
My weapon is property of the royal army. Find your own one.
You aren't looking really bad. Sorry, I can't help you.
I will slay all monsters who dare to attack this little town.
Shes verry attractive. To bad my duty leaves me no time to date her.
He does a fine job.
One of theese reclusive druids.
His job to teach the young heroes is important for our all survival.
He can swear and curse as good as the rowdyest seaman I met.
I am a follower of Banor.
The heavenly warrior! Read books to learn about him.
I have to stay here, sorry, but I can heal you if you are wounded.
Zerbrus at your service.
There are wolves, bears, snakes, deers, and spiders. You can find some dungeon entrances there, too.
Dungeons are dangerous, be prepared.
My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
HAIL TO THE KING!
You will learn about magic soon enough.
In the world of tibia many challanges await the brave adventurers.
Ask the shopowners for their wares.
My weapon is property of the royal army. Find your own one.
You aren't looking really bad. Sorry, I can't help you.
I will slay all monsters who dare to attack this little town.
Shes verry attractive. To bad my duty leaves me no time to date her.
One of theese reclusive druids.
He can swear and curse as good as the rowdyest seaman I met.
Such a chicken-hearted person.
Bye.
Greetings young traveller.
Hm.
pages.title: Zerbrus

pages.name: Loui
npc_lines: BEWARE! Beware of that hole!
While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that hole. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard THEM! There must be dozens!
They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger monsters that would devour them outside.
Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy hole.
They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
Pah, king! He should do something about this hole!
I'm a monk. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that hole.
The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
My name is Loui.
Sorry I am out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in the town.
I have no idea how long I've been in this hole. It seemed like an eternity!
Everything around us, that is Tibia.
I am a humble servant of the gods.
I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
I have no quests but to stay away from that hole and I recommend you to do the same.
The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger monsters that would devour them outside.
Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
There must be an army of them, just down this hole..
This is the place where everything starts.
Most adventurers take their first steps there.
He owns a shop in town.
Who's that? Never heard about her.
He's a farmer.
I tried to warn him about these monsters but he just laughed at me!! It's an outrage!
She owns a shop in town.
A hermit on the other side of town.
She owns a shop in town.
She owns a shop in town.
Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
She owns a bar in town.
He owns a shop in town.
Young and inexperienced he is.
He has his own monsters, I believe.
Seymour is the headmaster of the local academy.
The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
I'm sure he has never seen monsters like those in this hole before.
The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
I tried to warn him about these monsters but he just laughed at me!! It's an outrage!
Harmless old woman.
May the gods protect you! And stay away from that hole!
pages.title: Loui

pages.name: Bashira
npc_lines: Welcome to Ab'Dendriel's store for general goods.
Ashari, Jogador.
I'm Bashira Darkmark.
I sell various equipment and buy some stuff. Ask me for a trade if you're interested.
I sell shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, cups, scrolls, parchments, documents, watches, various sources of light, fishing rods and worms.
I sell torches, candelabra, and oil.
Buy a watch.
His presence here is a waste of space and talking to or even about him a waste of time.
He's quite amusing for a human.
The people of Thais boast about their mighty kingdom, but eventually their short lives will doom everything they build.
Their merchants have no patience, and all too fast, they lose their masks of friendliness.
Carlin has some capable fighters, although they lack the grace of an elf.
Their magic is almost as impressive as their ego.
Without us and our tools, nothing would work in this town.
Useless leaf-eaters.
They left. Perhaps we should do that, too.
A stupid Cenath myth.
I'm not dealing with food.
He may scare the tree dwellers or the bigmouths, but not the Kuridai.
One god of many. They are all alike and of no use.
That's our race.
They have some talent in mining and smithing.
They have nothing to give us.
They are lazy and clumsy. We should use dwarfs instead.
My inventory of general goods is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.
Asha Thrazi, Jogador.
pages.title: Bashira

pages.name: Brasith
npc_lines: Ashari Jogador. Fresh fruits and vegetables just arrived from our harvest.
I'm Brasith Seedsinger.
I sell all the things we grow or gather at this place.
I sell corncobs, cherries, grapes, melons, pumpkins, bananas, strawberries, and carrots. I also sell juice squeezers to make fruit juice. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Sorry, I can't help you.
His house is out of place in our city which is built in accordance with nature.
This poor human seems to think he can become an elf by spending time with us.
I heard only terrible stories about that city.
Their traders seem suspiciously friendly. I don't trust them.
The humans of Carlin at least try to live in harmony with nature.
The Cenath forgot as much as they had learned. I doubt they find the wisdom they are looking for without the things they neglected in their pursuit of knowledge.
The Kuridai left the true path and don't see their mistake. Their way of living may have been suitable in the past, but if they don't come back to us, their path will lead into darkness.
We still have much to learn but we are on the correct path at least.
The Abdaisim are on the true way of our race, maybe even closer than we are. But by abandoning the other elves, they harm themselves more than they realise.
They're lost. If they still exist, they are alone in the cold and the darkness.
Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Their simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
The beauty of a forest is easily missed by the unobservant.
With the growth of a community comes the need to 'use' nature rather than to 'flow' with nature. This is sad but necessary.
He thinks that he's incredibly powerful, but he only owns the mindless power of destruction.
We abandoned the gods a long time ago. Shortly after, they abandoned us.
Sadly, our race lacks unity. And the differences we face will grow and grow until eventually there is no race left.
They work deep in the earth and claim to have lots of knowledge about it. Still, all they know are minerals, they know nothing about the life it stands for.
They are so many, so aimless, so divided. They have chosen a path I wouldn't want for my own race.
I don't claim to understand these creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.
Asha Thrazi.
pages.title: Brasith

pages.name: Dreadeye
npc_lines: Ah, a visitor to intimidate. Splendid!
An amusing question in its own, naive way. Let me put it this way: I have become an outcast, and am no longer free to move about my own city. ...
However, despite their limitations, my kind still regard me as useful. I can do .. things they can't or won't do. So I am of value to them. ...

I have gained magnificent insights into things lesser bonelords could only dream of at the price of losing touch with concepts common amongst my kin. An insignificant price to pay for the riches I have gained! ...
This makes me valuable .. for the moment. They come to me in secrecy to ask for my guidance in their petty schemes. ...
They need my genius for help and that makes them less inclined to get rid of me. If the incompetent fools mess up and things go horribly wrong then they have a scapegoat to blame - me. ...
However, I am just biding my time. One of these days, they will come for me .. and I'll be gone.

You only know my race from the remnants that are scattered through this world. These remnants are nothing when compared with those bonelords who grasped the world by its throat in the glorious days of our dominance! ...
We were the rulers, the ultimate masters. Fate and the Gods betrayed us. Stole what was rightfully ours. But we have survived. We are still here. What once was ours will become ours again. ...
We just have to wait. Patience is our power.

Only true bonelords can understand our language. Even I in my... changed state have a hard time understanding even the simple parts of our writings and some parts of it are completely alien to me now. ...
You, human, will never understand our language as you will never understand our ways.
This city was built by enslaved corpses and souls. It oozes pain and despair. Just how my people like it. Sadly, it is only a pale memory of the past. ...

In ancient times our cities were symphonies of agony, choruses of lost souls. Ah, the marvels of long gone times. How pitiable, that we lack the resources to enslave your puny race to sculpt something as glorious as the cities of the past. ...
But, our time will come again! We merely need to wait. When the time comes, we will be ready. ...
All it needs is a well timed push in the right place, human, and we will retake our rightful place and the agonised screams of your kind will be music in our ears!

Be grateful that you can't even hope to grasp the concept behind my name. When I was more... active and had dealings with your race, captured specimens referred to me in your language as 'dreadeye'. ...
While they still had the ability to speak, that is. That will have to suffice.
He is a desperate fool, turning to me for guidance, for those who deal with us pay a high price - they serve us as undead slaves for eternity, muhaha! ...
And a lucky fool for I have my reasons to oblige his request.
Ah yes, the issue of golems. I know. Much of the knowledge on this subject that my race have... acquired over the centuries is at my disposal. ...

And I am disposed to share it. Ah, I guess you are surprised, mortal? Well there are... issues you cannot possibly hope to understand with your limited mind. Actually I can hardly comprehend them myself. ...

But my madness brings certain insights. There is no need to understand, there is only the need to do what has to be done. I will make sure one of my messengers delivers Telas the information he requires. ...
I hope he does not scare easily.
A vain and elusive race. Powerful enough to defy the Gods... so they thought. Now their power is gone, their race declined. They exist still, broken, bereft of any true power. ...
They are as good as dead. With our expertise in necromancy, we recognize the signs of death when we see them. Unlike us bonelords they will never rise again.
What you understand under the term necromancy is only the tip of the iceberg compared to what we are doing, puny human. We are the masters of souls. ...
Creators, shapers, masters. Ours is a complete realm beyond your understanding. Our knowledge borders the realms of apotheosis and it is only a matter of time until the final step is taken.

You could not hope to understand it anyway. But we were close. So close that the Gods struck down our empire and our race. But we survived. We are still here. And our time will come. You can't delay the inevitable.
Bye. Think twice before you return here.
pages.title: Dreadeye

pages.name: Edala
npc_lines: Ashari, Jogador. How... nice to see a human taking interest in a beautiful art such as music.
Ashari, Jogador... that sound was.. interesting.
Ashari, Jogador. You've made some... progress playing the lyre, haven't you..? I want to believe you have.
Jogador. My regular visitor. I certainly... appreciate your efforts to entertain me, but let me assure you, I'm quite comfortable up here by myself. Alone. In silence.
Ashari, Jogador. I'm starting to feel a little sorry... for your lyre. Being forced to produce such noise must be a tragic fate.
Jogador! You're driving me insane! I beg you, take your lyre away from this sacred and peaceful place.
AAAARGH! Jogador! My ears! I'd prefer listening to drunken dwarves rambling all day to the sound of your lyre! Please, at least get it tuned. Here, you can have this elvish diapason.
This item has magical abilities. We elves use it to tune our instruments so they create the most silvery, delicate song. It might have other uses, but I wouldn't know about that.
pages.title: Edala

pages.name: Elathriel
npc_lines: My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.
Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magics.
Dreamers are of no practical use. I don't mourn their demise.
Confused cowards. With all their skill they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.
We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.
Be greeted Jogador.
It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.
For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the keys to open it when needed.
It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. It's secured by a sealed door.
If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
Believe me, it's better for you that way.
It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.
I mastered some spells of battle.
Not that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.
A human weakling, not much more.
I couldn't care less.
Druids' magic is to peaceful for my taste.
I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.
We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.
Like all inferior races they can be at least used for something good. The other castes are just jealous about our use of them.
I still doubt it exists.
Even if he'd walk through the town above the other castes won't see the necessity to follow OUR way.
Asha Thrazi, stranger.
pages.title: Elathriel

pages.name: Elf Guard
npc_lines: Ashari Jogador.
I am a guardian of this town. I have no time to chat!
The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
There are no Teshial.
If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.
Asha Thrazi.
pages.title: Elf Guard

pages.name: Eroth
npc_lines: I greet thee, outsider.
I am the leader of the Cenath caste.
Magic comes almost naturally to the Cenath. We keep the secrets of ages.
I can teach the spells 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.
The Kuridai are aggressive and victims of their instincts. Without our help they would surely die in a foolish war.
They lack the understanding of unity. We are keeping them together and prevent them from being slaughtered one by one.
We are the shepherds of our people. The other castes need our guidance.
Gods are for the weak. We will master the world on our own. We need no gods.
Asha Thrazi. Go, where you have to go.
pages.title: Eroth

pages.name: Lynda
npc_lines: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim Jogador!
I am a priest of the great pantheon.
King Tibianus is our benevolent sovereign.
Life is a gift of the gods, honor life and don't destroy it.
It is my mission to spread knowledge about the gods.
My name is Lynda. And the spirits tell me that you are Jogador.
The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
Now, it is 0:00 am.
They are creatures of the gods of evil!
Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
Good bye, Jogador. May the gods guard you, my child!
Do you wish to confess your sins, my child?
So tell me, what shadows your soul, my child.
Meditate on that and pray for your soul.
Do you want to make a donation?
May the gods bless you!
The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Fardos is the creator, the great obsever. He is our caretaker.
Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
Toth, lord of death, is the keper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
The goods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deceiver and the thief of souls.
Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
I dont want to talk about that subject!
He is a favourite of the Gods of Evil and one of their Champions. He will have his come uppance one day.
pages.title: Lynda

pages.name: Marvik
npc_lines: Welcome to my cave, Jogador. How may I help you?
I don't care about armies.
I am the chief druid. I am responsible for all members.
I am a druid. Druids concentrate their magic on defence, healing, and nature.
Everyone who joins the Druids has the opportunity to learn many magic spells.
Sorry, I only sell spells to druids.
Our members use their magic power to protect their life and the life of other creatures.
Kings come and go.
I am Marvik. Probably you heard from me.
Marvik is my name, so what?
Eh, I haven't seen daylight for a long time. So, don't ask me, what time it is.
Sorcerers are very aggressive. They use their power for fighting and killing.
Even in my visions, I couldn't get any enlightenment about the whereabouts of this weapon of legend.
A misguided follower of evil.
Crunor, the eternal tree, is more than nature. Even more as the sum of each part of nature.
I don't know him.
I don't like his kind of humour.
The McRonalds are true believers.
Paladins are quite proud of their magic but lack the understandig of the powers they wield.
A little more seriousity would suite him well.
A shopkeeper.
Warriors are the main recipients of our healing powers.
I understand, he's a warrior of some kind.
Though she focuses not only on Crunor, she is an enlightened person.
So much power and so little philosophy ... a dangerous combination indeed.
He saws the seeds of evil through spreading rumours.
He is a great healer.
An armourer.
A misguided soul who lost the path in the darkness.
Farewell.
pages.title: Marvik

pages.name: Muriel
npc_lines: Greetings, Jogador! Looking for wisdom and power, eh?
I am the second sorcerer. I am selling spellbooks, let me know if you're interested.
A sorcerer spends his lifetime studying spells to gain power.
Of course, power is the most important thing in the universe.
The king is a patron of the arcane arts.
We supply the army with some sorcerer recruits now and then...
There have been many generations of sorcerers in the past. Today, a lot of people want to join us.
Arcian was a childhood friend of mine. We studied the art of sorcery together but later, our ways parted ...
Whereas I stayed here to instruct young new sorcerers, he devoted his life to his own studies ...

Since his experiments tended to become a bit dangerous and he wanted to further explore a magic phenomenon he discovered in the Plains of Havoc anyway, he moved there and took his wife and his two assistants with him ...

We stayed in contact for a while and he maintained a one-way teleporter to the academy. As I was missing any message from him for some time, I travelled to the plains to learn what might have happened ...
I found the house overrun by ghouls, and no living soul. I have to assume that those ghouls have killed them and dragged everyone in their lairs. I left as soon as I could ...
I wouldn't have wanted to see what they've done to my old friend. It's a sad story indeed.

Laira was the wife of my childhood friend Arcian. She was a warm and caring person. I hope she had not to suffer for long as ... she was killed by the undead. Sorry, I don't want to speak about that matter anymore.
Porgol was a quite bright student, although a bit overambitious. I was surprised when he agreed to accompany my friend Arcian to the Plains of Havoc to support him in his studies ...

I was quite sure he'd rather study at the Edron academy instead. But sometimes people surprise one in a positive way. All the more it is tragic he found his death in this assault of undead on Arcian's house.
They are rumoured to be hidden somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, far to the east.

I heard that a member of the Explorer Society was in fact searching for the First Dragon. What a foolish endeavour - please excuse this comment. A romantic idea and a brave venture but seriously: the First Dragon. It is just a myth! ...
However the explorer found an ancient inscription underneath the city of Thais. Reportedly he discovered it in the small cave where the first time ever a dragon was sighted on Tibia.
The enchantments on this weapon must be awesome.
I don't know exactly where it is. Someone told me you have to pass some tunnels full of orcs, somewhere underneath the king's castle. But that might be just gossip.
The dragon was ancient beyond compare. Eventually even he had to succumb to old age and flew to the dragon cemetery to die there. Or so it is told.
Our guild is working on a new spell, but I won't give away any details yet.
You may call me Muriel.
Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers. (se o jogador não for sorcerer)
I'd love to help you, but I'm now in retirement, fortunately. I finally have more time to gain even more power. (se o jogador for sorcerer)
Time is unimportant.
I wonder how he actually got these awesome powers.
He's not a jester but a poor joke himself.
She is quite proud of her puny magic tricks.
A bar is no place that suits a scholar like me.
Knights! Childs with swords. Not worth of any attention.
She keeps the whole wisdom of our ancestors and leads our guild.
Pretty and compentent.
Simple farmers.
I don't like jokes about my name!
He has some minor magic powers.
A simple smith.
He has our permission to sell mana fluids.
The wisdom of spellcasting is the source of power..
Each spell that starts with 'Ad' needs a rune. You have to have a blank rune with you when you cast it. You can buy runes at the magic shop.
In a spellbook, your spells are listed. There you can find the pronunciation of each spell. Do you want to buy one for 150 gold?
pages.title: Muriel

pages.name: Abran Ironeye
npc_lines: Hail, Jogador!
I am Abran Ironeye.
I don't care if you like it or not. Stop staring at it!
I am a busy man. I run the Ironhouse.
What do you think? Here weapons and armor are forged, repaired, and sold.
My Ironhouse is more than a warehouse..
If someone would bring me that weapon I could reshape the realm... and reward this hero beyond his dreams.
I don't know anything about a teddy... and if you are smart you shouldn't either...
The world is ready for a significant change.
As a man that grows up needs no mommy, a warrior has to outgrow his need for gods.
I would like to see a true warrior-king in Thais... like in the old days. But who knows, perhaps one day the tides of fate will bring such a man to power. Who knows...
Thais has outlived its usefulness since years. Its star is sinking.
Their independence is a proof for the weakness of Thais.
Such a great tool wasted for garrison duties, a shame.
If someone would bring me that weapon I could reshape the realm... and reward this hero beyond his imagination.
Quite a challenge, but his bets for power were made without the finesse of a true warrior.
I won't give away my tricks, learn your own.
The taxing keeps the Thaian kingdom alive, but it also might break its neck one day.
You should know that on your own!
I trust only in skill, not luck.
You are dismissed.
pages.title: Abran Ironeye

pages.name: Alwin
npc_lines: LONG LIVE THE KING!
That's classified information!
I am a protector of the people of Venore.
The harbour is to the north, the weapon market in the south, the general market to the west, and the bank to the east. You will find other shops and the Hard Rock Tavern in the center.
Tibianus III is our beloved king! He rules over Venore from far away Thais.
Tibianus III is our beloved king!
The swamp is a dangerous place and full of monsters, not to mention all those swampelves living at shadowthorn, amazons, and swamptrolls.
The swamp is full of nasty snakes and there's a dragon breeding ground somewhere in the swamps.
They are the best example for the results of the Carlin madness.
This hideous creatures are even more ugly than the normal trolls. They are treacherous and use several poisons.
Those elves hide in the swamps and are trying to kill all humans in this area.
This information is confidential.
They are our rolemodells.
Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.
I doubt you have the security clearance to ask that.
Every guard dreams of becoming one of them one day.
Look for the Hard Rock Tavern to learn the latest news.
Ask the merchants of the city. There are more than enough
We of the red guard are the special forces and town guards.
This city, a member of the Thaian kingdom, is under the protection of the Thaian army.
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Alwin

pages.name: Oswald
npc_lines: Oh, hello Jogador. What is it?
You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
She's a little witch, trust me. She used to be the girlfriend of this evil Partos some time ago.
Oh, hello Jogador. What is it?
I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.
I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent Durin!
I have a job of great responsibility, mostly I keep annoying persons away from my boss.
You better don't ask, you wouldn't like the answer.
Ah, yes, yes, hail to King Tibianus! Long live the king and so on...
I overheard a conversation of officials, that magic will be forbidden soon.
My name is Oswald, but let's proceed, I am a very busy man.
Hey, I am not a shopkeeper, I am an important man!
It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!
It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.
It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.
You are not the first one to ask about that. Am I the only one that preferes wine to such disgusting stuff?
What do you expect from ex-soldiers? He is nuts! Hacked on the head far too often.
Isn't he the artist formerly known as the prince?
I never found any rumour concerning him, isn't that odd?
They say she killed over a dozen husbands already.
This man lives in the darkness like a rat and is also as handsome as one of them. He surely is up to no good and often consorts with sinister strangers.
Just last week a one eyed man, who had a room at Frodo's, met him in the middle of the night.
He sells his scrolls far too expensive.
I was told he lost a body part or two in duels... if you know what I mean.
He is rumoured to summon kinky demons to... well you know.
You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
Fascinating! Absolutely fascinating!
I heard he was a ladies' man in younger days. In our days he is rumoured to wear women clothes now and then.
A simple shopkeeper with minor intelligence.
They say he isn't truly dead. He was... or is a necromant after all.
Some say he is Ferumbras in disguise.
What a shame. He claimed to be the king of thiefs and was caught stealing some fruit.
Just between you and me, he can be quite a tyrant.
AHHHH!!! WHERE??? WHERE???
Finally!
pages.title: Oswald

pages.name: Prisoner
npc_lines: Ahhhh!
Have mercy!
I admit! I admit!
I repent!
Noooooo!
Please! I beg you to stop!
Take it away! Please!
pages.title: Prisoner

pages.name: A Prisoner
npc_lines: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they capture you as well?
Yes, they capture people. I guess that's their job.
Job? JOB? Hey man - I am in prison! But you know - once upon a time - I was a powerful mage! A mage ... come to think of it .., what is that - a mage?
Better save time than comitting a crime. I am a poet and I know it!
My name is - um... hang on? I knew it yesterday, didn't I? Doesn't matter!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
They are trying to capture me! Or hang on! Haven't they already captured me? Hmmm - I will have to think about this.
I am the mightiest sorcerer from here to there! Yeah!
Hey! That's me! You got it! Thanks mate - now I remember my name!
I have many books in my home. But only powerful people can read them. I bet you will only see three dots after the headline! Hehehe! Hahaha! Excellent!
How could I escape? They only give me rotten food here. I can´t regain my powers because I have no mana!
It´s easy to find your way through it! Just follow the pools of mud. Hehe - useful hint, isn´t it?
You want to sell me blank runes! I will give you 50000 gold for each rune! Interested?
Tataah!
He is the worst of them all! He is the king of the minos! May he burn in hell!
The only monster I cannot conjure. But soon I will be powerful enough!
Apples! Real apples! Man I love them! Can I have one? Oh please say yes!
Power. Hmmm. Once while we were crossing the mountains together a man named Aureus said to me that parcels are equal to power. Any idea what that meant?
Sure I have the key! Hehehe! Perhaps I will give it to you. IF you can solve my riddle.
Great riddle, isn´t it? If you can tell me the correct answer, I will give you something. Hehehe!
Hurray! For that I will give you my key for - hmm - let´s say ... some apples. Interested?
No! I won't tell you. Shame coz it would be useful for you - hehehe.
He is the leader of the outcasts. I hope he will never conquer the city of Mintwallin. That would be the end of me!
My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics?
Good bye! Don't forget about the secrets of mathemagics.
Next time we should talk about my surreal numbers.
pages.title: A Prisoner

pages.name: Quentin
npc_lines: Welcome, adventurer Jogador! If you are new in Tibia, ask me for help.
My name is Quentin.
Job? I have no job. I just live for the gods of Tibia.
That is where we are. The world of Tibia. Admire its beauty.
Our king resides in the castle to the west.
First you should try to get some gold to buy better equipment.
They created Tibia and all life on it.
On Tibia there are many forms of life. There are plants and people and monsters.
Just walk around, you will see grass, trees, and bushes.
I am a simple monk. I just know Sam, Frodo, and Gorn. They all live in the main street to the north.
I don't know much about the Tibian army. Ask general Harkath Bloodblade about that.
Harkath Bloodblade is his name.
Legends tell us that that Excalibug is a gift of the gods. Banor used in his battles. They say it was passed on to one of his followers.
Sorry, I know nothing new. Please ask Frodo about that topic.
There are really too many of them in Tibia. But who am I to challenge the wisdom of the gods?
You do not need any healing right now.
You are poisoned, my child. Let me soothe your pain.
First you should try to get some gold to buy better equipment.
If you need money you should slay monsters and take their gold. Look for spiders and rats.
There are spiders' nests beyond our city near Gorn's shop and at the McRonalds' farm in the east.
There are sewers underneath the city. They say these sewers are brimming with rats.
You can enter the sewers thorugh a sewer grate. But watch out. There are many rats. And don't forget to bring a torch.
First you should buy a bag or backpack. That way your hands will be free to hold a weapon and a shield.
Take a weapon into your hand and select a target. If you are wounded you should eat some food to heal your wounds.
If you would like to heal your wounds you should eat some food. Frodo sells excellent meals. But if you are very weak you can also come to me. I will heal you.
Now, it is XX:XX. Ask Gorn for a watch, if you need one.
He is selling equipment. If you still have no backpack you should go and ask him for one.
He is our blacksmith. He sells weapons and armour.
He is the owner of Frodo's Hut, the tavern north of this temple.
She is the leader of the local Paladins' guild.
Muriel is a famous sorcerer. He is the keeper of arcane secrets that are known only to few mortals.
The leader of the Knights' guild is a man of few words.
I admire the healing skills of Marvik.
Our king resides in the castle to the west.
She is a highly competent priest.
A hard man but his heart is in the right place.
Hush! Do not mention the Evil One in these walls.
He is the king's jester, but he believes himself to be the king of fools.
He is the guard of the royal castle.
This man is spreading horrible rumours all the time.
The McRonalds run the local farm.
Please do not mention the fallen one.
I hope I won't become that forgetful when I'm old. But he is a good man, although I don't know him very well.
pages.title: Quentin

pages.name: Robin
npc_lines: Ah, a visitor. Greetings Jogador!
I am the Chief Huntsman of Thais.
I am Robin. Some call me Rob, others Woody.
I am his Master of the Hunt as I was his father's Master of the Hunt.
A misguided follower of evil.
Time... it's running that fast when you are as old as me.
These kids call themselves an army... In the old times we had a REAL army, I tell ya...
News? In the woods I learn nothing of importance to the world.
Crunor gives and takes. That is his way. As long as we don't hunt more than we need, we are at balance with Crunor.
I don't like swords in general.
My buddy Quentin is getting old, too. Things were different in our youth.
Oh, what a charming young man. He's often here asking me about my youth and the people I met in my life.
A master, or better mistress, of the bow. But with her big feet she just chases all game away.
Can you imagine his father was such a fine guy? A shame what his son has become.
Sells a lot of useful stuff, that guy. I remember the days when we were so poor that we could not afford anything the former owner offered.
I have not much use for heavy armor.
I hardly know him.
Druids have their ways with nature, but they would rather cuddle a bear than hunt it.
Such guys don't live long. The grandfather of our king had a new jester every season.
So young and so beautiful! She makes even an old man as me... um... feel a bit younger again.
Another one of a few friends of my youth who's still left.
Can you imagine this youngster handling a guild? Ah, come on.
I meet him often at Frodo's. He's a fine fellow, but he always tells me the same stories because he forgets that he already told them to me.
The farmers are fine fellows.
Farewell, Jogador.
pages.title: Robin

pages.name: Tim, The Guard
npc_lines: LONG LIVE THE KING!
It's my duty to protect the city.
I am a guard and proud of it.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
I am healthy and vigilant.
We of the red guard are the special forces.
The royal jester.
Sam is our blacksmith. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the left.
He is a soldier in the silver guard.
Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the north west of the city.
Gorn is our provisioner. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the right.
Frodo runs the local tavern. You'll find it at the main crossroads to the north-west.
The high knight of the knights' guild. It is in north-east of the town.
Marvik is the great druid of the local guild. You'll find him by climbing up the citywalls at the east.
Muriel is the head of the local sorcerers' guild. You'll find it in the south-west of the city.
Elane is responsible for the local paladins' guild. It's in the west of the town, directly south of the post office.
He is a role model for us.
Benjamin was a brave fighter. He runs the post office in the west of the city.
I only see him when he heads home in the wrong direction.
The royal general. A warrior worth Banor's blessings.
Oh yes, he's an old friend of mine. He left Thais to protect a small village from a goblin clan.
The bear? Yes, I know him. Well, this is kind of a personal story. And one that I don't want to share with everyone.
Behave while in the city or we get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?
There's a smith, a provisioner, and a tavern.
The castle is at the west of the city.
In the city you will find the guildhouses of the knights, paladins, druids, and sorcerers.
Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!
Of course we guards are members of the army.
Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.
Brave warriors, indeed.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.
Take this! (burning effect, 5 turnos de 10 hitpoints)
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Tim, The Guard

I am a guard and proud of it.
I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

pages.name: Wyat
npc_lines: Salutations!
I am the sheriff of the Thaian territory.
I am follower of Banor.
He is the patron of justice and bravery.
HAIL TO KING TIBIANUS!
Look up our 'Tibia's most wanted' lists.
Sam, the Thaian smith, is a man of great diligence. Whenever in need of weapons or armor, just ask him.
The castle should be relatively safe from criminal transgressions.
Our enemies are numerous and not all are obvious.
The city is not as bad as some people might claim, but we certainly have our problems here.
We will handle each problem with care.
The poor fool lost his mind some years ago. It's a good thing they gave him a job in the post office.
He's so funny, I could listen to his jokes for hours.
A woman of great skill and courage. No one deserves the title of a Grandmaster of the Paladins more then her.
He was a rowdy in his youth, but now he's a fine citizen as far as I can tell.
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Wyat

pages.name: Trimegis
npc_lines: <mumbles> Greetings, Jogador.
I am the kings new courtmage and advisor in arcane matters.
The last courtmage was killed by Ferumbras in one of his attacks.
He failed in his quest for power since he ultimately forfeited greater powers for a quick but limited powerboost by enslaving himself to some dark entities.
Our king frequently relies on my divinations and spells of protection.
I am commonly known as Trimegis.
Power comes to those who have the intelligence to claim it.
My spells are my personal secret.
Time does not matter in the end.
Many call themselves a sorcerer, but only a few truly understand what that means.
The only weapon I need is my magic.
Some dumb holes for adventurers seeking trouble.
Paladins are another example that diversing one's resources between goods, mundane weapons, and magic does not make a good mixture.
At least one mundane who knows his proper place.
I have certainly no business with such persons.
That old fool wanted to become courtmage too. But he just doesn't cut the mustard.
A bar is fine to distract the mundanes from doing something foolish.
Limited in his vision as all knights are.
The king listens to the advice of this swordsman far too often.
She has the 'know how', but sadly does not really know how to use it efficitenly.
Gods are not as reliable as something you mastered on your own.
He's quite good in magical theories, but lacks practice in the field.
A truly disgusting fellow.
Mixing up magic with religion can't do any good.
A man as mundane as a rock.
He made the best he could of his limited abilities.
Brawns but no brain.
Another bogeyman. Who's afraid of someone who is that 'powerful' that he hides in some dirthole?
Farewell.
pages.title: Trimegis

pages.name: Demon Mother
npc_lines: Oh no. Not again!
Where is this brat again?
You need a serious beating.
I want some days off.
Greetings, meatbag. Speak quick, my patience is short.
I'm the mother of thousands of demons. If you think they are a pain when they are grown up, you haven't met the young ones. And particularly the babies can be bothersome. ...
I desperately need a few days off or I cannot guarantee for anything!

My little darlings are somewhat tiresome sometimes. And there are hundreds of them. Even I need a rest from time to time. Some time for myself. Do you have any idea for how long I didn't have had my horns done? ...
And it's not easy for a single demon mother to meet an evil guy. As soon as they hear you have a few hundred children at home, they teleport into another dimension! ...
Even demon mothers want to relax now and then, have a bath in the lava pits and listen to the screams of some tortured souls. ...
And I am not the kind of mother that let's her little demons watch the torture pits the whole day. I expect from them to do something creative and evil on their own. ...
I won't drop them into some foreign dimension to take care of their own like other demon mothers do. ...
Of course a torn off head will regrow in a few days but I'm old-fashioned and don't like to see my little darlings suffer. ...
This is where you come in! I entrust this world to take care for my little darlings for a while!
Ah, well. My kids sometimes like it rough. To calm them, I usually slap something hard on their head. Hey, don't give me that look, we are demons after all.
I need some of you mortals to care for some of my children. They are only demon babies so it shouldn't be too hard, even for such limited creatures as you are. ...
I'll hand you one of my babies and you'll take care of it. You can only care for one baby at a time. ...
Demon babies are moody and spoilt. Each few hours it will request something from you and you will have to fulfil its wishes to keep it happy. It will let you know what it wants. ...
Do whatever pleases the baby to satisfy it for a few hours. If you comply with its wishes often enough, it will become cheery. It might take a few days and don't think it's easy. ...
Some of the baby's wishes might be exotic and others outright dangerous. But that is the fate of babysitters since the dawn of time. ...
Bring my darlings back to me as soon as they are cheery. This phase will last for a while and it will be easy for me to keep an eye on them. ...
If enough of your people help me and bring me my cheery darlings, I will be pleased and your world will be rewarded. ...
If you fail though .. well, let's say you will not like this alternative. I can become really mean if I am mad and most demons owe me something! ...
So are you up to this?
Uh ... Uhm ... Really? Fabulous! Here we go! Take care! It is now bound to YOU, so don't try to swap it with another baby. My magic will prevent that and return it to you!
You did surprisingly well in handling my little darling. I might have use for your nanny skills another time. (Se você já tiver feito isso)
Are you ready to take care of one of my little darlings for a while?
Hey! I already gave you one of my children! If you have failed to take care of it, it will find me. And then I'll find YOU!
Though I feel like tearing you apart, I can't even blame you. Still, if your world fails, I will make you suffer!
Are you here to bring one of my little darlings back to me?
Brilliant! Your world might actually avert my wrath. We will see.

We are creatures of power and knowledge. We are more diverse than you mortals will ever comprehend. The knowledge and wisdom we have gained in our long lives are paling your fleeting vision of what you think is the world.
Do you really think I have time to think about gods? I have hardly time for a spontaneous prayer that Zathroth may give me some spare time! ...
But I guess he is too busy and can't answer those prayers, so I take the matter into my own hands, just like mothers usually do.
I forbid my children to play there. With all those good-doers questing there, they might get hurt.
<Grumbles>
pages.title: Demon Mother

pages.name: Bezil
npc_lines: Hey Nezil, let's go to the Jolly Axeman Tavern after business is done.
Are you talking to me, Jogador?
Hiho, Bezil at your service, Jogador. We sell equipment of all kinds.
We sell equipment of all kind. Is there anything you need?
As you can see, we offer quite a lot, such as torches, shovels and the like. Ask me for a trade to have a look.
