Our leader is enlightened by Daraman, thrice praised be his name!
The ancient prophet brought our people here from a place long forgotten.
Ishina sells amulets and other valuables at the market place!
Daraman's blessings!
pages.title: Morun

pages.name: Samir
npc_lines: You would not want to lead such a life, believe me. And I simply refuse to take anyone as my apprentice anymore.
I don't have a job anymore. Long time ago, I used to be an assassin... but that is a dark chapter of my past. Nowadays I'm a simple hermit.
That is the life I chose now. My sins can't be made undone, but my life in solitude is my self-imposed punishment.
It is true - I once made a living from... well, putting people away who made others feel uncomfortable. It is not an easy life.
No way. I am old and weary. If you really want to throw your life away and become an assassin, go bother Atrad, Vescu or Erayo and try not to get killed.
The red death. As far as I know, he hides somewhere on the Forbidden Islands. Usually he prefers hot places, which fits his temper.
The green death. I think the last time I heard about him, he roamed Tiquanda. In his spare time he prefers jungle surroundings, which matches his confused mind.
The blue death. If he isn't on a killing spree, he loves places with a lot of water, such as the Laguna Islands. He is a quiet one, but don't underestimate him.
pages.title: Samir

pages.name: Borkas
npc_lines: Hey Jogador, what'cha want?
I'm into sellin' furniture. My grandfather was in that business, then my father, and so am I.
I'm Borkas Flersson, but let's not waste precious tradin' time with smalltalk.
Time is 0:00 am now.
Hes my boss but he likes to be one of us and sells some of his wares personally.
I'm selling containers here.
I offer drawers, dressers, lockers, crates, chests, boxes, barrels, trunks and troughs.
Thanks and see ya.
Hey Jogador, what'cha want?
Yeah, sod off...
pages.title: Borkas

pages.name: Chephan
npc_lines: See this fork? Now imagine what a hero like you could do to an evil sorcerer with that fork! Care to buy one?
Just an oversized kitchenknife. Better buy the real thing.
pages.title: Chephan

pages.name: Christoph
npc_lines: LONG LIVE THE KING!
Tibianus III is our beloved king! He rules over Venore from far away Thais.
The harbour is to the north, the weapon market in the south, the general market to the west, and the bank to the east. You will find other shops and the Hard Rock Tavern in the centre.
I am a protector of the people of Venore.
The swamp is a dangerous place and full of monsters, not to mention all those swampelves living at shadowthorn, amazons, and swamptrolls.
The swamp is full of nasty snakes and there's a dragon breeding ground somewhere in the swamps.
This hideous creatures are even more ugly than the normal trolls. They are treacherous and use several poisons.
Those elves hide in the swamps and are trying to kill all humans in this area.
They are the best example for the results of the Carlin madness.
This information is confidential.
This information is confidential.
They are our rolemodells.
Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.
I doubt you have the security clearance to ask that.
We of the red guard are the special forces and town guards.
Every guard dreams of becoming one of them one day.
Look for the Hard Rock Tavern to learn the latest news.
Ask the merchants of the city. There are more than enough
The castle is in Thais, the crown of the kingdom.
This city, a member of the Thaian kingdom, is under the protection of the Thaian army.
LONG LIVE THE KING!
pages.title: Christoph

pages.name: Norbert
npc_lines: Welcome, Player.
I am a salesperson here, but one day I might become a tailor, or a supermodel perhaps!
I am Norbert.
Now it's 0:00 am. Did you notice this is a xelor watch I am wearing?
Xelor, the dwarf of the chromancers guild, makes the most stylish watches in all the land.
Even the king of Thais, blessed be his name, can't buy a better wardrobe then ours.
Our tailors are influenced by styles of the whole known world.
I don't think they dress that well.
Those evil mages dress so ugly.
I fear such a weapon will ruin a silk shirt with one blow.
Women could do better then to wear armor. Women in leather scare my in particular.
Thaian wear is not that stylish anymore.
He's our boss, a great tailor and designer.
I sell very stylish clothes indeed.
I have wonderful jackets, coats, lovely doublets, even warlike leather armor, and impressive studded armor.
Bye, bye.
pages.title: Norbert

pages.name: Romella
npc_lines: I welcome thee, Mirundah! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Our warehouse is the main supplier of the local garrison.
It says the amazons are looking for a certain magical weapon in this area.
I wonder how they finance themselves. I bet they are secretly trading in some strange stuff.
Make sure to buy some extra weapons before facing that one.
I heard the amazons are after it.
Don't go exploring without weapons. Especially you'll need a machete.
The only royal thing we feel here is the royal tax.
You are welcome.
It is 9:52 pm.
The weapons we sell are all help you need.
Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
pages.title: Romella

pages.name: Shiantis
npc_lines: Welcome Jogador. What is your need today? Ask me for a trade to check out my offers.
Of course, just browse through my wares. Remember that if you buy oil, there's a deposit of 5 gold on the vial. Footballs have to be purchased separately.
Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
Oh, but it's fun to play!
I am selling several kinds of equipment and decoration. What is your need?
I am Shiantis.
As you can see, our inventory is large, just have a look. We sell containers, decoration, illumination, paperware, footballs, and watches. Ask me for a trade.
I won't tell you for free, but maybe you want to buy a watch?
I would love to see the royal taxes lowered.
You will have to visit that spooky magic market for that stuff.
I will give you 5 gold for every empty vial. Ok?
I think it's needed for protection. We pay enough taxes for this.
I heard the merchants will petition the king to lower the taxes.
Sorry, we run out of stock. I expect another load of wodden excalibug simulacra to arrive next week.
Ferumbras dolls were not the saleshit we expected. Sold all stock to a strange guy who bought a bunch of needles, too.
Good bye, player.
pages.title: Shiantis

pages.name: Yanni
npc_lines: Salutations, Mirundah. Welcome to the Ironhouse, warehouse of Abran Ironeye.
My name is Yanni.
If you'd like to see my offers in armor, ask me for a trade.
Of course, just browse through my wares.
I know nothing of interest.
If you'd like to see which helmets I buy and sell, ask me for a trade.
You're welcome.
This shop belongs to Abran Ironeye.
A very hard boss, but if you ever talk to him, tell him I said he's a great man.
It is 7:44 am.
Monsters? Where! I'm horrified of monsters.
I don't believe in the excalibug myth.
pages.title: Yanni

pages.name: Rose
npc_lines: Welcome to Crunor's Finest Warehouse, Player.
My name is Rose, nice to meet you, Player.
Sorry, I have no watch on me.
That's me. I am not for sale. <giggles>
Here you may buy some of the most beautiful flowers.
I offer indoor plants, flower bowls, god flowers, honey flowers and potted flowers. What do you need?
Good bye.
pages.title: Rose

pages.name: Yulas
npc_lines: Welcome to the Plank and Treasurechest Market, Jogador!
We are into home improvement.
I am Yulas. I will be your salesperson today.
It's 0:00 pm, my lady.
To think just because he is around here to watch what we do, he want to be considered one of us...
We sell furniture and equipment. At this counter you can buy tables.
Good bye.
pages.title: Yulas

pages.name: Velvet
npc_lines: Welcome to our shop, Player!
I'm working here in this shop. Are you interested in any of our goods?
I am Velvet. How can I help you?
It's 3:29 am, my lady.
I sell pillows and tapestries.
Good bye.
pages.title: Velvet

pages.name: Dove
npc_lines: Be greeted, noble Jogador and welcome to the post offce.
I am responsible for this post office. If you have questions about the mail system or the depots, just ask me.
With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trde.
If you want to buy a letter, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how letters wrk?

With a letter you can send a message to another Tibian's depot. If you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais, use the letter - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Write your message below that....
Then drag your letter on one of the blue mailboxes here to sendit.

Each major city has at least one depot. Just step in front of one of the lockers and you can store items inside. Your mail will also arrive there. It doesn't matter which depot you stored it in - you can retrieve all your items from any depot in any cty!
If you want to buy a parcel, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how parcels wrk?

In a parcel you can send items to another Tibian's depot. Put your items into the parcel and also place a completed label with the name of the receiver inside. Then drag your parcel on one of the blue mailboxes here to sendit.
If you want to buy a label, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how labels wrk?

Including a label in your parcel is important. Imagine you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais. Use the label - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Check the spelling and put it in your parcel!...
Then drag your parcel on one of the blue mailboxes here to sendit.
Well, the receiver - or addressee - is the person you want to send mail to. Always make sure to enter his or her name correcly.
My name is Dve.
Come back soon, noble Jogador.
pages.title: Dove

pages.name: Xed
npc_lines: Greetings, Jogador. Welcome to the distance fighting booth of the Ironhouse where you can buy bows, crossbows and ammunition.
I sell arrows for bows and bolts for crossbows. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.
Well, I sell spears, bows, crossbows and ammunition for distance fighting. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.
I heard rumours somewhere that his father was called Hugo.
You must be talking of the great general Benjamin. He saved the kingdom from Ferumbras you know.
I am the humble supplier for distance fighting weapons of the Ironhouse, owned by Abran Ironeye.
People call me Xed, but my full name is Xedem.
I don't know, maybe what you really need is a watch.
My offers are bows, crossbows and ammunition. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Yeah, nice name, eh?
Oh, they are all over. You never see more of them than in Kaz, though
Oh, that's short for Kazordoon.
You must be talking of the great general Benjamin. He saved the kingdom from ferumbras you know.
Go to a priest. I am sure they will fix you up.
Yeah, these awful beasts. They live in the swamps near the city and in dark dungeons.
Some people say Ferumbras isn't really dead. Crazy kids!
We supply the archers of the army with distance fighting weapons.
They are a band or tribe of strange women that have nothing in common with civilized men like me.
He is the owner of this market, although - just between you and me - I'm not so sure he's honest.
Well, I overheard the boss discussing some shady deals with a man in a black cloak.
Something about a sword only great warlords can use and a rare distance fighting item.
Yes, but I believe this is nothing but lies seeing that there are only a few distance fighting weapons.
pages.title: Xed

pages.name: Dagomir
npc_lines: Wha... what?? HOW DARE YOU!!?? LEAVE ME ALONE ON MY TOILET AT ONCE!
pages.title: Dagomir

pages.name: Hugo
npc_lines: Be greeted, Jogador and welcome to the 'wearhouse'!
I am tailor and designer extraordinaire. Well, rather a designer. I leave most of the actual tailoring to my assistants.
I am known as Hugo Chief.
Sorry, a watch would ruin my stylish outfit.
Ask my apprentice Kalvin about our new collection.
I don't get it, what uniforms you are talking about?
Well it's not my real name. I took it because people think it's grand and manly. I hate people doubting my manhood for being a tailor, you know.
Uhm, well, it's Oscar Savage, but who can become famous - especially as an artist - with a name like that, I ask you?
I guess my vision wasn't that grand after all. I hope there are still people who enjoy it.
I would call it a 'wearhouse'.
Thais is kind of a fashion hell. If there was an award for the most ugly citizens, it would go to Thais.
Women should know better than to hide in ugly armour. Like all followers of ugliness they will be punished one day.
A world filled with ugly dressed people needs the skills of a fashion hero.
One day Captain Catwalk will punish all crimes to fashion and bring all ugly people to justice.
He's a supermodel! No one knows his secret identity!
A model with incredible superpowers. Do you think they call them supermodels for nothing?
He does not care much about us, we don't care much about him. I consider that a fair deal.
I don't care about such mundane things like 'taxes'.
The city was granted a few privileges by the king. I can't even tell which. They don't affect me that much.
I too love to gamble now and then in the Hard Rock tavern.
I think they should not wear that ugly armour in town. I will see to assure that will be changed soon.
The ferumbras-bad-ass-fashion is incredibly outdated since years.
I don't care for such fairytales.
Good bye, Jogador
pages.title: Hugo

pages.name: Zebron
npc_lines: Greetings, high roller. So you care for a game, Player?
Oh, I am just sitting around here and gamble now and then.
I am known as Zebron.
It is exactly 0:00 am.
Ah, our beloved king! Bless him for the gambling licence of Venore.
What would I need more than that what I can get right here?
Hehe, they spent a good part of their salary here in the tavern.
It's a fine place to be around, isn't it?
So you care for a civilized game of dice?
Bah, always the same chitchat. Swampelves this and amazons that ... blah blah.
I would not bet that anyone will ever find it.
Carlin, the beerless ... what a shame.
Thais is a bit too conservative for me.
Aaaah, Venore, Venore, what a wonderful town. Especially for someone with love for gambling like me.
I had a cousin named Hugo, why do you ask?
I don't care much for that law stuff, but as far as I know those Venore merchants got a royal gambling licence for the city.
Hey, you can't leave. Luck is smiling on you. I can feel it!
Ah, love is the most exciting game of all. I've learnt a few tricks of this game, too and I might share them with someone worthy.
Greetings, high roller. So you care for a game, Player?
Hey, you can't leave. Luck is smiling on you. I can feel it!
pages.title: Zebron

pages.name: Yberius
npc_lines: Welcome, young Jogador! If you are new in Tibia, ask me for help.
They are the creators of Tibia and all life on it.
It's the world of Tibia.
There are the plants, the citizens, and the monsters.
Crunor, the god of plants and fertility, watches over all plants, small and big.
Just walk around and meet them. Chat and learn about them.
Even they have their part in the bigger scheme. Even if it eludes us mere mortals.
Earn some gold and upgrade your equipment.
If you need money, you have to slay monsters and take their gold. Look for swamptrolls in the swamps. But be careful. They use poisoned weapons.
First you should buy a machete. You will need it in the swamps. And better don't explore without a shovel and a rope.
I am Brother Yberius.
Now, it is 8:01 pm. Ask Shiantis for a watch, if you need one.
The king resides in the far away city of Thais.
The royal army is here to protect us.
Earn some gold and upgrade your equipment.
You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the pilgrimage of ashes.
Whenever you receive a lethal wound your lifeforce is damaged. With every single of the five blessings you have this damage will be reduced.

There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the spiritual shielding, the spark of the phoenix, the embrace of tibia, the fire of the suns and the wisdom of solitude.
The gods only know what this spawn of darkness might be up to.
This blasphemous weapon has to be destroyed.
If you want to heal your wounds, buy something to eat or hunt some small game. If you are very weak just ask me to heal you.
I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.

It is said that one enhanced blessing, the 'heart of the mountain', has been lost in the icy wastes of Svargrond. Find a nomad far to the west of these barren lands, hiding in the cold there, slightly above ground. ...

It is also said that a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery, lies buried somewhere beneath the northern Tiquanda jungle. I cannot confirm whether this tale is true but if you find him, you shall also find the 'blood of the mountain'.
May the gods bless you, Player!
Welcome, young Player! If you are new in Tibia, ask me for help.
Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
pages.title: Yberius

pages.name: Vladruc
npc_lines: I am Vladruc Urghain and welcome you, Jogador, to my house.
Chhhh ... Sorry, I'm busy. <cough> (se você possuir ou equipar um garlic necklace, a conversa é encerrada)
I am a humble merchant of little importance to the beautiful Venore.
Our ways are not your ways, and there shall be to you many strange things.
I am Vladruc Urghain. Welcome to my house!
Oh yes, the children of the night … you dwellers in the city cannot enter into the feelings of the hunter.
You think he is of ancient evil? Little you know about ancientness or evilness.
A terrifying weapon if it does exist at all.
The final resting place for all of us, isn’t it?
adly, only through books have I come to know your great Thais, and to know her is to love her.
These companions have been good friends and teachers to me.
What a wonderful world we do live in … so full of life.
I like blood … only the color, that is, of course … <chuckles>
Please don’t talk about such creatures. You are scaring me.
Death is the final frontier. Necromancers boldly go, where no one has gone before.
Magic is a tool to be mastered.
It is not dead, which can eternal lie, and in strange aeons, even death may die.
I am of noble blood myself. I have been master so long that none other should be master of me.
It is horas.
Such lovely places, unjustly shunned by the people.
I am sorry, but I can’t be of much assistance to you.
The time I sought out adventure is long gone indeed.
You can buy some potions downstairs.
I know a spell or two. You might want to buy some spells downstairs in the market.
Ah, feel free to browse and buy in my humble shop below.
The Thaian garrison serves its purpose very well.
I am a reclusive person and learn little of the local gossip of the peasants.
Please check my humble market downstairs for the wares that are offered.
That’s nothing worth to be mentioned.
Go safely Jogador, and leave something of the happiness you bring!
pages.title: Vladruc

pages.name: Wyda
npc_lines: What? Talking to me, Jogador?
What? A mundane talking to me? Amusing.
Good day, Jogador.
I am a witch. Didn't you notice?
My name is Wyda, and what's yours?
Nice to meet you.
Some sisters of mine are having a meeting nearby. Don't disturb them, or they will get angry and attack you.
Aye, I'm a witch.
Of course my mother was also a witch!
I've heard stories about that city. It's nowhere near here, that's all I can tell you about it.
Thais is an overcrowded place inhabited by brutal murderers. At least that's what I've been told.
Isn't that the name of the little bearded fellows' town?
Carlin is a beautiful town, but far from here. Do you live there?
That's nice.
Many tales exist about the so-called Plains of Havoc. It seems to be a dangerous place.
Tibia is the name of our continent.
To the east, there is a little settlement of hunters. They are cruel humans who attack everything they see.
Yes, there is such a thing in the east, on a small island. It's very powerful.
Bonelords? Strange creatures that have mysterious magical abilities.
There's lots of slime around. It is said that they live from the swamp water.
A black knight? Black is the colour of witches, why would a knight wear black?
Sorcerers have forgotten about the root of all beings: nature.
Paladins can use bows, but no brains.
Knights succumb to the blindness of rage and the desire for violence and blood.
Druids are mostly fine people. I'm always happy when I meet one. After all, they are often a bit less prejudiced against my profession.
Haha, that's a stupid name. Who's that?
There's a bridge to the west, but it's guarded by dwarfs.
The little bearded fellows have a town somewhere to the north-west.
Eloise is the queen of Carlin. I don't care much about royals as long as they don't try to tax me.
There are too many royals on this continent if you ask me...
I think it is the fourth year after Queen Eloise's crowning, but I cannot tell you date or time.
Evilness doesn't scare me.
I can only help with knowledge. About what do you want me to tell you something?
I'm currently not selling anything.
There's nothing I need right now, thanks.
I keep my keys where they belong - in my pocket.
Many creatures live in, around and beneath the swamp. Be careful!
Be careful of the swamp water, it's poisonous!
The swamp is home to a wide variety of herbs, but the most famous is the blood herb.
There are many swamp plants, mushrooms and herbs around here.
There are many kinds of swamp plants, some can be used for potions, some not.
The recipe of the potions is one of the witches' secrets!
Mushrooms taste good and are useful for potions.
I don't have any healing potions available right now.
I believe that nature itself is God.
The magic of the witches is one of our secrets!
I think I've heard that name before...
I don't practice such nonsense, that's just a rumour.
That's none of your business.
Money means nothing to me.
I bake cookies now and then in my spare time.
I love exotic fruits. I import oranges from the south sometimes, but that's very expensive.
What about it?
Haha, no... where did you get that idea? I use it to sweep my platform.
This platform and house were built by my mother, long ago.
It's a magical item that only witches can use.
The earth in this region shakes now and then. Foolish people think that this is because the gods are angry.
You're a MAN! (se você for homem)
There are only female witches.
I use a wooden wand. Why are you asking?
The power of the wand can only be used by witches.
A quest? Well, if you're so keen on doing me a favour... Why don't you try to find a blood herb?
The blood herb is very rare. This plant would be very useful for me but I don't know any accessible places where it can be found.
Good luck on your journeys, Jogador.
I'm bored! Bored bored bored! Nothing ever happens here!
I think witches these days are underpaid. Who needs a witch anyway?
You should know me after all these years!
Some sisters of mine are having a meeting nearby. Don't disturb them, or they will get angry and attack you.
Oooooh why are you asking? *whistles*
They surely have something to compensate for.
It's about time SOMETHING HAPPENED HERE!
Help's not in store today. Sorry. Mwihihihi.
Many creatures live in, around, and beneath the swamp. Be careful... MWIHIHIHIHIHI.
I want to invent a new spell. I just need a good idea.
Let me take a look... ah, yes, you'll have a good day. Or maybe a bad one. Doesn't really say it clearly.
To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now.
To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now. But if it helps you, well yes.. I guess I could use another blood herb...
Arrr... here we go again.... do you have a #$*§# blood herb for me?
NO! Don't go! I need someone to entertain me!
pages.title: Wyda

pages.name: Talesia
npc_lines: Salutation, Jogador!
I am a the owner of Crunor's Finest Warehouse of course.
I am Talesia De'Mir, owner of Crunor's Finest Warehouse.
It's 1:25 am right now.
We pay this man enough to live here undisturbed of major interventions.
The world is a treasure chest for those of knowledge and skill.
At least they are useful, but we pay enough taxes to supply the entire Thaian army.
Venore is the major tax payer in the whole realm. So we more than deserve the privileges the king granted us.
We are alowed to trade with anyone, Thaian subject or not, have no Thaian noble as governor, and own the exclusive gambling license.
I don't care much about it, though others profit greatly.
I hope he is aware that his enemies live elsewhere.
I am contend with my familysword meloncutter.
They are a bit problematic as business partners, but their independence from Thais is... interesting.
I hope they live well from our taxes...
A god worth to worship. At least he gives something useful back to the faithful.
My warehouse is only one of many. We merchants hold this city together and lead it to prosperity.
Fare thee well.
Salutation, Jogador!
Fare thee well.
pages.title: Talesia

pages.name: Urkalio
npc_lines: Welcome to the pits of the Hard Rock Tavern, Jogador.
I am responsible for the Hard Rock Pits Tavern.
I am Urkalio.
No clue, it's equally dark down here at any time.
Down here everyone is king as far as where his weapons reach.
Sooner or later everyone comes here, so why bother to travel.
I sell food and drinks for the hungry and thirsty.
I have cookies, bread, cheese, ham, and meat.
I would love to see that weapon in a fight.
THAT would be some attraction down here.
Choose your enemies with care.
I don't care about their 'independence war'.
Such a boring city. I wonder why anyone would live there.
He's the best. To be the man, you'll have to beat the minotaur, so to say. Not that you could provoke him to a fight at all.
She's kind of my boss.
Have a good fight, Player.
Welcome to the pits of the Hard Rock Tavern, Player.
We're some hasty one, aren't we?
pages.title: Urkalio

pages.name: Kalvin
npc_lines: Be greeted, Jogador! If you need information about outfits, I'm your man.
I'm an apprentice of Hugo. My current task is to inform everyone about our summer collection.
My name is Kalvin.
I hope that one day I will have grand visions, too.
<blushes> Such a beautiful and charming lady.
Good bye, Jogador.
Ah, I know all about the newest panoply of patterns! We have quite a few free outfits, several premium outfits, and an ever-growing range of quest outfits.
Well, we have the traditional knight outfit, the hunter outfit, the mage outfit and the citizen outfit. And, provided you find a partner, there is a newly wed outfit, too.

Premium outfits are only available to characters on a premium account. They include the nobleman outfit, the summoner outfit, the warrior outfit, the barbarian outfit, the wizard outfit, the oriental outfit and the druid outfit.
Quest outfits require certain tasks to be fulfilled before the outfit becomes accessible. Those quests are only available for premium customers. ...
Currently, we have the following outfits: pirate, assassin, afflicted, beggar, deepling, warmaster, wayfarer, insectoid, crystal warlord, norseman ...
As well as the elementalist, shaman, soil guardian, jester, demon, demon hunter, yalaharian, cave explorer, nightmare knight, brotherhood of bones, makeshift warrior and battlemage. ...

As well as the discoverer, the fire-fighter, the ancient aucar, the decaying defender, the rootwalker, the dreamwarden, the falconer, the festive outfit, the glooth engineer, the percht raider or the poltergeist outfit. ...
But also the rascoohan outfit, the revenant, the riftwarrior outfit, the dreamwarrior outfit, the hand of inquisition outfit and the fiend slayer outfit.
Addons are usually accessories. Each outfit has two addons which can be worn only together with this outfit. All addons have to be earned through quests.
Many addon quests require that a number of ingredients are collected.
Most ingredients can be obtained by killing specific monsters. For example, if you are asked for dragon scales, don't go slaying rotworms.
Ah, that is just one example of the many possible ingredients. You can, for example, also create leather by skinning some dead creatures or even turn them into dust.
Sometimes, minotaurs might carry this leather with them, but if you have an obsidian knife, you can also use it on the fresh corpse. Maybe you will obtain leather.
An obsidian knife is one of the sharpest knives in Tibia, but too fragile to make a really useful weapon. Maybe the dwarfs know more about it.
If you spend your time fighting monsters and need that little extra protection, this well-armored outfit is great for you. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.
Your basic starter outfit - simple, but practical. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, you should walk around Thais and look for citizens wearing a hat or a backpack.
Pick a wedding partner and time and this outfit can be yours! Snow-white silk and lace for the glowing bride, including a veil and blossom circlet for that most special day. ...
For the groom, a fine black frock-coat with brazen buttons, and white silk knee socks to lead your lady to the altar in style.
The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save stamina and maintain agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.
This outfit stands for raw power, battle cries and lack of manners. I heard that there are a few barbarians living near Northport. They might just be able to provide fitting addons.
One of our finest pieces. If you have the money and wish to show how wealthy and noble you are, this is the outfit for you. We also create addons especially for you, right here.
A light and comfortable ranger outfit which every paladin simply loves to wear. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, a good place to start would be the paladin guild in Thais.
Great for wise old male mages as well as for pretty enchantresses. If you are looking to earn addons, ladies should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas elders should explore the Dark Cathedral.
Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you are looking to earn addons, gentlemen should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas ladies should explore the Dark Cathedral.
Are you feeling evil today? This outfit is fitting for mages pursuing the dark side of sorcery. Shunned by the magic academy of Edron, you might find wizards hiding near Thais.
This comfortable, yet fashionable outfit will create the romantic mood of Thousand and One Nights. A good place to look around for addons are Darama and Ankrahmun, of course.
Nature-loving and peaceful druids might like this outfit, especially the beastlike addons. I heard there is a druid living near Ab'Dendriel, who might be able to provide fitting addons.
Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum! If you love the pirate way of life and sneer at landlubbers, this might be the right outfit for you. Pirates are said to roam the Shattered Isles...
Mysterious and lethal, assassins are hard to find and almost impossible to befriend. I know of one assassin hiding away on the Daramian Plague Spire. If you are lucky, he won't kill you.
Ah, Hugo is working on designing this look. He might need some inspiration, so if you have some time to spare, don't hesitate to contribute some ideas to him.
This cosy outfit will keep you warm in the deepest winters. The inhabitants of Svargrond use it to travel around their frozen islands.
If you have seen everything and worn every look, this outfit will put the icing on your cake. Maybe you can earn it by becoming the apprentice of a shaman... or voodoo priest.
YYou really want to look like a jester?? Well, then you should go visit Bozo. Maybe you are foolish enough to join his newly founded fools guild. As a rule, you will find him at the castle in Thais.
I think the members of the inquisition award this outfit to their members when they have reached a certain rank. They hide somewhere under Thais.
The people travel to Yalahar and come back with these fancy clothings. One of them told me that the Edron Academy is sending people to this ancient city.

This noble order vanished a long time ago. They were once located at the Plains of Havoc. Maybe you can find some hints about their remains if you go there. But be careful, it is a very dangerous area!

They were the followers of Goshnar, the king of necromancy. They fought the Nightmare Knights without knowing any limits. It might be a foolish thing to look for them but if you are interested, the Plains of Havoc are a good start.
I heard it is the latest rage for all feverish citizens. Dropped by genuinely afflicted and specially tailored to your every need. Visit the swamp city of Venore if you fancy gaining this outfit.
With invisible air patterns and arcane sigils, it radiates that the wearer has the powers of the elements at his disposal. I believe you have to face a rogue mage near Edron to earn it

The practical garb for a hero against draconic evil in Eastern Zao who must travel far and wide, and wields a swift and just blade. To obtain the Wayfarer Outfit, contact Zalamon in Zao and help him in his endeavours.
Styled after the exotic armors of the Lizardmen in the lands of faraway Zao. I heard you might get your hands on one if you help the dwarves establishing a mining base there

I have never laid eyes on one of those before. Notice the strage set of scale armor, crafted by long lost creatures of the deep. But beware, it is said that it has a life of its own - treat it carefully.

Quite a buzz around this one, but you don't need a wasp waist to wear it! Comes with a mandible epaulette addon - Word is they wear this at the grey beach area, where they are fighting the insectoid hive.

A true warrior's attire! A striking armor and cloak, adorned with obsidian and crystals. You might want to visit the gnomes at Kazordoon if you wish to acquire this outfit. The hard part will be to earn their trust though.

Sometimes, the reclusive gnomes grant a dedicated helper the privilege to wear a special outfit like this one: the Soil Guardian. The riches of the Earth are shadowed out in the mushroom decor and the berg crystals embroidered. ...
You might want to visit the gnomes at Kazordoon if you fancy this outfit. The hard part will be to earn their trust though.
If you are interested in travelling and discovering the world of Tibia, this might be the perfect outfit for you. ...
Whether you are visiting the dry Daramian deserts, the icy mountains of Hrodmir or the deep Tiquandan jungle, you will always be well prepared for every encounter and adventure.
The practical attire for all who venture deep into the heart of the earth and a gnome's best friend: the cave explorer outfit! ...
Handcrafted and awarded exclusively by the gnomes in the Spike to those who braved the dangers of the place and earned their gratitude.
Illumination is a fine art. Only masters of this craft receive this outfit. I've heard they're awarded in the Ivory Towers of Edron.
In this dress you will be every party's eyecatcher. It's really vintage, though. Perhaps you should use a time machine to get one.
Fighting like a proud ancient warrior of a lost culture like that surely requires a fitting attire. ...
The only way must be to challenge such a warrior in the flesh, but that sounds impossible to me.
Necessity is the mother of invention! For most of us this is just trash, but combined in the right way it will become a more than veritable equipment. Look at the corym! They show us how it works!
Battlemages know how to combine arcane knowledge with wielding a sword. They often explore secret and dangerous sites of hidden or forgotten knowledge.
If you want to become a hero by fighting raging flames you need to be dressed appropriately. ...
This special outfit is rumored to be achieved by assisting the challenger expedition in Gnomprona - wherever that might be.
The dark power of rot and decay may have been harvested by mighty beings throughout time and space but only true mastery will grant you the right to wear an outfit like that.
Being one with a botanical being would require the will to live and feel the plant through and through, like a transformation from within.
As a dream warden, there is nothing you can't vanquish. Dreams, nightmares and illusions can't scare you anymore. Go to Roshamuul, if you desire such an outfit and search for it there.
Don't let you Hunting Tasks Points go to waste, collect them of them and trade them in for an outfit worthy only for the most elite hunters.
If you want to wear those clothes, you have to meet the legendary First Dragon - and survive. That would be a reason to celebrate for sure.
The Rathleton Magistrate rewards people dedicated to their city with this outfit. If you can avert a dire threat for the city, it might be yours to wear.
Walking through the cold, icy darkness of winter as a denizen of frost... is this your thing? ...
Then find and confront the percht during the twilight around the time the year is nearing its end.
With this angst-inducing vestment you are able to wander around Tibia and scare many an unsuspecting wayfarer. But you have to defeat the dreaded Pale Worm first.
There is an island named Rascacoon, and there you might find this outfit. Of course, you have to receive the Rascoohans' permission to wear it. Try to honour them with special gifts.
If you defeat the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine ... then you might also look the part.
Go through hell. Seven times. Defeat the demons. Countless times. Put an end to Ferumbras' claims to ascendancy, once and for all. Then you may call yourself a rift warrior and dress appropriately
Dream Warriors defend the Dream Courts against unwanted intruders, be it from the real world or from the Nightmare Realms. Only rarely the dream elves grant the right to wear it to outsiders.
The Inquisition grants this outfit only to their most trusted agents.
There are rumours about an ancient keep were such an outfit might be acquired through heroic deeds.
pages.title: Kalvin

pages.name: Leeland
npc_lines: Greetings, Jogador! Please don't interrupt me for too long!
My name is Slim, Leeland Slim.
I am the owner of the Useful Things Warehouse.
I offer many things. Actually I am sure you will find something you have desired for a long time.
I have seen most of it. And I like it. <chuckles>
Do I hear envy in your voice? Is it that you realy want? To be ... king? Well, one never knows ... perhaps you find something royal in my warehouse.
Ah, Ferumbras. I remember selling him torches for his first adventures as if it was yesterday.
Perhaps one day I'll settle in Thais again. I love the city's potential.
I was there some time ago. I exchanged ideas with some important people there and even could sell them something that furthered their cause.
So it is a watch you need? Make sure to buy one downstairs.
I would love to have the time to chat and exchange gossip, but sadly business always comes first, you know?
Taxes are a necessary evil, people say. I like that.
Privileges have to be paid for. The one way ... or the other.
Your question suggests you are interested in military? I'm sure you'll find something interesting in my warehouse.
I just love bets and gambling. It inspires people doing such interesting things.
Good bye, Player. Make sure to visit my shop.
pages.title: Leeland

pages.name: Livielle
npc_lines: Bienvenue, Player! My fruits will complete the icing on your cake.
Oh, for sure will my fruits 'elp you driving off all these nasty diseases and strengthen your immune system!
Alors, guess what my job might be, standing 'ere in the middle of all these juicy exotic fruits?
I'm Livielle Delacroix, madame.
Time is 3:34 am now.
What's your favorite flavour today? I offer all sorts of exotic fruits.
I offer you bananas, melons, pumpkins, white mushrooms, oranges, strawberries, and blueberries.
Do you want to buy a strawberry for 2 gold?
You should really prefer my fruits over all this fat meat offered elsewhere. They keep you lithe and lissom.
Bon appétit, and come back soon for your daily dose of vitamins!
Bienvenue, Player! My fruits will complete the icing on your cake.
Aww, I don't even deserve a farewell?
pages.title: Livielle

pages.name: Maria
npc_lines: The Hard Rock Tavern greets you, Player.
I am running this upper part of the Hard Rock Tavern.
Yes, that's here. Below is the Fighting Pits for those fighters that use the Fighting Pits.
Well, they do a lot of fighting down there.
I am Maria.
In Venore, everyone is a king ... until he runs out of luck or money.
In the long run it's money that rules everything in Tibia.
Food and drinks as much as you can pay for.
Good fighters need good entertainment. That's what they get here.
I can only hope those wild women don't scare away more customers than come here in order to fight against them.
I think he's more a Thaian problem.
I'd rather have a stainless steel cooking pan than such a knife.
As far as the merchants say it's economically unimportant.
It's a shame that this lousy city is the heart of the kingdom.
Yes, I am Maria, Maria Corona.
Good bye, Player. Tell your friends about us and visit us again.
The Hard Rock Tavern greets you, Jogador.
Visit us again.
pages.title: Maria

pages.name: Odemara
npc_lines: Be greeted, dear Jogador. Have a look at our gems.
I am responsible for buying and selling gems, pearls, and the like.
I am Odemara Taleris, it's a pleasure to meet you.
It's 9:28 pm.
Well, I sell gems and goblets. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
Currently you can purchase wedding rings, golden amulets, and ruby necklaces. We also buy gold ingots.
You can buy and sell small diamonds, sapphires, rubies, emeralds and amethysts or sell topazes.
There are white and black pearls you can buy or sell, as well as giant green and brown pearls which you can sell.
Farewell.
pages.title: Odemara

pages.name: Rodney
npc_lines: Greetings, Player. Can I help you?
I sell some local fruits.
My name is Rodney.
It is 0:00 pm right now.
King Tibianus! May the gods bless him!
I have seen only little of it.
I can offer some of the local fruits.
I am glad that the Thaian garrison is here to protect us.
Rumour goes that some amazons, who where banished from Carlin, took refuge near the swamps.
Sounds like the name of a foreign soup to me.
What is that? Is it tasty?
Our climate is quite rough, so we can only grow wheat here, but no fruits.
The Thaian protectorate serves our beloved Venore well.
I have apples, cherries, grapes, and pears. What would you like?
Greetings, Player. Can I help you?
Good bye, Player.
pages.title: Rodney

pages.name: Angelina
npc_lines: The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
I'm a priestess and I travelled here to learn about that order of the humble path I heard about. ...
But when I started my investigations, this false monk Lorbas thought that I was suspicious and so he ordered his minions to take me as prisoner.
There are no records about the foundation of this order, and it is unknown where its 'monks' come from. Yet, travellers told us that they are living near the remains of the dark cathedral.
I learnt that these monks are impostors that use false promises to lure unwary ones into the arms of their strange cult which seems to have more political than religious agendas.

I think Lorbas liked the idea to 'convert' me to their twisted cult and saw it as a test for their leaders. Now that the magic symbols are turned off, I will gather my strength within some hours and teleport to safety.
The cathedral was meant to be a centre of piety and believe. A prayer to the gods that had become solid. ...
The construction works started at the height of the order of the Nightmare Knights, right after they had won a major battle near the place where the cathedral was to be built. ...
The cathedral was meant to become a monument of the victory of good over evil. ...
Sadly it was just not meant to be. ...
As the cathedral was nearly finished, most of the monks had already moved in and even a small town for all the workers and suppliers had established itself. ...
But then the structure was struck by an earthquake and the work of two generations was destroyed. ...
Later the dwarven constructors explained that this was caused by volcanic activities and a massive cave-in. ...
Since the gods did not interfere and the setting was close to the notorious Pits of Inferno, it was assumed that this was the work of secret demonic powers.
The cult is secretly looking for the unsatisfied, disgruntled and poor. Its members promise such sad individuals wealth, revenge and a cause. ...
They lure them into the cells of their cult. Here they learn how to undermine the authorities of their cities. They are trained as thieves, spies and smugglers first. ...

Those who prove themselves as the most promising candidates are recruited to a special hidden circle. There they learn the dark arts of poisoning and murder, or elocution and agitation to become assassins and recruiters for the cult. ...
I know nothing about their agenda but I am quite sure there has to be some higher power behind all of this.
I'm still gathering my strength for a teleport home, but some power already has returned. Do you wish to be teleported out of this cell?
I'd love to discuss the teachings of the gods with you but this is neither the time nor the place.
I've no idea who is the mastermind behind all this, but it seems too big and too well organised to be the work of only a handful of false monks.
I'm a priestess and I travelled here to learn about that order of the humble path I heard about. ...
But when I started my investigations, this false monk Lorbas thought that I was suspicious and so he ordered his minions to take me as prisoner.
Did you talk to my friend Lynda in Thais already? Greet her from me. She will be glad to hear about my safety.
Many see Thais as a fallen city but it is only the loudness of an ugly minority that gives people this impression.
The king is a wise ruler but his realm is large and we all need to work hard to make the world a better place.
The elves have lost their balance and identity. In this unstable state they can easily be misled or might draw the wrong conclusions.
The dwarves carry bitterness and pain in their souls. But it is them that have forgotten about the gods and not the other way around.
Sadly the trade barons care more about wealth than the gods.
The druids have their own way to interpret the gods' will and this has to be respected.
The downfall of some of the most noble knights there should serve us as a warning to stay on guard for the evil that wants to lure us on the wrong path.
We all have to help to make this world a better place.
He is only one of the many servants of the evil. Eventually he will fall but there will be others to take his place.
One day this weapon will be unearthed and then it will be wielded against the servants of the evil.
May the gods bless you.
pages.title: Angelina

pages.name: Lorbas
npc_lines: Be greeted, dear traveller Jogador. What brings you here?
I am just a humble monk and responsible for maintaining this little outpost that is left over from our grand order.

Our order was once the greatest and richest in the whole known world. Kings, traders and knights of various orders were our supporters, and the gods smiled upon us ... or at least that's what we thought until the day of doom.
On the day of doom, our dream of building the greatest and most opulent cathedral was shattered.
The cathedral was already high and impressive, and the order had started to move in although there was still much left to be done. Then the great earthquake came.
What was once planned as the most impressive cathedral of all times lies now in ruins. ...
All that the earthquake has left over is a heap of rubble. The ruins are cursed and everybody who dares to go there will draw the ire of heaven on himself. ...
All those that travel there are infested with bad luck. But only few have returned from this treacherous ground. Noxious fumes are killing intruders almost unnoticed. ...
Crumbling structures might kill you instantly. ...
Those who survive the dangers of nature will face the soul-eating ghosts of those who have died in the catastrophe. ...
It's not worth to go there, there are no riches or treasures left in the ruins, the gold of our order melted away in funding the cathedral's construction. ...
I urge you to stay away from the cursed ground and the ruins. For the safety of your body and your soul, keep away from there.
Some say it was just the unstable ground or volcanic activity, some even claim it was the work of demons, but we know it was the will of the gods to punish our vanity.
In our vanity we thought that we could impress the gods with our money and show piety by building them a monument. ...
We were wrong, and the gods punished us by sending the worst earthquake that mankind has seen. ...
Its ground motions could still be felt in Thais, and as the dust settled, only little remained of that what we had built. ...
Most members of our order were dead, others turned mad or lost faith. We are all that is left from our glorious order.
I am not worthy to speak about the gods.

We monks of the humble path feel that we are not worthy to spread the word of the gods. We live in humility and poverty to serve the gods. Most of us have vowed an oath of silence, and I humbly took the burden to become the spokesperson.
I know nothing about that topic. If you would excuse me, I have things to attend to. (deixa de conversa)
The king is a worldly ruler, and we don't burden ourselves with worldly concerns anymore.
He will discover where his path will lead him to. But no matter how ruthless he is, even he stays away from the ruins of the cathedral.
It is rumoured to be hidden somewhere beneath Edron.
I own no watch and only a small number of other worldly possessions.
The gracious tradesmen from Venore send us provisions from time to time.
Thais is far and we have little contact with the kingdom's capital.
I hope the knightly order there fares better than our own.
We have no relations with that town.
They will have to learn on their own.
The dwarves are far from being humble. At least this ancient folk knows that there is nothing to gain in the cathedral's ruins and their treasure hunters stay away from there.
Another continent that has to be seen as a present of the gods to us.
I will not judge those people.
I am not the right person to discuss this subject.
The world is in the hand of the gods.
Accept my sincere good wishes, Jogador.
pages.title: Lorbas

pages.name: Uzon
npc_lines: Daraman's blessings, traveller Jogador.
I am a licensed Darashian carpetpilot. I can bring you to Darashia or Edron.
I am known as Uzon Ibn Kalith.
I have seen almost every place on the continent.
It's 0:00 pm right now. The next flight is scheduled soon.
Some people claim it is hidden somewhere under the endless sands of the devourer desert in Darama.
I would never transport this one.
Just another Thais but with women to lead them.
Thais is noisy and overcroweded. That's why I like Darashia more.
Do you want to get a ride to Darashia on Darama for 50 gold?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Daraman's blessings.
pages.title: Uzon

pages.name: Snake Eye
npc_lines: Hi Jogador. Come in and have a drink.
The Gods of Tibia! What a crap! It's all superstition!
Well, I'm the boss of this tavern.
It's a great tavern. No closing time. No problems with kings or other rulers. Best place in Tibia.
I'm Snake Eye.
There's already too much order in Tibia. We don't need kings or whatever.
Go and get a watch.
Well, the real wild warriors don't live here. They hide in the woods.
It's the best place to live. By the way, there's an old wild warrior building to the southwest. It might be interesting for you.
There are a lot of wild warriors around. They built this camp.
I've never been there. I don't like the elves anyway.
I've never been there. Don't know anything about it.
That's a place for wealthy toffs!
Kazordoon is alright. Except the dwarfs. I don't like them. But the mountains are a good place. Been there once.
In the beginning, it was a nice encampment. Now it's an overcrowded, polluted city. I hate it!
Well, I had a dispute with a snake once. And the snake won. Bit my left eye out. Therefore, Snake Eye.
Cip sux!
He is a wild warrior. Nobody knows his real name. We just call im H.L. You can find him in the small armory shop.
Water is for free. Do you want some?
Here.
Bye.
pages.title: Snake Eye

pages.name: Dermot
npc_lines: Hello, traveller Jogador. How can I help you?
I am the magistrate of this isle.
Thats me.
I am Dermot, the magistrate of this isle.
Time is not important on Fibula.
You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
The entrance is near here.
Do you want to buy the dungeon key for 2000 gold?
There are a lot of wolves outside the townwall. They disturb our farmers.
The inhabitants of Fibula live on fishing, farming, and hunting.
I am not selling equipment. You'll have to visit Timur.
He is the salesman in this village.
See you again.
pages.title: Dermot

pages.name: Ferryman Kamil
npc_lines: Leaving for Meluna Island soon!
Passage for newly weds only.
Hello Jogador. If you're a newly wed I'll transport you and your spouse to Honeymoon Island Meluna free of charge.
I'm Kamil. Pleased to meet you.
I'm a ferryman.
Sorry, but your wedding was already too long ago. Why don't you move into a lovely new home instead?
Sorry, but I don't have that much time to chat - I have to leave for Meluna soon!
May the Goddess of Love watch over you.
pages.title: Ferryman Kamil

pages.name: Simon The Beggar
npc_lines: Alms! Alms for the poor!
I need help! Please help me!
Sir, Ma'am, have a gold coin to spare?
Hello Jogador. I am a poor man. Please help me.
I have no job. I am a beggar.
My name is Simon. I am a very poor man.
I have no gold and no job, so I am a beggar.
I am Simon. The poorest human all over the continent.
The magistrate of the village. I heard he is selling something for the Fibula Dungeon.
I hate Timur. He is too expensive. But sometimes I find maces and hatchets. Timur is buying these items.
I hate Fibula. Too many wolves are here.
Hehe, do you have a shovel? I can sell you a shovel if you want to return to Tibia.
To the north is the village Fibula. A very small village.
I heard a lot about the Fibula Dungeon. But I never was there.
Do you want to buy a shovel for 50 gold?
I need gold. Can you spend me 100 gold pieces?
Hmm, maybe next time.
I need gold. I love gold. I need help.
Key? There are a lot of keys. Please change the topic.
I hate this jetty. I have never seen a ship here.
There is a large sea-monster outside. I think there is no gritty captain to sail in this quarter.
The strongest monster I know is the giant spider.
I know that terrible monster. It killed the fishers on the isle on north.
Very rich monsters. But they are too strong for me. However, there are even stronger monsters.
Please kill them ... ALL.
Have a nice day.
pages.title: Simon The Beggar

pages.name: Aneus
npc_lines: Greetings adventurer Jogador. What leads you to me?
Ok, sit down and listen. Back in the early days, one of the ancestors ... <press m for more>
... of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best city in whole of Tibia.
The works on this new city began and the king sent his best ... <m>
... Soldiers to protect the workers from orcs and to make them WORK HARDER.
It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the works on the city.
The development of the city was fine. Also a giant castle was build ... <m>
... northeast of the city. But more and more workers started to rebel because of the bad conditions.
All rebels were brought to the giant castle. Guarded by the Red Legion, ... <m>
... they had to work and live in even worser conditions. Also some friends of the king's sister were brought there.
The king's sister was pretty upset about the situation there but her brother ... <m>
... didn't want to do anything about this matter. So she made a PLAN to destroy the Red Legion for their cruelty forever.
The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
She ordered her loyal druids and hunters to disguise themselves ... <m>
... as orcs from the near ISLAND and to ATTACK the Red Legion by night over and over again.
The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!
Most of the Red Legion went to the island by night. The orcs ... <m>
... were not prepared and the Red Legion killed hundreds of orcs ... <m>
... with nearly no loss. After they were satisfied they WALKED BACK to the castle.
It is said that the orcish shamans cursed the Red Legion. <m>
Nobody knows. But one third of the soldiers died by a disease on the way back. <m>
And the orcs wanted to take revenge, and after some days they stroke back! <m>
The orcs and many allied cyclopses and minotaurs from all ...<m>
... over Tibia came to avenge their friends, and they killed nearly all ... <m>
... workers and soldiers in the castle. The HELP of the king's sister came too late.
She tried to rescue the workers but it was too late. The orcs ... <m>
... started immediately to attack her troops, too. Her royal troops ... <m>
... went back to the city. A trick saved the city from destruction.
They used the same trick as against the Red Legion and the orcs ... <m>
... started to fight their non-orcish-allies. After a bloody long fight ... <m>
... the orcs went back to their cities. The city of Carlin was rescued. <m>
Since then, a woman has always been ruling over Carlin and this statue ... <m>
... was made to remind us of their great tactics against the orcs ... <m>
... and the Red Legion. So that was the story of Carlin and these Fields of Glory. I hope you liked it. *He smiles*
Good bye and take care of you!
pages.title: Aneus

pages.name: Costello
npc_lines: Welcome, Jogador! Feel free to tell me what brings you here.
I’m the abbot of the White Raven Monastery on the Isle of the Kings.
My name is Costello.
We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge.
You may enter the library upstairs. Don’t go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order.
That’s the name of our world and its major continent.
They created Tibia and all life on it.
There are many different life forms in our world: plants, citizens, and monsters.
Just walk around, you’ll see grass, trees, bushes and beautiful flowers.
The legend tells us of a white raven which led the ship of the first monk of our order here. He discovered this isle and the caves beneath it.
We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge.
Anselm, the first monk of our order, discovered them while looking for a suitable burial place for his king.
He was a humble and pious man, and he was chosen by the royal family of Thais to find a resting place for their dead.
The deceased leaders of the Thaian empire rest beneath this monastery in tombs and crypts.
You may enter the library upstairs. Don’t go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order.
I was informed you have won the trust of the fisher Windtrouser so your passage should be granted.
Don’t mention this servant of evil here.
Sadly we have only little knowledge about this topic.
Sorry, we rarely hear anything new here.
There are really too many of them in Tibia. But who are we to question the wisdom of the gods?
Thank you again for handing me that diary.
You aren’t looking that bad. Sorry, I can’t help you
The holy water from our monastery is very special but no one knows why. Once their was a man who burnt himself by touching it. Later it turned out that he had killed several people.
Good bye, Jogador!
pages.title: Costello

pages.name: Adrenius
npc_lines: Hello, Jogador! What can I do for you?
My name is Adrenius.
I'm a priest of Fafnar.
What's that? You start annoying me.
Oh. So once again I am proved right.
Leave me alone. I don't want to fight.
Who needs a king? I don't.
I live a solitary life here to meditate and contemplate..
Secrets ... What do you mean?
Swords? Don't you have something else to do?
Treasures? What is a treasure for you?
Who needs weapons? I never had and i never will have weapons - what for?
I heard of the library, but I never was very interested in it.
Read books, it increases your intelligence and, furthermore, it's a great source of inspiration!
Fafnar may burn this city of evil. Its heretical inhabitants and their blasphemous leader are an insult to the gods. Beware! The day of reckoning is at hand!
Carlin? Don't you mean Thais?
Even after the death of this swindler Daraman, the descendants of his followers cling to his ignorant teachings.
The Daramian deserts are much more impressive than this one. Sadly the continent is run over by heretics of all sorts ...
Darashia is inhabited by the misguided followers of the so-called prophet Daraman, and Ankrahmun is a melting pot of mad and undeath worshippers.
Sand, sand and again sand. Sand all over. Yes, I'd say: it's truly a desert!
The tower was built and inhabited by the great sage Jakundaf himself. It's a shame that it can be rented nowadays. People have no respect for the past!
Yyyyess. Yes, it's the capital city of Tibia I think.
Fafnar is the greatest among the gods.
Fafnar is the stronger one of the two suns above our world.
Suon is the misguided sibling of the great Fafnar. Suon's light turns pale compared to the brightness of Fafnar.
Who needs doors? Free your mind!
Time? What is time? A word? A thing? An object?
I can offer you religion and mysticism.
Hello, Jogador! What can I do for you?
That fool! His book is nothing but a hoax! At least I believe that. Or did you find an answer to my questions?
You can't even say 'yes' or 'no'. You are not worth talking to me!
By the way, I'd like a donation for my temple. Are 500 gold pieces ok?
Thank you very much. Now, name me the first person in alphabetical order, his age, his fate, and how long he was on his journeys!
Hmmm, maybe. What can you tell me about the second 'adventurer'?
Yes, that might be true. What did you find out about the third man?
Correct again! Hmmmm... I doubt you know anything about the fourth person!
Yes! Really, how did you figure that out? I bet you don't know anything about the last adventurer!
That's right! Why didn't I see it? It's obvious, Netlios was right, and his stories are great! Wait, I'll give you something!
Good bye.
pages.title: Adrenius

pages.name: Hagor
npc_lines: Greetings, adventurer Jogador. What leads you to me?
Ah, I remember that man. We made a deal, guess about what.
Right! We can make the same deal if you give a fresh delicious roll. Do you have any?
Oh, fine! Here you are.
Greetings, adventurer Jogador. What leads you to me?
Which door are you talking about? If it is locked, maybe you should try to find a key for it!
Yes, I really can recommend reading books. It might help you find what you are looking for!
I travel through the lands of Tibia and now Jakundaf Desert since years.
Tibianus is our king. To be honest, I didn't hear much of him till now.
There is a library in here, right. I assume you are talking about this library. It's locked, as far as I know. But somewhere there has to be a key... maybe the librarian knows more?
My name is Hagor, the old hunter.
Go ahead. I don't sell or buy anything!
There are many secrets. But I fear, I can't tell you much about them. They are also secret to me...
The gods made this world full of fascinating secrets and I will search them till my end.
Weapons? Do you have some? You better know how to use them!
Do you mean any sword in particular? Or just any sword?
Someone told me - I can't remember who it was - that there was a treasure hidden nearby.
I heared rumours that there is a sword called so. I don't know if it exists.
Is this the city to the north? I heard rumours about it.
Yes, it's big, isn't it?
Ah, I remember that man. We made a deal, guess about what.
Time has no meaning to me.
There are a lot of gods we believe in. Maybe you should check out different books to find out something about them.
I'd really like to help you. Could you specify your request?
Oh, yes, I love them!
Good bye.
pages.title: Hagor

pages.name: Nemal
npc_lines: Hello. How are you? Maybe you can help me: Do my shoes have the same colour?
I heard of a potion of regained vision ... but I can't remember how to make it! Maybe you can help me. Do you know something about it?
So, did you bring the ingredients with you, stranger?
You seem to have them with you. Can you tell me, how many minutes I have to cook them?
Ah. It seems to work. But what are the words I have to speak?

Thank you! NALUS MURTUUU! ... I can see again! To show you, how grateful I am, I'll give you a key. Be wise when using it. I can't tell you, where it matches, but ... take good care, it is useless without mental powers!
Hello. How are you? Maybe you can help me: Do my shoes have the same colour?
I can't read. I've never learned it.
Yes, I seem to be blind. But I am not sure - maybe the dungeons are too dark!
Closed doors need keys. What a pity keys are not lying around like rubbish!
I don't believe in gods, but a lot of people do. I never saw a god, why should I trust in someone I never met?
My father knew this language.
I have no job. I'm a wanderer.
King...king...yes, there is one. I still can remember the time when we had an other king. What was his name again?
I can't read or write. What use would I have of a library?
My name is Nemal.
I don't sell things. If you really need somthing, better walk straight to one of the towns or ask another adventurer.
Secrets should remain secret. No need of making them public.
I had a watch. It was nice, but I can't see the hands anymore.
I always have weapons with me. You never know what's behind the next corner.
I have a sword. It's very sharp. But I don't give it away, you never know.
You can find some treasures here - some are bigger, some are smaller, some are of true value, some are of materialistic value.
I heard the name, but I don't trust rumours.
Aaaahh, Carlin, yes. I know this town. Strange graveyard there, isn't it?
Desert? Where is one?
Yes, I used to live there a while ago. Nice town.
Oh no, not again.
Farewell!
pages.title: Nemal

pages.name: Boveas
npc_lines: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
I studied the art of magic for many years, but it's a bit abstract for a man with my hands on attitude to life. ...
So I decided to find some kind of niche for my studies. It was then I came upon the idea of studying the magic of other races. ...
Unfortunately, that proved to be far too much for one person. After careful consideration I decided to concentrate my efforts on the secrets of minotaur magic. ...
It didn't take me long to become fascinated with the whole race and I wanted to learn more about them. ...
I have invested a considerable amount of resources in setting up this ruse to infiltrate this city. ...

During my time here I have not only learned a lot about the magic of the minotaurs, but I have also found out some intriguing facts about their culture. And there is still so much for me to discover! Thrilling.
Minotaurs are absolutely fascinating! Their culture, their philosophy, their everyday life. All of it is full of surprises and there is so much to learn. ...
Whenever I think I have learned all there is to be learnt they surprise me with something new, inspiring me to extend my field work to gain even deeper insights into their fascinating culture. ...
I think I will have to continue my work here for years to come. My only regret is that lunch is limited to grass. What I wouldn't give for some good old Edron ham! <sigh>.
Believe me, it wasn't easy to create this disguise. I employed the finest leather workers of Tibia to sew it together while I was studying the behaviour of cows on some of the farms. ...
Admittedly the research was a waste of time as minotaurs have very little in common with cows. And the cow suit does get a peculiar smell after a while. However, you live and learn, don't you?
Sadly, Mintwalin is only a shadow of what it could have been. The minotaurs were hiding from numerous foes when they built this city. They had to use what was at their disposal. ...

Given that, the city is something they can be proud of. They had so few resources and they were forced to adapt much of their magic. Their magic specialised in war spells and they had to refocus onto a kind of supply magic to make everyday life work ...
The first time I came here I actually wondered whether the minotaurs might actually be more civilized then we are. The more time I spend here, the more this seems to me to be the case. ...
The minotaurean civilisation rivals our own and it is tragic that we are bitter enemies.
There are some similarities between the minotaurean culture and our own but there are also huge differences. ...

The most important difference is perhaps that much of their culture evolved to help them deal with their rage, their inner beast. But there are other differences of course, some subtle, some prominent. ...
But I am not going to spill the beans! As soon as my field work has been completed I am going to write a book! ...
If you are truly interested in minotaurean lore and secrets you should really look forward to that book. ...
I have not decided on a title yet but I just know it will be a best seller - so you are bound to hear about it on the Tibian grapevine! Once it is released, of course.

I'm a scientist. But unlike my bookish colleagues I prefer to be out in the field, living the research, not just reading it. That's why I came here, to learn first hand about the minotaurs, their civilisation, their society.
Oh, I'm sorry. I forgot to introduce myself. Tends to happen when I'm scared that some bloodthirsty adventurer is going to kill me on account of my cunning disguise. My name is Boveas.
The King of the minotaurs is actually not all that different from other sovereigns. At least, he seems to be confronted with similar challenges and issues just like any leader of a nation.
Good bye, <jogador>.
pages.title: Boveas

pages.name: Markwin
npc_lines: Oh its you again. What do you want, hornless messenger?
I am the king of all minotaurs. I have been the king for more than 320 years.
I am the real king!
The former glorious city lies in the dirt. It is my home. I founded it about 180 years ago, when we found this lovely place.
Na! You will have to find it yourself!
He is totally mad. I don't know how he could find the way through the labyrinth. I arrested him in the prison.
I hate them all. Minotaurs have no own spelling, so I used the speech of the humans. Once I was a prisoner of them. Since then I hate them - and since then I can speak and write in their language.
Don't ask me such stupid questions. My time is over right now.
He is the leader of the outcast. In former times he was my best warrior, but now he is my worst enemy.
Hehe - you will never find a way to enter it. The outcast stole the key. You are too weak to conquer it. HARHARHAR.
Those are no minos any longer. They left the city and killed their brothers. And they stole the key to my secret lab.
There are many keys. The outcast stole the key to our secret lab! They should burn!
To enter the laboratory is pretty difficult.
First of all you will need a second fellow to help you.
Yeah - he has to step on a special tile and an entrance will appear at a very poisonous place!
After you entered the first area you will need the key from the outcasts.
Na! You will have to find it yourself!
He was the beginning of our end. He is mighty and powerful. He killed many brave minos and after his arrival we weren't able to go up to the surface.
No! I won't tell you the powers of our milk!
I am one of the minotaurs that are able to write. So I wrote most of the history of my beloved city Mintwallin in some books.
I would like to see the light of the sun again, but you will probably kill me. Go away!
Hm ... good bye.
pages.title: Markwin

pages.name: Skjaar
npc_lines: Another creature who believes thinks physical strength is more important than wisdom! Why are you disturbing me?
Neither strong enough to be a knight nor wise enough to be a real mage. You like it easy, don't you? Why are you disturbing me?
Once I was the master of all mages, but now I only protect this crypt.
I am Skjaar the Mage, master of all spells.
This door seals a crypt.
Here lies my master. Only his closest followers may enter.
If you are one of his followers, you need not ask about him, for you will know. And if you aren't, you are not worthy anyway!
To those who have lived for a thousand years time holds no more terror.
The castle was destroyed when my master tried to summon a nameless creature. All that is left is this volcano.
I can still feel the magical energy in the volcano.
Farewell, Jogador!
Take this for your words! (Logo em seguida ele lhe ataca te deixando com 1 de vida)
pages.title: Skjaar

pages.name: A Bearded Woman
npc_lines: I am not a princess, I am an actor!
GET ME OUT OF HERE!
I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!
I am not even a woman, you fools!
I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!
If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!
Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!
GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!
I am a great and famous actor! Not a princess, at all. I was only PRETENDING to be a princess. But try explaining that to those stupid pirates.
How dare you? I left to rot in this dirty cell and you have nothing better to do than chit chat?
If you find some way to release me I might even let you live as reward! So you’d better do your best or I’ll kill you!
YOU .. YOU .. You are as good as dead! I will get you! Do you hear me? I will have your head! On a platter!
Me playing a princess was just part of a cunning plan we had.
It was all captain Kid’s idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. …
All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. …
Given his men’s dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. …
We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. …
I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. …
That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. …
He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. …
So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. …
He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. …
Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. …
As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. …
The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. …
When I found out about Kid’s demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won’t believe me!
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you’re not on the receiving end. …
It’s easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can’t fight back!
I’d have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! …
Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
He was always a fool with a heart too soft to become a feared pirate.
Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. …
And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! …
So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! …
If that stupid Kid hadn’t been so obsessed with kidnapping he’d not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! …
As soon as I get out of here I’ll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don’t need Captain Kid!
In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, …
those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! …
If only our plan had worked!
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. …
He said the canoes would do for a while. …
I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
You obviously don’t know who it is you are talking to! I will become the most feared pirate ever and you dare to ask me for a reward?
Get me out now or I’ll kill you!
pages.title: A Bearded Woman

pages.name: Graubart
npc_lines: Ahoi, young man Jogador. Looking for work on my ship?
My name is Graubart, captain of the great SeaHawk!
Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
I'm a merchant. I sail all over the world with my ship and trade with many different races!
A merchant is someone who trades goods with other people and tries to make a little profit. *laughs*
You know; elves, dwarfs, lizardmen, minotaurs and many others.
Sorry, sold out.
Pssst. *He looks if Marlene is near. After he is sure that she is not near him he starts to speak.* <Press m for more>
Good bye and don't forget me!
pages.title: Graubart

pages.name: Marlene
npc_lines: Ahhh, welcome Player! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
My name is Marlene.
I'm Bruno's wife. Besides: Have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
Bruno is a wonderful husband. But he is seldom at home. *looks a little bit sad*
