Ah, old Graubart. A very nice person. But he is strange. He always is busy when I want to talk to him. *lost in thoughts*
Only some days ago I was at the docks late in the night and was looking for my husband's ship when suddenly a known noise appeared near the docks. ...
I know this noise very well because it is the noise of a ship sailing very fast. I searched the horizon in hope to see my husbands ship. ...
But instead of a ship I saw a huge shape far away. It was like a big snake swimming in the sea. ...
I couldn't see it clearly because of the fog but I think I saw two lava-red eyes glowing in the nightly fog. ...
I ran into the house and hoped that my husband would arrive safely from fishing. And after one hour he finally arrived. ...
I told him about what I saw but he didn't believe me because he never saw anything like that in all the years before. But you believe me right? Go and convince yourself. ...
Just go to the docks at exactly midnight and be very quiet. Look at the horizon and maybe you will hear and see it, too!
A very nice person. He has a great story to tell with big fights and much magic. Just ask him for his story. ...
I heard that he came from far, far away. He must have seen soooo many countries, cities, different races. ...
He must have collected so much wisdom. *sigh* I wish I could also travel around the world. ...
I would try to visit as many cities and meet as many beings as possible. Who knows what strange races I will meet? ...
Maybe I can also find a lovely new dress for me. I have been looking for one for months now but never found a good one. Maybe... *keeps on babbling*
Well, I heard about evil beings living in a dungeon below us. So once I tried to find them and went down the hole far to the southwest. ...
I'm pretty curious, you know. *smiles* So I took the coat of invisibility from my husband and went down there. At first I only found some spiders, snakes, and wolves. ...
But after some time I found a ladder to a deeper level of the dungeon but I didn't dare to go down there because I heard many voices. ...
The voices were very strange and I ran back to my house because they were very loud and very angry. I hope they will never get the idea to attack the surface beings. ...
I heard they are almighty and have incredible powers! I already packed our stuff for an emergency escape. You never know. Maybe they plan to conquer the whole world. ...
I bet that they look very ugly. Most mighty monsters look very ugly. Hmm, you seem to be very strong. Maybe you can go deeper and explore the area. But be careful, please. ...
I heard that they can kill humans with only one hit! And that they have magic abilities twenty times stronger than the mightiest sorcerer in our world.
My pleasure, I always enjoy sharing interesting stories.
Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
pages.title: Marlene

pages.name: H.L.
npc_lines: Hmmm. I buy weapons, armor, and other stuff. What do you want, Player?
I don't have anything to offer, but I buy almost everything. Wanna trade?
I buy all kinds of armory and weapons.
Won't tell you.
Ha! Thais. I lived there once. You know, I was in the royal army. But what they're fighting for... it's all wrong. I deserted.
You get an excellent fighter training in the army. But they are fighting for the wrong cause.
I don't really want to talk about it.
About what? I have no time for this, now move along.
Didn't I already tell you to go? If you don't have anything important to say, leave me alone.
They should hang him...
Yeah. I'm a wild warrior. Well, to be honest, I was. I left them. Some of them became too aggressive. Simply attacking everyone for no reason is not good.
Well, at least there's one place worth visiting in Tibia. Here!
Elves... I hate them.
Dwarfs are good people. I like them.
Might be a good place to live. But the people are too Thais friendly for my taste.
He the boss of that tavern. He's alright.
Women are not good for fighting. I don't need them. I don't trade with them. And I don't like them.
pages.title: H.L.

pages.name: A Dead Bureaucrat
npc_lines: Back again? How can I help you this time?
You wouldn’t look any better if you worked 200 years without a break!
I’m one of the lucky ones that have to work a SMALL eternity for Pumin.*SIGH*
Sorry, I seem to have forgotten it
I’m a bureaucrat who does not even find the time to eat. Just look how bony I am! *SIGH*
Don’t bother me with that worldly stuff.
It is not allowed for us, but if you have some stuff with you … be my guest.
Good bye and don’t forget me!
pages.title: A Dead Bureaucrat

pages.name: A Ghostly Knight
npc_lines: Failed. I have ... failed.
The pits. We have sealed the pits. We have concealed the way.
I cannot ... tell you. I died ... long ago ... But I still remember my duties.
My duties are the only thing death had left me. I have no remembrance of my mortal days ... perhaps with one exception.
I remember there used to be something I liked. Grapes! Delicious juicy grapes! What a joy it is to even remember.
You would not have some grapes for me, would you?
It does not matter. It is only a faint memory anyway.
You would not have some grapes for me, would you?
No, you don't have any with you. That is a shame...
Oh, thank you! Thank you! Why, to know such delight! It is almost as if I could taste them again ... almost ...
Listen, mortal. There is so much I forgot, but I remember that the passage is hidden. It can only be revealed through luck or careful exploration ...
One of you must stay here and watch while the others explore every spot of the caverns ahead ...
There are so many ... hidden switches. I can't remember where. But ... they will open the path.
Loneliness ... again.
pages.title: A Ghostly Knight

pages.name: A Ghostly Sage
npc_lines: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely noticed you. I am so lost in my thoughts.
I have to fulfill my duties.
We sealed the doors to the inner sanctum using magic to make sure only the right keys could open them.
The keys were lost, probably forever. Of course, I could search the spirit world for clues, but then ... who cares about keys? ...
I rather spend my time reflecting about the philosophical nature of beauty. *sigh* If I only had a god flower. It is so hard to find a start without a sample.
Do you have a god flower for me?
Oh, how beautiful! Yes, this will definitely assist my studies ... It is amazing how much I seem to have forgotten. Well, I have talked to other spirits about that key ...
It seems the last remaining key was taken from a slain knight by a cyclops ...
However, the cyclopses eventually lost the key themselves. I think it is legitimate to conclude that you may find a hint concerning the key's whereabouts in the cyclopses' lair.
A yes, the Nightmare Knights and the Pits of Inferno. I vaguely remember these insignificant concepts ...

Ever since I died I have struggled to keep my superior mind intact by pursuing advanced metaphysical philosophy, but I do remember things about the time when we built this complex and locked its secrets and treasures away.
We sealed the doors to the inner sanctum using magic to make sure only the right keys could open them.
My name... it was so long since I last heard it... it seems to be erased from my memory.
I have to fulfil my duties.
Are you stuck here...? Do you want me to bring you out of these cursed halls?
So be it. Travel well.
Then stay here.
A yes, the Nightmare Knights and the Pits of Inferno. I vaguely remember these insignificant concepts ...

Ever since I died I have struggled to keep my superior mind intact by pursuing advanced metaphysical philosophy, but I do remember things about the time when we built this complex and locked its secrets and treasures away.
So where was I ... ?
pages.title: A Ghostly Sage

pages.name: Oldrak
npc_lines: Welcome Jogador! Rarely I can welcome visitors in these days.
My name is Oldrak.
I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the Nightmare Knights.
A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
Now, it's hora atual dentro do jogo.
Beware the foul undead!
Tibles are the various holy books of Tibia. They are a prized possession for every pious pilgrim. You may find one under the guidance of the gods. If you ever lose it, I might be able to help you.
If you've lost your precious Tible, I can ask the gods for guidance on how to find another one. But it will require a donation of 1,000 gold. Do you want me to help you?
I'm a monk. Worldly belongings are of no interest to me. Therefore I have nothing to do for an adventurer.
Good bye, Jogador!
They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
Before these battles were fought here, they were called the Fair Plains.
This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The Dreamers'. The order became extinct a long time ago.
Many died in the battles against evil, some went mad, unable to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the powers of darkness.
They learnt the ancient art of dreamwalking from some friendly elves.
While the elvish dreamwalkers experienced bright and happy dreams, the humans strangely had dreams about dark omens.
They dreamt of doom, destruction, talked to dead and tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the schemes of darkness.
He was the greatest necromant who ever cursed our land with the steps of his feet. He was defeated by the Nightmare Knights.
There are many rumours about the Pits of Inferno, which are also known as Nightmare Pits. Even if I knew any of these secrets, I wouldn't tell you.
The Ruthless Seven - Banor help me - have their domain deep under the Plains of Havoc. I don't even dare to speak out their names.
They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so were able to foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
Using this knowledge, they formed an order to thwart these plans. As they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they decided to name their order 'Nightmare Knights'.
These plains are not safe for ordinary travellers. It takes heroes to survive here.
This area in the South from which all life has vanished really worries me. If you find out more about it, let me know. Maybe I can help you.
How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
Ah, the curse of the Plains of Havoc, the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.

There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
pages.title: Oldrak

pages.name: A Ghostly Woman (Dream Realm)
npc_lines: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive...
Once I was alive too. I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
Once I was alive too. I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
We lost ... perhaps everything is lost. Perhaps there never will be any new knights of our order.
Only those who passed the tests of the dream challenge would be able to become nightmare knights.
These halls are only a decoy to distract the inattentive. The true way is hidden well.

There is a secret .. but no ... I can hardly remember ... and I can't tell you anyway ... But ... perhaps ... It is so cold here ... If you gave me some ordinary boots that might give me some warmth I would give you a hint.
Do you have a pair of boots for me?
No ... you don't. Still so cold ... so cold
Oh thank you. Perhaps this will give me some comfort. It is that cold since I am dead ... for so long ...
All I can give you is a little hint though: Not me but only the lost heroes can show you the way; and though it's only a game, it might change what will happen.
Alone ... so alone. So cold.
pages.title: A Ghostly Woman (Dream Realm)

pages.name: The Dream Master
npc_lines: Be greeted, visitor.
Although the Nightmare Knights are still remembered by the people for their valorous fight against demons and the undead hordes they were more of a spiritual order rather than a fighting one.
A strong spirit is what constitutes a true warrior. Armed with a firm belief in his philosophy, he wins a battle by using his mind rather than his body, which is only a lesser tool ...

In the end your body is all but a crumbling shell that you leave behind. Our familiarity with dreams makes it much easier to understand this concept since in the world of dreams your body follows the will of the mind ...
The conscious mind shapes the matter of the dreams. Only those who can prove themselves in their dreams posses the strength of mind that is necessary to become one of us ...
Still a strong mind does not necessarily grant strong morals as our failures in the past have shown.
When our dreams tell us about the possible future they are never bright. This is why we refer to ourselves as the Nightmare Knights ...
If someone whose faith is not enough strong to overcome such seemingly overwhelming evil, he may succumb to despair or even worse might become convinced that evil is the superior force ...

A few of our members have choosen to abandon our teachings, including some we considered our most noble and wise members. Ironically, they have failed even worse on the dark side which they supposed to be so superior.

You must neither overestimate the importance of dreams nor underestimate it. Dreams can be your guide. If you are are skilled in the art of dreaming they might even give you a glimpse of things to come ...
Yet remember that it is ultimately in your hands to decide what to do. The dreams are but a hint.
Goshnar is a tragic figure. While he was one of us he tried to fight evil in such a desperate way that he never managed not live up to his own expectations ...
While trying to understand his enemy, to make out their strengthes and weaknesses he became more and more like them ...

In the end he switched sides and took the robe of the necromancer king. His quick ascension in the ranks of the Brotherhood of Bones was unheard of. He appeared to have an aura of power and invincibility ...
But though he united most of the Brotherhood under his banner and allied himself with demons he ultimately failed. ...
His failure was a typical lesson of the ultimate failure of evil. His spirit was already broken when he joined the ranks of the evil hordes ...
He succumbed to the seemingly easy way as did his allies. They lived in the hell they had created on their own ...
Surrounded by treacherous allies, always fearing betrayal, always in need to prove themselves, never being able to show any weakness without someone trying to seize upon that opportunity ...
A Nightmare Knight would hold his ground in a battle against impossible odds just to cover the retreat of his friends ...

A member of the Brotherhood does try to run if the tide of battle seems to turn against him, since he can safely assume that the others will run too and those who run last will be those who suffer most ...
This is why they ultimately failed. Their failure did not save our own order though.
The Nightmare Knights are almost extinct now, and as far as I know I am the only teacher that is left. But you might be right and its time to accept new disciples ...
After all you have passed the Dream Challenge to reach this place, which used to be the process of initiation in the past ...
So I ask you: do you wish to become a member of the ancient order of the Nightmare Knights, Jogador?

It is humanity and community that ultimately defines us. The undead know nothing of either. They are stripped of everything but their selfishness and call upon themselves one of the worst curses of all, the curse of loneliness.
The community gives us hold and strength. And we give the community hold and strength in return. We don't live alone and as a community we are one ...

By caring for others we care for ourself. Not only because we might need others, too, one day but also because helping others without expecting a reward cleanses our soul from greed and selfishness ...
These are the poisons that turn our better selves into something less, something small, ugly and self-centred.
The Brotherhood embraces hate and selfishness and pursues the illusion of power. They think only the fittest may survive. But they don't see that we are not individuals but a community ...
The best fighter may be ill-suited to tend the wounds of those in need and even the most helpless person can make somebody else smile or love them, thus enriching their lives ...

The Brotherhood thinks they are free because they only pursue their own goals without morals or remorse, but they don't see they have become slaves to their greed and lost everything of importance on their way.
There is no power. Nowhere ever. There is only responsibility. To think about responsibility as power is already the first step into the wrong direction.
They are mighty individuals that survived for aeons in the merciless society of demons. This alone is proof enough of how dangerous they are ...
I believe they attained their status by mimicking a tool of their enemies: their own flawed version of a community. By forming an alliance they gained strength ...
It put an example other demons followed with more or less success ...

But they cannot truly understand the concept of helping each other, so in the long run their alliance is doomed to fail. They will end up devouring each other, for they cannot stand the thought that others may wield power, too ...
But then, we are mere mortals and this day might be far away. So we will have to deal with them either way. ...
Still it is possible that one of them can be attacked without the six others interfering on his behalf, since this, after all, is the way of demonkind.

Soul orbs are the demons' substitute for true souls. They are powerful magic devices. It is said there are cyclopses who know how to forge weapons from soul orbs. I also buy them, so if you want to get rid of them, ask me for a trade.
He is the enemy of all living things. He lost all humanity long ago, and that which is left is nothing but burning hatred for everyone and everything ...
Although he can be defeated, he will only truly die when he recognises the mockery his life has turned into.
Demonic essence can be looted from most demonic beings. The pits of inferno are full of such creatures.
We managed to seal and contain the evil power of this place for at least a while. It was obvious that we could not stop these forces forever ...
But then, we had to do our best for as long as we could. And so we did. Those who perished have given their best in the interest of all living beings.

Necromancy is like a disease that spreads through your soul. By studying the dark art you learn to perceive life and death in a different unhealthy way. Both become tools you use as it pleases you ...
You lose your respect for life and death alike. In the end you have abandoned all that is worth living for. You will end off in a dark, decaying world of your own making ...
You will have minions and masters, but no friends. You will know power and submission, but no fulfilment.
Good bye. May the gods watch over your path.
pages.title: The Dream Master

pages.name: The Orc King
npc_lines: Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!
I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the orcs and master of this hive.
The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and minions. I embrace the rage of the horde.
The orcish horde of this hive is under my control. I sense their emotions and their needs and provide them with the leadership they need to focus their hate and rage.
Hate and rage are the true blessings of Blog, since they are powerful weapons. They give the hive strength. I provide them with direction and focus.
The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore divine.
To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the world.
The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a slime.
Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil djinn bestowed upon me!
This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted lamp, and he cheated me!

For Eons he was trapped in an enchanted lamp by some ancient race. Now he's free to roam the world again. Although he cheated me I appreciate what he and his brethren will do to this world, now it's the time of the Djinn again!
Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two wishes.
He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!

I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the Deathwish Mountains.
He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!

His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the good Djinn too.
I will not share anything more about that topic with you paleskins.
You are as ugly as maggots, although not quite as as tasty.
We will meet again.
pages.title: The Orc King

pages.name: Ruprecht
npc_lines: Bem, ele não gosta que fiquem contando sua história por ai... mas mesmo assim eu conto! Há muito, muito tempo atrás, Noel não passava de um pequeno anão insaciável. Um real pão duro, eu digo mesmo...
pages.title: Ruprecht

pages.name: Murim
npc_lines: Hello and welcome to the Farmine bank and post office, Player!
A promising project for Kazordoon.
I hope this new project lets Kazordoon prosper. Half of my family is involved in Farmine one way or another. If things turn out well, we will earn a hefty sum of money.
My only mission is to keep this little office running.
A weapon of pure power - or a weapon of pure imagination. Who knows?
Ah, my proud brothers and sisters. Only dwarfs could succeed with such an immense tunnelling project.
Now he is one-of-a-kind and a born leader.
If he only stopped bugging Ongulf about resources. We've already spent too much money on things that yield no immediate profit. ...
But in the end, only profit will convince the imperial mining guild to continue their support.
It took my three weeks with almost no sleep to do all the paperwork for my business permission, but it was worth it! ...
The guild is sticking to the old traditions and that is a good thing for sure.
Luckily we're far away from them.
Bye.
pages.title: Murim

pages.name: Swolt
npc_lines: Hello.
The Farmine project is a spark of hope for the whole dwarvenhood. The resources here might lead the dwarfs to a new golden age.
: h, home sweet home! Though I don't mind being here for a while, my heart still belongs to Kazordoon. ...
In a few decades, I'll certainly return there and hand over this tavern to someone else.
Every dwarf needs some relaxation now and then. This is the place where the miners come to share stories about home and hear news about the latest events like the giant beaver rodeos.
If you need to ask, you don't need to know.

The cousin of my mother's neighbour knows someone who claims to have seen a strange guy in the Kazordoon tavern. He was wearing a dark cloak and beneath it he hid a weapon that might have been Excalibug.
If the orcs come here to kill us, we will be prepared! They will pay heavily for every attack.
It wouldn't surprise me if there were another minotaur city somewhere on this continent. They are a pest.
Dragonkin! You can't expect anything good from dragons and the likes of them.
Bye.
pages.title: Swolt

pages.name: Pompan
npc_lines: Hello.
He can be quite stubborn sometimes but I see why they chose him to head this venture. ...
If you've ever talked to dwarfs, you'll recognise that he is an rather open-minded and flexible fellow.

Of course they are dangerous. But we all know: Orcs can die, can't they? And speaking of that, they might have stolen some interesting stuff from these lizardmen that could be of some value for someone with an exotic taste.

They are neglectable as they have nothing to offer. They live in horrible primitive conditions, but we are not here for charity work. As long as they don't have anything interesting to offer, we will simply ignore them.
They are an incredible threat. At the moment, they are occupied with the orcs. But once they are done with the orcs, who will be next? They might even plan to conquer human civilisation... ...
I agree with my superiors that a preventative strike will be the best solution. The lizards' cities are rich and the land offers plentiful resources that would easily cover the costs of a war.
My lovely hometown was always at the forefront of science, exploration and daring ventures. I see some profitable opportunities in this project, and I'm in constant correspondence with my superiors.
My superiors are a board of tree traders from Venore who are looking for new opportunities.
The mines do well. If only the miners would loosen their purse strings.
Bye.
pages.title: Pompan

pages.name: Pemaret
npc_lines: Passages to Edron and Eremo's Island. Also selling fresh fish!
Greetings, young man. Looking for a passage or some fish, Jogador?
My fish is of the finest quality you could find. Ask me for a trade to check for yourself.
I'm a fisherman and I take along people to Edron. You can also buy some fresh fish.
My name is Pemaret, the fisherman.
My boat is ready to bring you to Edron.
I love to sail on the seas of Tibia.
Now that's a special one. Where did you hear about it? I would be interested, you know... Well, this fish is extremely rare and cannot be found in normal, clean freshwater. ...
If you want to catch one, you will have to look for a really dirty lake. If you were able to catch one however, this would be a very versatile haul. ...
It is said that, in combination with certain magical or non-magical items, this fish somehow... changes his looks and gains a completely new purpose. I heard of someone making a weapon out of it! ...
Hey, don't look at me like that. It... it's just a tale what do I know. ...
Anyway, I heard of people using flintstones, the hair and wax of strange creatures I never saw before, an eye of a foreign sea beast and some kind of old, broken ring.
It's a lovely and peaceful isle. Did you already visit the nice sandy beach?
Do you want to get to Edron for 10 gold?
Oh, you know the good old sage Eremo. I can bring you to his little island. Do you want me to do that?
I love to sail on the seas of Tibia.
Good bye, Jogador. You are welcome.
pages.title: Pemaret

pages.name: Yoem
npc_lines: Hello Jogador! Do you need some equipment for your house?
My name is Yoem. I sell furniture and equipment.
Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
Yes, I know him since we were small children. He's a brave and virtuous man.

Yes, the Curse of the Full Moon has reached Cormaya, too. More and more people are affected but something is really strange: Some of them weren't bitten by were-beasts. So far we thought this is the only way to be infected. ...
But now it's obvious that there has to be another way. If you ask me: I guess it's the ground water. Someone has to enter the caverns underneath Cormaya and investigate. ...
In the east of the island there are tunnels where we often spot were-beasts at night. Perhaps you should start there.

So I was right, it is the ground water! Please try to reverse this contamination. Unfortunately, I don't know anything about magic or arcane matters. But you could ask somebody at the Magic Academy of Edron.
You succeeded! Thank you very much for your help, my friend. Please return to Edron and tell Daniel Steelsoul about it, he will be interested in this outcome, too.
Good bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Yoem

pages.name: Sinatuki
npc_lines: Sajoq, jinuma(ou Player)!
Sajoq! <giggles>
Su gura jinuma. Si gura chakoya. <first points at you then at herself>
Nupi, si gura Sinatuki! Sinatuki jusipa! Jusipa!! <holds her belly and points with her hand at her mouth>
Nupi, nupi!! Tiyopa Sinatuki chuqua! Chuqua, chuqua!!!! <points with her hand at her mouth>
Nupi, tiyopa chuqua pa Sinatuki!
Chuqua jamjam!! Tiyopa Sinatuki?
Nupi, nupi! Sinatuki gura jusipa! Jinuma ji chuqua pa Sinatuki??
Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you>
<wrinkles her nose, tries what you brought to her and spits it out> Yuk pa chuqua?? Tiyopa taluka chuqua!
Juk?? Jinuma ji quata chuqua! <seems to be confused>
Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you and gives you five glimmering crystals>
Quatu, quata jusipa. Nguraka suq! <seems pleased and doesn't need anything else>
Yuk taluka?? Chuqua? Ahhh! <drives her wand against the floor and makes a gesture like pulling something out of the ground>
Kisavuta! <giggles>
Nguraka! <giggles>
Gukaju, jinuma!
pages.title: Sinatuki

pages.name: Penny
npc_lines: Welcome home, Sir/Lady Jogador.
Wait... will you take me a diamond when you're back?
Farewell, and may Justice be with you!
I am miss Penny, your secretary.
Yep, Penny's my name. You seem to be as smart as you're talkative.
I'm a secretary. I'm organising all those papers and your mail.
<Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
You can get a letter from me.
Here you are.
Don't stare at me.
pages.title: Penny

pages.name: Rabaz
npc_lines: This horrible dust is everywhere.
Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, Jogador.
I was sent by the Edron academy to help the kingdom’s dwarven allies with magical supplies. You have no idea what an enormous logistic problem this poses. …

Actually, I had no idea either. Supplies are short and dwarfs are stubborn. This combination works not too well, you know? The dwarfs are not too supportive towards my efforts and my main customers are adventurers like you. …
I’m not sure if this is what the academy leaders had in mind with their help, so I wouldn’t be too surprised if they would pull off the support and abandon this shop. …
Only time will tell how things develop. For now, they are content with this status quo.
I’m selling spirit, health and mana potions, runes, wands, rods and spellbooks. If you’d like to see all of my offers, ask me for a trade.
Wands can be wielded by sorcerers only and have a certain level requirement. There are eight different wands, would you like to hear about them?
Rods can be wielded by druids only and have a certain level requirement. There are eight different rods, would you like to hear about them?
I really hope those dwarfs know what they are doing. I feel not too comfortable with a few tons of stone over my head. …
If the dwarfs are not cautious, the whole mountain might come down on us.
He is quite loud for such a short person. Sometimes you might be scared if he’s talking to you at that volume, but I guess in the course of time, you’ll get accustomed to that.
Adventurers constantly come up with some stories and half-truths about this weapon. For instance, some claim the weapon has been found and was taken away by the gods. …
This, however, is based on a completely unrelated story of Tibia’s history. After all these years it’s quite hard to figure out what is fact and what is myth.
Have a look. But perhaps you just want to see my potions, wands or runes?
The academy has quite a reputation in the fields of knowledge and research.
<sighs> Those dwarfs are so obsessed with mines. You could spend some weeks just learning their different words for mines and the difference in their meaning. …
To me ‘mine’ only translates to ‘dark and damp cave’.
You have no idea how stubborn the officials of this guild are. If I should ever again think of my superiors back in Edron as stubborn and inflexible, someone should slap me in the face.
Well, you can carve a room into some cave and even decorate it. To me it’s still a cave. …
The thought of having tons of stone and rock above me, just waiting to come crushing down on me, is not very encouraging.
Well, you could ask me for a trade to deposit your flasks, but you can also do it old style. I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Ok?
Sorry, we removed the old life and mana fluids from our assortment. However, we offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes, just ask me for a trade.
A town only dwarfs can love. No daylight at all. The smell of earth and fire everywhere. Well, actually it’s like here but a bit cleaner <sighs>.
Ah yes, my new passion. It is pure fascination that led me to write a book about plants. Via my great almanach of botany I will bring the diversity and beauty of plants nearer to everyone in Tibia.

The book I am currently writing delves into the world of plants. It will cover every plant found in Tibia, including an appendix with newly discovered species in Zao such as the strange corrupted and deformed growths found within its borders. …
While visibly corrupted, these plants have their own very special beauty every botanist or lover of nature will surely comprehend.
Good bye.
pages.title: Rabaz

pages.name: Prezil
npc_lines: Welcome, adventurer Jogador! What brings you here?
I'm Prezil.

Building the temple is progressing slowly, but steadily. It's not all about setting up statues, you know - you also need to pray to the right spirits and channel the energies that flow through this mountain.
This temple has a slow start but we dwarfs are patient like stone. One day, this temple might become an important place, particularly when thinking of the sickness of this land.
There is a force of corruption at work in this land. It is not the destruction caused by humanoids but something else. ...
It's like a hidden plague. Something that takes away the strength of earth and life itself. ...
I have no idea what it is or what its source might be, but its presence haunts me even in my dreams.
Dragons that rule over an empire of minions are an alarming turn of events. I never heard that dragons did something like this before. ...
Those changes confuse me but we will adapt in the course of time.
It's obvious that a new path often leads to new enemies. Now that the path has been chosen, we'll have to cope with the problem.
Orcs are a known threat - an enemy we know all too well. At least we know how to handle them. However, their strange alliance with the minotaurs is something that we've only noticed now.
We'll see if they keep their word. We'll see if they hold the reigns of the orcish horde. And we'll see how long they will survive in this savage land at all.
The embrace of the earth is strong here. I can feel ancient powers running just like veins of ore run through a mountain. ...
But I also sense a sickness that is spreading. Something unhealthy winds its way through the streams of power in this land. ...
It is not very strong here, but I can feel its source far in the north. ...
I'm able to ward it off our base for now, but it will become stronger and stronger with each year passing.
I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
Farewell, Jogador!
pages.title: Prezil

pages.name: Ongulf
npc_lines: Hello.
You humans often think of us dwarfs as a shorter version of yourself. As a matter of fact we are quite different. ...

You'd have a hard time to understand our society and personality, and of course each dwarf is different just like there are no two rocks alike. Members of our race still have much in common, and we even have some things in common with humans. ...
You have to find out yourself which things. Form your own opinion and have a mind of your own.
Well, considering the sheer number of humans, it wouldn't surprise me if we encountered some humans in this new land. They are primitive but at least not hostile. ...
Maybe we can settle some mutual agreement of help in some way.
Well, it's a long story but you really should listen to understand what is going on here. You can also hear a short
So what would you like to hear, the long story or the short version?

After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon. ...
After several tries with mixed success, the project of the technomancers proved the most successful. Their steamships studied and mapped the great underwater rivers deep beneath the earth. ...
With the help of certain apparatuses, they tracked deposits of ore and compiled ship routes to reach them. These mining bases had some obvious advantages and disadvantages. ...

The suitable spots had no connection to the surface. On the one hand, this meant that the new mines were safe from most kinds of beasts. On the other hand, it meant that all food and material had to be brought there by ship. ...
Special, heavy ships were built to carry ore and supplies back and forth. The only limitation for such bases had been the range of the steamships. ...
Recently, the technomancers with the help of the temples of fire and earth made some crucial discoveries that allowed the ships to extend their cruising range almost limitlessly. ...
The survey ships of the technomancers were once again sent out to find new, promising resources. ...

Sadly some of the ships never returned and others only found minor deposits of ore, not worth the effort. But one of the ships made some groundbreaking discovery - a cave that had a connection to the surface. ...
As far as the explorers could tell, the area had been unknown to dwarfhood and mankind so far. ...
What was more, the said cave system had an abundance of rare ores. The imperial mining guild agreed to fund a new project and to name it 'project far far away'. ...
Don't look at me, I'm not the one who came up with that name! Those technomancers are such an imaginative bunch. But where have we been? Oh, yes, the new project! ...
Well, some ships were sent to establish a first base. ...

It became painfully obvious that the number of workers needed there could not easily be supplied by the ships alone. Also such a base would require an amount of money, expertise and manpower that the guild could not provide. ...
We would need help and additional resources. That's were you come into play. If you are interested, let's talk about possible missions.
The orcs out there make me nervous but at least for now they seem to be kept at bay by their minotaur masters.
I am still surprised by the role the minotaurs are playing in this land. I wouldn't consider them allies but in this strange new land, they are the closest thing to allies we have for now.
Bye.
pages.title: Ongulf

pages.name: Maritima
npc_lines: Oh hello, visitor from the dry land.
I'm a mermaid. I sing songs and play with the fishes.
I'm Maritima.
Fishes are my friends. I really hate that the quara treat them so badly.
The quara in this area are a strange race that seeks inner perfection rather than a physical one. ...
Considering that they are quara, they are rather peaceful as long no one enters their territory. ...

However, recently the quara got mad because their area is flooded with toxic sewage from the city. If you could inform someone about it, they might stop the sewage and the quara could return to their own business.
I've only seen the city from afar.
Some centuries ago, the Yalahari used to visit the bottom of the ocean. Then all of a sudden, their visits ended.
Use your knowledge wisely, Jogador.
pages.title: Maritima

pages.name: Zirkon
npc_lines: SHHHHHHH, QUIET HERE! THIS IS THE SACRED PLACE OF THE DWARVEN GEOMANCERS!
pages.title: Zirkon

pages.name: Xorlosh
npc_lines: I'll never get it working again.
Sigh! I need to get that elevator working!
Who are you? Are you a genius in mechanics? You don't look like one.
Best mechanic in town.
My name is Xorlosh and I'm the best mechanic here at Beregar!
Go ask Grombur, he always has a cask at his side.
Our great citadel is a masterpiece of dwarven workmanship. I'm afraid only dwarfs are allowed to enter the deeper parts of the city.
The book about tunnelling is in the library which is located in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
Some son of a rotworm put WAY too much stuff in this elevator and now it's broken. I could do with some help to fix it.
To be honest....he goes on and on and on about his romantic issues. It's getting annoying.
They are crooked. I could do with some help to fix them.
He's not a bad guy. He knows how to drink, he's strong and... well, he's a dwarf like me and y... err... just like me.
I'd love to chat with you about the high art of mechanics but I'm too busy.

It's a crystal mine. Very rare crystals can be found here. We mine them and produce all kind of precious things out of them. Well, not me. I'm too clumsy for that kind of work so they promoted me to a guard! ...
I'm a good guard, no one without permission is allowed to enter.
Hehe, they don't expect me to be done so quickly, so I PRETEND I'm not ready yet. Hrhrhrhr.
He's a great emperor. You'll find him on his throne in the citadel.
Haven't seen him for a while. Maybe he's in one of the mines.
There should be a book in our library about tunnelling. I don't have that much time to talk to you about that. ...
If you want to have some information, you'll just have to find that book. If you need some equipment, go ask Harog. You'll find the library in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
Alright, back to work.
pages.title: Xorlosh

pages.name: Tehlim
npc_lines: They must be rescued!
Oh no, no, NO! Whatever shall I do?
Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!
I'm the cook for the expedition party. The only one who didn't get cought by those.... those MONSTERS.
They call me Tehlim Madtreat. I can make a meal from almost anything.
The only place I know is Beregar. My home.
The other members of the expedition have either been killed or imprisoned by the trolls.
We were attacked by some sort of assassin trolls or something. They came over us like a storm and in the blink of an eye it was over... everyone was either killed or captured.
I could do with one right now.
What kind of rescue party are you?! I neither have wares to sell nor do I want to buy something.
Ships have captains. Dwarfs usually don't have ships so we don't have captains. Smart, huh?
I won't tell you the secret of our success. No!
I hate ships! I hate water! I hate fish! So let's talk about something different.

I am famous for having invented the most amazing meal ever known to dwarven kind! I call it 'hangman's relish'. I am not going to tell you the recipe, buuuut it contains lots of brown ale, special mushrooms and ground soapstone. Delicious!
Uhh yes, I heard the stories about the lost tribe. Really interesting. There are rumours that they used these old tunnels around here when they left Beregar.
This part of the mine was abandoned a long time ago. There are no crystals left. The expedition had the task to check for new veins of crystal... but before we could find one, THEY found us.
I have nothing more for you to do. You could keep me company, if you wanted to. We could cook something, play a game or.... mock some trolls. Hrhrhrhrhr.
His son Rehon was with us. I don't know if he survived the troll attack.
You have to search the area for him. If he's still alive then rescue him... if not... you'll have to be the one to tell his father. I'm sorry.
Ahhh, forget technomancers, pyromancers are way better. Never seen one, huh? Figures. They are kind of shy.
Beregar is our world. We don't want to be drawn in to any of your kind's conflicts.
Their hideout must be somewhere in the ore wagon tunnels. If you want to help me find Rehon and the others just ask me for a mission.
The expedition had the task to check for new veins of crystal....but before we could find one, THEY found us. Those trolls are.... different.
Wasn't that destroyed ages ago? Whatever, it makes no difference to me.
See you soon, right?
pages.title: Tehlim

pages.name: Rehon
npc_lines: Will I ever get out of here?
It's about time someone showed up! Maybe you are more chatty than my skinny friend here!
Hey skeleton, my friend, what do you think?
Hello, my friend.
Me and my expedition party were supposed to find new crystal veins here in the old mine tunnels.
I'm Rehon, son of Rehal. Don't be afraid, I don't bite.
I have never visited one of your cities. Once you have seen Beregar, you don't need to go anywhere else.
Lovely, huh? The shady lights, the smell of iron and stone. Ahhh, it's time I got back there.
Don't mess with her - you'll lose. I promise.
He's a drunkard but a good worker... at least when he's drunk.
I can't be completely sure, but I don't believe anyone else survived the troll attacks.
Oh well, he's kind of..... strange, but basically he's alright. I heard he likes Bolfona <giggles>.
He's on the right way to become the drunkard of the year.
Hah! When you find out how he makes his money you'll laugh! He sells rotworm urine as rust remover and earns a fortune with it. Muahahahahaha!
You're kiddin' me.... just get me out of here!
All dwarfs know how to fight. There is no need to have a special vocation for that.
He's a really good soul. Whenever you're in trouble Nokmir will help you. He covered up for me soooo many times when I was little.
Get me out of here NOW!! And don't you dare to complain about the rhyme!
He's a wise emperor and a good father but I can't imagine being an emperor myself.
By the Gods, it's about time someone showed up to rescue me.
Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.
Do I look like a sorcerer?
Tehlim is alive?!? Well, at least he won't starve down in the tunnels. Hehehehe.
The stone we walk on, the air we breathe... or in this case, the rubbish and the stench that surrounds us.
It's time to leave this filthy place.
I have never seen such well-trained trolls. I wonder if there is a conspiracy behind that.
I'd say I'm an explorer and adventurer. Always in trouble. Hehehehe.
He has a talent for repairing things. He wasn't trained in that but he has a feel for it instinctively, you know what I mean? I can't really explain how he does what he does.
Those Yalaharians are crazy. Good for nothing but trouble. I prefer to stay in Beregar.
Don't leave me to rot down here.
Leave without me. I'll sneak out on my own.
pages.title: Rehon

pages.name: Emperor Rehal
npc_lines: May Fire and Earth bless you, stranger. What leads you to Beregar, the dwarven city?
I'm the Emperor of the Dwarfs of Beregar.
I'm Emperor Rehal, Son of Fire and Earth.
Believe me. I'm OLD.
Our castle is the mountain above our heads.

There's a legend about a dragon lord so greedy that he continued his dire existence even after his death in order to guard his ill-gotten gains. The legend says that he guards a treasure of enormous value.
Do you mean that big cave under Beregar? Be careful down there, you won't find anything there except for horror and death.
I'm afraid you have come to the wrong place to ask for help.
There have been many heroes among the dwarfs, and there always will be.
Every dwarf receives basic training in combat skills. Be careful down in the mines. They may mistake you for a monster.
Feel free to give it a try, but I'm afraid you'll have problems getting equipment here. My people are not used to your kind and may act dismissively.
For us citizens of Beregar, this mountain and this city are all that matters.
You won't be allowed to enter the main parts of Beregar. The city is divided into three parts. We have two living quarters for the two different tribes, and one community quarter. ...
Unfortunately, one of the living quarters is abandoned as one of the tribes left Beregar when Tibia was still young.
Sorry, only dwarfs born and bred in Beregar are allowed to call themselves citizens.
Our guild halls are not accessible for anyone other than the inhabitants of Beregar.
So the lost tribe found itself a new home. This is good news indeed.
Not many people have visited Beregar these past years, so news is....let's say....scarce.
In the early years of Tibia, there were two tribes in Beregar. A conflict between the tribes led to one of the tribes leaving Beregar for good.
I'm afraid you have to be a dwarf to truly understand what the conflict was about.
My father was Ransar Crystalvein. It was he who discovered the huge deposit of crystals in the eastern mine.
We neither have nor need an army.
Well, justice is a tricky thing. Can one be just to everybody at once, and if not, to whom should one be just?
Chaos cannot exist without order but the reverse is also true, order cannot exist without chaos.
Your kind has a different perception of time to us. When a dwarf tells you that something may not take too long, it will probably take much longer than you expected.
Not a very common profession among dwarfs.
Our guards are well trained but I wouldn't call them 'knights'.
We prefer fighting with an axe in our hands.
Among us dwarfs, you'll find Masters of Earth, the so called geomancers, and Masters of Fire, the pyromancers.
Hmm, I've heard of them but I've never seen or talked to one. I don't think they would like to be deep down in the belly of a mountain.
I always liked him and I still can't believe that he really stole that ring.
He's very ambitious and always volunteers for the long shifts.
Farewell, Jogador!
pages.title: Emperor Rehal

pages.name: Pythius The Rotten
npc_lines: COME CLOSER, MY FRIEND!
I AWAITED YOU!
INTERESTING QUESTION. WHAT IS MY JOB? I'D SAY I'M AN AMBASSADOR OF GREED!
ONCE I WAS PYTHIUS THE IGNITER, BUT NOWADAYS PEOPLE CALL ME PYTHIUS THE ROTTEN.
I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN UNDEAD CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILY AND NEVER REGRETTED IT. MY TREASURE IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY.
THEY LEAVE ME ALONE AND I LEAVE THEM ALONE.....WELL, EXCEPT THIS ONE OLD DWARF WHO TUMBLED INTO MY CAVE LAST WEEK. HE SEEMED TO BE OLD. I BET HE DIDN'T EVEN SEE WHAT KILLED HIM. HAHAHAHA!!
DWARVES. THEY HIDE UNDER THEIR MOUNTAINS AND THINK THEY ARE SAFE THERE.
OUR RACE BECAME WEAK OVER THE TIME. I MADE A STEP INTO A BRIGHT FUTURE THAT I'D RECOMMEND TO EVERY OTHER DRAGON. NOWADAYS THEY ARE JUST FATSTOCK. I ABOMINATE THEM!!

I HAVE SEEN THE GLANCE OF THIS CITY BACK IN THE DAYS AND I WATCHED THEM DOING THEIR RESEARCH. IT WAS FUNNY TO SEE THAT THEY COULDN'T HANDLE WHAT THEY EVOKED. I TOOK THEIR TREASURES AFTER THEY SLAUGHTERED THEMSELVES. HAHAHA!
FLESHY LITTLE BEINGS. I LIKE THEIR GREED! HOW ABOUT YOUR GREED? ARE YOU INTERESTED IN SOMETHING OUT OF MY TREASURE?
THERE IS NO WEAPON IN TIBIA THAT COULD HARM ME.
WONDERFUL, WOULD YOU BE SO KIND AND SCRAPE OFF THAT PIECE OF FLESH FROM MY TOE! MUAHAHAHA!!
SHOOT AT ME WHATEVER YOU WANT AND WAKE ME UP WHEN YOU ARE DONE.
CAN I BORROW AN ARROW OR BOLT FROM YOU? THERE IS A NASTY LITTLE PIECE OF DWARF STUCK BETWEEN MY TEETH!
DON'T KNOW IF YOU REALISED BUT YOU CAN'T KILL ME. I'M ALREADY DEAD.....AND BE CAREFUL HOW YOU TALK TO ME, OTHERWISE I MAY KILL YOU!
AHHHHH, THE BATTLE OF CARLIN. I CAN STILL SMELL THE BLOOD. ORK BLOOD, HUMAN BLOOD.....WHAT A FEAST. I GET HUNGRY WHEN I THINK OF THOSE DAYS.
THE HOME OF YOUR LITTLE KINGS. HOW PATHETIC.
HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER?
I COULD PUT AN END TO YOUR ABSURD LITTLE LIFE. YOU'D SERVE ME AFTER DEATH AND YOU MAY HAVE SOMETHING OUT OF MY TREASURE.
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY TREASURE. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
NEVER UNDERESTIMATE THE POWER OF GREED. PEOPLE KILL OUT OF GREED, THEY GAIN POWER BECAUSE OF GREED AND SOME EVEN CONTINUE THEIR LIVES AFTER DEATH BECAUSE OF GREED.
I'VE SEEN MANY KINGS COME AND GO. THEY ALL THINK THEY RULE TIBIA BUT HAVE NO IDEA....HAHAHAHA!!
THIS IS MY SECRET AND WILL NEVER, EVER BE REVEALED TO A LIVING BEING.
I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT?
I'VE SEEN THIS WHOLE CONTINENT, EVEN THOSE PLACES YOU DON'T KNOW THEY EXIST. I FOUGHT WARS FOR DIFFERENT RACES AND I HAVE SEEN CIVILISATIONS RISE AND FALL.
I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN UNDEAD CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT?
I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT?
YOU LIKE THEM? WHAT WOULD YOU GIVE ME IN EXCHANGE?
GOODBYE, AND MAY GREED BE ALWAYS IN YOUR SMALL BEATING HEART. HAHAHA!
pages.title: Pythius The Rotten

pages.name: Pyromental
npc_lines: Thissss issss the ssssacret place of the pyromanccccersssss. Leave!
pages.title: Pyromental

pages.name: Nokmir
npc_lines: You are....kind of tall! Hello. What brings you here?
I guard the entrance to the northern part of the mine.
My name is Nokmir.
It's a crystal mine. Nothing special, at least not for a dwarf.
Yes, I'm a dwarf and you are standing in the crystal mines of Beregar.
Yes, these are the crystal mines of Beregar. The city itself is just above. Just go up the stairs south of here and you're almost there.
He's a good emperor but I doubt he is wise enough to see the truth behind that false accusation against me. If just someone would find out the truth about that whole mess.
Sooner or later, his drinking will get him into trouble. I promise.
I try to stay away from him, he really annoys me with his 'I'm sooooo in love' chitchat.
He is a genius in mechanical issues. You find him south of here at the elevator.
I don't drink beer at work anymore. It just causes trouble.
I heard that Emperor Rehal imprisoned him. I never thought that he would be able to do such a malicious act.
I doubt Rerun will need it in prison.
You've already helped me soooo much. I wouldn't dare bothering you again.
You are in the mines of Beregar. Made your way through the lava cave, huh? Not bad.
Bye. Enjoy your stay here in Beregar.
pages.title: Nokmir

pages.name: Kihil, The Guard
npc_lines: MIND YOUR MANNERS FOREIGNER! To address the emperor greet with his title!
HAIL TO THE EMPEROR!
How dare you!
LONG LIVE THE EMPEROR!
pages.title: Kihil, The Guard

pages.name: Harog
npc_lines: Armor, weapons! Buy a new one or refurbish your old!
Is your armor rusty? Try my special rust remover and it will shine again.
Buying nails! Got any?
Hmmmm, I saw you helping Nokmir and talking to our emperor. Seems like you are not THAT bad. What do you want?
Mind your own business if you don't want to trade.
Look what I have to offer.
I'm really busy right now. Leave!
It's about time.
pages.title: Harog

pages.name: Grombur
npc_lines: Darn! How could I get more beer without leaving my post?
<sings> What shall we do with the drunken dwaharf! Lalala!
STOP RIGHT THERE!..... Oh, just a human. What's up big guy? Why do you disturb me?
I AM GROMBUR GOLDTOOTH, GUARD OF THIS MINE HERE! No one is allowed to enter.
You haven't heard anything about me yet?! I aehhhhhhohoh........sorry....I AM GROMBUR GOLDTOOTH, GUARD OF THIS MINE HERE!...Impressive, huh?
THAT is a problem....I tell you. My shift lasts for 48 hours and no one cares about my thirst. That's such a shame! The barrel over there is already empty and I still have 37 hours to go.
Congrats on finding it! We don't get many visitors here.
I AM GROMBUR GOLDTOOTH, GUARD OF THIS MINE HERE! No one is allowed to enter.
Down here! Yes, here. I'm a dwarf.
I already told you that you may enter, and now leave me with my cask........ahhhh.
What a wimp! 'Bolfona here, Bolfona there!'.
I love this job. No threat on this side of the door, and everyday I find someone stupid enough to bring me beer, hrhrhrhr.

It's a crystal mine. Very rare crystals can be found here. We mine them and produce all kind of precious things out of them. Well, not me. I'm too clumsy for this kind of work so, they PROMOTED me to a guard! ...
I'm a good guard, no one without permission is allowed to enter.
No more trouble for me, no more work for you. Leave me alone with my cask.
He is guarding the entrance to the northern mine if you're looking for him.
Every year the most honoured dwarf gets promoted. I for myself are not keen on being promoted. I prefer sitting here with my cask of beer.
I don't mind who sits on that throne as long as I have enough to drink.
I'm sure he's still drunk after THAT amount of beer he drank yesterday.
Oh well, I liked Nokmir. He used to be a good dwarf until that day on which he stole the ring from Rerun.
See ya....and don't sneak up on me next time.
pages.title: Grombur

pages.name: Frok, The Guard
npc_lines: MIND YOUR MANNERS FOREIGNER! To address the emperor greet with his title!
HAIL TO THE EMPEROR!
How dare you!
LONG LIVE THE EMPEROR!
pages.title: Frok, The Guard

pages.name: Frafnar
npc_lines: You're so beautiful like a gold vein that...makes me insane...ARGHH..NO
My sweet chocolate pie, why don't you come by? UAHAHA, I'm so untalented!
...I love you like the most beautiful crystal I own....nonono
Don't you see that I'm trying to write a poem? <sighs> So what's the matter?
I guard the entrance to the western part of the mine.
I'm Frafnar and I guard the entrance to the western part of the mine.
I don't drink any beer until Bolfona agrees to drink one with me....or two.
The citadel under the mountain. How poetic! Maybe I could use that in my poem for Bolfona.
She is sooooo beautiful, so feminine, so elegant. You'll find her in the tavern of Beregar.
They have been closed for ages. We dug too deep and woke up some ancient evil.
We may be small, but you better don't underestimate us.
From there the deeper parts of the city can be reached. Too bad for you that only dwarfs may enter there.
It's a crystal mine. You know, long corridors, rails, ore wagons and....surprise...CRYSTALS.
He always stares on Bolfona. If he touches her ONE time, I promise I ..... Calm down Frafnar! Breathe deeply! Nothing happened.
Are you in love, too? Just asking because I also tend to forget things just seconds after they have been told me.
Have you heard the news? He has stolen Rerun's ring.
The emperor and his staff live there.
I'm writing it for Bolfona. I'm rather a shy dwarf, you know.
I'm writing it for Bolfona. I'm rather a shy dwarf, you know. Don't dare to go to her and tell her about my feelings, but maybe you could help me.
Yeye, I won't miss you!
pages.title: Frafnar

pages.name: Drog
npc_lines: If you shaved yourself, it would be more obvious Bol!
Hey Bol, where's the beer I've ordered?
<gulp gulp>
<Gulp>... Hellooo<burp>oo!
<giggles>
<Gulp gulp>....Ahhhh.
I heard that he's been missing for a week now. For sure that half-blind mole fell into the lava!
These 20 beers each evening kill ME. Muahahahaha!
Bol......I'd love to lay down under a cask of beer and you open it. You think that's possible?
One question Bol: Why don't you have an urinal in your tavern?
Muahahahaha!!!
NO WAY! You're kiddin' me?!?!
Calm down Bol!
Hey Bol, that last beer you gave me yesterday must have been bad. It took me 2 hours to get to my place!
Naa, it was in the northern mine. I'm on duty in the western mine this month.
Wanna play dice Bol?
Ohoh, I gotta go now. Just remembered that I have a rotworm in my oven.
About time, Bol honey!
pages.title: Drog

pages.name: Bolfona
npc_lines: You consider yourself superior? Let me show you the drinking skills of a female dwarf.
YES, I'm female. Got a problem with that?!?
Come on guys, have a drink.
Here's your beer, Drog!
Are you talking to me? Well, go on chatting but don't expect an answer.
I'm standing behind the counter in a tavern. What do you think I'm doing?
Who are you that you are interested in a dwarf woman?!? Pick someone of your own kind.
Did you hear something about old Borre? Haven't seen him for a while.
These 20 hour shifts kill me.
If you pay for it, no problem.
I am not sure if I'd like to trade with you.
I told you 1000 times, it's because of the mushrooms. They grow faster and so the flavour of the mushroom beer is better!
Guys, I have a good one. Do you know the term for a foolish, tall being that roams through Beregar? ....It's a HUMAN! Hahahaha!
Have you heard the rumours about that other dwarven city?
I'll give a good thrashing to the next lucky dwarf who spills beer on my counter. Understand?!
Bad?!? It was your 13th beer today!!!
Hey Drog, have you been in the mines when that rotworm attack took place?
You still owe me 2000 gold from our last game.
I THINK YOU NEED A GOOD SPANK FROM A WOMAN, HUH?!
WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?!?
Drog, your next beer is on its way!
Oh well, you don't seem to be THAT bad. What do you want?
Good news!
pages.title: Bolfona

pages.name: Baltim
npc_lines: Hi there. I hope you're here to trade and not to waste my time.
I am the overseer of this little outpost. You probably had already some encounters with my men. Hehe. Serves those cut-throats right if you taught them some manners.
I'm Baltim, not that it would be of your concern.
Of course, just browse through my wares.
I don't sell wares, but ask me for a trade if you have an offer for me.
I wonder if things were better if Venore ran the mining operations.
It seems even the dwarfs know better than to try their luck here.
Thais has no affairs here.
The mines are not at our disposal for now but also here we have enough to plunder for a while.
I don't mind if the people of Svargrond convict us of hunting seals. We earn good money with it.
Carlin lost interest in this place quite fast.
I'd love an assignment in Port Hope, on the other hand, here I can make my own decisions.
I'm in charge here on behalf of Venore.
We should rather concentrate on Edron than wasting our time here and freezing our toes off. But who listens to me?
I hate that place and I would love to burn down that whole settlement.
One barbarian is as worse as the other if you ask me.
Those barbarians will regret the day they turned our offers down.
The elves are of no great help here. They prefer to stay in warmer climates.
His appearances are good for business.
A myth the locals probably enjoy.
I couldn't care less for kings and queens. Here I'm the king as long as I can pay the guys and keep them suspicious of each other.
This place is godforsaken.
Bye.
pages.title: Baltim

pages.name: Zora
npc_lines: Ah, look what the north wind blew here. Hope you're up to some business.
I am overseeing some of our operations here. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
About time someone is interested in my wares. Footballs have to be purchased separately.
Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
Here you go.
Oh, but it's fun to play!
I am overseeing some of our operations here. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I am known as Zora and just for your information, there is no longer a bounty on my head.
I was ... kind of wild in my youth.
Now you're talking my language. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
That ruffian Baltim and me are leading this little operation.
Venore will recognise my efforts here and I am sure I'll get a promotion soon.
We thought about manipulating some dwarfs to clear the mines for us. On the other hand, this would not be very effective as the dwarfs would not give up the mines either and are allied with Thais.
The mines are still a problem. Those raiders make it impossible to do something about the mines.
TThey somewhat remind me of the men I sailed with in my youth. Still they are enemies and I ordered our men to kill them on sight.
We have many enemies but they lack brains and brawn to challenge our operations.
Well ... Thais is far away.
Not even the king's arm reaches this place.
Carlin is a thorn in our side. A little one but a thorn nonetheless.
Soon enough, the little queen in Carlin will lose the last influence she is still having in this area.
Business is growing awfully slow there. We should really assign someone with some talent to improve our influence over there.
If things progress well here, my next command might bring me to Edron.
If I had more ships and men, I'd take over that town in one surprise attack. But the way things are now, this would be a waste of resources. Well, our base here is sufficient for now.
It's a sad thing that our people are split. With each year that is passing, we drift further apart from each other.
They are a bit too friendly with Carlin for my taste. Fortunately, they don't show up here too often.
He is more a problem in the South.
Looking for that weapon seems quite unprofitable.
Leave the gods alone and they won't bother you.
Buy something or leave. Don't bother me!
Come back when you're up to some business, Jogador.
pages.title: Zora

pages.name: Beatrice
npc_lines: Selling general goods and paperware! Come to my shop!
Hello, hiho, and ashari Jogador. Looking forward to trade with you.
I'm selling all kind of useful equipment.
My inventory of general goods and paperware is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.
I'm called Beatrice.
There are always rumors about the dangers in the far north of Edron.
It's horas right now.
I vaguely remember that name.
That's just a myth like the screwdriver of Kurik or the endless casket of mana potions.
I've seen him once. What a handsome man!
I supply them with some basic stuff.
We are no longer in need for supplies from there.
I don't like travelling much. I prefer to live in the safety of our city.
Even though they rebelled against our king, the city is supposed to be very lovely.
It's the best place to live at.
See you later, Jogador.
pages.title: Beatrice

pages.name: Edvard
npc_lines: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
Welcome to Edron Furniture Store, Jogador.
Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.
My name is Edvard. I run this store.
You mean my specials, don't you?
It is horas. Do you need a clock for your house?
Good bye.
pages.title: Edvard

pages.name: Chrystal
npc_lines: Welcome to the post office!
Don't forget to include a label in your parcel!
If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
No, no, no, there IS no parcel bug, I'm telling you!
At your service Jogador and welcome to the post office.
I'm responsible for this post office. Just ask for our offers.
My name is Chrystal.
Our post system spans the entire known world.
We deliver letters and parcels even there.
Our post system even delivers letters and parcels to and from this isle.
Hail to the king!
The army ensures the safety of the traderoutes and of our mail system.
I bet he never gets any letters.
Better ask knights about that.
Sorry, that's postal secret.
Mr. Postner is the leader of our guild and the most prominent postofficer in the whole land.
Yes, our guild is the lifeblood of the tibia cominity so to say.
You can apply to join only at our headquarter.
You can find it on the road from Thais to Kazordoon.
It is horas right now.
Who is next?
pages.title: Chrystal

pages.name: Iwan
npc_lines: Gems of all kinds! Precious jewellery!
Feel welcome Jogador.
I sell gems of all kind.
I'm Iwan.
I haven't been told anything of interest lately.
You can buy and sell small diamonds, small sapphires, small rubies, small emeralds, and small amethysts.
There are white and black pearls you can buy or sell.
Currently you can purchase wedding rings, golden amulets, and ruby necklaces.
Our island is rich in precious stones.
I never visited that city.
We supply Thais with gems found on this isle.
I know only so little about our world. It's a pity.
I am sure even the king would appreciate my wares.
I know not much about the local army.
I hope the academy is safe from his assaults.
I am sure you'd easily recognize it by the gems attached to it.
It should be horas right now.
Bye, bye.
pages.title: Iwan

pages.name: Rudolph
npc_lines: Oh, a customer. Hello Jogador. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a trade.
Oh, I am a tailor, can't you see?
Oh, I have wonderful clothes and shoes. Just ask me for a trade.
Oh, I have wonderful jackets, capes, cloaks, tunics, leather legs, and scarves. Just ask me for a trade.
Oh, I have wonderful leather boots and sandals. Just ask me for a trade.
Oh, I'm Rudolph, you know.
Oh, we tailors learn much, but don't talk about it. It's the tailors' code of honour, you know.
Oh, now it's horas.
Oh, dear.
Oh, that thing must be dangerous. One could hurt himself quite badly with it I guess.
Oh, the king. What a well dressed man he is.
Oh, such handsome guys and such ugly uniforms.
Oh, what a lovely city it was once.
Oh, there is not much sense for fashion in this world.
Oh, these women ... oh, go away.
Oh, what a lovely city it is.
Oh, good bye.
pages.title: Rudolph

pages.name: Willard
npc_lines: Selling weapons, ammunition and armor. Special offers only available here, have a look!
Greetings and Banor be with you, Jogador! May I interest you in a trade for weapons, ammunition or armor?
I am the blacksmith of castle Bloodrock.
I am Willard, the smith.
Rumors are too sinister things that a true warrior would care for them.
My offers are weapons, ammunition, armors, helmets, legs, and shields. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I sell all sorts of arrows for bows and different bolts for crossbows. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.
Edron is a fine city to live in.
If the king sees the time is right, he will certainly start a campaign to reclaim what belongs to Thais.
A fine city, but I love the peace of Edron more.
It's my dream that one day the whole world will profit from the Thaian governance.
Hail to the King! He's our benevolent protector.
I supply them with all they need.
I would be honored if it's one of my blades that one day delivers him his punishment.
Adventurers search for this blade all over the world. Even here.
Now it is horas.
Farewell, Jogador.
pages.title: Willard

pages.name: Bonifacius
npc_lines: Tasty food! Right here!
Thousands greetings, Jogador. How may I help you? I have delicious food to offer.
I can offer you meat, salmon, fruits, cookies, rolls, eggs, and cheese. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I have oranges, bananas, grapes, pumpkins and melons. Ask me for a trade if you want anything.
I sell delicious food. May I be at your service?
My name is Bonifacius.
I heard the corn prices in Thais are going to be increased.
Our climate is quite rough, so we can only grow wheat here, but no fruits.
It is horas right now.
Is that a new exotic vegetable?
Uh, I hate all kind of bugs.
Our wise King Tibianus be praised!
I'm glad about their healthy appetite.
We recive food from Thais with every arriving ship.
The world provides us with all kinds of delicious food.
We do not buy any wares there. Our food is of high quality - Thaian origin.
May the gods bless your travels Jogador.
pages.title: Bonifacius

pages.name: Fiona
npc_lines: The Edron academy is always in need of magical ingredients!
Good day, Jogador. I hope you bring a lot of magical ingredients with you.

Oof, there are too many to list. Magical ingredients can sometimes be found when you defeat a monster, for example bat wings. I buy many of these things if you don't want to use them for quests, just ask me for a trade.
There are many quests out there where magical ingredients are required. If you are not sure whether you might need the stuff, better keep it.
I buy magical ingredients for the Edron academy and study their effects when used for potions.
I am lady Fiona Mercury.
I never wear a watch. I dislike the pressure it gives me.
Sure, take a look. Apart from those, I also buy some of the possessions from famous demonlords and bosses. Ask me about it if you found anything interesting.
Well, I stocked my wares up a bit.
He fascinates me. I've heard that they found his hideout... I'm very curious what will happen.
Not the ideal place to raise your children in, but still a world with its own charm.
I love the peaceful atmosphere.
Sorry, I don't need any steel here.
Good bye and please come back soon.
pages.title: Fiona

pages.name: James
npc_lines: Food of the finest quality! Right here!
Hi there Jogador. You need food?
I am a humble farmer.
James.
I am too poor to afford a watch.
He scares me a little.
I never saw him in person.
I was born in Thais, but my family moved to Edron among the first settlers.
If I were you, I would stay here.
May Crunor bless our harvests.
Fine, thanks.
I sell some food.
I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, meat and apples. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Sorry, can't offer you any help.
There are dangerous monsters and renegade knights in the northwest behind the river and the mountain.
I stay away from dungeons as far as I can.
A brave warrior as far as a farmer like me can tell.
The mages and druids have quite an appetite. They buy much from me and summon even more food.
I am nothing but a humble farmer and know nothing about that.
Bye.
pages.title: James

pages.name: Mirabell
npc_lines: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, Jogador. Sit down, have a drink or some food!
I can offer you beer, wine, lemonade and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.
I am the owner of this tavern, which is known far beyond Edron.
My name is Mirabell.
Oh, there are so many. Just ask other travellers like you.
It's horas right now.
King Tibianus III should visit our beautiful isle more often.
Sadly most of them are too disciplined to visit my tavern.
I heard horrible things about him.
I heard the Knights of the True Blood are looking for it on this isle.
I think it is the best place in Tibia.
Thais will loose influence on Edron more and more.
He's my cousin and lives in Thais.
They should return to the Thaian realm.
I think Edron is the best place in Tibia.
Come back soon, traveller.
pages.title: Mirabell

pages.name: Thomas
npc_lines: Selling paperware.
Feel welcome, Jogador. If you are interested in paperware such as books or scrolls, ask me for a trade.
Selling spellbooks, notebooks, scrolls, documents, parchments, inkwells, and the like.
Thomas.
Nothing interesting.
No idea.
Know nothing interesting about him.
Ask in the castle.
Only heard of him.
This town.
Never been there.
Like it here best.
Bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Thomas

pages.name: Luna
npc_lines: Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
Greetings, traveller. Maybe you'd like to take a look at my offers...
I sell various herbs, mushrooms, and flowers.
I'm selling various herbs, mushrooms, and flowers. I also buy a few plants and things I need for growing them. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I sell herbs, mushrooms, and flowers. But curses are not my subject. You could ask Sinclair, though.
I'm called Luna.
I fear I know nothing new that is of any importance.
Sorry, I don't know.
I don't know much about the king, sorry.
I sometimes heal soldiers with my herbal mixtures.
Mentioning his name makes me shiver.
I am not an expert for weapons.
I prefer the wilderness to cities.
Goodbye, traveller.
pages.title: Luna

pages.name: Lailene
npc_lines: What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
I sell and buy magical robes and hats. My inventory is still small, but I'm confident that it will grow over time. Ask me for a trade to have a look.
Here.
I sell and buy magical robes and hats. My customers usually appreciate that I don't ask where they got the robes from they're selling to me.
Lailene. That's enough.
It's time you stopped bugging me.
Currently I only buy batwing hats. Ask me for a trade if you want to sell one.
Excuse me, but I'm here to trade and not to chatter. If you're not interested in my wares, don't disturb me continuing my experiments.
See ya, Jogador.
pages.title: Lailene

pages.name: Arkulius
npc_lines: Oh my! Alverus!! Did you really...?!?! I have to recalculate it to make sure that I made no mistake.
...the arithmetical paradox has the same value in a metaphysical way, then...
Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!
...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
<mumbles>
...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where...
How dare you asking me this?!? I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the HEADMASTER of this academy!!
I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the headmaster of this academy.
Time is an illusion and completely irrelevant to me.
You're welcome. Are you leaving now? Hopefully <sighs>.
The doctrine of elementalism is a very complex topic. Only the eldest may understand what it's all about. My dear friend Alverus took it way too far.
It happened while he carried out an experiment concerning the creation of the elemental shrines. I still get goose bumps just by thinking of it. ...
You need to know about the process of creating an elemental shrine to understand it completely, but I don't want to go into detail now. ...
Anyway, his spell had a different outcome than he had planned. He accidentally created an Ice Overlord, pure living elemental ice, who froze him in a blink of an eye.

We presumed their existence all these years but we were never able to prove it. Well, ironically my friend Alverus provided results by letting himself transform into a block of ice that can't be disenchanted.
The creation of the elemental shrines is a really complex matter. They are actually nodes, locations where the matching elemental sphere is very close. ...
The shrine itself is like a portal between our world and the elemental sphere and enables us to use the elemental energy emerging from it.
There are five spheres we know of: ice, fire, earth, energy and spirit. ....<mumbles> Hmmm, should I ask or not?....The heck with it! Now that you know about the spheres ...
I found a way to visit them. It's VERY dangerous and there is a decent chance that you won't come back BUT if you succeed you'll write history!!! Ask me about that mission if you're interested.
At last! Good things come to those who wait.
pages.title: Arkulius

pages.name: Sandra
npc_lines: Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.
Hello Jogador, welcome to the fluid and potion shop of Edron.
I sell potions and fluids. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
I am Lady Sandra Astralian.
