Though most of our noble order abandoned the more theoretical studies at the academies, it is an evil lie that we are failed students who know more about drinking and eating than about magic. ...
Once we have revealed all of Kullu's secrets, we will be envied by all. And of course we all will become famous and incredibly rich.
Kullu's recipes are as precious and complicated as are his spells. You often even need magic to have them done. Instant freezing and boiling are quite handy for most of them. ...

Not to mention the special conditions you have to take care of. Though most people lack the refinement of tasting skills to recognise the difference of a pasta caramellum made at full moon in winter and one made at an eclipse in autumn.

Now once we've got enough ingredients to finish the bridge, we have to face another challenge. And that is the cake keep itself! Is is an almost impenetrable though edible fortress made completely out of cake! ...
The thing is, to reach his secrets we will have to eat the whole cake! This is easier said than done though as the the cake regenerates itself periodically with the help of magic. ...
So we only have a few minutes to eat a whole layer of the cake, only then it will not regenerate but the upper layer will come down. So layer for layer we have to eat that cake. ...
It will take an army of hungry Tibians to eat them all in time. Even then things have to be somewhat coordinated. ...
People have to be brought here, wait for their turn to eat and of course stay hungry. Eating another layer might prove futile if you do not wait a few minutes for the hunger to return. ...
The good thing is that all people, big and small, can participate. ...

I guess the isle had a nice and flashy name in the past. But you know how people are. Someone started to call it the Cake Isle and I guess it is only a matter of time until this is shortened to CI. ...
People don't take their time anymore, not even for enjoyment.
Kullu's spells are highly sought after. There are a few minor ones he sold before he became an eremite. And there are rumours about some others.
Well for instance there is the ultimate sweetness spell that makes everything taste extremely sweet. Even if you freeze or hit your finger with an hammer it tastes sweet! ...
Or the refill spell that refills your cup, bottle, bowl etc. as long as there is a tiny bit left in it. Marvels that we will rediscover!
I am Brian. Brian the baker, that is.
We invented machines that can extract the essence of the cake golems. That is the part that gives them the stability to move and withstand damage and environmental hazards. ...
Well, actually we had them built by the dwarven technomancers. But it was us who figured out the basic principles! ...
However, whenever a cake golem gets into one of those machines, it gets disassembled in the blink of an eye and we get the enchanted base which we use to build our bridge.
Do you have some sugar for me? Please note that you can hand me all your sugar at once, if you want to.
Sorry, you don't have the sugar we are looking for. You can loot it from the cake golems.
Good bye.
pages.title: Brian The Baker

pages.name: Casper
npc_lines: Hello and greetings! How I love our meetings!
To guide you in this challenge I was sent, Kurik asked me to and so I went.
Down below awaits you a quest. Soon we will learn who is the best.
Go down now and be attentive and quick. With the slow ones kicked out, only the fastest will stick.
If you are cunning and act smart, you might be lucky and get a reward.
I'm not yet impressed and just for the rhyme ask me again but another time.
Change you will and run around. Find your match or return to the ground.
You've got your wand. Now leave me be. I say farewell, away with thee.
Kurik the genius, Kurik the mad. Is the world hollow or is the world flat?
I'm a jester, I'm a fool. I have no name, though it'd be cool.
A charming smile and a rhyme on my lips, I'll give the fools a few answers and tips.
Goodbye to you, our meeting was cool. I yet have to guess if you or me is the fool.
pages.title: Casper

pages.name: Balduin The Baker
npc_lines: Hi there Bennie. I guess you are here to assist me in my job!

I'm a member of the Magic Bakery Alliance. We are an order that is dedicated to further the knowledge of bakery for the benefit of mankind. Our goals are as numerous as the recipes we come up with each season.
Currently we are trying to reclaim another part of Kullu's wisdom. Year after year, we try our best to break the defences of Cake Keep Isle.

He was a great mage but an even greater cook. His recipes and spells are priceless. Sadly, even if we succeed in breaking the defences of Cake Keep Isle, we will only manage to decipher a tiny fraction of his knowledge. ...
And still, we don't know what happened to Kullu. He retreated from our world to fully concentrate on his research on cooking recipes and spells. ...
He was some sweet tooth for all that we know. And for sure a genius when it comes to baking and magic. ...
His kitchen magic was that amazing, you could not tell where baking ended and magic started.
To be undisturbed, he placed his keep on an isle that existed on a planar instability which allowed him to phase the isle out of existence for most of the time. ...
Additionally he surrounded the isle with a sorcery of his invention that defied most attempts to reach it. ...
It took us quite a while to figure out that he'd never be able to weave a protection spell against something he loved so dearly like cakes and bakery wares. ...
So we came up with the idea of the bridge.

After a few failed attempts with gingerbread boats and the like, we figured out how to reach Cake Keep Isle. We used the very ingredients we could derive from his cake golem attacks to build a stable cake bridge to his isle.
Ah well, that's an .. uhm .. funny story. ...
You see, after the first expedition reached the isle, they took so long trying to find a way to Kullu's secrets that the isle began to vanish into the void while they were still there. ...
The entire time, they were harassed by Kullu's cake golem guardians of the keep. In the last minute, they cast emergency teleports to their home cities. ...
The good thing is it was not too late and all escaped. Well, the bad thing is their spells somehow reacted with the void-rift of that place, building astral tunnels from the void to said cities. ...

Now, whenever the isle manifests, the tunnels manifest as well. The ugly part is that through this one-way tunnels the cake golem army that was apparently sucked into the void has access to the cities and can raid them. ...
But they are not only an annoyance but also our greatest chance. Nasty but tasty little buggers. They can be troublesome but we need them for our bridge construction.
The golems that raid the cities supply us with two major materials that we need to build our bridge to Cake Keep Isle. ...
One component is the sugary mass that can be gained if you slay one of them. We use it as a kind of mortar. ...

The second part is a bit trickier to get. It is the raw cake material. It is kind of challenging to gain it. We built extraction machines that can drain the base material from the still animated corpses. ...
We placed one in each of the raided cities. You will have to lure the golems into the machines, to extract the material from them. ...
We need it to have a stable base material that is resilient against wind, weather and salt water.
We accumulated 116 of 200 sugary mass. We can't fail this year! We will not allow it!
I'm somewhat worried. Getting the base material is always the tricky part. People are usually a bit too eager to kill. We accumulated 140 of 200 base material until now.
We are a mystic order of bakers who pursue goals for the benefit of all mankind. Don't even listen to the lies and propaganda spread by those who envy us.
Though most of our noble order abandoned the more theoretical studies at the academies, it is an evil lie that we are failed students who know more about drinking and eating than about magic. ...
Once we have revealed all of Kullu's secrets, we will be envied by all. And of course we all will become famous and incredibly rich.
We are a mystic baker order. Don't listen to those who envy us and spread ugly lies and propaganda. We are dedicated to uncover the greatest secrets about cooking and baking. ...
Baking is the only trade worth to be considered. Without bakers everyone would starve. We are what ties a society together, preferably with a thick, sticky and sweet mass made of fruits. ...
We are the momentum of culture. Baking is what divides civilization from barbarism.
Good bye.
pages.title: Balduin The Baker

pages.name: Sharon
npc_lines: Welcome to Travora, Jogador! I suppose you're here for the character world transfer.

Character world transfer means that you will leave this world and move to a new one to live there. If you need detailed information just ask me. I can also check if you're ready and teleport you up to the departure platform.
I can tell you about the requirements for a transfer, about what happens to your skills, quests, money and items, and I can also check if you fulfil the requirements.
Well, first of all you need to be signed up for a transfer on the Tibia website. Without that, nothing will happen! ...
You MUST NOT have a black or red skull or have a final warning! Of course we don't want criminals to move around freely. ...
You MUST give up all your bonds on this world. No marriage. No guild. No house. ...
You can only move every 6 months! So if you've already changed worlds, you need to wait 6 months for a new transfer. ...
There is also an item limit. I can tell you about what happens to your money and items, and I can also check if you meet the requirements.
You are allowed to bring 1000 items with you. They MUST be either in your inventory or in the Travora depot, else they will be deleted! ...
Some items are limited to ONE only. That includes all pieces of equipment - such as weapons or armors - and some valuable quest items. ...

For example, you can only bring ONE Sword of Valor, ONE Stonecutter Axe, ONE Nose Ring and so on. Runes, potions and ammunition are unlimited, but of course you could buy all that on your new world and save the space! ...
I recommend selling all other items and deposit that money on your bank account. Or you could give them to friends who stay here! ...
I can check if you meet all necessary requirements for a transfer.
This depot has 1000 item slots. It is south of here. Make sure to put all of your important items there! The rest will be deleted!

You may only take one item name with you - or one pile of it, if it's a stackable item. Please check your transfer depot here on Travora as well as your inventory and make sure you only have ONE or ONE STACK in total!
You meet all in-game requirements for a character world transfer. Have you also signed up and paid on the Tibia website?
Bye-bye, Player! Don't forget - if you logout on the platform above and fulfil all requirements, your character will arrive on your new world after the next server save.
pages.title: Sharon

pages.name: Lazaran
npc_lines: Me greet. You no enemy of tribe.
Me Lazaran.
Me chief of tribe.

Our tribe here live long time. Tribe once was great, one of many. Now we are all what left of tribe. Snakemen hunted our people. Snakemen make many kill. Our people go hiding. Only go out in night when snakemen sleep. ...
All who survived gathered. Made new tribe. We trying to survive. We no seek war with others. We little hunt and much eat mushroom found in caves. Growing mushrooms we do to survive.
Our mushrooms need harvesting. Is really easy, but we so much things to do... you help out if want! ...
Use big mushrooms in two mushroom caves to harvest. Please bring brown ones to me. Have magical power! You can keep rest!
You early! Already done harvesting and have nice brown mushrooms for us?
Me take those . You keep rest. Me thank you! Your reward is ancient knowledge of tribe! Me teach you something. <whispers in your ear>
Me no want talk about Makao.
Yes.. Namasa young pretty woman.
He sound our war drums! That where name come from. Tatak, tatak!
Me look for Kito everywhere again. Always gone when something needs doing.
Very wise priest. She speaks to gods, and can also speak to you. You can find upstairs on prayer place!
We know many gods. Pandor, god of war, Uzroth, god of spirits, Krunus, god of food and Fasuon, watcher with two burning eyes. You see, we know many gods, more than I can count.
Pandor ashamed of us. We lost all to greens. Now we not in favour of Pandor. That's why we live in cave.
Uzroth is master of spirits, good and bad. Uzroth is very moody. One day he give you present, next day he send evil spirit. Must do much to make Uzroth happy.
Krunus let things grow. Gives women magic to grow little people.
Fasuon is watcher and judge. All day his flaming eyes looking on world. Only in night he sleeps, that is why many evil happens in night.
Green ones on wolves chase us in plains. Dragon people are worse. All that green is mean. Ungh! Ungh!
Like snakes on legs they are. Living in great cities in North. Once ruled all the land. Hunting all. Green men fought and stole plains from snakemen who are people of the dragons.
Fierce warriors, led by horned ones. Great numbers. Stealing plains from dragon people.
Horned people only few but fearsome warriors. Master of green ones they become. Making all green ones obey.
You ill? You make strange noise.
Not know of mean Otau. If he mean to you he not our friend either!
No, no, me called Lazaran. Not Leezaraad.
We come and see little men. They like us, only very little. They having good weapon and armor, like the greens.
Me no know what you mean.
Many mighty monster rule land. We fight. We lose. We flee to mountain to hide.
Land called Zao by snakemen. Perhaps has meaning in snake language. We no need other name for land than land. Is no other we know.
Yes we often starving. Food not plenty.
You speak language of priests. You language is holy language only leaders and priests speaking. That why we know you good. ...
Language of my people other language is. Tribe only know few words in holy language from prayers.
We often eat bug. Excalibug sound much yummy!
Bee-ah? Sound like animal. Hope is not dangerous!
Yes! We drink to peace. And to success of great hunt.
Go good.
pages.title: Lazaran

pages.name: Chrak
npc_lines: Greetingz, competitor.
Ze tournament iz ze ultimate challenge of might and prowrezz. Ze rulez may have changed over ze centuriez but ze ezzence remained ze zame. ..
If you know ze rulez, you might enter ze arena for ze battle.
I waz informed zat you were zent to fight for one of ze mozt preztigiouz officialz of ze court. According to ze rulez, ziz zponzorzhip allowz you to participate in ze tournament. ..
While in ze pazt, ze tournament waz ztrictly non-leazal, ze ztakez have raized conziderably nowadayz. Zo lizten clozely: You will enter ze tornament az a team! ..
Two of you muzt have gotten ze permizzion to enter ze arena. Zen you have to ztand on ze platformz in ze back and one of you haz to pull ze lever. You will be tranzported into ze arena. ..
Once you enter, zere will only be victory or deaz! You have to be aware zat zere will be no chance to flee ze combat! Firzt you will face one team of opponentz. ..

You don't have long to defeat zem becauze zoon anozer team will enter ze fight. Az outziderz you will certainly be ze target of zeir concentrated attackz, zo it iz advizable to get rid of your opponentz az quickly az pozzible. ..
You might even gain zome time to regroup and tend your woundz if you are quick. After fighting zix teamz, you will have to face ze current champion of ze arena of ztrive. ..
If you manage to defeat him, your mazter winz ze tournament and all honourz. Zo if you feel prepared for ze battle, you can azk me to enter ze arena any time.
Zo you want to enter ze arena, you know ze rulez and zat zere will be no ozer option zan deaz or victory.
I grant you ze permizzion to enter ze arena. Remember, you'll have to enter ze arena az a team of two. If you are not familiar wiz ze rulez, I can explain zem to you once again.
pages.title: Chrak

pages.name: Emilie
npc_lines: Hello helpful citizen Jogador! Finally!
We agents of the Combined Magical Winterberry Society try to ensure the harvesting and processing of winterberries into all sorts of useful, magical fluids. ...
AND we have an important mission for you - yes you. One that will influence practically all of Tibia.
Winterberries are special berries only harvestable during a short time of the year. They are used to refine potions of all sorts. They can severely enhance their magical effects. ...
Without them it is generally a little more difficult to create effective potions.
The Combined Magical Winterberry Society was founded more than one hundred years ago by mage Tolwyn Winter. ...
It's our duty to ensure the harvesting and processing of winterberries to secure a steady flow of the appropriate magical resources for potions and other magical fluids in this world.
We oversee the treading of winterberries in all of Tibia. The processed berries will be used to refine magical potions such as health or mana potions.
Ahem... WELCOME! The Combined Magical Winterberry Society is proud to have you on board... mumble... mmh... which thank you very much... in our humble opinion... is our duty to... mumble ...
And that is why you are here now. To help us, yourself and everyone around you of course. Are you ready to join us and do you have at least 3 bunches of winterberries with you?
Good! Then I'm officially allowed and encouraged to transport you to one of our cellars. Are you prepared to leave?
Just perfect! Have a safe journey! And good treading...
pages.title: Emilie

pages.name: Sinclair
npc_lines: Indeed, there has to be some other way.
No, we have to give this another go.
Yes indeed, all of the equipment should be checked and calibrated regularly.
Mmh, interesting.
Greetings Jogador. I have - very - little time, please make it as short as possible. I may be able to help you if you are here to help us with any of our tasks or missions.
I'm one of the few leading scientists in the field of ecto-magical research and development. There is a lot of work to do, time is very precious right now and we have practically no supporters.
Ah you are interested in science? You should speak to Spectulus upstairs, maybe he has something for you.
Good, you're eager to work, however, you should speak to Spectulus first.
Of course you can help researching, I may have a mission for you concerning that matter.
My colleague and fellow campaigner in our quest to explore the world of the spirits. He was the first one I encountered actively interested in this field of science.

Spirits can be good and also evil. In common belief, spirits are often seen as guides or guardians of people. But there are many forms and types of them, and they often actively try to cause harm. ...
We also use 'spirit' as a broader term to describe all sorts of ghosts, ghasts and apparitions here at the Spirithunters headquarters.
In contrary to ghasts, ghosts are dangerous phenomena that can change their position, they wail and can even manipulate materia in the case of 'poltergeists'. ...

It is also possible to communicate with some of them, but be wary of their true evil nature and keep your distance. You may even encounter harmless ghosts out there. But those are very rare and usually tied to sad events.
Ghasts largely differ from ghosts in a way that they are almost always stationary, silent manifestations of a dead person or creature. They are also a common illusion poorly talented mages think of.
Apparitions can be visions - very similar to day-dreams - of spirits or ghostly phenomena. ...
Those visions always feel very real, we tracked several cases where people were actually... 'eaten' by one of those. You should take them very seriously.
You should talk to Spectulus first if you need more information about what we do here.
My name is Sinclair. Pleased to meet you. Now where was I - oh yes.
Well, we are indeed not far from a major breakthrough in the field of ecto-magical disturbances.
What? Well, let me see - it is horas. Satisfied?
I erm - I'm not much of a politician I'm afraid.
Well, there are some phenomena even the army is at a loss with. And who are you going to call then? Oh well.
We can work quite untroubled here in the university - at least for now.
Thais is a lively city, that's for sure. Well, I'm not much a people person actually, so... maybe you should ask someone else about that.
Aren't there several islands near Carlin? Hm, I wonder if one can find anything interesting there.
Its people are what we are doing all this for. All our research, all magical devices we create - it's all for the purpose to do good in our world.

Spectulus talks about this sometimes. I guess it is one of his dreams. You know, being able to finally chart the unknown that is above and around us all. The sea of light. Not entirely my cup of tea, though.

There was a greedy man from Edron who wanted to find a very rare gem. Based on a loose story told by a travelling merchant, he found the mountain where the gem had to be ripped from the clutches of the stone. ...
He searched so hard and with so much effort that he became obsessed by not only the stone but the search itself. He turned every stone, spent all his money and crew and equipment. ...
His obsessiveness would eventually cost him the only precious thing still left to him, his own life. ...
His obsession became so powerful, however, that it is said he roams the small mountain to this very day. The hidden stone still his object of desire. ...
If this is indeed true, we have an object or relic here - the stone itself - which could be used for our paranormal studies.
Oh, have you lost the spirit cage? You know, you will have to catch all those spirits again - are you sure?
Alright, I have another prototype ready. You will have to catch all the ghosts again on your own of course. ...
Oh and be careful with this one, the magical reluctance of the barriers against ecto-magical disturbances is quite fragile. Don't lose it again or the device might get 'angry'.
The spirit cage is a portable, safer version of the spirit chamber. You can change its position while it is active. The magical barrier is infinitely smaller and will shift accordingly. ...
However, it can only hold a limited number of spirits or ghasts.
Goodbye and good luck Jogador.
pages.title: Sinclair

pages.name: Jack
npc_lines: Mh...
Could it be...? No. No way.
So much to do, so little time, they say...
They won't believe me anymore, they just won't believe me. Well, my sis is slowly accepting that this was all a lie. I don't know about my mother, though.
Well, currently I don't have any occupation. Besides my love for sculpting sulky sculptures, like the one in the back there.
My name is Jack. What's your name? Ah yes, Jogador.

Sometimes, when I really need some time for myself, I take a walk outside. Somehow she always thinks I am up to something when I'm not here. Or maybe she just doesn't want to lose me. But why? I always came back, didn't I.

Well, she is a little older than me and I believe she thinks mother favours me in some way because I am the youngest. I wouldn't know for sure, however. And mother always keeps her busy. Not that she'd never complain, though.
That's me alright. Any problems with that? No? Thought so.
It's about horas.
Gesundheit! It seems you caught quite a cold.
I... was... sculpting sulky sculptures. For all my life. Until you came in here and DESTROYED MY MASTERPIECE. Go away. I don't like you.
Mh, never been that far.
I don't care about much outside of my home here in Edron. And why should I even.
Well, Tibianus is a good king as far as I can tell. On the other hand, I don't care about him much as long as I can do what I like to whenever I want to.
Yep, that's my home. Nice city and all. Been here all my life, don't intend changing this.
Good to know that they're there to defend us. I for one would never join the army, though.
Never heard about that.
Don't know. Guess it just doesn't happen much in these parts.
Yes yes. Goodbye Jogador.
pages.title: Jack

pages.name: Sister Of Jack
npc_lines: Lalala...
Where did I put my broom? Mother?
Mhmhmhmhm.
Mother?! Oh no, now I have to do this all over again.
Mh hello there. What can I do for you?
I help my mother to do the housework.
I’m Jack’s sister, and you should really not be here.
Oh this time he is in for it! Mother will be so upset!
Mother takes good care of us. We never had to worry about anything, with her doing all the… thinking for us.
It should be horas by now.
I wanted to go there once, but mother said I shouldn’t.
I don’t go outside much.
I wanted to visit the king once but mother said I shouldn’t go.
Edron is our home and it will always be.
Jack never wanted to have anything to do with the army.
I don’t really know what you are talking about.
I guess I don’t have any news for you.
Goodbye then.
pages.title: Sister Of Jack

pages.name: Mother Of Jack
npc_lines: Jane!
Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
JAAAAACK? EVERYTHING ALRIGHT DOWN THERE?
There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What were you thinking, Jane?
I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.
I do the cooking and some other housework. Jack’s sister Jane is helping me a lot, though.
I’m the mother of Jack and Jane.
JAAACK!! Why won’t he come up here? Jack!! No, no I can’t believe it.
Well, Jane is of course helping me with the household, always doing this and that. Hardworking girl she is, hardworking girl.
It’s exactly horas.
I don’t even know where that is.
I’m happy right here as long as Jack and Jane are with me.
Now you start asking the same things like Jack’s sister, what’s all the fuss about visiting the king anyway.
I have lived here as long as I can remember. And the same goes for Jack and his sister Jane.
I would never allow Jack to go away from here, he stays with us.
I’m afraid I don’t understand.
I’m sorry but I do not have any news for you.
Farewell.
pages.title: Mother Of Jack

pages.name: Lothar
npc_lines: Welcome to my humble hut, Jogador. What brings you here?
It's on the door.
Some call me animal whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple stable keeper.
I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and tamed.
It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an item, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
Take care of yourself.
A rare sturgeon is said to be the favourite food of unsatiable maws dwelling in nightmarish Roshamuul.
You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
Oh, it looks quite old. The scribbled notes are barely readable. But I have the impression that you could borrow a very special book with this ticket.
What a pretty ball, my friend. At first glance it looks like a toy for kids. But I guess a foxmouse would also like to play with it, given the fact that foxmice are very playful animals.
Oh, what unusual colours. Very pretty, indeed. I guess, this is the kind of delicacy a giant beaver would appreciate.
You could surely wind up a small mechanic toy with this key.
What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.

The Regalia of Suon! Only a few of them were ever forged, back in the times of the old empire of Kilmaresh. This is a very rare and precious treasure. The Regalia of Suon are a gift that would be worth even a gryphon's favour.
This piece of cloth will enable you to gather ghostly residue, that will be shaped by your willpower to create a rideable haze.
Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.

Did you know that you can also create those by yourself? Trade a gold ingot with the sweaty cyclops in Ab'Dendriel for a cup of molten gold. If you use that on a fir tree, you have a small chance to get a golden fir cone. ...
Those are needed to impress the white deers that roam around Ab'Dendriel sometimes, but I'd wait until you are able to enrage one to make sure it has the necessary strength to carry you.
Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the ladybug. Both of them might actually go well together.
Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.

At first sight this candle might only illuminate your house. But this light is something special. Moles are, as you probably know, blind. Nevertheless they feel very appealed by this candle stump. That might be the way to tame them.
Tales of a mystic jaguar roaming sunken cities somewhere in Tiquanda tell of a sacred creature, blessed by a benevolent god named Tukh.

Oh, what a beautiful amulet. Really very artful and elaborate! It would be a fitting adornment even for a creature as majestic as a noble lion. If you offer it respectfully such a kingly animal might accompany you.
There are creatures of darkness and cold, living on a remote island and fighting against light and warmth. It is said that they can be subdued and forced to do the bidding of others.
I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.
How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
This fiery horseshoe will only fit a steed just as fiery and wild.
The stampor in the back? She's my friend, but she came to me out of her own free will. I must admit I've never managed to tame any other stampor. ...
I heard that there's some sort of voodoo magic which would allow you to summon a stampor, but I'm not a voodoo expert, so I wouldn't know.
Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.
Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.

It is said that ferocious creatures once thrived on lush islands in the far northern sea. They died aeons ago when times of great cold came and formed the icy wastes of Svargrond as we know them today. ...
Travellers from the north have told stories of these creatures, watching them from within the ice in the deepest caves, still vigilant as if frozen in time. 'Ursagrodon' they called them. ..
With tinder and some kind of fireproof vessel, you could create a device to melt the ice surrounding their remains and see for yourself what this is all about.
That's an interesting one, nothing like I have ever seen myself. What you describe is a device of which I heard that it grants literally 'complete' control over some sort of... artificial thing? ...
Well, if you ever happen to come about a stroke of luck and find such a thing - use it on an appropriate mount, it will probably be mechanical, driven by... something.

That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.

Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
I heard stories about those artificial flowers. The werelions of the Darama Desert create them and they come in different colours. Each colour has a different meaning. ...
White silk flowers are used as love pledges, for example. But red ones are decorations for bravery and valour. ...
If you offer one respectfully to a white lion, such a kingly animal might accompany you willingly.
The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
pages.title: Lothar

pages.name: A Beautiful Girl
npc_lines: So you have come, Jogador. I hoped you would not...
I don't have a profane 'job' - it is my destiny to devour evil and bring a new dawn.
My name would be unspeakable for your tongue. You may call me Devovorga - which comes rather close.
You sound like you wish to help me. Yet I must walk this path alone - but thank you.
I see how corrupt this world has become and it makes me want to cry.
What you call 'corruption' could be salvation - and what you consider 'good' is rotten to its pitch black close.
You're welcome to join me in the pain you also helped causing.
An ugly brat creeping out of a dirty old hag's belly turned into a juggernaut.
They strayed from their path and are far from their old roots.
Little critters are digging and digging away of that which nurtures us all.
I've watched them for a long time and hoped to see something better... but... they're not.
Irrelevant beings driven by rage and violence.
My enslavers and creators formed and summoned my soul and then, seeing I was too powerful for them, trapped me deep down here. How foolish of them.

Can you imagine thousands of years trapped down here? I'm thirsting for life. I will face my creators and enslavers and free this beautiful world from them and from anything else that keeps destroying it.
I will not turn against you if you just leave me alone and let me do what I have to do - for now.
You lack receptors to even come close to my experience of pain. You can't paint a rainbow with only yellow colours.
Yes, I was created. And I'm not a mere being like humans, devils, demons or even gods. I'm a weapon. I'm devouring. I'm hungry. I want revenge.
How cute and shallow that sounds from your limited vocal chords and lips. You should have heard my enslavers pronounce it - accompanied by thunder in their voices that shook earth and sky.
I'm trapped in this useless body. But I can feel it begin to change... finally...
I've been waiting here for a long time. Even before this continent started turning dark.
He was the only one I knew who could truly see the soul in beings other than humans and animals.
He had potential. But he got too distracted by his selfish thirst for blood.
I watched the boy. What a sad story - and how sweet his release was in the end.
He doesn't matter anymore. None of them actually does.
What you call 'corruption' could be salvation - and what you consider 'good' is rotten to its pitch black core.
All good questions start with 'why'. Except those that start with 'do'. Yet, I can't answer this one - I'm asking myself as well. WHY?
It might be too late to eradicate all the evil in this world - it has been growing and proliferating for too many years now.
Its sunrise will leave you overwhelmed and blinded.
I've been waiting here for a long time. Even before this continent started turning dark.
*shudders and trembles*... wait.. what did you say? I'm trying to focus on our insigni.. no, I mean, interesting conversation, but I feel slightly sick... I'm sorry.
pages.title: A Beautiful Girl

pages.name: A Wandering Soul
npc_lines: Is that you...? No... it's not... she never woke up again... the pain... cursed... to wander... Leave me alone in my mourning...
I saw you... who are you... what do you want from me...?
No... I don't think I can help you... leave me alone in my mourning...
pages.title: A Wandering Soul

pages.name: Ben
npc_lines: Groar.
*The bear eyes you knowingly*
pages.title: Ben

pages.name: Nurik
npc_lines: Leave me alone, please. I have to prepare for my departure.
pages.title: Nurik

pages.name: Telas Golem
npc_lines: What .. happened?
Where .. am I?
There ...
is a mission. I have a mission to fulfil. ...
My memory is coming back. ...
Some of it.
There ...
was a name once. ...
So long ago.
must find order in the chaos. ...
It .. will take time. But ...
my mission is important. I will need help ...
all the help I can get. ...
My mission is ...
to save the world.
When ...
I understand what ...
happened, I will need ...
help. ...
Lots of help. ...
Alliances will have ...
to be forged. ...
If I could only remember. ...
If I could only ...
understand. ...
I need time. ...
When the time comes ...
I will need you!
The world is ...
in great danger. I ...
have forgotten why. ...
Or have I? There is something ...
I have to remember ...
or was it to forget?
No danger ...
just certain and complete destruction.
My memory is hazy. ...
My thoughts are in ...
chaos. I need time to ...
sort all these thoughts ...
to make sense of ...
pictures ...
sentences.
The ...
enemy knows no time. ...
He knows no haste. ...
Our only chance.
I can't remember. ...
must not remember.
The source ...
we could not cleanse it.
Things ...
can't be undone. The only hope ...
for the future ...
is the future.
The person ...
over there.
The body ...
is nothing but a vessel.
Good .. bye.
pages.title: Telas Golem

pages.name: Robson
npc_lines: Hrmpf, I'd say welcome if I felt like lying.
I was once a trader but after some years stranded on this remote isle, I felt that I liked that kind of life better and just stayed here even after steamships found that isle.
I was on a steamship to sell some wares in Edron. On the boat was a drunken human mage who all of a sudden thought he could speed up our trip by conjuring some winds. ...

Not that a steamship would have sails or that something like this would make sense in an underground cavern! But such thoughts did not occur to that drunken fool and soon we had some veritable STORM in our underground cave ! ...
The storm tore the steamship apart and I tied myself to a plank and drifted in the water for what felt like days. Then I finally reached that isle here. ...
I fought the inhabitants of the isle and my axe earned me some respect I guess. At least they no longer bothered me over here. Using some wreckage, I built my first hut here. ...
I was living on fish, mushrooms and some hunted meat. My only light source were some luminescent mushrooms. ...
First I thought I could not stand it for a month but when I was eventually found by an exploring steamship, I felt that I no longer wanted to leave at all. ...
Of course I ordered some resources that I had missed all those years. I also ordered building materials to build a real hut. And guess what happened? ...
They sent me PARCELS! I mean I was lost for years, all that I wanted was some decent wood to have a real home and they sent me PARCELS! ...
What did they think I was going to do with them? Build a castle or what? However, the next shipment brought me the correct material and I could finally build a decent home. ...
By the way, if you need a parcel just ask me. I have to get rid of a few thousand.

It seems there was once a building in the centre of the isle. The ruins are still there. Some of the pillars outside remind me of what I've seen in a bonelord hideout that we've raided when I was younger. ...
The rest of the ruins here, though, does not fit into that. Either the isle has been populated by different inhabitants, or by some race that I don't know at all. ...
Be it as it may, there has to be something about this isle that attracted inhabitants before me and I wonder what that might be. ...
I could not figure it out in all those years though. So I doubt anyone can do that during my lifetime.
I'm Robson Stonespitter, Son of Earth of the Dragoneater fellowship.
You mean the little guy over there? I call him Lunch. He is my ... uhm friend ... I guess.
You won't believe it, but I found him in a giant fish that I captured. When I cut the beast in pieces, I saw a little goblin cowering inside. ...
He did not seem to be a threat and I kind of adopted him. Since I captured the fish for lunch and it was lunchtime I named him Lunch. ...
He learnt our language quite fast. Well at least the basics. He never bothered to improve his grammar but I'm no teacher anyway.
See you next time!
pages.title: Robson

pages.name: Cruleo
npc_lines: <gulp gulp>
Muhahaha!
This will earn me some handsome amount of gold!
I don't like visitors. I hope for you, you are here to trade?
I hope you have something of value to offer!
I'm a hunter and proud of it. I'm also willing to buy certain trophies of your own hunts if you are interested to trade.
Hunting is not for the chicken-hearted. I'm a hunter, my father was a hunter and my father's father was a hunter. That is the way things are. You hunt or you are hunted. ...
There is no shame, we humans fought our way up the food chain. In fact it is an honour and we should not mock our ancestors' efforts. ...
We humans are hunters, like it or not. Hunting is part of life and it is how the world works and was meant to be.
Those pesky tree dwellers are bad for business. They care more for the animals than for us humans, why would we care for them or their assumed pets? ...
Their days are over, even when they fail to see that. This is the age of humans and it is us who decide what is right or wrong.
I think she is quite amusing in her naivety. The funny thing is, I bet as much as she cares for those stupid animals, she'd love to strangle guys like me to death. ...
Funny thing, eh? However, her efforts are futile. There have always been hunters and there always will be. I'm sure there is even a hunter in her. ...

But let her dwell in the luxury of her illusions to be better than others, I couldn't care less. For now she is only an annoyance, if she ever really crosses me ... well, it's a cruel world out there.
A magnificent animal indeed but still not more than an animal. Those damned elves are behaving like they are sacred or something. ...
Gladly, the elves are the only ones who believe that nonsense born out of fairy tales. ...
Several rich people are firmly convinced of the mythical nature of the deer and pay handsomely for their antlers and furs. If you happen to 'find' some, I'll be interested to trade with you.
The white deer antlers are worked into several objects or even used in medicine.
The fur of the white deer is prized by followers of the latest fashion, magicians and nobles. Some use them for assumed magical purposes, others for prestige, others for style.
Bye.
pages.title: Cruleo

pages.name: Ottokar
npc_lines: Oh my! Oh my!!
All these troubles...
Where to get enough food for all?
This time things are getting troublesome.
Greetings my friend! You look like you're in quite good health!

The poor often are the ones worst afflicted by plagues, for various reasons. Here in Venore, the swamp fever makes things even more dangerous. If I had some more medicine, though, things would surely change!
The swamp fever is an old curse that has befallen this settlement ever since its founding. We still know very little about it. ...

There seems to be a connection with humidity and starvation though. The upper classes apparently need not fear the fever as much. They contract it significantly less often, and usually receive immediate treatment with effective medicine. ...
A luxury that the poor cannot afford.
Do you have any medicine pouch with you?
Oh, I see. If you happen to loot any of them, please bring them here. We need them desperately.
I used my family's fortune to provide Venore with a poor house, where those without money, food and hope can find shelter.
With the funding by some temples and donations of gracious adventurers, I am able to provide the homeless with some food and health care.
I have to be honest: there is no reward I could give you for a donation, regardless of how high it is. Your only reward would be to know that you have helped. ...
So do you still intend to make a donation for the poor, knowing that there is no reward waiting for you?
I can't blame you. These are hard times.
Thank you. How much do you want to donate?
Thank you very much, your help is appreciated.
You are very generous. This will feed a lot of empty stomachs!
I feel ashamed you offer that much and all I have in return is my gratitude.
I really don't know what to say in view of such a great help. We will be able to do a lot with your money. The roof! Perhaps we can even spare some money to fix the roof! And blankets! ...
We could buy blankets for the winter! Oh, thank you! A thousand times thank you!
I am stunned by your generosity. This is just incredible. Oh, all the opportunities! Thank you so much!

This has to be a dream! It can't be true! I just can't believe this! Words cannot express my gratitude. Rest assured your money will be put to good use! You have changed a lot of lives for the better today!
Hm, it seems you do not have all the money you want to donate. Maybe you should start with smaller steps.
In Venore with all its riches, the difference between the rich and the poor are extreme. The upper class cares little for anything beside their own personal gain.
Some Thaians came here, lured by rumours of becoming rich within a short time. ...
Of course their dreams were shattered, and the few that could even earn a meagre living can consider themselves lucky.
It is said that in Carlin, a female aristocracy suppresses men, and that to laugh on the open streets there is deemed a frivolous and punishable offense.
What we hear of Edron is that it is a war-ridden isle on which a knightly order fights for supremacy again monsters, with the ordinary people paying a high blood toll for a futile agenda.
The word is that the elves don't like foreigners at all.
The stories of Liberty Bay sound all too familiar to the ones that foreigners tell who have come to Venore. ...
I know a lot of desperate people who left with the intent to begin anew in Liberty Bay. Until today, we have never heard of them again.
Kazordoon is a dark and humid place filled with smoke and the constant sound of hammering. As far as I know, only dwarfs can survive there.
The king is far away and I doubt that he cares for the poor even in his own royal city. We here in Venore feel little of the king's benevolence, but still have to pay taxes.
Trolls are brutal cannibals and are the main reason why the poor can't even find some food in the environments. ...
It is not too farfetched to assume they are the source of the swamp fever. Though it seems as if they were immune to it, they might be carriers of the disease.
Good bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Ottokar

pages.name: Benevola
npc_lines: Greetings. I hope you are here on a mission for nature!
Have you captured any wolf?
No you have not.
Too bad.
I'm a preserver of nature. It's a sad thing, but as so many so-called intelligent beings tamper with nature's balance, it has become necessary to adjust things to maintain the balance.
The natural balance is a delicate thing. Greed is its greatest enemy. I do that little that I can do to preserve the balance.
Nature's balance sometimes seems like a myth or unreachable ideal. But we must do our part in keeping the balance because our intelligence gives us this responsibility.
Many have lost their touch to nature. They have given in to greed and the excuse of necessity. ...
Yet, some still know, at least deep in their hearts, what is the right thing to do. This is my hope.

There are many stories and legends about the white deer. For sure it is a magnificent beast but this might be its downfall. It's majesty awakes the greed in the hearts of others and greed is balance's greatest enemy.

The wolves hunt their share until they feel no hunger anymore. Greedy people hunt the deer for its antlers and fur. The lowered deer population leave the wolves starving and aggressive until they become a threat.
You might have occasionally encountered a few wolves and probably even fought them. Those are the few wolves that got too hungry and daring so they left their hiding place. ...

Most wolves of a population you won't see at all though. They hide in the shadows and hunt by night. You only see them when the hunger drives them out and you will see that hunger makes them ferocious enemies.
As long as many hungry wolves are out there, the deer population cannot recover. Therefore I placed magical traps in the wilderness. ...
The traps will recognise any wolf that is starving and then pacify and magically shrink it. ...
When you lured a starving wolf into a trap, please bring it to me. I will keep it in suspended animation until the balance is restored.
Good bye.
pages.title: Benevola

pages.name: An Ancient Priest
npc_lines: Greetings mortal! What brings you here? I have a job to do you know.
I'm the caretaker of this tomb. I also know these parts like the back of my hand - just in case you need a status update.
I preserve the history of the great Pharaoh Horestis.
He was one of the first Pharaohs of the united tribes and under his rule the race of man flourished to formerly unknown heights.
He wisely used the power of his position to unite the tribes of the desert who formerly defied the rules of the dynasty.
The ancestors of the dynasty led the human tribes from the lizard-ruled jungles to the desert where they could finally live without prosecution.
In the jungle the cruel lizards hunted humans for sport and although food was abundant, the humans were denied any hunting grounds as the lizards claimed everything for themselves.
The lizards were powerful and many. They wielded magic unknown to the race of man at this time. Nothing could oppose their rule in these days. ...
The desert was harsh but avoided by the lizards. Due to cunning and resilience the humans prevailed where the lizards had failed.
They learned to live with that little that the desert and the sea had to offer. They dwelt in the caves of the mountains, however, some split and rather roamed the desert.
The caves were the first safe haven of humankind since the beginning of time. They were widened and artificial caves were added. ...
Even later when a settlement had been built at the coast, the caves served as final retreat and fortress in times of danger.

Some defied the rules of the dynasty that had made the jungle of Tiquanda taboo for all humans. When they wandered into the jungle to hunt and steal equipment and secrets about the desert, they provoked punishing raids by the lizard people.
The raids were a great danger for the tribes of man in these days. They had not the manpower or weapons to stand against the might of the lizards.
Only slowly the humans became a power on their own. They learned from the desert, they learned from its inhabitants and finally, they learned how to communicate with its spirits.
The spirits of nature and of the animals began to talk to selected individuals. Individuals that used forbidden arts derived from what had been stolen from the lizards.
In the jungle, the humans had learned some of the most basic principles of magic through observation and experimentation. ...
Although everything connected with the lizard was seen as tainted, many of the greatest minds turned their attention to those studies.
The first shamans of mankind wielded only little power and there was only a small distinction between magic and making fire or creating a tool. ...
But when their dabbling with magic brought them into connection with the spirit world it became a breakthrough.

The spirits talked to the shamans and taught them many new things. The rock revealed its secrets and taught the humans to build with stone and to melt ore to metal. The water taught them about the places where to find it and how to conserve it. ...
The scorpion taught the use of poison and medicine, explained how to craft an armor and told them much about warfare. Many more spirits revealed their secrets, big and small.
With the emergence of these secrets, the shamans came out of hiding and boldly rose to power. Fights ensued and only the most mighty would prevail as leaders.
The most powerful shaman and fighter became the chieftain and the others became priests under his rule. ...
The chieftain married only into the families of priests and soon the first dynasty emerged.
When the dynasty emerged, the chieftains were called Pharaohs. They were the absolute rulers on this side of the mountains. Soon the caves were abandoned and people left for fortified settlements.
When the caves were abandoned, Horestis ordered to rebuild them into a temple and a tomb at once.
Wide parts of the caves were planned to become a temple where the spirits of nature could be worshipped. ...
It served as spiritual centre of the realm and Horestis's tomb was an integral part of the complex.
For a few generations after Horestis's death, the complex has been used as planned by the Pharaoh. ...
Then the interest in the old spirits waned and new rulers embraced more sinister secrets ...
Those were stolen and traded from the lizards and gained by bargains with the envious and reclusive scarab spirit. ...
The spirits turned more and more away from the humans and the humans turned away from the spirits. So the old pact had been broken.
The spirits, the temple and the tomb became forgotten. ...

A few of the remaining priests, loyal to the pact, exiled themselves to the complex and summoned vengeful spirits as guardians of the tomb and the temple and they constructed several protections to ensure that Horestis's eternal rest is not disturbed.
Many of the protections faded away over the centuries. ...
A few of the most powerful remain though. Foremost there are the spirits and guardians of the temple that will fight every intruder. ...
But their might is bound to the tomb and if Horestis's rest is disturbed, they will eventually fade away. The tomb itself is sealed with the help of Horestis' canopic jars. ...
As long as the canopic jars are intact, the tomb is sealed against any intruder. Also Horestis's honour guards keep watch. ...
If Horestis's body will ever be desecrated, they will rise from the desert to take revenge upon the living. Vast armies of undead warriors will seek revenge and try to strike down the living. ...
Finally there is Horestis's scorpion curse. He was the high priest of the scorpion spirit and his scorpions will spawn, particularly from the bodies of scarabs.
The canopic jars contain the preserved organs of Horestis's mummified body. ...
They are powerful magic talismans that ward off any intrusion into Horestis's tomb.
Horestis's body has been desecrated. His curse now hangs over the land like the shadow of the vulture. Abandon all hope mortals, his vengeance will be dreadful.
pages.title: An Ancient Priest

pages.name: Huntsman
npc_lines: Howdy partner.
I'm just a simple huntsman.
I hunt game of all sorts to earn a living. I respect the balance of nature though and take only as much as I need.
To be honest, I don't care too much about that spiritual balance thing. Better talk to Benevola about such things. ...
As a matter of fact though, if too many animals are killed, things might rapidly change for the worse. ...
So it's only practical thinking to keep the balance in mind as long as I can afford it.
pages.title: Huntsman

pages.name: Pyro Peter
npc_lines: Ah hello, hello - I hope you are familiar with the dangers of fire!
We need to do something to protect Shadowthorn or it will be devoured by the flames. And this is no ordinary fire. The firestarters laid waste with all their wrath, all their hate. ...
I am afraid no water of this world can stop it. We have to find another way.
Right now... countless firestarters are waiting in their cells below Shadowthorn, waiting to strike again. To take revenge and see the elves burn.
Guarded by three overseers, the firestarters are locked away beneath Shadowthorn. But they are thirsting for revenge. ...
However, with all three guards alive and a whole garrison of elves around them, there will be no way out of their cold, damp prison.
Guarded by three overseers, the firestarters are locked away beneath Shadowthorn. But they are thirsting for revenge. ...
However, with all three guards alive and a whole garrison of elves around them, there will be no way out of their cold, damp prison.
It started with the rise of the temple of the bog god. It appeared over night. There were no witnesses except the creatures of the bog. ...
When the elves saw the monument the next day, they felt a strange and powerful presence. The elder god of the bog.
When the elder god rose in the bog outside of Shadowthorn, many fell for his mighty influence. ...
His powers so vast, his might so inconceivable, some elves turned to and followed him the very moment they set foot on the temple ground.
The followers of the bog were numerous after the bog god temple appeared. ...
However, many outsiders and watchful people of Shadowthorn sensed that following this entity blindly was wrong. ...
They stood against the followers and a conflict arose.

Not long after the incident in the bog, discrepancies between the followers and the resisting people escalated. In a short but devastating battle between both fanatic factions, the houses of the followers were kindled by the resistance. ...
Eventually the followers got the firestarters under control and locked them away in underground prisons, leaving Shadowthorn an eerie place full of hostility.
The flames will... the... what? Ah I uhm, I'm Peter. A-and you are ...? Ah, nice to meet you Jogador.
Job? JOB? This is not a simple job, I'm here to WARN people, to HELP the citizens of Venore! They just won't listen to me...
I'm on a mission, yes. A mission to help the people of Venore - the people of Tibia! We must be aware of what happens at Shadowthorn!
FIRE!! All of Shadowthorn is in flames! ...
With all their overseers dead and the legions of followers in the era severely diminished, the firestarters got away. The elves BURN!! But these are no ordinary fires!! ...
The fires lit by the firestarters are fuelled by their hate, their intolerance and anger - only water from the bog can extinguish such mayhem. ...
We must go there and fight the fire to redeem ourselves and save Venore from the ever devastating flames!
I want to warn the people of Venore of the dangers of Shadowthorn but... but they won't listen. It seems they all just ignore me.
Goodbye, goodbye.
pages.title: Pyro Peter

pages.name: A Dark Priestess
npc_lines: Be greeted in peace ... for now.

Since the days before men walked Tibia, two races of demons wage war against each other in the halls above. The reasons for that war are that numerous that recalling half of them would require several weeks. ...
And each day of war adds more reasons to it. The only reason for them to stop their war for a moment would be to crush any intruders.

The war of the demons has reach an eternal stalemate. Only intruders might tip the scales of favour for a while. But even the side profiting from such an intervention would not be grateful since they would feel their advantage is a cheated one. ...
Should one side get considerably weakened, the other will take more hold in the complex. ...

Eventually the more powerful side will be able to summon their leaders to our plane and will dominate the battlefield for a while. Eventually though, a backlash of the other demons will drive them back and the stalemate is restored.
The Shaburak/Askarak are in advantage right now.
The word 'demon' is extremely imprecise. It is like a baby calling everything with four legs a 'cow'. ...
There are demons that are more a tool than a sentient being. Then there are demons whose intellect dwarfs the greatest minds of humanity. ...
Some are unique, others belong to races and subspecies and even in a given demon race the differences might be extreme.
You misled fools know nothing about the truth. The lies that your temples feed you have poisoned your mind! ...
Zathroth is the source of everything. When the other gods hesitated to do the necessary to start creation it was Zathroth who stepped forward and took it upon him to commit the great sacrifice.
Even before the priests of Zathroth were banished from the cities, they spread lies to poison the mind of the people. ...
When the priests had left it became even worse, and now after several generations of lies and propaganda, all what is left in the minds of the people is a fabricated scarecrow.
Zathroth teaches us that without sacrifice there is no progress and everything you gain is connected to a burden.
A burden comes in many shapes. Often it is the burden of knowledge. Sometimes it is the burden of necessity.
There is no knowledge that is forbidden. If you are powerful enough to take it, it is yours. Be aware though that knowledge for the sake of knowing alone is a sin in the eyes of Zathroth. ...
Those who 'know' are entitled to act! The more you understand the more you are responsible to change things even when the ignorant world will blame you for that.
Doing the necessary is always a burden. Ignorant people will blame and fear you for your actions. Some things that have to be done are not going to make you popular. ...
More often than not people won't understand your actions. Often it is not possible to explain things at all.
pages.title: A Dark Priestess

pages.name: Dronk
npc_lines: Mh, oh? It looks like YOU WANT to help, well then...?
I'm responsible to oversee the security and integrity of the mine tunnels. ...
Ah right, and you can help me out here if you want. PROBLEM IS, you probably don't even know what you are doing here. ...
See the pumps there? And the pool of water over there?
Good, because that is part of the problem. AND THE PROBLEM IS, while these pumps are able to drain the water out of the pond over there, they only work for a limited time. ...
They run on *coal* you see, COAL. And that's the one thing I just don't have down here right now. ...
Yeah I know that I could mine some more or just loot some creature's corpse but I can't leave just yet. ...
Still, even with that pool drained, I still need to find Groam and I surely won't leave without him.

The rotworm driven tunnels have to be reworked by dwarven miners before we can use them safely. They seem a bit erratic for the untrained eye but the worms are trained to dig towards the richest deposits of ore. ...
So our tunnels are exceptionally safe but sometimes even we run into problems.
As you might have noticed, the tunnel here is filled with water. We got the machines from the technomancers to pump the water out but our resources on coals are quite thin. ...
Most coal is used for blacksmithing and something as unimportant as an inaccessible tunnel is not deemed worthy of our black gold you know. ...
We KNOW it is no ordinary tunnel system down there though but we found some kind of ruins down there. PROBLEM IS, we had no spare time for exploring before the water drove us out. ...
Now I really would love to get the machines running but first we have to gather enough coal to make them work.
Are you willing to donate some black gold so we can get that pump pumping?
Dwarfs need coal for all kind of things, most prominently for blacksmithing. So coal is always rare but we need it to run that machine over there.
I don't understand the technomancers magic completely, but using coal on one of the three pumps down here will drain the water in the pool at the end of the tunnel. ...
PROBLEM IS, when the water is drained, something seems to 'awake'. ...
Hey stop looking like that, I know it's true, I don't make this up. I HEARD THEM. Alright, I heard them.

Somehow the water of the pool will return after some time, I don't know why. Maybe it has to do with 'something' down there. It makes the water rise... ah I don't know. I just want my buddy Groam to be ok.
Well, Groam is a friend. Groam and I already had that pestering pool all drained, but that didn't last long. SUDDENLY, we heard voices from down there, VOICES my friend. ...
We didn't know what to do, so we started searching the mud. AND THEN, I had that sudden urge to just leave that place. ...
PROBLEM IS, when I turned around to ask Groam about it, he just said something about an entrance and then he disappeared. ...
So my buddy already went down there, but he did not return. Eventually the water came back and the voices stopped.
Well, they are clearly... hey, wait - stop looking like that. They are there, they are talking to me. Surely you must hear them, too... clearly now... just now... or not?!
The city is a marvel to behold and unconquered in centuries!
If it weren't for us dwarfs, the world would have already been overrun by monsters of all kinds.
Ah by any chance, did you see... ah nothing, bye then.
pages.title: Dronk

pages.name: Lunch
npc_lines: Uhh! Visitoooors!
I am many, many things. Me bodyguard for Robson. Watching over him when sleeping. Me good fisherman. Me fish soo many fish that sometime no fish is left. ...
Aaaand me many, many other things. All so more much fun with Robson. At home at goblin camp me only was punching ball for bigger goblins.
He good dwarf. Not kill me but gave me food and bandages. Me and Robson very great friends!
Isle so scary. Evil monsters everywhere. Robson sometimes gone exploring. Me begging him not to go but he so brave. Gladly he always back for Lunch.
Me new name is Lunch.
Me old name no word was. Hard to make noises for Robson. Robson named me Lunch because we met at lunchtime.
Dwarf are dangerous fighters. Me first very great fear of Robson because dwarf he is. But Robson good dwarf is. Not killing poor little goblin. ...
Uh, of course mayhaps that making him bad dwarf, me not sure.
Other goblins always mean to me. Took me to human castle to steal stuff in their cellar. But we got alarm and metal men came after us. Me was cornered and fled through toilet. ...
Me squeezed long way through stonecracks until me fell into water. ...
Me thought me drown but nonono! Biggest fish ever came and swallowed me! Many long days in fish! Or even hours! But later suddenly fish was jumping much, then suddenly light! ...
And me kind of: 'Oh! Goblin heaven!' but it was Robson who caught big fish! Imagine! He freed me and friends ever since! True story!
Bye.
pages.title: Lunch

pages.name: Yawno
npc_lines: Mmhmn... eh? Ahm, so what is it... *yawn* Ya here for the fish, too? Or are you just here for some... *yawn* news?
Well, just between the two of us - the lake is still crystal clear right now. Ya know, it's TOO CLEAN. That ain't attract no shimmer swimmer, it doesn't. ...

The lake needs to be dirtier, filthier, murkier yupp. An' I bet ya don't know the secret, eh? How to get it real dirty? Corpses. Loads of corpses. Piles of 'em. Throw 'em into the water, eh. You'll see.
It is the rarest of all fish! Hard to come by but worth every second... *yawn*... of time, ya invest. You only get a chance to catch him in extremely dirty water. ...
And Lake Equivocolao is really the only place where it can be found. I am sure my old buddy Pemaret in Cormaya knows a thing or two about that bugger, too.

This lake is the only place shimmer swimmers can be caught. However, if the lake is too clean, they will not settle. My guess... *yawn* is that this lake has underground connections to... to... caves... *yawn*...
Finally, now some shimmer swimmers should arrive... *yawn* as soon as I have taken my nap... I will... start... to...
Throwing corpses into the water is the fastest way to make it dirty and murky - just perfect to attract shimmer swimmers. It doesn't even matter what kind of corpse, heh.
Yeah, yeah... bye, erm... *yawn*
pages.title: Yawno

pages.name: Gruffy
npc_lines: Hello there Jogador! It's good to see you.
The Combined Magical Winterberry Society and its members try to ensure the harvesting and processing of winterberries to all sorts of useful, magical fluids.
The Combined Magical Winterberry Society was founded more than one hundred years ago by mage Tolwyn Winter. ...
It is our duty to ensure the harvesting and processing of winterberries to secure a steady flow of the appropriate magical resources for potions and other magical fluids in this world. ...
What? No, all further information is on a... a 'need to know' basis. Where? No! That's not - I mean I won't tell you where our... IF we even HAVE any headquarters.
Alright, first thing is - you deliver your berries and put them into one of the moulds over there. We need to fill the vat with berries before the actual treading can start. ...

When enough winterberries have been put into the moulds, the vat is full and the treading starts. When this time has come, everyone needs to enter the vat and start TREADING like they never trod before. ...
It's possible that you may have to deal with the berry pest, a whole swarm of small flying buggers who will try to feed on the winterberries. ...
If that happens, you will have to remove them. All of them, or the treading cannot continue. ...
Depending on the state of the berries, you will need to add water or sugar to the mix after some time. I will tell you which, just listen to me when the time comes. ...
Whenever you want to return to Thais, simply ask me to transport you back. And that's basically it. All clear or do you want me to repeat it?
Winterberries are special berries only harvestable during a short time of the year. They are used to refine potions of all sorts. They can severely enhance their magical effects. ...
Without them it is generally a little more difficult to create effective potions.
We oversee the treading of winterberries in all of Tibia. The processed berries will be used to refine magical potions such as health or mana potions.
Name's Gruffy, I'm a proud *sigh* representative of the... etcetera, etcetera... Combiwintersociety etcetera. You get the idea. ...
As you probably already know, we have a mission for you - and, based on your presence here, I assume you recently accepted to help us.
Alright, so you want to return to Thais. Are you ready to leave? <dependendo da sua resposta você é transportado de volta a thais>
The Combined Magical Winterberry Society and its members try to ensure the harvesting and processing of winterberries to all sorts of useful, magical fluids.
We oversee the treading of winterberries in all of Tibia. The processed berries will be used to refine magical potions such as health or mana potions.
Well it's the Annual Autumn Vintage. We should try to gather and process as much winterberries as possible this year.
See you around.
pages.title: Gruffy

pages.name: Scrutinon
npc_lines: Jogador. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
This island is cleft. Go there only prepared or you will meet your end. The surface of this forgotten rock is a barren wasteland full of hostile creatures. ...
Its visage is covered with holes and tunnels in which its leggy inhabitants are hiding. Its bowels filled with the strangest creatures, waiting to feast on whatever dares to disturb their hive. ...
And you will find no shelter in Quirefang's black depths, where the creatures of the deep are fulfilling a dark prophecy. ...
It is impossible to reach it by ship or boat. However, there was one before you. A visitor who found a way to enter the island.
He travelled on the very ground to reach the hostile shores of Quirefang. He used something that turned the soil and carved a way to the island. ...
You will need to follow his trail if you want to reach it.
I am waiting. Beyond time and ever watchful. And I expected you, traveller.
I will see you again.
pages.title: Scrutinon

pages.name: Yasir
npc_lines: Yasu me halaka. <greets you friendly>
Si! Haneka ariki!
Me Yasir.
Tje hari ku ne finjala. Ariki?
Soso yana. <shakes his head>
Si, jema ze harun. <waves>
pages.title: Yasir

pages.name: Eighty
npc_lines: <beep> <beep> Welcome to the.... <crank> Tibian Bank.
My model number is 80-M.
I have access to the full functionality of a human bank employee.
Come again if you need something. <beep>
pages.title: Eighty

pages.name: Chip
npc_lines: Please don’t keep me from my work.
Shh… I don’t really have a job. I need the wood I chop here, though.
Yeah, to be honest, it’s not really my wood. It belongs to the queen. But what choice do I have?
Queen Eloise from Carlin likely wouldn’t approve. Be so kind to keep this little secret to yourself.
Those bandits have my wife and kids. If I don’t bring wood, I don’t know what they’ll do. Hell, I’d even trade some with you if you had any.
They hide somewhere near the Plains of Havoc. I’ve never seen their hideout, though, they just send me messages and tell me where to leave the wood.
If you have a piece of wood, I’d give you some money for it. I don’t have much, but I’d appreciate your help.
I need all the wood I can get. My hands and my back are already aching from all the chopping. If you have any for trade, let me know.
I don’t have anything for sale.
People call me Chip.
Probably better that way.
pages.title: Chip

pages.name: Knightmare (NPC)
npc_lines: Hello Jogador and welcome. I guess you are here to talk about my job or to get your present!
Here you are! Have fun.
World-builder, god, sage, storyteller. All of it fits in it's limited way. I for myself would humbly settle for storyteller since this is what interests me the most and seems most important. ...

A great deal of Tibia's background was created by me or based on my ideas. As far as the greater concept is concerned, there are still so incredibly many things to be told, I hope to fit them in one by one whenever possible.
I am known as Knightmare, though it was not my first choice of a name. The name I initially thought of was already taken. ...
In hindsight it's probably better to be known as Knightmare as my other choice seems rather dumb to me today. Dumb enough to not mention it at least <wink>.
I always felt that been called a god is a bit exaggerated. I could use some of my not-so-godly powers to get you out if you are stuck here.
Do you want to be teleported to the temple in Thais?
Well I have not only created a great deal of Tibia but I have also witnessed all of its glorious and darker moments over the years. Have you ever known the story about urine? ...

Or how about what happened to the Thaian drawbridge? Have you heard what problems the most early runes have caused? Or did you know about the evolution of monsters and how the level system changed over the years? ...
Perhaps you might rather hear about the mysteries of ancient Tibia or would you rather learn about the old player houses? ...

Once upon a time the northern drawbridge of Thais was fully operational. Though it could be used to block at least one path into the city and annoy other players it worked quite well until the number of players grew. ...
The city became increasingly inaccessible from the north, but some players enjoyed hunting those responsible for lifting the drawbridge or even started to guard the lever. ...
The deathblow for the drawbridge came from an unexpected side though. It was the fishing that made the drawbridge inoperative. ...
Since the server distinguished between fishable and temporally not fishable tiles, it was unable to reset tiles that were not fishable as it expected them to be. ...
That sometimes lead to holes in the bridge that were a rare myth for a while, but soon became more and more common. ...
After figuring out that the bridge mechanics had to be changed in any case, it was decided to lock the bridge once and for all and to allow undisturbed access to the city.
Runes were originally introduced as a quick and easy way to target spells. Still, they were not as unproblematic as first thought and they caused several unforeseen problems. ...
The first runes worked in a quite simple way. The server was just told which rune was used on which target and it faithfully applied the effects. ...
This caused several problems though, since it assumed real players would use the runes in the real game as intended. ...
Of course this was not always the case. First of all, though the server checked if there was a blockade between user and target it did not check for the proximity of user and target as well. ...
So a manipulated client could theoretically use a rune from one end of the world to the other as long as there was nothing blocking it. This was a clear exploit and was eliminated fast though. ...
It got more complicated when it came to using runes on another level though. ...
In the past it was possible to use runes on something you saw, that was not blocked and in range. That meant though, that you could use runes from a roof on some creature in the street. ...
