If you are interested - and have fed all five extractors with cake mass that is stuck on you -, I can hand you one.
I have a choice of three rewards. Tell me which one you want: a cake cabinet, a cake backpack or a cake tapestry?
We are a mystic order of bakers who pursue goals for the benefit of all mankind. Don't even listen to the lies and propaganda spread by those who envy us.
We are a mystic baker order. Don't listen to those who envy us and spread ugly lies and propaganda. We are dedicated to uncover the greatest secrets about cooking and baking. ...
Baking is the only trade worth to be considered. Without bakers everyone would starve. We are what ties a society together, preferably with a thick, sticky and sweet mass made of fruits. ...
We are the momentum of culture. Baking is what divides civilization from barbarism.
Though most of our noble order abandoned the more theoretical studies at the academies, it is an evil lie that we are failed students who know more about drinking and eating than about magic. ...
Once we have revealed all of Kullu's secrets, we will be envied by all. And of course we all will become famous and incredibly rich.
I am Brutus. Brutus the baker, that is.
Now that the isle is conquered, we can search for Kullu's secrets, at least for a while.
Good bye.
pages.title: Brutus The Baker

pages.name: Nina
npc_lines: Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.

The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient

We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we will rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.

The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient
pages.title: Nina

pages.name: Spirit Speaker
npc_lines: Can you hear that...!? Oh, hello there. Have you come seeking wisdom...? A story perhaps?
Yes.. nature speaks, this whole continent has a voice and it screams for help when changes are about to happen, it senses danger and warns us of evil presences and changes of the world. ...
This land is alive and every event we participate in has an impact on its people and on the environment. ...
So be ready and aid the world in its time of need. You may be greatly rewarded.
WISDOM! Such a desirable thing, isn't it? You have come to the right place, I have much knowledge to share about the world you live in, more than you could ever imagine. ...

But not everyone was born to possess great wisdom, especially when they intend to use it as a tool of destruction. Like Ferumbras for example, who used his immense power to call upon great demons to lay havoc on the city of Thais.
The sword is known as the Sword of Fury. Is the legend true? Who knows.

Many have tried to wreak havoc and destruction on various cities over the years. In days past our cities were raided by hordes of orcs, but they were defeated in their attempts to conquer our capital cities by the brave adventurers of those times. ...
They carried with them strong unique sets of armor, specifically crafted for that war. ...
They were recovered by the warriors who defeated them; but those ancient pieces of armor are rarely seen these days.

Ahh so you like legends, do you? Here's another one. It is said that the ancient pharaohs who ruled Ankrahmun in days long past, were mummified and buried with their most precious belongings in tombs beneath the sands of the desert. ...
It is also said that they were buried with the pieces of an ancient magical helmet of great power. Legend holds that the pharaohs will not part from their treasures easily... even after death.
There are many treasures out there for adventurers like you to claim, child. If you are brave enough to descend into hell itself! ...
There are many tasks around the world for experienced adventurers like you on the journey to the very Pits of Inferno! But beware! You never know what horrors stand between you and your desires.
Do you want to know what horror is, young adventurer? Horror has a name in these lands... actually, seven names. ...
Apocalypse, Ashfalor, Bazir, Infernatil, Pumin, Tafariel and Verminor. The Ruthless Seven, seven archdemons under the command of a god.
Zathroth is the god that controls the Ruthless Seven and he is the God of Destruction, #N. He is the evil half of one of the elder god. The other half is Uman the Wise. ...
Together they are one. Interesting, isn't it? Thought so.
I do not have a proper name, for I am a child of nature. I was given the gift to communicate with ancient ethereal beings; that is where my name comes from: the 'Spirit Speaker'.
The gift that has been bestowed upon me is the ability to communicate with the spirits and other ethereal entities who are among us. ...
It helps me uncover important knowledge about our surroundings. Knowledge I then share with the people who visit this place to inspire them to explore the wonders this world has to offer.
Job? I am a spirit speaker and a traveller of these lands. I discover its mysteries and learn about its past... our past. ...
Now you may be wondering what I do with all that knowledge and the answer is simple - I share it.
Mysteries! This world is full of them; take for instance the mysterious creature who lurks in the jungles of Port Hope which is said to carry one of the rarest plants known to botany! ...
Or the tales of underwater kingdoms ruled by fish-like creatures. Or perhaps the legend surrounding a demonic tree on the Plains of Havoc. ...
Interesting, isn't it? And this is just a taste of what is out there for you to explore.
May the spirits guide you.
pages.title: Spirit Speaker

pages.name: Omrabas
npc_lines: He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
If I ever lay hands on him again...
Typical. Easy come, easy go.
<groan>
At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode.
I used to be a famous necromancer in my lifetime. However, some... people... conspired against me, and the result you see before you.
Did I not mention it? You have the exceptional honour of meeting the soul of Omrabas the Black. Presently residing inside this skull.
The sunken, undead soul of Darashia. The breathing, beautiful corpse of a once lively city, glowing darkly, unhealthily, gloriously... but I get carried away.
Help me? You? I don't think you are ready for that yet. Come back when you are more experienced in the ways of Drefia.
That king above ground? He's been in charge for quite a while, I understand. No serious rivals, eh? Lucky him.
<scoffs> The Tibian king's parthetic soldiers, do you mean? Or are you alluding to... <falls silent>
He's been in charge for quite a while, I understand. No serious rivals, eh? Lucky him.
These lands are ripe for the taking. Give me an army of undead, and... <cackles>
The sap of life. The juice of the living, the flow of the carnal energies... <sighs wistfully> Oh, to feel it rushing through my veins once again!
If you want my opinion, they're just bloated necromancers, really. Upstart, pretentious lot! Highly... specialised in the uses of blood, though, which can be useful at times.
I know he used my pupils against me, and when I am back in the flesh, he will pay! ...
Never again will I be fooled by other dark brothers. Treacherous lot, all of them... <grumble> <mumble>
We always shared a... common interest in undeath.
Yes, obviously I am one of the numerous undead here. We are in Drefia, after all.
Parasites. Came here to profit from our experiments and blood reserves. Arrogant lot, too. Keep to themselves, luckily.
Ah, our dark, stern beauties. Skilled with herbs and masterly dancers. Only drawback is, they charge you heavily for their services.
Ha. Ungrateful imbecile lot. After all I've done for them in my lifetime... <grumble> , <mutter>...
Very single-minded. Smelly. Tend to burn easily.
Much better servants than simple skeletons. The binding spells are quite complex, though, but the effort is well worth it.
Many restless souls roam the sunken graveyards of Drefia. ...
Whole families are buried here, so if you're on the search for relatives, just visit the crypts, you might meet them ...
... though not in the flesh, as it were. <cackles>
Useless, slobbering things. Only on the lookout for food.
Some Grim Reapers haunt a forsaken temple deep under Drefia. Only people with a death wish would venture there!
Nasty little creatures, aren't they? The result of a failed experiment, but the theory was sound. They can be useful, if you know how to tame them.
Simple transformation, but not without use. Good servants. Can be quite clever.
Besides simple guardings tasks? Hmm. Not very resourceful. And they tend to fall apart.
Can be useful. Have an unhealthy appetite, though.
PSST! Keep your voice down, will you? Strange things they do, and - well, just be careful mentioning them, and watch your back around them.
All in good time. <cackles>
The Dragonbone Cemetery? Not far from here. Old dragons lay there down to die, it is presumed. Or maybe they were slain there. Or died from a mysterious illness. ...
Anyway, lots of dragon bones there. Skulls, horns, ribs... Only place to find dragon tears, strange things, but that subject requires more study.
<scoffs> Help me? You? I don't think so. Come back when you are more experienced in the ways of Drefia.
Are you mocking me? Get lost!
pages.title: Omrabas

pages.name: Ashari
npc_lines: Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
I am the first voice amongst this community.
I am the leader of our people in worldly matters. I am the one who gives everyone its responsibilities and sees over our resources.

This world is unforgiving and barren. Little can be done about that, but those of the second generation left us with more than the sins of the ancestors. They also gave us a home, hope, and at least some meagre resources.
We do not know for how long sinners have lived and died here in the afterworld before some of the second generation saw the damnation that the deeds of the first brought upon them. ...
Second generation might have only been true for some of them. Some might have been third of fourth generation already, who knows. ...
They were free of some of the taint of their mothers and fathers, and saw through their lies. Saw them as the sinners that they were. ...
It became clear to them and their leader Feridil that only by distancing themselves from the sinful outcasts, they could begin the long walk on the road to salvation. ...

They drove off the sinners and claimed a small part of this afterworld for themselves. They chose a home near the entrance to the afterworld to make it easier for the wise of Abar Dendri to watch and ultimately judge them. ...
They also made note of each new sinner, that arrived in the afterworld. And they marked them, so they could later tell if a petitioner who came to join them, was of second generation at least. ...
They secured the resources that they needed and organised their harvest. That was how our community came to be.
Larfion, our shaman, knows more about such matters. He is the guardian of our souls.
We are bound together in our need to purify ourselves in this harsh afterworld. Our resources are limited and our enemies numerous. But it will help us to atone.
Meditation and hard work purify body and soul. But the taint runs deep.
This is but a mockery of the world of light. Here we do not live, but are not truly dead either. We are similar to the undead that roam these caves. But unlike them we have the hope to atone.
Meditation and hard work purify body and soul. But the taint runs deep.
Bye!
Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
Oh if you want to help me, you can lend me a hand watering our garden, cultivating wild magic for our shaman, collecting fire for our settlement. ...
You can also start by helping us sterilise the dangerous mushrooms that have been preventing us from entering our crystal mines. They are literally spreading like a disease lately. ...
If you manage to get all of this done in a single day, I will offer a bonus!

Thank you. We use the unscathed tears of the gods we found in these hellish dephts to water our gardens. It is thanks to these that we can survive down here. The garden feeds us as the fire gives us warmth. ...

Take this vial and venture down the path of these depths to find the unspoilt cradle of tears. Oh - and please heed my words: there are old remains of the forest above down there. They seem connected to the cradle. Sometimes... they can come alive.
The world weeps for the sins of our ancestors. They are bitter but they are a gift. Even the teas of the world are full of life and hope.
Filigree flasks we create with our own crystal tools. Worthy vessels for the purest of tears. I already gave you one, you didn't lose it - did you?
Oh? Well, then... we will have to make another one, right? Please return to me after a while, I will see what I can do.

Our shaman, Larfion, has asked me again to cultivate some of the wild magic for him that roams free in some nearby caverns. I do not know what this is for, but he seems to need quite much of this lately. ...
It is a demand we simply cannot fulfil with all our other tasks at hand. ...
Please take this receptacle to the magical cavern, you will recognise it when you are surrounded by magic. There are strangely coloured crystals down there but they are harmless. ...
You will need to concentrate to cultivate the wild magic there. Listen carefully as I will try to explain to you how this is done: ...

The most important thing is the order. First you gather 'fury magic' which usually appears red, second you should gather 'nature magic', appearing green. The third component to combine the two previous is 'fire magic' which should be fiery yellow. ...

To neutralise all three and complete the cultivation, you should add a tiny bit of 'water magic' which shimmers blue. The components in the receptacle will now melt to a physical form and form a dry, rough powder.
Our ancestors were sent into the fire for their sins. Yet, our small settlement needs the fire to survive. We also need fire to cleanse ourselves in a traditional ritual. ...

There are harmless flames emanating from the ashes of fire elementals in extremely hot areas. There is a cave not that far from here where we used to gather fire for the ritual using firecatcher urns. ...

However, recently the heat down there has risen tremendously. The only way to gather the fire from the ashes would be to quickly get in, eliminate enough elementals and gather the flames from their ashes with the firecatcher urn I gave you.
I already gave you that task, once you have gathered the flames, bring the urn back with the vial I gave you.
We use these unique urns to capture the harmless flames from the ashes of fire elementals. Didn't I already give one to you? Did you lose it?
Oh? Well, then... we will have to make another one, right? Please return to me after a while, I will see what I can do.
We mine crystals from some nearby mines. The meagre ore veins we found were not enough to make and repair useful, durable tools for everyone. ...

The crystal cave we used to visit to get the crystals is near our camp, yet we cannot go there anymore. The cave is also hotbed for large mushrooms. Those are not exactly edible but not dangerous, either. ...
However, our workers there started to get sick mining there. We used to train firebugs to use them as a means to create fire. They would help a great deal in eliminating this spreading disease. ...

When we discovered that it's a strange illness that befell the mushrooms, most workers refused to go even near that cave. Now we have no elf left to fight this plague. Please go to the mine and burn away that pest.
If you manage to finish all our tasks within a single day, you will receive a special bonus. Return to me once you are finished.
Bye!
pages.title: Ashari

pages.name: Repenter
npc_lines: I am sorry, it is not our custom to talk to outsiders. Please address our leader, Ashari.
pages.title: Repenter

pages.name: Larfion The Shaman
npc_lines: I greet you - and I have to ask you to... just tell me if you have something for me.
I'm the spiritual guide and keeper of knowledge for this community.
We are the shame born, the repenters, the pardoners. The sins of our ancestors are the poison in our souls and our shame in the eyes of those born in the light of the suns.
Our ancestors were outcasts and evil. We still bear their taint and shame. No such sinner is allowed in our ranks, but we welcome all those born down here. ...
Only who is of the second generation can atone for the unspeakable sins that led to the punishment of the ancestors.
The suns are the eternal eyes of the great judge. He who is the justice of the purified.
The suns are the eternal eyes of the great judge. He who is the justice of the purified.
All those who are born without sin in the light of the suns are purified in death. Unlike us tainted ones.

We are unclean because of the sins of our ancestors. In this harsh afterworld we are allowed to distance us from the ancestors and atone for their sins. If we die here, we are damned into nothingness. ...
Only if we live in purity and humility, we might find pardon in the eyes of the lightborn.
Those who are born under the light of the suns, are born pure. Unlike us. They live a life in light, splendour and without hunger, thirst or fear. They are wise and just and watching us. ...
If they deem us worthy, they will take us into the light on the day of the prophecy.
Our ancestors were soaked with evil. They were vile criminals that were cast out of the light and the lands of splendour that the ancestors called Abar Dendri. ...
The wise judges of Abar Dendri spoke justice and they spoke true. No outcast was ever to see the light of the suns again. No single life could atone for their sins. ...
Through those wise words they gave a clue. A shed of hope which they bestowed upon the sinners in their wisdom and mercy. ...
But they were blinded by the darkness of the afterworld, they have been banished and their minds were clouded by the evil of their sins. ...

Only Feridil of the second generation was enlightened enough to see what those words meant. He gathered the second born, slew the sinners and drove off those who escaped to cast them deeper into darkness. ...
Then the great judge spoke to him in a vision. He showed him the path to salvation by purifying the blood by generations of atonement.
In their wisdom the wise of Abar Dendri provided the children of the sinners with an harsh environment to work off the sins through hard work. ...
With every drop of sweat and blood that is shed in our suffering a little bit of the ancestors sinfulnesses is driven out. ...
Only by enduring this trial we can better ourself. It is a slow process, since obviously the ancestors' sins were grave. ...
If we needed any proof for that, the fact that the wise of Abar Dendri have not yet deemed us worthy to return into the light should show any doubter that we are not cleansed yet.
Abar Dendri it is! As the words of the repenters that came before us told us. It is the land of plenty, without any need and where the light always shines and it is warm without a fire.
Yes, well you see, I am... waiting for something. Did Ashari tell you anything? Or ask you to do something?
I greet you - and I have to ask you to... just tell me if you have something for me.
Yes, yes erm - goodbye.
pages.title: Larfion The Shaman

pages.name: Tomruk The Ruddy
npc_lines: This is really sanguine!
Ah, fresh blood. My favourite.
Hmm... the conductors are too dry to transmit energy.
Interesting reaction. Bloodcurdling. Must inspect further.
Hello hello! Please don't touch the equipment, it's very valuable.
Are you joking? Does the colour of my robes tell you anything? I'm a very important researcher!
You will address me with my full name: Tomruk The Ruddy.
A fellow student of the dark arts, eh? Well, I specialise in the various conductive abilities of blood, you see. ...
Perhaps you had read my treatise...no? Well, it'll revolutionise practical necromancy, let me tell you!
Ah, the sweet sap of life, the nectar of the gods, the river of emotions, the... <ahem> best thing there is.
Do you wish to join our ranks, talk to brother Elryed The Sanguine when he's back from his errand.
It takes practice, skill and dedication, but you might get there if you try!
Backward bunch. Incredibly old-fashioned approach to blood and narrow-minded about it.
Well, it has its merits, yes. But I contemplate a study trip to the Plains of Havoc. Broadens your vision!
Never heard of him. Brothers are given new names when they reach priesthood, anyway.
Plenty of those here in Drefia. Got one myself, as a matter of fact. Handed down to me. Quite old and torn.
Huh. Always speak in riddles. If they deign to speak to you, that is. Paint strange pseudo-animals on the floor and prefer ashes to blood.
Breeds supplies for the blood god.
Well, someone has to sort out all those peasants' concerns, I believe.
Shepherd dogs to their king. Don't care myself, frankly. There are worthier things.
Hrm, yes, technically you could say that. Research has advanced a bit, so the concept is outdated.
Not much to do with them, more's the pity. Beautiful, lively things.
Ah, fascinating creatures. Unfortunately, I had a... professional misunderstanding with a viscount, and now, our relations are somewhat strained.
Good harriers for fresh supplies, but you have to keep them from gnawing at their find.
Of what interest would those sad things be? Not a drop of blood in them!
It can take some that way. Giving in to their hunger. Not much use then.
Hmm? Oh yes, farewell, farewell.
My pleasure, I assure you. Farewell!
pages.title: Tomruk The Ruddy

pages.name: Zarifan
npc_lines: <sigh> lost... word...
<sigh> ohhhh.... memories...
The secrets... too many... sleep...
Loneliness...
Guarding...secret...magic words...don't remember... forgotten, forgotten!...
...Zarifan... long, long ago... now...memory, fading.
... I... I ... lost... no return...grief....
Speech...words..all lost...all faded...difficult...to..remember...
Home... lost...all in darkness.
Everywhere...
They listen..
None...must know... need...magic words...
Long ago... forgotten... sadness.
The undead god...powerful... rituals.
Too much... spilled... to much...greed.
Undead... dark summoners...dark plans.
... Far...away...no power, here.
..what of now?.... <sigh> ... not now...
Friends...know things...I listen.
Brothers... betrayed... split... rivals
...Brothers... enemies... many, many... servants now... lost.
Friends... lost....now eternal hunger...horrors.
Fare...well...
pages.title: Zarifan

pages.name: Elyen Ravenlock
npc_lines: <hums a dark tune>
The rats... the rats in the walls...
<chants> Re Ha, Omrah, Tan Ra...
Hello, brother. What is it now?
I prefer to call it my calling. I am the Mistress of the Dark Chants in Drefia.
I am the Dark Priestess Elyen Ravenlock. Your name is of no concern to me.
The dark flower. Our chants are its perfume, our dances its colour.
I serve the Dark Lord. As do you, but you do not know it yet.
Our brothers in the service of the Dark Lord.
The dark well inside our fleshly hull. It sings to us, and to the Dark Lord.
You could assist, I assume.
Urgith's chosen. They run through our halls, free and unhindered. Do not harm them.
The Gardens Of Night surround our sacred temples, east of the Necromancer Halls. Dark and light mix there, as do our chants.
Our most elusive brethren. They do not like to be mentioned.
They are drawn to bl ood like a wasp is to honey. They have a ...special interest in it, I presume.
Butchers, henchmen, assassins to the unwary. Keep clear of them, brother.
For yourself or someone else? Give the details to our apothecaries upstairs, they will settle the price, too.
Do not touch the sacred scrolls! Leave this room at once!
Yes.
pages.title: Elyen Ravenlock

pages.name: Jorge
npc_lines: Come over here if you have to resupply!
Hi there! You have surely come here because you have heard of me, and what a great replicating artist I am, right? ...
Or could it be that you haven't heard of me? Anyway, I am always on the hunt for beautiful and rare items. Almost a collector, you could say. ...
My grandfather taught me the art of carving and replicating. In my younger years I have also developed a knack for hunting. I once started to catalogue all the monsters in this world. ...
So I resorted to copying interesting artefacts that were found inside all those monsters. Just look at my display here. They look just like the real ones, eh? ...
Anyway, can you help me, please? You seem to be eager to fight against any monster that comes your way!
Yes, carving. The fine art of taking an undefined, amorphous, something, a knife and making something beautiful out of it. ...
Actually, it is creating something by reducing it. Beautiful, eh? I had some years to practice what my grandpa taught me - so feel free to look around later, but first - can you help me?

The art of creating something that looks and feels and behaves like the original. It requires a lot of appreciation for detail, diligence and time. But the outcome is ultimately rewarding, don't you think? Anyway, could you help me, please?

Yes, raids. From time to time, a special horde of monsters appears somewhere on this world. You will see it when it happens - just follow the people rushing there! Or ask your fellow adventurers when and where a certain raid is expected.
Take care!
pages.title: Jorge

pages.name: Oblivion
npc_lines: Hm.
I understand.
Yes. I listen, master.
Not yet, my brothers. Wait.
Be greeted.
A guest at the doors.
All gone, all but Oblivion remains.
Wine at the feast.
Travellers.
The shadows know all between the doors.
Between two breaths.
The gods exhale.
The eye of the gods.
A mountain casts a different shadow from an ocean.
Drinking from a bloody cup.
Dogs at the lord's table.
Light through the lace of seasons.
Leaves of a tree.
A thought in the house of souls.
A soothing hand on sore eyes.
Yes.
pages.title: Oblivion

pages.name: Lavirias
npc_lines: Ashari visitor. I wonder what it is you seek in Ab'Dendriel.
I guess I'm what you'd call a sage or perhaps a mystic.
I'm dedicated to delve into the deeper secrets of nature. As all seekers of knowledge, I have to dedicate much time and effort into the subject of my studies.
I think nature is some kind of complicated mechanism and that we are all part of it. The function of some parts is more difficult to figure out then that of others.
Especially the part that Ashar'Tel plays in the workings of nature is, what I try to figure out.
Since my studies center around the nature of Ashar'Tel, there is little I can base my research on but my own discoveries.
A city has to have a soul. I think the soul of Ab'Dendriel is Ashar'Tel. If the others would only see it that way too.
Ashar'Tel's fame and myth has grown with time as the tree itself has grown over time. Though everybody sees something in this tree, it's rarely the same for everyone. ...
Humans travel here and look at Ashar'Tel as an avatar of their god Crunor. Dwarves probably see only firewood. ...
The Elven council sees it as a valuable resource yet I see something completely different.
The tears of Ashar'Tel, the water of life, the blessing of the tree. It has probably more names then it has uses. ...
The water that condenses as some kind of supernatural dew on Ashar'Tel's leaves is gathered and prepared by some of the eldest and wisest spellweavers of our kind.

The raw power of the water is wild and without direction it seems. To drink it is like trying to mount a wild stallion. It has to be tamed and guided into a direction to be of any use and not a danger.
The tears of Ashar'Tel, the water of life, the blessing of the tree. It has probably more names then it has uses. ...
The water that condenses as some kind of supernatural dew on Ashar'Tel's leaves is gathered and prepared by some of the eldest and wisest spellweavers of our kind.
It was obvious that the raw waters of Ashar'Tel might be dangerous, but the fate of the forest furies has shown how dangerous and unpredictable it can be.

Once they were only a rebellious sisterhood, inspired by foolish amazons from Carlin they tried a rebellion on their own. In their foolish, juvenile overconfidence they stole unrefined water of Ashar'Tel. ...
Assuming the elders were withholding power for themselves or something else. In the end they learned the hard way that there are things better left to those with wisdom and experience. ...
Their careless misuse of the waters deformed their body and mind. Sadly it did not stop there. ...
As if it weren't bad enough for the furies to be transformed, a tribe of orcish raiders got the rest of the stolen water into their hands and spawned a new, abominable breed of orcs, the rorcs. ...
They are a halve orc, halve terrorbird variant that is erroneously called 'rorcs'.
Using divination magic year over year on Ashar'Tel I can see and understand more about it then anyone else. I sense... well, something. A consciousness. ...
An own will. Nothing like the one of elves, humans or even dwarves. Ultimately alien thoughts but they are thoughts. ...
The tree is alive in more then the obvious way and it... has a purpose. It... wants something. Urgently! Sometimes it feels not only urgent but frighteningly fierceful. It is hard to explain.

To understand what I do, you would have to trade everything for a life dedicated to studies like I did. You'd have to spend years of meditation and divination to get a glimpse of that what I can see and feel... yet not fully understand even now.
Understanding is a process. It takes time. A lot of time. And right now I'm wasting a lot of time with idle chat, can we please continue? Good.
I bid you farewell.
pages.title: Lavirias

pages.name: Falonzo
npc_lines: Greetings, adventurer!
I'm professor Falonzo from the mage's guild.
I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that place to study this anomaly.
This plane is now inhabited by intruders and creatures that accidentally became dragged in. ...
It is neither completely of our world nor is it still that disconnected and unreachable as it used to be. I fear it's only a harbinger of something more dangerous and more sinister.
Well, the whole place here is an anomaly so to say. You can hardly have missed the fact that you arrived here through a mystical gate. ...
Well actually it's no gate at all but a rift in the fabric of nature. It is this minor plane trying to reconnect to our world.

This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we know. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. Lost and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.
Infernalists were the first who found their way into this sphere. Hoping to tap its rotten power somehow. Yet this sphere created creatures of its own and draw others here from other planes.
This place became a fiery trap to certain beings with an affinity to fire. Somehow it reconnects randomly with the known world, to which it once belonged ...
but also to other places that it shares some affinity with like hellish places of unspeakable evil that spawn infernal creatures.
Something is tearing at the fabric of reality. I can't tell what is it but the boundaries between worlds are fading. ...
A process that what watched for over a century but which has extremely grown in momentum over the last few years. Something is happening and it's for sure nothing good. ...
Be it as it may, the plane trying to reconnect was only a side effect. It still might teach us about what is happening and it has for sure attracted some attention already.
Well, that was how it used to be. Lost and without any connection to our world. But that was before things ... have changed.
We know about other planes of existence but in all history it has never been as easy to reach them as it is now. ...
Sometimes world seem to overlap and we can identify more and more such planes and worlds. More then we ever had imagined. All we can tell is, that something is changing. And not for the good.
Such an anomaly can't go unnoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted intruders and other entities were dragged into by the nature of the sphere.
Good bye!
pages.title: Falonzo

pages.name: Mysterious Ornate Chest (NPC)
npc_lines: What veils the first wall of testimony.
Accepted.
What veils the second wall of testimony.
Accepted.
What veils the third wall of testimony.
Accepted.
What veils the fourth wall of testimony.
Accepted.
What veils the fifth wall of testimony.
Accepted.
State the meaning of the first five walls of testimony.
Accept.
pages.title: Mysterious Ornate Chest (NPC)

pages.name: Gnommander
npc_lines: Hi there! Welcome to the spike.
I'm the operating commander of the Spike, the latest great accomplishment of the gnomish race. ...
The Spike is a crystal structure, created by our greatest crystal experts. It has grown from a crystal the size of my fist to the structure you see here and now. ...
Of course this did not happen from one day to the other. It's the fruit of the work of several gnomish generations. Its purpose has changed in the course of time. ...
At first it was conceived as a fast growing resource node. Then it was planned to become the prototype of a new type of high security base. ...
Now it has become a military base and a weapon. With our foes occupied elsewhere, we can prepare our strike into the depths of the earth. ...
This crystal can withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and it's growing deeper and deeper even as we speak. ...

The times of the fastest growth have come to an end, however, and we have to slow down in order not to risk the structural integrity of the Spike. But we are on our way and have to do everything possible to defend the Spike.
I'm responsible for the security and reward heroes to our cause. If you are looking for missions, talk to Gnomilly, Gnombold and Gnomagery.
I can sell special outfit parts. If your fame is high enough, you might be worthy of such a reward.
You are not worthy of a special reward yet.
pages.title: Gnommander

pages.name: The Gate Keeper
npc_lines: Are you the Key Master?
<loses interest immediately>
Are you the Key Master?
Enter the Spirit Grounds, Key Master.
The realm between realms, where all doors open on themselves only. The place where the spirits dwell that have unfinished business or were... called.
The call of the Ancients was sounded. The Key Master knows it. We too have been summoned to prepare for their arrival.
Enough! Don't waste your breath, mortal. Go now onto the grounds to do what you came here to do.
The balance has been broken, the doors pried open, the keys scattered and lost. ...
The Key Master will find them and close the doors that were not meant to be open. ...
And then he will unlock the Other Door.
The Key Master will know.
My name is unpronouncable in your language.
The nearest you may come to is Zg'!kch of Cthle-ZüuKh'lkrlxchwr.
Travellers between the doors.
I am the Gate Keeper. I guard the doors and await the Key Master.
We are in their atrium. Some doors lead to them. Soon...
Yes, soon. Or maybe it has happened already, long ago. ...
Time has no meaning to them.
Serving the dark ones. Some do not know what they are meddling with, rattling at the doors like children.
The breath of darkness, the eye of the night, the body of the other.
Really! No need to be rude.
Really! No need to be rude.
<loses interest immediately>
Use a sharp blade, a powerful staff or spell to send them on their way.
Too many doors open. Too tempting for some. The shadows run and hide.
A broken seal on a letter long read.
pages.title: The Gate Keeper

pages.name: Gnomux
npc_lines: Hi!
I'm responsible for resupplying foolish adventurers with equipment that they may have lost. If you're one of them, just ask me about a trade.
Here you are.
What could I say about gnomes that anyone would not know? I mean, we're interesting if not fascinating, after all.
I came here as a crystal farmer and know the Spike all the way back to when it was a little baby crystal. I admit I feel a little fatherly pride in how big and healthy it has become. ...
When most other crystal experts left for new assignments, I decided to stay and help here a bit.
pages.title: Gnomux

pages.name: Gnomargery
npc_lines: Hi!
I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
It's good to be a gnome for sure!
Now that's gnomish ingenuity given shape! Who but a gnome would come up with such a plan to defeat our enemies.

On the levels outside, we encountered the first serious resistance of our true enemy. As evidenced by the unnatural heat in an area with little volcanic activity, there is 'something' strange going on here. ...

Even the lava pools we have found here are not actually lava, but rock that was molten pretty much recently without any reasonable connection to some natural heat source. And for all we can tell, the heat is growing, slowly but steadily. ...
This is the first time ever that we can witness our enemy at work. Here we can learn a lot about its operations. ...

How they work, and possibly how to stop them. But therefore expeditions into the depths are necessary. The areas around us are highly dangerous, and a lethal threat to us and the Spike as a whole. ...

Our first object is to divert the forces of the enemy and weaken them as good as we can while gathering as much information as possible about them and their movements. Only highly skilled adventurers stand a chance to help us down here. ...
The area is as treacherous as dangerous, and all of its inhabitants are eager to tear everything unknown to them into pieces.
pages.title: Gnomargery

pages.name: Gnomilly
npc_lines: Hi!
Sorry, but no! Your expertise could be put to better use elsewhere. Here awaits you no challenge. You are desperately needed in the deeper levels of the Spike. Report there immediately.
I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
On these levels we found evidence of some monumental battle that has taken place here centuries ago. We also found some grave sites, but oddly enough no clues of any form of settlement. ...
Some evidence we have found suggests that at least one of the battles here was fought for many, many years. People came here, lived here, fought here and died here. ...
The battles continued until someone or something literally ploughed through the battlefields, turning everything upside down. All this killing and death soaked the area with negative energy. ...
Necromantic forces are running wild all over the place and we are hard-pressed to drive all these undead, spirits and ghosts, away from the Spike. ...
Unless we can secure that area somehow, the Spike operation is threatened to become crippled by the constant attacks of the undead. ...

The whole growing downwards could come to a halt, leaving us exposed to even more attacks, counter attacks, and giving the enemy time to prepare their defences. There's a lot to do for aspiring adventurers.
We are the only protectors of the world against the enemies below. With small stature comes great responsibilities, as they say.
pages.title: Gnomilly

pages.name: Gnombold
npc_lines: Hi!
I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
The levels around us are... well, they are strange. We are still not entirely sure how they were created. It seems obvious that they are artificial, but they seem not to be burrowed or the like. ...

We found strange stone formations that were not found on other layers around the Spike, but there is no clue at all if they are as natural as they look. It seems someone used some geomantic force to move the earth. ...
For what reason this has been done we can't tell as we found no clues of colonisation. ...

There are theories that the caves are some kind of burrow of some extinct creature or even creatures that are still around us, but exist as some form of invisible energy; but those theories are far-fetched and not supported by any discoveries. ...

Be that as it may, whatever those caves were meant for, these days they are crawling with creatures of different kinds and all are hostile towards us. The competition for food is great down here, and everything is seen as prey by the cave dwellers. ...

Some would like to feast on the crystal of the Spike, others would prefer a diet of gnomes. What they have in common is that they are a threat. If we can't keep them under control their constant attacks and raids on the Spike will wear us down. ...
That's where adventurers fit in to save the day.
Gnomes have lived autonomous for so long that it still feels odd to work with strangers for many of us.
pages.title: Gnombold

pages.name: Morax
npc_lines: Ah, it's you again. I take it you have something I should see?
As researcher and keeper of the archives, I study, record and collect potentially dangerous heretic materials and beliefs. Books, scrolls, music, fil - I am sorry, what was I saying?
pages.title: Morax

pages.name: Sandomo
npc_lines: Hm. Greetings.
First, you will help us rebuilding this wretched bridge we cannot cross. We need mortar and there are several types of monsters who try to keep us away from it. ...

Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
Our brother Mortis is constantly working on keeping the bridge intact. We tried some simple wood planks first but it didn't work out that... well. ...
What we need is enough mortar to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
We scouted some caves beneath the island which hold plenty of chalk to mix some good mortar. The entrances are not very far from here in fact. ...
However, the entrances are somewhat... twisted. The entrance we had mapped to a certain cave one day, would lead to a completely different cave on the next. ...
And even when emerging from one of the caves you never know where you are since its exits are just as deceptive. ...
Once you gathered some chalk, you should also find gravel on the island. If you have a pick and a bucket, you should be able to collect enough fine gravel to mix some mortar. ...
Do not forgeet to bring some buckets, if you are in short supply, brother Maun will hand some out to you - for a fee of course.
Head to brother Maun if you are in need of basic supplies. He will help you - for a small fee.
Brother Maun is a valuable member of the Inquisition. He will help you out with supplies. Provided you can actually compensate of course.
Head to brother Maun if you are in need of basic supplies. He will help you - for a small fee.
Several of the evil critters of this land will simply not cease to attack us and every project we undertook on this island. ...
They seem to keep us from fixing the giant traverse separating us from the rest of the island and you can see numerous guards in front of the wall even from down here. ...
There must be ways to draw them away from us - your mission is to find them. Now get to it and keep us these monsters at bay.
For all I know, we are about to breach a fortified bastion of pure evil. Once this nichtmare mural falls, we will have access to the whole island. ...
I will bring every trained man, woman and every volunteer I can muster to this battlefield. We will! Prevail. We will! Throw them back into the abyss they spawned from. ...
As I did not get that far into the island yet, I cannot give you much advice. Try to use your surroundings. Find something that works and make this wall tumble down. ...
It would also surely help if we could draw some of the creatures there away from it, as they are surely connected to this thing. I presume it is similar to the creatures guarding the bridge. ...
Maybe you can make some creatures angry somehow and make them focus on something else? Whatever you do, put your utmost effort into it.
Our brother Mortis is constantly working on keeping the bridge intact. We tried some simple wood planks first but it didn't work out that... well. ...
What we need is enough mortar to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
We should really use whatever this wretched island offers us against it. There are many ways to confront an enemy - make something out of everything. Bones, stones, resource deposits...
I am Sandomo, lightbringer of the inquisition and commander of the Roshamuul mission. Well, at least of what is now left of that mission.
The inquisition is the cleansing fire of the gods. For only with their guidance we shall purge the land.
He is an inspiration to us all.
A dreadful and accursed place we have to prospect. I thank the gods that I can see this place so that I can praise the mercy of the divine to spare us from such an abominable fate.
We are here to explore and prospect this desecrated shard of the gods creation. ...
This island is currently in a state of demonic stranglehold. Yet, the Inquisition WILL win this land back from the grasp of evil. ...
In my position as of the righteous Inquisition, I hereby declare you adjutant of the Inquisition - basically that means you are under MY command now.
The servants of evil are powerful. Yet armed with faith and side to side with our brothers and sisters, we shall prevail. ...
This island however, is a different story altogether.
First, you will help us rebuilding this wretched bridge we cannot cross. We need mortar and there are several types of monsters who try to keep us away from it. ...

Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
Oh, so you want a reward, hm? Well... let's see. What did you do for us - helping Mortis with his repairs and defended him? Or did you help in further destroying the mural amidst hordes of evil?
Alright, so you mixed and delivered 0 mortar and ...
You killed 0 frazzlemaws and ...

You also hunted 1 silencers. That would equal 1 of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my books for now or trade it for something else.
Ah yes, you currently have 0 of righteously earned inquisition gold in my book. 100 inquisition gold equals one cluster. How many clusters do you want in exchange?
Gold? Gold! Yes, well. Gold. Quite the predicament we're currently in here, right? Heh... well, there is not much I can do. ...
The ways of the inquisition to show gratitude are manyfold. Yes. Well, I hope you have some other important questions, I currently don't have a lot of time on my hands.
Strange things, aren't they? We gathered quite a lot of them when we came here. We actually stockpiled them because we didn't know what... heh, I mean, well. They are of course of much value. ...
To someone like you, that is. I am perfectly serious about that. Then again, I always am.
Of course, let's see. Hm, you have earned 1 of righteous inqusition gold. Do you want me to add this amount to my books? This will reset your current records, too, however - so?
As with the guzzlemaws there seems to be an endless supply of these creatures. A frazzlemaw however, is far larger than the guzzlemaw and even more dangerous. ...
Remember to keep your distance when fighting them, their bite can not only hurt - you may be swallowed whole. Based on what I found out so far, they seemed to have a false god, the Overmaw.
There are a lot of these snappy creatures on this island. We cannot say how many but so far we already fought countless specimens while defending the bridge, yet they keep coming. ...
If you happen to get bitten by one of them and the infected ichor starts spreading on your body... well, try to get rid of that part of your body. Good luck!

As far as I could venture, I did some meager studies on the maw creatures. Seem to have some kind of false god. They call it the 'Overmaw' and bow to its will. They erect shrines to its honors all over the island. ...
If you take one down, they will just create another one on top of it. Maybe keeping these shrines intact but desecrating them in some way, would draw their attention.
So, it seems you sounded 0 horns at the great mural and ...
You desecrated 0 shrines of the maws that roam these lands. And ...
You also lured 0 silencers away from the that cursed wall. Oh yes and ...
You actually eradicated 0 of the wretched eyeballs, Sight of Surrender. ...
That would equal 0 of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my books for now or trade it for something else.
Oh well, these huge eyeballs are not to be trifled with. They can pack a punch and may be the most sturdy living thing I have ever seen in my devoted life in the inquisition. ...
Try not to attack them with blunt weapons, focus on their head gear and you may... well you may as well just flee before surrendering to them.

They seem to be very focussed on sounds. They have a distinct siren call and seem to actually 'communicate' with each other. Maybe there is a way to distract them from attacking us when using this against them. ...

From what I have seen and heard from up here, they are annoyed by extremely loud noises. When I say 'annoyed', I mean they get angry. And when I say 'angry', well those vicious beasts are as fast as lightning and as a demon itself.
The servants of evil are powerful. Yet armed with faith and side to side with our brothers and sisters, we shall prevail. ...
This island however, is a different story altogether.
I do not know a lot about these creatures. If we could only muster enough men, we could probably tame them and use them to transport supplies deeper into the island.
Praise the gods, I bid you farewell.
pages.title: Sandomo

pages.name: Mortis
npc_lines: Yes yes, hello there. Praise and all.

We all have our reasons to fight. The gods, justice, revenge or just to do the right thing. Regardless what the reasons are, the enemies are all the same: heretics, cultists and servants of the lords of evil.
He is competent, pious and to the point. Just the man we need in dire times like this.
Look around you, it's a fiendish wasteland. There's nothing to it. And I am repairing the very pathway that will lead even deeper into its tainted heart. ...
Yet, if it is of use to the inqusition, I will not complain. There IS a demonic presence here that needs to be purged after all.
There are vile creatures roaming these lands. We are currently under attack from all sorts of critters while working on this bridge. ...
I believe Sandomo has named them 'Frazzlemaw'. They seem to feast not only on us but on everything we add to the bridge! ...
Mortar? A sweet treat to them. Stone and bricks? One giant bite. Wooden planks? Gone in an instant. ...
I, however, need mortar to maintain this bridge. If we want to sustain this giant traverse, the only way is by using stone, chalk and gravel.
There are vile creatures roaming these lands. We are currently under attack from all sorts of critters while working on this bridge. ...
I believe Sandomo has named them 'Frazzlemaw'. They seem to feast not only on us but on everything we add to the bridge! ...
Mortar consists of chalk and gravel. Mix those ingredients with water and you will get a fine building material. ...

There are enough stones for me around here, but I also need mortar to repair the bridge. If Sandomo says I shall repair this bridge, I shall. But I cannot fight these fiends and do repair work at the same time. ...
Well, now you know my dilemma, feel free to help me out. Mix some mortar and fill it into these troughs. Oh and... Sandomo will pay you, I guess.
Once you have mixed mortar by adding water to a bucket of gravel and chalk, fill the mix into one of the troughs over there.
You will need a bucket to fill the water, gravel or chalk into. You can get one down at the outpost from brother Maun.
I know we brothers all do this for the inquisition, the gods and all that but... I know this is dangerous work. Talk to Sandomo and I am sure he can offer some kind of reward.
The gods of good are our light in the darkness. We owe them to fight this battle.
This is a bizarre place and dreams are almost like living things here.
Goodbye.
pages.title: Mortis

pages.name: Gederas
npc_lines: I hope you have a good reason to come here.
The inquisition has to wipe out all demon resistance in this area. Before we can begin to heal the land, these abominations have to vanish. ...
It were my studies that unearthed the location of this abominable isle.
I was just a simple sub-leader of a branch of the inquisition, when a demon we purged from a desecrated temple tried to bargain for its freedom with information. ...
Of course we killed the vile abomination, but first we extracted the very information it deemed valuable to us. ...
It thought we might trade it in for his existence. Its information was of course vague and spiced with lies, but it was a start. ...
From thereon I dedicated my time in referencing books and praying for enlightenments from the gods. ...

I managed to deduce many facts about a base of the most evil of all demons, an unholy gathering place to plot and indulge in unspeakable rites. Some Yalahari texts even referenced this place as Roshamuul and to be avoided. ...

With an adventuring party, I located a compass-like device of Yalahari origin that pointed to that place. By the guidance of the gods, I had also found an artefact that allowed ships to travel the treacherous waters around this isle. ...

When our vanguard arrived here, we were unprepared for the sheer number of opponents and the massive fortifications. So it was only natural to call upon the heroes of the land to face this threat. ...

Despite all fortifications, the demons obviously never expected to be attacked here. Regardless of the progress we make though, this place is far from free from demonic presence and the purge has to continue.

At least they did not consort with demons, but their disregard of the gods is inexcusable and probably the reason for their downfall. Of course all their work is tainted and must be handled with care. ...
After my successes, I was granted to oversee all research about the Yalahari.
The works of a sinner are tainted by their sins. That's why we have to treat everything besides from our holy texts with care. ...
You can never tell if something is not the work of a sinner and how much of his taint has spilled into it.
You can see the taint everywhere. This is what will become of the world if we don't stop these vile invaders here and now.
They are the enemy of course. An enemy who knows no mercy and deserves none. There is no option but confrontation.
Beware of your dreams. They might be just the door to your soul the demons need.
A brilliant man with a brilliant mind. He is far too valuable to be endangered here.
I am no books expert, but if you found it here it is probably full of demonic lies.
The gods trust in us that we cleanse this place. If we fail, not only will our own souls be doomed but perhaps the whole world itself.
Farewell.
pages.title: Gederas

pages.name: Asnarus
npc_lines: Good day, Jogador. Ask me for a trade.
I am bound by my word to serve here as a trader. I will provide this service faithful for 111 years, as I vowed.
I lost a game of chess to the chief inquisitor Henricus. By my word I am now bound to a service of 111 years.
We Djinn are ageless and ancient. What is hundreds of years to me would be at most something about an hour for you, so I don't care much.
An overly ambitious and childish undertaking to try to purge the world of evil. But even the least of us must play their part in the war against evil, even you humans.
We Djinn do not dream as you mortals do. Therefore I don't fear to sleep; not that I need any sleep at all.
I never even heard about this place. I doubt any Djinn was aware that it existed, which is odd and disturbing. It is a place of evil for sure, even if it was not what the inquisition expected.
They are our bane and shame. Unless they see the light and begin to walk the right path, they are no better than the vile demons; yet they could be so much more. ...
It's to be blamed on us Djinn that we still fail to save our brethren from their evil ways.
Fierce beasts, no better than the Efreet. You humans do well to fight them. They are vile and despicable, and I don't mind to be of some assistance in that fight, offering my service.

Humans are so weak and fragile, so disconnected from the true world, which is magic and its flow. The most powerful of you may wield strong spells of destruction, yet they are still not connected to magic as we are.
A myth of humans to strive to be more than human, by the use of tools that bestow godly powers to them.
That is my name.
We are a powerful embodiment of magic. We are so different from you humans that it's often hard to understand each other. Not that we'd care much. ...
Your puny, little ambitions are of little concern to us. Everything you strive to accomplish will be blown away like sand before the desert wind in a blink of a Djinn's eye. ...
Therefore we are as patient as we are wise. You humans, though, are nothing but a curiosity, and nothing that will endure like us.
An upstart human, pretending to be an efreet. Disgusting, but nothing more.
Bye.
pages.title: Asnarus

pages.name: Siestaar
npc_lines: Greetings, <jogador>. How can I be of help? Some Bank business?
Siestaar, at your service.
No need to make fun of my name.
I'm responsible for running the bank here.
We can change money for you. You can also access your bank account.
A place of malice and evil. A testament of what our world would become if the demons should prevail. It also shows our fight is progressing. The demons can be beaten by those true to the gods.
My dreams ... well, they haven't been pleasant for a long time. So little has changed to me at all. The dreams here are more lively and you almost never forgot what you dreamed last night.
He is a wise leader, and my continued survival is only granted by his generosity and trust in the soul of humans to find the light even in its darkest hour.
They are only one of the opponents the true believers have to fight. Often it is harder to fight the own inner demons though. It we fail on one front or the other we are doomed. ...
Only with the guidance of the gods can we prevail.

I failed the inquisition once, but I will do my service here as a deserved punishment for my failure. I will die here in service of the inquisition or I will return if pardoned when I have proven my sincerity to make up for my failure.
When fighting evil, dangers are manifold. I gave in to the temptation to read just one more page with dark knowledge, just one more forbidden book to better understand the workings of the enemy. ...
It was that by fighting the enemy I almost became the enemy. Praised be the gods that my shortcomings were discovered in time and that a cruel fate could be prevented. ...

After ... a while, I was released from the dungeons in custody of other inquisitors. I did my best to show my dedication to the cause, and proved that I had abandoned my quest for forbidden knowledge. ...
After years of meek service to the inquisition and the churches, I was given this chance to redeem myself.
Certainly a holy weapon indeed.
Sweet dreams.
pages.title: Siestaar

pages.name: Auron
npc_lines: Welcome to the post office.
This unit is a sophisticated gnomish crystal golem, responsible for maintaining communication with other places in the world, even in a hostile and dangerous environment. ...
This unit is responsible for keeping the local post office and spreading the word about gnomish accomplishments and products.
This unit is referred to as Auron.
That is the correct identifier for this unit.
All hail our gnomish overlords!
A place categorised as extremely dangerous. Artificial workforces are suggested to keep harm away from living beings.
Demons are to be avoided by this unit. This unit has to engage into combat only in emergency situations. For protection against demonic forces, gnome-forged armour is highly recommended.
The inquisition acquired the usage of this golem unit via a trade agreement with the gnomes.
Bye.
pages.title: Auron

pages.name: Eruaran
npc_lines: Ashari <jogador>, so we meet again! What brings you here this time. General information, transform, improve, create, outfit or talk?
We met occasionally in your dreams. Don't mind, it's rare that such incidents are remembered at all.
So you are here for the creation of a dream matter item. I guess you are familiar with the general process.

I can refine some of the raw essences like dream matter you may find here and refine them with lesser dream substances like clusters of solace to shape them with help of the dreamcatcher. I can try to shape them into several forms of your liking. ...

Yet when shaping the essence it becomes closer to a dream once more for a short time. It might be that I loose the grasp onto that matter and everything dissolves into nothingness and will be lost. ...
If we created a basic version of the object you desired we could use more material to refine it even further, making it stronger by making it more real and defining it more. ...
This though comes with an extreme risk since the dream matter of the item is very likely to shatter. ...
Even that stronger item might be further refined at even greater risk. I'm not even sure I could do it at all without harm to myself but I might try.
True dream matter are something like an idea in the process of becoming solid. It's quite rare and many creatures covet it because even possessing it gives them some sort of comfort. ...
So it's likely that you will have to fight for it. But dream matter is a such power without a form it might be worth it. Combined with clusters of solace the idea gets substance and form.

Clusters of solace are full of raw options but they are powerless on their own. Combined with true potential they can be used to create something powerful or refine it even more by giving the idea of the item more reality.

From time to time fate smiles upon those who take great risks and have strong dreams! If you have the ingredients we can try give the ultimate refinement to swords, axes, clubs, bows, crossbows and spellbooks.
For the creation we'd need dream matter and some clusters of solace. For any process of refinement we'd also need a lesser version of the item you want to refine of course.
One handed or two handed?
Do you want to spend your dream matter with those xy clusters of solace and give it a shot. Yes or no?
Ah it looks like you forgot to bring enough materials!
Know this: the creation is an unsecure and dubios procedure. You can try to obtain swords, axes, clubs, bows, crossbows and spellbooks.
For your noble deeds I can offer you to make some of your dreams come true! I send the potential of an unique outfit in your mind. You can make it real! ...
Are you interested?
The dream warden outfit! Let's see if you are worthy. Tell me: base, claw or mask?
In order to get the dream warden outfit, you have to prove yourself worthy, <jogador>.
You have to find a dream warden claw in order to wear it!
You have to find a dream warden mask in order to wear it!
So I guess you are curious what I'm doing here.
I came here not by choice but due to circumstance. I was drawn into this place by the power the dreams. Imagine it like swimming in a lake and suddenly getting into a vortex. ...
I could still have avoided it but curiosity did not allow such a phenomenon to be ignored.
This a place unlike any other on this world. There are other places where dream and reality might mix up but this here is unique in a frightening way.
Whoever created this place was accustomed in handling the substance of dreams. No, not only to handle it, but to master it. ...
But whoever did that, they did only mettle with the most disturbing dreams, bordering to madness. Not only that, this place seems to draw those very dreams here somehow. ...
I can still feel it. The pull is there, it might be weak, compared to what it once must have been, but it is still here, like a magnet of some kind.

Much of what you can see here is made from the substance of dreams. It might look like stone and structures but in it's core it's the stuff dreams are made of. It's dreams that became solid and remain that way. ...

The matter is still subject to change though. I can feel the change, the malleable form of things, but they are stable and not threatened to become the insubstantial dream matter that they were made of. It is just amazing.

There are many objects completely made of dreams and imagination that have become solid. Some of them might be useful to be transformed or refined into something else. Look out for clusters of solace or dream matter.
It is one thing to have a certain amount of control over ones dreams, it is another thing to shape them. ...
It is incredibly difficult even for the most skilled the manipulate reality via the dreams and even more so, to manifest something of a dream into the awaken world. ...
Still the latter is something that have been done almost casually here everywhere. You can't understand what frightening power that is. Even more considering that apparatus that I found here.
Not only that those who once dwelled here were able to seemingly handle dream matter with ease, They also created this construct that works in a way that should not be possible at all. ...
In truth it is a potent dream in itself, that is probably why it can interact with dream matter at all. ...

For now it only sees to create a vortex of some sort in the realm of dreams, still dragging dreams here and turning them into ... something. However it is so much more. It seems it works like a musical instrument of some sort. ...
That is, if you use it to create the right 'tune' you can use it to shape the dreams it draws upon.
I can certainly do some minor transformations of dream matter, using the apparatus. It still needs some extremely raw dream matter as a basis and a number of clusters of solace to refine it. ...

Still it would be a very unreliable process since I'm not familiar with that apparatus and due to it's damaged state. Chances are that it will yield nothing and the material only dissipates into the realm of dreams again. ...
If I'm successful though I could draw upon the dreams of countless warriors and magicians to shape them into something wonderful.
I came here not by choice but due to circumstance. I was drawn into this place by the power the dreams. Imagine it like swimming in a lake and suddenly getting into a vortex. ...
I could still have avoided it but curiosity did not allow such a phenomenon to be ignored.
Maybe I was once an elf, perhaps that was only a dream though. Does it really matter after all? I think not. Dream, reality, human or elf, that all is of no consequence at all. ...

We are what we do, we are what we decide. To limit yourself to be an elf or whatever is to abandon the potential of what you COLUD be. I'm sorry I'm not here to preach or teach though and I'm terrible in such things.
What once was a dream became true. I acknowledge that at least.
Humans have impressively big dreams. Yet they are strangely insubstantial, very different to those of others.
Don't ask others to explain you dreams. Experience them. Dreams are your friend, your mentor, your private fortress and they could be so much more if you just listen to them.
We were intrigued by the way, they handled their dreams. We taught them what we thought would help. Then we walked with them for a while to learn on our own, but we couldn't. ...
Our ways were too different. In the end their noble goals fell prey to treachery as far as I know.
I heard about them in some dreams. Gladly they can't and never will be able to enter the realm of dreams. ...
Only a few demons with a special affinity are able to truly enter the dream realms, others can only send you vague nightmares at best ...
Even the nightmares of their enemies did not give the seven enough foothold to enter the dreams and as far as I can tell they never even bothered ...
It's almost as if they are afraid of dreams for some strange reason.

Some demons sleep and some demons even dream, but strangely enough they usually walk in another world of dreams, totally separate from that of our own and it's a gap that can only be bridged by brute force. ...
Something that is acomplished by only a few, special breeds of demons.

Some demons sleep and some demons even dream, but strangely enough they usually walk in another world of dreams, totally separate from that of our own and it's a gap that can only be bridged by brute force. ...
Something that is acomplished by only a few, special breeds of demons.
I've walked with them in their dreams. A bit single minded and repetitive in imagination but if it's that what they like and care for, it's good for them and not for me to judge.

I have no better word for this apparatus. Exactly it's not even of this world. What you see is only it's representation to our minds. It even looks different for you and me but we both see at least some kind of machine. ...

Other creatures might see totally different things. It's original purpose is hard to tell. By its very nature it's existence alone is like a connection between the world of dreams an this one. But it's far more. ...

It's obviously also a dream matter dispenser and dream shaper. I assume in the past it was used to alter the shape of the city at the leisure of it's creators. I was most certainly used to crate items of craftsmanship only limited by imagination. ...

It's both impressive and frightening that some race accomplished so much. Yet by all possibility in this design I feel something is ... lacking. I can't put my finger on it yet but everything we see here seems to be flawed in a strange way. ...

I can't yet tell the nature of that flaw but I'm sure that set some severe limitation to the power of the creatures that once lived here. Perhaps when I find out what the flaw is, I might be able to do even more with our findings here.
That place is made of dreams, but not good dreams, that's for sure. Still dreams are dreams and might be adjusted or even reshaped.
That's only a word. Words are rough and imprecise. If you'd walk the dreams for a while things would become far more clear because they are lost in obscurity. ...
I'm a living dream, rider of nightmares, wanderer in paradises and hells. I have seen wonders beyond compare. I experienced things a untrained mind could not only grasp. I am what I am.
Yes yes. Goodbye <jogador>.
pages.title: Eruaran

pages.name: Zedrulon the Fallen
npc_lines: Welcome to this temple, holy warrior! Let me heal you.
It was my destiny to be here, and the will of the gods.
I was one of the first to cross the bridge, one of the first to breach the wall. That was where I died! I know I was dead, though I will not speak about what I have seen. ...
It's not that I don't want too, but - I simply don't understand. - Anyway. ...
My body was torn, mutilated, destroyed. When I regained consciousness I was here. I... just knew what I had to do. ...
With prayers and sermons, and by sacrificing my own blood, I cleansed this place, repelled its evil and sanctified it. ...
I am certain I was guided by the gods, and it is here that I will stand in vigilance over this place, on this cursed and befouled isle.
You are poisoned. Let me soothe your pain.
Too few take up their god-given duty to fight in the war against evil. ...
Blessed be the few men and women, sinners though they may be, who atone for at least some of their own corruption by slaying the corruption that are the servants of the gods of evil. ...
Their continued existence is proof that they are ours to be handled, that it is our fault that they exist! Every cruelty they commit is also your fault, because you failed yet to stop them!
He is a great man, but with greatness come pride and other vices. He is to be observed closely. ...
Those who rise the highest might fall the deepest and hardest. Only the gods are without failure and without blame.
The demons are nothing without our sins. They feed on them. Thrive on them. Their power is testament to our weakness. If the demons are powerful, we are to blame. ...
To slay them is therefore to cleanse ourselves and to at least somewhat atone for our sinful lives.
Fear not, the gods will guard your sleep here. Here, every evil in your dreams comes not from without, but from a taint within your own soul. ...
You should repent to purify yourself and your sinful mind.
Come back soon to repent your sins!
pages.title: Zedrulon the Fallen

pages.name: Gaberiel
npc_lines: Hi, Jogador! Nice to meet you. Wonder why you never met me here? Well, I stranded here and can't really remember how. ...
I just remember I have to give everyone a small green light. May it enlighten your paths.
Hi, Jogador! Nice to meet you again. You were already greenlit!
Hi, Jogador! Nice to meet you. I stranded here years ago and can't really remember how. I had some small green gifts for the Tibians. But then I left Thais and wandered the world of Tibia ...
I saw many wonders and fascinating places. But now I returned to Thais and have another present. Here, my friend, take this tapestry.
Hi, Jogador! Nice to meet you again. You already got your observer tapestry!
pages.title: Gaberiel

pages.name: Silas
npc_lines: Hello, friend. If you need bows or spears, ammunition or paladin spells, then ask for a trade.
I am a hunter and trainer of hunters. And I teach paladin spells to those of my kind.
You seem staggered by it. The invention of glooth added to the uniqueness of our city, I believe - there is no glooth in your lands, I understand?
A strange substance, gained, I think through some sort of process from an animal. Our historian in the magistrate, or Dr Alaistar Stanton, can surely explain it better to you than I can.
A kind and intelligent man, but too naive in his dealings with the minotaurs. You'd better purchase some sturdy bow if you go out there to their camps, friend.
Those brutish creatures cannot share the island with us. We should eradicate their kind, once and for all, or we shall never be safe.
pages.title: Silas

pages.name: Roswitha
npc_lines: Hello, my dear. You look like you need a good drink and a chat! Come on in!
I am Mrs Roswitha Brandon. Mr Brandon has been dead these ten years, poor soul. Nowadays, Mrs Roswitha will do.

<sighs> He was a passionate fisherman, my poor husband was. Loved nothing as much as the sea wind in the sails and the ship's rudder in his hand. Well, almost nothing. He loved to brew glooth and drink it, too, that's for sure. ...
Those damned dangerous cliffs and contrary winds around our isle are the reason I shall never again see him in this life. <dabs at her eyes>
It has a romantic ring to it, that's for sure. Though I guess he has to blow his nose just like the likes of us.

Horrible brutes they are! Always fighting and attacking us. The only decent sort is Maro - you know, the toolmaker from the upper city. He used to come down here in our part of the city once and a while.
Well, the island would be lovely if it wasn't for all the terrible beasts that roam it! <sighs>
Your city is probably quite different from ours. I bet however you got nobs and ordinary people just as well as we do.
I run this place. It used to be the old post coach station back when Rathleton was a lot smaller, but my late husband made a bed and breakfast of it.
The city's smartened up, at least on the hill up there <snorts>. Those nobs won't look at the likes of me, oh no. But at least the glooth gets us by in hard times.
Ah, all I've got for comfort these days. I can tell you some stories about this town that will astound you! Just ask me for a story!
Ah, where would I be without a good gossip or two. <winks> Just ask me for a story!
You know they say some poor souls have been captured and made to work inside metal bodies and that's how gargoyles were made? I hope Mr Brandon's soul was not captured by one of those fellows!

Did you know? That friendly Mr Barnabas Dee is a soothsayer who's foretold many things for this city! If only he had foretold Mr Brandon's death, maybe my poor husband would not have sailed. <shakes head>
My grandfather used to tell me the mists around this isle were the breath of sleeping dragons, who only breathe out every ten years. Now that would be a sight to see!
Some say Rathleton was built on the ruins of an ancient order, some say, on a demonic site, and that the mists arising are the souls of the dead ... <shudders> I don't want to believe THAT, though!
I have been told that a weird scientist blew up the old factory to run from his debts, and that he's now hiding in one of your towns, gambling and drinking. For shame!
They say Alaistar Stanton married a minotaur princess and brought their child with him when the minotaurs would not accept a human as king. Can you believe that? <shakes head>
There's a phantom of the old opera, underneath the sewers. It stalks the city at night. Some of my customers have seen it! They say it looks like a horrible beast, moaning and roaring! <shudders>
Flint used to be the city watch captain. But when he lost his best friend in a battle against the minotaurs, he resigned and became a blacksmith instead. Poor man!

No one has ever seen Azalea's face, she's always hooded. Some say she is hideously disfigured from a curse that she can't lift, always searching for a cure and that's why she became a druid and doesn't dare show her face, poor thing!

Some say glooth does all kinds of strange things to you. Some claim it made them light as air and they could fly! Though I guess that's a whiff of peppermoon pollen too many, poor souls. Still, who knows. Try a pint of glooth for yourself! <winks>
Well, if you drink it too quickly, there's no knowing what'll happen. <winks> If it gets cooler, it's harmless, though. No worries. ...
One cold, frothy, tasty pint of glooth coming up!
pages.title: Roswitha

pages.name: Barnabas Dee
npc_lines: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer spells, you have come to the right place.
