That's the tribe living in this village. They are one of the settled clans, whilst others are still nomadic. In addition, they seem to be the only tribe so far that tolerates humans. ...
Mainly because the shaman sees a benefit in our presence.

Ghorza is the tribe's shaman. I have the impression that she is a rather unusual ogress, because she's interested in humans not only in the sense of a tasty snack. She seems to think that we could be useful to her and the tribe.

The shaman is very important for an ogre tribe. Often, but not always, the shaman is an elder ogress. She cares for the spiritual welfare of the tribe, appeases the spirits, blesses newborn ogre-children and the like. ...
This tribe's shaman is Ghorza.

Ogres value food above all things. They like meat or beer, but as I found out they also adore sweets! They're downright scoffing them. But they don't know how to make cookies or candy. And at this point the humans come in. ...
As far as I'm concerned, I survive amongst the ogres because I play the role of a merchant here. I provide them with sweets, they let me live here and pursue my studies about Krailos.

Krailos is this vast grassland and steppe you are standing in, and is mainly populated by ogres. The region is located north of Oramond, bordered by high mountains to the south and a wild sea to the east, west and north. ...
It's a secluded area, but it seems to has a very interesting history.

The ogres are simple, warlike people, more interested in a fight and good food than in politics. Ogres like conflict; they are impulsive and quick to anger. They prefer to solve conflicts through combat rather than words. ...

They are distrustful towards strangers like us and tend to welcome them with avoidance in the best case. Lately yet, the Bloody Skulls tribe here has shown a sort of interest in trade with other peoples.
Oramond lies south of here, separated from Krailos by a high mountain chain. It's very different from the ogre lands, but also dangerous. Many minotaurs live there.
Krailos is surrounded by many underwater shelves. They make it difficult for ships to reach the coast unscathed. At the rugged shores you may find the one or other shipwreck.

An honorable death is not the highest purpose in an ogre'€™s life, but rather a fulfilled life, which primarily means enough food and a comfortable hut. Food carries great weight in ogre life and society.
Yes, the drying of seas and rivers is a big problem in Krailos. Gradually, all sources of fresh water are fading away. If you want to know more, you should ask Ghorza.

Ogres value food above all things. They like meat or beer, but as I found out they also adore sweets! They're downright scoffing them. But they don't know how to make cookies or candy. And at this point the humans come in. ...
As far as I'm concerned, I survive amongst the ogres because I play the role of a merchant here. I provide them with sweets, they let me live here and pursue my studies about Krailos.

The ogres are a tribal people, divided into several different clans. Leader of a tribe is usually the strongest male ogre. The chieftain is supported by an ogre-shaman. If the shaman is female, the two are often, but not necessarily, a couple.
Once a sophisticated, but peaceful grassland empire existed on this peninsula. It was noted for its advanced architecture and philosophy. ...
But it was destroyed hundreds of years ago through social breakdown, caused by their interest in forbidden things. ...

In this empire the ogres were not quite slaves, but rather a kind of deprived lower class. Yet it seems they were the only ones to survive the downfall of this ancient realm, perhaps simply because of their physical strength.

There are quite a few goblins living here in Krailos. I suppose they originally arrived as stowaways on the ships that now and then burst at Krailos' rocky shores. Most of these goblins are kept as slaves by the ogres. ...
As are other smaller races like dworcs or coryms.

The humans who lived here so long ago worshipped the suns of our world. Not only the calm and considerate Suon but also his reckless and wild sister Fafnar. As far as I found out, the veneration of these two aspects was in balance for a long time. ...
But the the adherents to the wild goddess Fafnar prevailed and the destructive nature of their goddess eventually caused the downfall of this ancient empire.

Suon is one of the two suns of our world, considered as one of the gods, the son of Fardos, by many. Some call him the Life-Bringing Sun and believe that he observes creation with love and blesses us with warmth and growth. ...
Others guess he is just the misguided sibling of Fafnar and that his light turns pale compared to her brightness.

Fafnar is one of the two suns of our world, considered as one of the gods, the daughter of Fardos, by many. Some call her the Scorching Sun and believe that she observes creation with hate and jealousy. ...
But others think she's the stronger of the two suns, that Suon's light turns pale compared to her brightness.
Fardos is considered the creator, often called the Great Observer. Many people believe that it was his doing that we possess divine souls.

Ogres worhip the Great Hunger, a kind of spirit being they believe will eat up the entire world if not fed regularly. Therefore they often perform rites of sacrifice - with food but also with living creatures, to feed this entity.
My name is Larek. Some call me Larek the Wayfarer, because of my voyages to many faraway lands.
Of course, just browse through my wares.
Farewell.
pages.title: Larek

pages.name: A Goblin Exile
npc_lines: Hello, hu-man! Away put your weapon, I am meaning no harm.
Used to be philosopher priest shaman for East Waterwhirl clans! Keeper of sacredness! Truth teller! But this no say anything to you, hu-man. ...
These days, me exile hermit waiting for new time. Keep things safe and hallow lost artefacts of goblins, for Frog God to look kindly on our last hope! ...
Frog God leads me to places where find useful stuff needed for salvation of goblinkind. I pray, his golden eyes lead. I find. I hide.
Used to have one, when still in city. Left it behind. Now, old hermit waiting for goblin redemption I am. Nemmo Tokrok Argkaz Ar-Vanda Ho'Memot.
Always hungry, always, take, kill, eat, destroy! Must have been spawn spewn out by Night Snake to prey on poor Frog God children.
Holy, holy, holy. Poor goblin pray to Frog God for new time of peace for goblins!
No story to tell in dark times, not here. Might come when called! Suffice it to say that it chases Frog God and hates cool earth and water, no friend of goblins.
For long time, goblins safe in mountains. Lived and prospered! Sang songs of golden times, passed on knowledge from old to new goblins! Then ogres came.
Goodbye, hu-man. Don't let ogres bite you.
pages.title: A Goblin Exile

pages.name: A Runaway Goblin
npc_lines: Hu-man! Eek! Go away!
Am, er, purveyor of things! Yes! Bring stuff where needed, discreetly-like! Heheh!
Oh, kind hu-man asks for goblin name! But too dangerous, am sought goblin! Ogres must not know!
Very perspicacious hu-man!
Urgh, ogre smell baaad! Like rotten rat cheese and dragon eggs! Terrible day for goblins when ogres found us! Slavery, sadness, sorrow!
Yes, please go!
pages.title: A Runaway Goblin

pages.name: Grubokk
npc_lines: Huh! Talking food! Hello!
Me guard goblin slaves. Good job! Free food! Hur hur!
Grrrrrr! Me mighty Grubokk! You puny morsel!
Land of ogres you see out there, hu-man!
Ogres strong! And our tribe strongest!
Full of air from too much fan-ci-ful words. Worship puny, powerless frog. Tinker with tools without own strength. Not know true power. Not earthed like ogres. Deserve to be slaves!
Huh! Grubokk got all under control! Goblins quiet! But if not... tell me and Grubokk may have task for you! Harhar!
Huh! Grubokk got all under control! Goblins quiet! But if not... tell me and Grubokk may have task for you! Harhar!
Arr harr! Pesky goblins up to no good? You wanna teach lesson? Me reward you!
Good! But first, you promise on life you no help goblin! You SURE no help goblin?? Say it!
That will show uppity goblins! Will take away water. Then they not feel so thirsty for revolt, harr! ...
Three things to make them sorry. Cut off water supplies in mines first. Then poison wells in their wormy city tunnels. Then flood them out of mines with sea water! ...
Will be nicely marinated and seasoned when they wash up here! HAHAHAH!
Hur! <belch>
pages.title: Grubokk

pages.name: Mazarius
npc_lines: Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what brings you here, to my humble adobe.
Ah, a good man and a competent aid.

The elves are like lost children. Their potential might be great, but they lack focus and dedication to truly improve. If their myths are true, some of the more early elves might have accomplished ascension. ...

Yet even if hints strongly suggest those stories are true, the sheer inaction of those assumedly ascended beings is disturbing. Perhaps what those legendary elves achieved was something completely different.
Instead of banding together and starting to change something, they and Thais keep wasting resources in hostilities.
I like the quietness and the climate. And admittedly it helped my studies not to be constantly disturbed by petitioners.
Edron has become as stagnant as the teachings in its academy. No new idea has been thought there for decades. The whole Edron is an example for what happens when humanity has become fat and lazy.
The dwarves are leftovers from a time long gone by. They have outlived their usefulness to the gods and seem to have come to terms with that. ...
They are as unchanging as rock and no greatness awaits them any more. They missed their chance, if they ever had any.
Thais has become a melting pot of some source. Yet whatever you melt, if the ingredients are corrupted, the outcome is always flawed.
An almost laughable greed is persistent in that city. At least this makes knowledge and materials conveniently available to those who can match their prizes.
Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what brings you here, to my humble adobe.
Ah, you have heard about my search for experienced help. And indeed your reputation for solving certain problems has preceded you.
My problems are, so to say, dire news for the whole world. <sigh> I don't want to confuse you with overly complicated and lengthy stories, so do you want to hear the long version or the short?

You have to know I'm a scholar of some renown. In the course of my latest studies about ascension, I stumbled upon disturbing facts about the person of the all to well known Ferumbras, the fiendish. ...
He obviously had taken an interest to the topic of ascension, and I came into possession of some of his early writings. ...
This, combined with investigation and divination, bit by bit led to the conclusion that all that Ferumbras has done in the past may be part of a cunning plan. ...
Considering his writings and the books he based them upon, it became clear that Ferumbras is planning his ascension to godlike status. ...
All of his attacks and defeats only served one purpose: to become an integral part of the people's knowledge, fears and beliefs. ...
He actually used this as an energy source, and combined it with some sources of power which might not all be of our own world. ...
He uses this energy to increasingly empower himself and will eventually be prepared to take the final step to transform himself into a godlike being. ...
He uses his public awareness to anchor himself and bides his time to infuse himself with power, step by step. ...
With the knowledge what to look for, I acquired expensive but powerful artefacts to scry the world for the expected power signature - and indeed I made contact. ...
To my horror I had to recognize that Ferumbras had already made significant progress, and his final bid for ascension is imminent! ...
His power levels are already too high for there to be any hope of stopping him with conventional means. ...
But not all is lost yet. During my studies about godhood, I learned that the dark Zathroth himself had created a weapon so powerful that it could actually slay a god. ...
Yet even he deemed this so-called 'godbreaker' too dangerous, and split it into seven parts. These were at some point entrusted to his powerful minions, known as the Ruthless Seven. ...
Ancient, forbidden texts hinted at a hellish place where the seven built deadly dungeons, and placed some of their most fearsome and terrible minions as guards, before they sealed the place off. ...

I'm confident that I can prepare a matching ritual that will breach their protection and allow someone to enter their realm; but I'm in no way suited to handle the horrors to be encountered there. ...
Therefore I have to ask you, if you are willing to retrieve the parts of the godbreaker, and face the threat of the ascending Ferumbras?
My studies indicate that without all doubt Ferumbras the fiendish is in the process of accumulating nearly godlike powers. We have to stop him. ...
Therefore I need you to enter a hellish dimension and acquire the parts of a weapon, the godbreaker, powerful enough to stop him once and for all. Are you willing to help me in this dire mission?

I'm pleased to have such a competent assistance in this matter. Our first task will be to breach the pocket dimension where the godbreaker is hidden. Therefore I ask you to gather 30 demonic essences which will allow me to open it.
For a long time, I thought the godbreaker to be some apocryphal myth. But apparently others had learned about the godbreaker in the aeons past and lusted for its power. ...
They had gathered hint after hint - until, ultimately, they were squashed by the Seven or their minions; which only made the leads that hinted at them all the more probable. ...

What Zathroth hoped to accomplish with the creation of such a weapon can only be subject to speculation. Assumedly he already had slain Tibiasula, so the godbreaker might have been even more powerful, more absolute. ...
However, it has to be assumed that in the end the sheer power of his creation scared Zathroth, who had to fear the weapon could one day be used against him. So he disassembled it. ...

He kept the parts hidden and guarded, and if the resources can be trusted and my interpretation is right, moved them again and again, never satisfied with a hiding place. In the end he entrusted the parts to the Ruthless Seven. ...
Knowing that they would never, ever allow one of their own to come in possession of all parts. Since then, the parts have been hidden in a demi-plane shared by the Seven.

Given the internal power plays amongst the Seven, they are the ideal keepers for individual parts of an powerful artefact. Not one of them would allow his compatriots to hold such a power, and neither would trust the other.

It is a place, so to say, not completely of this world. It is separate of, yet strongly connected to, our own world. I would imagine it is quite limited in size and its laws of physics and magic should be roughly the same as ours. ...
Being home to a host of demons for a while, I expect it to be an hostile and dangerous environment.
Ascension is a fascinating topic that dates back to efforts and philosophies of some of the most ancient, and mostly extinct, races which fought in the godwars. ...
Probably born out of desperation, they extensively researched ways to acquire godhood themselves. ...
Some of them at least even met with moderate success. But the process is complicated at best, and may vary from race to race or even from one individual to another. ...
The theories differ vastly and waxed and waned in popularity over the centuries if not aeons. Even today and in human society there are a number of obscure ascension cults. ...
Some of them claim that humans are most suitable for ascension because they already own a bit of divinity through Banor's godly spark.
Although already powerful in his own right, it is obvious that his ultimate goal seems to be the ascension to godly powers. ...
His whole existence seems to be centred on becoming a name that strikes fear into the heart of men and to become a persistent figure in the minds of humanity. ...

This gives him a hold in reality and a kind of mould to fill with his power and conscience. It's also obvious that this kind of belief of the people alone won't be enough to empower him sufficiently. ...

Therefore he has to tap into other, probably even more sinister power sources. I can't tell what these sources are, but my scrying revealed that he has reached massive amounts of power. He has probably been infusing himself since years. ...
By now he is apparently reaching the end circle of his ascension and could make his final move any day.
Good bye!
pages.title: Mazarius

pages.name: Bozarn
npc_lines: Greetings. The master is waiting for you in the basement.
I'm a manservant, like my father and my grandfather before me.
My master is a noble and wise man. He dedicated his life and fortune to the pursuit of knowledge. ...
He became a scholar of note at a young age, and in our days he is often consulted amongst his peers for his vast knowledge of diverse topics.
I'm not knowledgeable enough to comment on my master's studies, but he certainly is well known for them to men of learning from all over the world.
In modern days our responsibilities are numerous.
Times have changed, and the nobility and the rich usually don't employ large staffs of people any more. Only the most important ones are kept and entrusted with more and more duties.
Only the most civilized realms have a nobility worthy of that name. I doubt that any of the non-human races even grasp the concept of nobility, which might explain their barbarism.

There is a new breed of nobility. Sophisticated men and women, who, through determination and intelligence, rise to a status that allows them to be recognised by the true nobility as almost, but not quite, equals.
Who hasn't heard about that madman. A threat to society and civilisation indeed! The master is more familiar with this topic, though.
Pardon me, but I'm afraid I'm not familiar with those bands the Thaian youths listen to.
Good bye!
pages.title: Bozarn

pages.name: Captain Pelagia
npc_lines: Welcome on board, Sir Jogador. Where can I sail you today?
I'm one of the few captains who sail here at all. The waters of Krailos are dangerous. Hidden underwater shelves were the bane of many a ship - as you may gather by the wreckage all around here. ...
But I sail people to Krailos and back to various Tibian locations.

Krailos is this big peninsula north of Oramond. The two regions are separated by a high mountain range, so Krailos is only accessible by water. And that's not easy either, as many dangerous underwater shelves surround Krailos. ...

The island is covered by a vast steppe and dangerous. That's because of the ogres, naturally. Beware of those beasts - they are maneaters. You should set foot on these shores only on careful deliberation.
They are big, brutal and dull creatures and it is said they love the taste of human flesh. Yet it is rumoured that lately, one single tribe tolerates the presence of humans. ...
But I don't know if that's true or just idle gossip, so be careful. Oh, and you have to swim to the coast. Because of the reefs here I can't come closer to the shore, I'm sorry.
Maybe later.
My name is Pelagia.
Good bye and beware of the ogres!
pages.title: Captain Pelagia

pages.name: Shadowpunch
npc_lines: In victory or death!
Show your heart of steel!
Rainin' blood!
We both know it's the thrill of combat you're here for, so let's get to it. Just tell me if you're ready to fight or if you need me to explain everything to you. ...
I also sell first aid potions if you need it.
I have no name, I have honour.
Setting up and watching over fights in the arena is what I do.
I can tell you how much time you have until I throw you out of here - it's almost up!
I can give you details about the fighting rules for each mode, explain how to initiate a fight. I can also give you information on prizes.
First rule: every kill is justified in the arena. Otherwise, the PvP rules of your world will apply to the arena on your world. ...
As for the rest of the rules, the most important thing to know is that there is a time limit for each fight as well as right before a match. ...
After the fight has been initiated by giving me the necessary details, a timer will be started. ...
A fight is won if either only one player is left or only one team (at least one member of the team still standing at the end of a fight). ...
The fight will be canceled if the predetermined number of players for a fight does not show up in the anteroom. ...
If a fight is in progress but takes too long or no clear winner could be termined (this includes team fights were at least one member of both teams is still standing), it will be canceled as well.
Every premium player can participate in the arena. To initiate the arena, just talk to me and tell me if you want to play last man standing or a team deathmatch. ...
If the arena is not currently occupied you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create one-on-one matches in both modes by adding only 2 players. ...
If you opted for a team deathmatch, you will have to select the members for each team by telling me the correct names. ...
After that you will have to specify the stakes for the fight.
I can give you information on stakes or how the prize money will be split in last man standing or team deathmatch mode.
Depending on the stake the initiating player has determined for a fight, each player will have to have this amount of gold on his or her bank account to take part. ...
As soon as the match starts (not while waiting or by entering an anteroom after the fight has been initiated), the money will be deducted. ...
Together, these stakes will add to the prize money, which will either go to the single winner of a last man standing fight or to the winning team in a team deathmatch. ...
If the match cannot be finished within the time limit, this money will be lost!
In a last man standing fight, the prize money which consists of all stakes of each player together, will go to the last player standing. ...
In a team deathmatch this money is split evenly among each player of the winning team (please note that the final share will be rounded down in case of uneven splits). ...
If a winning team consists of 5 players and only 2 members are still standing at the end of a fight, the money will still be split among all 5 members of the team.
Good, let's do battle. Which kind of rumble strikes you fancy, a team fight with chosen participants, or last man standing?
Good fight, good night.
pages.title: Shadowpunch

pages.name: Lorenzo
npc_lines: Hello, brave fighter! What can I do for you? Do you want information, to exchange something or to simply talk?
I will hand out arena badges depending on your results in the PvE arena. You can keep them or exchange them for potions - with a chance to win a special surprise cube, just to spice things up a bit.
If you finish all 10 waves of an arena battle, you'll obtain a fixed amount of arena badges. The exact amount depends on the selected difficulty level. ...
I can check the total amount and offer you potions in exchange for them. Do you want me to hand out your arena badges now?
There are 5 difficulty levels when fighting against waves of monsters in the arena. Each difficulty level grants you a certain amount of arena badges which I will hand out to you. ...
Level 1 grants one badge, level 2 grants two, level 3 grants three, level 4 grants four and level 5 grants five arena badges.
As a special service for our most valued customers, we hand out a surprise cube! By using it, you have a chance of getting nice little goodies.
Well, I guess you'd like to know what I'm doing here.
It's my fate to trade potions in exchange for arena badges. Actually my whole family earns its living that way - maybe you'll get to know them someday! ...
You can meet my brothers and sisters by visiting the other arenas.
It's my fate to trade potions in exchange for arena badges. Actually my whole family earns its living that way - maybe you'll get to know them someday! ...
You can meet my brothers and sisters by visiting the other arenas.

It's quite easy. I give you arena badges for each completed arena battle. Surviving 10 waves against monsters in the arena will grant you a fixed amount of badges depending on the difficulty level. ...
You can keep the arena badges or exchange them for each kind of health, mana and spirit potions. I'll charge 1 arena badge for the amount of 100 mana or health potions. ...

100 strong potions of either mana or health will be charged with 2, 100 great health potions with 4 and 100 great mana potions with 3, 100 ultimate potions of either type with 7 and 100 supreme potions with 10 arena badges. ....
You can also select 100 great spirit potions for 4 and 100 ultimate spirit potions for 8 arena badges. ...
Would you like to exchange for health, mana or spirit potions now?
Take care and come back soon!
pages.title: Lorenzo

pages.name: Deseus
npc_lines: We both know you're here to fight hordes of monsters, so let's get to it. Just tell me if you're ready to fight or if you need me to explain something.
I can give you details about how waves in the monster arena work and explain how to initiate a fight. I can also give you information on prizes and fees.
First thing to know: dying here will not cost you anything, except the fee you need to pay for each match. You will keep all your experience, skills and loot. ...
After a fight has been initiated by giving me the necessary details, a timer will be started. ...
If you can survive all waves of monsters, you may receive a prize and earn a place in the hall of fame. ...
The fight will be cancelled if the predetermined number of players for a fight does not show up in the anteroom. ...
If a wave is in progress but players take too long and cannot finish all monsters within the time limit, the fight will be cancelled as well.
Every premium player can participate in the monster arena. To initiate the first wave, just talk to me and tell me if you want to play. ...
If the arena is not occupied, you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create solo matches.

Surviving a full battle over 10 waves will grant you a reward based on the difficulty level you have selected. Please talk to my assistant right next to the arena entrance for more information on how to claim your reward.
Initiating a fight against monsters in the arena will require an entrance fee of 1000 gold. Please make sure to have enough money on your bank account before setting up a fight.
Keeping the creatures down there in check mainly. And we have quite a lot of attractions to offer here. Don't you worry!
I am Deseus. Just D E S... ah never mind.
Good, let's do battle. Remember that you can cancel a setup any time. Are you ready to assemble your team?
Good fight, good night.
pages.title: Deseus

pages.name: Fadil
npc_lines: Welcome! I suppose you are looking for a trade.
My name is Fadil.
I am a Darashian trader. I specialise in strange and unknown objects out of other dimensions. I know that sounds weird. But believe me, such things do exist!
It is 4:42 am.
I'm interested in objects out of pure plasma or energy. If you really have the like of it ask me for a trade.
Of course, let's have a look.
I don't have any weapons to offer.
I only buy plasmatic and energetic objects. If you have to offer something like this, ask me for a trade.
Goodbye. It would be nice to see you again.
pages.title: Fadil

pages.name: Yana
npc_lines: Trading tokens! First-class equipment available!
Tokens! Looking for gold tokens!
Blessings, Jogador! How may I help you? Do you wish to trade some tokens, or do you need some information?

I'm collecting rare tokens made of metal or gemstones. At the moment, I'm interested in gold tokens. If you should happen to have some with you, I could exchange them for special weapons of different types.
I'm Yana O'Reilly, bespoke smith and a token trader. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Yes, that's my name. My mother chose it, it means prudence or cunningness in some old and almost forgotten Tibian language.
You might find my cousin Cledwyn downstairs on the main floor. We're all interested in rare tokens, always on the move to offer our services in exchange for these treasures. ..
There's a kind of a competition on who's the most successful token hunter. If you should have any gold tokens with you, we could make a deal.
Yes, he's my cousin. He also collects rare tokens, but unlike me he's interested in silver tokens. Call this passion something of a family trait.
Tokens are small objects made of metal or other materials. You can use them to buy superior equipment from token traders like me.
There are several ways to obtain the tokens I'm interested in - killing certain bosses, for example. In exchange for a certain amount of tokens, I can offer you some first-class items.
If you have any gold tokens with you, let's have a look! Maybe I can offer you something in exchange.
Disrupt the Heart of Destruction, fell the World Devourer to prove your worth and you will be granted the power to imbue 'Powerful Strike', 'Powerful Void' and 'Powerful Vampirism'.

Here's the deal, Jogador. For 100 of your gold tokens, I can offer you some special equipment pieces which you can charge with a certain item type. I have the following item types to offer: mayhem, remedy or carving. ...
I may also give you a short description what these labels mean. So, which item type are you most interested in?

A weapon of mayhem increases your chance to hit harder and to enhance the damage you inflict. A weapon of remedy gives you a certain chance to gain a part of a creature's life energy for yourself. ...
And a weapon of carving does the same with a creature's mana.
Farewell, Jogador.
pages.title: Yana

pages.name: Emilio
npc_lines: Drome fighters! You can trade your hard earned drome points here!
Fighters from the old arena still visit me to exchange their hard earned badges! Earned in blood that is... mostly.
Hello, brave fighter! What can I do for you? Do you want information, to trade drome points, talk about the old days or take a look at our famous Phants?
Name's Emilio!
I specialised in trading potions in exchange for arena badges. I always liked that job, watching the fights from time to time, helping younger heroes with their first fights. ...
So I kept it. Actually my whole family earned their living this way, you can still meet my brothers and sisters by visiting the other arenas. ...
Maybe you'll even get to know my whole family someday!
We keep a register of every fighter that comes through. If you want to know your personal drome level, starting level or drome points you came to the right place! ...
If you want to know how all this works I have to ask you to refer to the sign over there. I just don't have the time to answer these questions.
In the old arena, if you finished all 10 waves of an arena battle, you'd obtain a fixed amount of arena badges. ...
The exact amount depended on the selected difficulty level. ...
I can check the total amount and offer you potions in exchange for them. Do you want me to hand out your arena badges now?
As a special service for our most valued customers, we used to hand out a surprise cube. By using it, you'd have a chance of getting nice little goodies.
Well, I guess you'd like to know what I'm still doing here.
Your current drome level is nível.

It's quite easy. I give you arena badges for each arena battle you completed in the past. Surviving 10 waves against monsters in the arena granted you a fixed amount of badges depending on the difficulty level. ...
You can keep the arena badges or exchange them for each kind of health, mana and spirit potions. I'll charge 1 arena badge for the amount of 100 mana or health potions. ...

100 strong potions of either mana or health will be charged with 2, 100 great health potions with 4 and 100 great mana potions with 3, 100 ultimate potions of either type with 7 and 100 supreme potions with 10 arena badges. ....
You can also select 100 great spirit potions for 4 and 100 ultimate spirit potions for 8 arena badges. ...
Would you like to exchange for health, mana or spirit potions now?
There were 5 difficulty levels when fighting against waves of monsters in the old arena. Each difficulty level granted you a certain amount of arena badges. ...
Level 1 granted one badge, level 2 granted two, level 3 granted three, level 4 granted four and level 5 granted seven arena badges.
Take care and come back soon!
pages.title: Emilio

pages.name: Artemyth
npc_lines: We both know you're here to fight hordes of monsters, so let's get to it. Just tell me if you're ready to fight or if you need me to explain something.
I can give you details about how waves in the monster arena work and explain how to initiate a fight. I can also give you information on prizes and fees.
First thing to know: dying here will not cost you anything, except the fee you need to pay for each match. You will keep all your experience, skills and loot. ...
After a fight has been initiated by giving me the necessary details, a timer will be started. ...
If you can survive all waves of monsters, you may receive a prize and earn a place in the hall of fame. ...
The fight will be cancelled if the predetermined number of players for a fight does not show up in the anteroom. ...
If a wave is in progress but players take too long and cannot finish all monsters within the time limit, the fight will be cancelled as well.
Every premium player can participate in the monster arena. To initiate the first wave, just talk to me and tell me if you want to play. ...
If the arena is not occupied, you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create solo matches.

Surviving a full battle over 10 waves will grant you a reward based on the difficulty level you have selected. Please talk to my assistant right next to the arena entrance for more information on how to claim your reward.
Initiating a fight against monsters in the arena will require an entrance fee of 1000 gold. Please make sure to have enough money on your bank account before setting up a fight.
It's not a job to me, it's an art. The arena is about getting into the fray, relentless, without hesitation. It's about blood, sweat and brute force. The art of breaking heads.
Friends call me Arte. So that's how you do NOT address me. I tend to better not get too 'emotionally attached' to combatants... you'll die soon enough anyway.
Good, let's do battle. Remember that you can cancel a setup any time. Are you ready to assemble your team?
Good fight, good night.

pages.name: Agostina
npc_lines: Hello, brave fighter! What can I do for you? Do you want information, to exchange something or to simply talk?
I will hand out arena badges depending on your results in the PvE arena. You can keep them or exchange them for potions - with a chance to win a special surprise cube, just to spice things up a bit.
If you finish all 10 waves of an arena battle, you'll obtain a fixed amount of arena badges. The exact amount depends on the selected difficulty level. ...
I can check the total amount and offer you potions in exchange for them. Do you want me to hand out your arena badges now?
As a special service for our most valued customers, we hand out a surprise cube! By using it, you have a chance of getting nice little goodies.
Well, I guess you'd like to know what I'm doing here.
There are 5 difficulty levels when fighting against waves of monsters in the arena. Each difficulty level grants you a certain amount of arena badges which I will hand out to you. ...
Level 1 grants one badge, level 2 grants two, level 3 grants three, level 4 grants four and level 5 grants five arena badges.

It's quite easy. I give you arena badges for each completed arena battle. Surviving 10 waves against monsters in the arena will grant you a fixed amount of badges depending on the difficulty level. ...
You can keep the arena badges or exchange them for each kind of health, mana and spirit potions. I'll charge 1 arena badge for the amount of 100 mana or health potions. ...

100 strong potions of either mana or health will be charged with 2, 100 great health potions with 4 and 100 great mana potions with 3, 100 ultimate potions of either type with 7 and 100 supreme potions with 10 arena badges. ....
You can also select 100 great spirit potions for 4 and 100 ultimate spirit potions for 8 arena badges. ...
Would you like to exchange for health, mana or spirit potions now?
I specialised in trading potions in exchange for arena badges. Actually my whole family earns their living this way, you can meet my brothers and sisters by visiting the other arenas. ...
Maybe you'll even get to know my whole family someday!
Agostina, you're welcome!
Take care and come back soon!

The fight will be cancelled if the predetermined number of players for a fight does not show up in the anteroom. ...
If a wave is in progress but players take too long and cannot finish all monsters within the time limit, the fight will be cancelled as well.

If the arena is not occupied, you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create solo matches.

Surviving a full battle over 10 waves will grant you a reward based on the difficulty level you have selected. Please talk to my assistant right next to the arena entrance for more information on how to claim your reward.
Initiating a fight against monsters in the arena will require an entrance fee of 1000 gold. Please make sure to have enough money on your bank account before setting up a fight.
From time to time have to keep the creatures down here at bay. Most of the time, however, I see that they are in a good mood - why don't you setup a fight now...!
Name's Hercule. Since you obviously not yet experienced the legend that is me, I guess you're simply new here.
Good, let's do battle. Remember that you can cancel a setup any time. Are you ready to assemble your team?
Good fight, good night.

Van Ore to you. Ach, I don't have time for this, really.
