Yes, and there is much to fear. But you are strong and can control it. Key to victory in these dead plains is to avoid the great plague that has come to this land. ...
The plants, animals, all the things you see and don't see are afflicted. Death spreads its wings and wants to carry all living things away and into his realm. But there is another difficulty. ...

The warmth. T'is missing from this place now. Before you came here, I was the last breathing thing down here. This very spot graced by the last glimpse of our constant, fiery suns. My warmth, t'was the last sign of life. ...
Alas for I am a tree, there is nothing I can do but share my warmth with you. What say you to this most generous offer?
T'was a fair offer, you have made your choice. But I remain hopeful yet. Pray return here shall you ever change your mind.
A great sorrow that befell this land a long time ago. What you see down here is the final stage of this corruption, spreading all over this continent. ...

Its roots are in the core of the land, it thrives and threatens all living things. Ought to be the end of all but something can be done. Elsewhere it can still be fought and contained, alas, t'is not the place nor the time.
pages.title: Crowned Tree

pages.name: Myzzi
npc_lines: I have to find some heroes. Find, find, find!!
Hello adventurer. It is good to see you.
I'm just a mere messenger and I'm here to find brave adventurers that might help my friends in this time of need.
Lady Alivar of the Summer Court and Lord Cadion of the Winter Court are in need of brave adventurers to avert a great threat for the whole world.
I know only little and I forget so much. So many things going around my mind! ...

However, I can grant you access to the Courts of Summer and Winter if you promise to help! There you can meet with Undal or Vanys, the servants of Lord Cadion and Lady Alivar. They will be able to tell you more about the issue.
So, are you willing to help in this time of need?
Oh no, oh no! What a pity! Please reconsider!
You are a true hero! Here, take my enchantment and you will be able to pass the portals. Now hurry, my friends are waiting.
Hello adventurer. I'm so happy that you agreed to help!
Goodbye, Jogador.
pages.title: Myzzi

pages.name: Stricken Soul
npc_lines: This place is... haunted... heed my warning... there are... ghooooooosts here...! Why are you giving me that... look? I am certain, there aaaaaaare ghosts here - I've seen them! Do you believe me?
Yeeeees... you need to help meeeeeee. I want those ghosts gone... this is my home and I need it to teach my students. Will you take care of the... ghosts?
Excellent... I hope they will haaaaaaunt my house no longer. What was your... naaaaaame again, tell me?
Ah yeeeeees, Jogador... I will remember you. Now, lessons are every day in the morning and once a week in the evening... ...
Oh, you're not here for this, are you? So about the ghoooosts, yes. You seeeee, there are 3 secret passages here. ...
Thiiiiis is no ordinary house... it is a nexus, a gateway to a once hidden cathedral. Sheltering a small and peaceful society of scholars and monks. Secluded from every distraction. ...
I was one of them and ordered to hold contact to the outside woooorld. But then, something... happened. ...
Outsiders managed to sneak in, infiltrate and influence the society... for the worse. Who knows for what ends. They chaaaaanged... ...
Shortly after, contact was lost... the nexus broken and sealed, ghosts appeared... eeeeeeeverywhere. ...
Find the three passages... one is right here in the cellars, one in the jungles of Tiquanda and one in the deserts of Darama. ...
Restore their connection and open this nexus to access the buried cathedral and find the cause to this... eliminate all remainders there if you must, Jogador.
I am... I was... I... it was such a looooong time ago.
I... was... not a servant. Not a lord nor a knight. I was a... traveller. Yeeeees. A scholar! I hoarded knowledge... some I would advise or teach. But of thoooooose I have no memory.
Yes, I am... a scholar! I teach... my knowledge... I can take you in as another student... just need to remember... your naaaaaame...
Faaaaare thee well.
pages.title: Stricken Soul

pages.name: Hireling (Cooking)
npc_lines: It is good to see you. I'm always at your service.
Hmm, yes! A variety of fine food awaits! However, a small expense of 15000 gold is expected to make these delicious masterpieces happen. ...
For 90000 gold I will also serve you a specific dish. Just tell me what it shall be: a specific meal or a little surprise.
Alright, let me astonish you. Shall I?
Aaah, the northern cuisine! A catch of fresh salmon right from the coast of Svargrond is the base of this extraordinary fish dish.
It is good to see you. I'm always at your service.
Hmm, yes! A variety of fine food awaits! However, a small expense of 15000 gold is expected to make these delicious masterpieces happen. ...
For 90000 gold I will also serve you a specific dish. Just tell me what it shall be: a specific meal or a little surprise.

Very well. You may choose one of the following: chilli con carniphila, svargrond salmon filet, carrion casserole, consecrated beef, roasted wyvern wings, carrot pie, tropical marinated tiger or a delicatessen salad.
A tasty chunk of juicy beef with an aromatic sauce and parsley potatoes, mmh!
pages.title: Hireling (Cooking)

pages.name: Absaan
npc_lines: Welcome to the Jolly Nightmare, stranger. Just name your poison.
Just a figure of speech. Though we also serve actual poison in this tavern. Some people have odd tastes and I don’t question that.
It has been a family business since more generations than I could count. In the old days it was merely a hole where my ancestors hid, when the court guys came for a visit to bash their own heads. …

But soon enough people learned, the courtiers saw it beneath them to become a threat and their fights became a spectacle to watch. One of my ancestors saw a chance to earn some coin and opened a business. …

The fights became a spectacle because of him. His daughter, who took over at some point, even secured some agreements with the courts and made several subtle suggestions that were adopted into the battles. …
More and more it became quite a spectacle in certain circles and the business flourished. People from all over the world come here to watch the fights or even participate.
Like many of my ancestors I dream to use our earnings to restore some of the goblin empire of old.
Ah, those courts are all the same to me. Snobbish and so full of themselves. …
But you can get along with them, as long as you know how to handle them and I’m dealing with worse people in this tavern day to day. Not looking at you here, of course.
As you will know, most goblins are not born with many gifts of the mind, so to say. They needed an upper class for a firm guidance, else they’d only manage to get themselves killed.
Of course you can’t entrust meaningful tasks to some goblin who is thick as a brick. They can only do the most simple tasks whereas the smarter ones have to oversee them. …
So it’s only to their best that there is a class who is overseeing and guiding them.
They might not be strong or skilled but there are lots of them. If you just send enough of them to do a job they will eventually get it done. …
Casualties are just a normal thing. The lower classes breed like mad anyway. …
This is why only they recovered from the onslaught of the other races whereas the upper class was nearly extinguished.
I have little use of gods. I think it’s wise not to drawn their attention upon me. So I can have a life of my own and do as I like.
In the past the court guys just cut down each other wherever they met. Then their leaders decided that they did not like to loose their hotheads without their consent, …
so they agreed upon some rules such as formal challenges and a dedicated spot to fight at. With some order established the caverns here were made a bit more cozy and my ancestors opened business. …
Later on some beasts were introduced, that the champions of the houses could fight, and even later foreign gladiators were allowed. …
The catching of beasts and hiring of gladiators was done with the money of my family so they had a slight say in the way the fights were set up. …
To increase the frequency of the fights we finally convinced them to allow strangers to become champions of their houses. Since then the business is prospering like never before.
I consider myself a bit more sophisticated than your average standard goblin. …
My family belongs to a long line of goblin nobility, from the days before our culture was destroyed by other races.
Well, bye then.
pages.title: Absaan

pages.name: Jack Springer
npc_lines: Welcome, Jogador! There is much we have to discuss.
I have a mission of great urgency, that will need all of your skills.
I need your help in a matter of utmost urgency.
The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to start best, just to describe it to you.
You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single source.
Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent events.
Well, in Rathleton there was an individual at work, looking for some ancient artefact of power. ...
To cover its escape the creature left another creature, known as the ravager to cover his tracks. But there is more.
Only recently someone was trying to manipulate the elven dream courts into releasing a monstrosity of nightmares, probably planning to control or recruit this creature. ...
But those incidents were just some of many.
The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the iceberg.
There is a scheming going on behind the scenes. Powerful good people were corrupted. Evil-doers got backup and resources from a hidden ally. ...
Powerful malignant creatures, gathering their kind under their banner and so much more. These things are not happening by chance. There is a pattern, a guiding hand.
This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even predates the rise of humanity.
Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the language it originates from is long dead.
It has a rather complex meaning and as far as we can tell it translates to 'army of those who are many, dedicated to the ultimate time of mayhem and despair'. ...
Other, more handy names are army of the last battlefield, army of the last days, legion of mayhem, dread legion or simply the legion.
We know little for sure. You can look into our books to see some of our sources. But most are vague and some even contradictory. ...
To summarise what we know, let me tell you this: The Shiron'Fal is an extremely old organisation. It seeks to accumulate power for some unknown but certainly sinister goal.

For this purpose, the members gather knowledge, artefacts and powerful individuals. The members are formidable at certain fields of expertise. They are cunning and powerful and act with no regard for others, with no remorse or mercy. ...
As they are doing this since ages, they must have acquired tremendous powers and knowledge. Their members often operate alone but are usually well funded with the necessary resources. ...
Whatever their endgame might be, each of their operations pose a grave danger to the whole world and have to be stopped.
Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some clashes.
In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to hurry.
Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent problem.
The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known knights.
The knights they aim at were tainted in life by their actions or happenstance. ...
This leaves their bodies vulnerable to their special breed of necromancy that would raise them as powerful lich-knights.
These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger scheme that we cannot make out yet.
We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent threats are at hand.
Death cultists of the Shiron'Fal are trying to locate the bodies of fallen knights and raise them in blasphemous rituals.
The churches of the gods worked hand in hand to supply us with the means to purge the graves of those knights.
Reaching the graves will not be without danger and if you encounter the death cultists you will have to fight them. Even worse, they might have even succeeded in some cases. ...
As a newly risen lich-knight is not able to leave the site of its resurrection for some time, you might have to fight some of them. ...
Let us pray that you never come too late or else some of the fiends might be able to leave their crypts.
While you travel and fight the threat where it arises, we will put all our resources into researching the ultimate plans of the legion. Perhaps I can tell you more when you report back. ...
Don't forget that you'll need very potent holy water for your task. If you need some, just ask me for a trade.
pages.title: Jack Springer

pages.name: Kallimae
npc_lines: Suon's and Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!
My name is Kallimae.
I'm the vicarious leader of the Midnight Flame.
Our actual leader is the lamassu Arishum but he lives very secluded. I see him on a regular basis and apply myself to the everyday affairs of our circle.

He is an old and venerable lamassu and also the founder of our order, the Midnight Flame. He lost his sight a long time ago when he was defending the ruins of Nuur against invading Fafnar cultists. ...
As a sign of gratitude and redemption the goddess Bastesh granted him the power of clairvoyance. Since then his eyes might be clouded but he sees far more than anyone can imagine.
We are a small circle of chosen knights and seers led by the lamassu Arishum. To honour the blinded lamassu, all our members tie gauze scarfs around their eyes. ...
All of our seers have second sight and are able to foresee certain future events or hidden secrets. Our circle is seven hundred years old but we don't have as many members as the Sapphire Blade. ...

This is because our purview is very special and our responsibilities are not to everybody's taste. Not all people appreciate knowledge about the future or strange dreams full of sometimes disturbing images.

Over a thousand years ago, Kilmaresh formed a contiguous land mass with Krailos and Oramond. It was inhabited by our ancestors who had established a thriving empire but it was cut off from the rest of the landmass by Suon's Wrath.
Over a thousand years ago, Krailos and Kilmaresh were a contiguous land mass, inhabited by our ancestors who had established a thriving empire. ...
Due to Suon's Wrath, the eastern peninsula was separated from the continent and is now cut off from the rest of the landmass by a strait. ...
Today, Krailos is mainly populated by the ogres. They were slaves in the old empire but freed by the Anuma right after the downfall.
Nuur was once the capital of the old empire, when Krailos and Kilmaresh were still a contiguous land mass. It was completely destroyed by Suon's Wrath and now Issavi is the new capital.
Oramond is the southern region of the continent that Kilmaresh once was part of, too. The peninsula is rugged and offers only little inhabitable space and natural resources. ...
Only through exploitation of the small and unassuming glooth-worms, the inhabitants managed to survive and even built a prospering civilization on their own.
The Fafnar cultists live and act in secret but they try to exert their influence wherever possible. This can happen by violence or by intrigue. ...

Sometimes they raid the city and surrounding villages, sometimes they try to influence powerful people here in Issavi. The cult consists of two major groups: the Burning Gladiators and the Priestesses of the Wild Sun.
The Burning Gladiators are fierce warriors who seek to enforce Fafnar's will with a vengeance. If necessary they also protect the Priestesses of the Wild Sun on their rather subtle missions.
Those priestesses serve Fafnar with great devotion. Other than the Burning Gladiators they seek to restore Fafnar's worship by intrigues and scheming rather than brute force.

Fafnar the Smiter! Beware of her and her followers! Fafnar is the wild and relentless daughter of Fardos and also called the Scorching Sun. Unlike her brother Suon, she observes creation with hate and jealousy. ...
Her worship is forbidden in Kilmaresh since the downfall of the old empire and with good reason. Her followers once caused a religious civil war that led to the old empire's destruction. ...
But the cult of Fafnar secretly survived and the cultists still plague the new empire. They cause plenty of trouble here in Issavi and in all of Kilmaresh.

Suon the King! He is a kind and benevolent god, a son of Fardos and we also call him the Life-Bringing Sun. Unlike his sister Fafnar he observes creation with love and blesses us with warmth and growth. ...
The worship of Suon and Bastesh grants Kilmaresh stability and growth - and this is exactly what the empire needs to prosper and flourish.
She Who Knows is a calm and mystical goddess, the patron of the oceans and sea creatures. She's the daughter of Uman and Sula and also called The Mistress of the Sea or The Keeper of Wisdom. ...

She was once attacked by the wild Fafnar, out of jealousy and pride. After the religious war between the worshippers of Suon and Fafnar, we adopted the world view that Suon's true sister wasn't Fafnar but Bastesh. ...
So we started worshiping her instead of the Wild Sun. Thus, Bastesh has a firm place in Kilmaresh's religious life since more than thousand years.
Fardos is considered the creator, often called the Great Observer. We believe that it was his doing that we possess divine souls.

She's a medusa and she's running the Seaside Theatre. If you wonder why a medusa is welcome in Issavi: This city has the philosophy, 'An Open Gate for Those of Peace'. This is why Alyxo and some others may live here. ...
Everyone is welcome as long as one respects Kilmaresh's laws.
I guess he's a sibang who lives here in Issavi.
This young woman once sought to join the Midnight Flame. Unfortunately she didn't have the gift of seeing, so we could not accept her.
She is now able to perform her ritual. I'm very grateful that you agreed to help her!
He's the leader of the Sapphire Blade. A kind and noble man but he is also a brave warrior and will not hesitate to defend Issavi if need be.
They are a group of elite warriors. All of them carry blades made of a blue metal called tagralt. They are often in conflict with Fafnar cultists and the remaining ogres on Kilmaresh. ...
Most of them are fighters but you may find some sorcerers among them as well. They are held in remarkably high esteem by the Anuma.

In the steppes of Kilmaresh, there are many rock formations, interveined with blue ore. This ore can be magically crafted into a rare and precious metal. Sapphire Blade members use this metal for their swords.
After the downfall of the old empire and Suon's Wrath, the Anuma took control of the new empire. Since then, the position of emperor or empress is always taken by a sphinx, lamassu or gryphon. ...
Only the wild manticores are excluded from this rank. These days we have a sphinx empress who is ruling Kilmaresh wisely and benevolently. I'm sure she has a name but none of us knows it. ...
To us, she is just 'the Empress' and this is all we have to know.

The Anuma are magical beings that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh. It is told that they were once created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. There are several kinds of Anuma: Sphinxes, lamassu, gryphons and manticores. ...
There might be even more but if so, those Anuma are living so seclusive that mortals barely ever encounter them.
Sphinxes have a leonine body, big feathered wings and human heads with their faces being a mix of humanoid and feline. They are highly intelligent and allegedly immortal. ...
Many sphinxes are benevolent, but some are rather merciless and dangerous. Make sure to treat them with all due respect at any time.

Lamassu have the body of a bull, feathered wings and a human head. They are willing to assist mortal creatures in combat if they are convinced that those under their protection are worthy and pure of heart. ...

They are benevolent towards humans - unless you disturb the peace of holy sites or graveyards. In this case they can be very unforgiving. The founder and leader of my order, the Midnight Flame, is the venerable lamassu Arishum.

Gryphons have the body, tail and back legs of a lion but the forelegs, head and wings of an eagle or hawk. It is said that out of all Anuma, the sun god Suon loved the gryphons most whereas his wild sister Fafnar favoured the manticores. ...

Gryphons live very reclusive and love the high mountain peaks of Kilmaresh. In very rare cases, a gryphon will forge a bond with a human it regards worthy. If this happens, the gryphon will agree to carry the mortal on its back.
Manticores have the body of a lion with a human face, leathery wings and a huge scorpion tail. They are lethal predators which have a preference for human flesh. ...
Other than most Anuma, manticores are ferocious and savage. Your best bet would be to steer clear of them.
Suon's and Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!

She is a member of my circle, the Midnight Flame. She is actually blind whereas the other members just pretend to be sightless. Most often you can find her in the small park south of the market place. ...
Unfortunately she is experiencing some difficulties at the moment.

Every member of the Midnight Flame has to perform a ritual once a year. The nature of this ritual as well as its purpose and needed ingredients - we call them paraphernalia - vary from member to member. ...
Bastesh be praised. The four members I'm talking about are Yonan, Tefrit, Narsai and Shimun. Please seek them out and ask them what paraphernalia they still need.
Could you already help Yonan, Tefrit, Shimun and Narsai?

He is a member of my circle, the Midnight Flame. Most often you will find him at the market place where he is trading with gems and jewellery. Unfortunately he is experiencing some difficulties at the moment.
She is a member of my circle, the Midnight Flame. You can find her in the mountains where she lives very much out of the world. Unfortunately she is experiencing some difficulties at the moment.

She is a member of my circle, the Midnight Flame. She is actually blind whereas the other members just pretend to be sightless. Most often you can find her in the small park south of the market place. ...
Unfortunately she is experiencing some difficulties at the moment.

He is a member of my circle, the Midnight Flame. You can find him in his hut in the delta region where he earns his living as a fisherman. Unfortunately he is experiencing some difficulties at the moment.
May Suon bless your path with his light and Bastesh your dreams with her wisdom.
pages.title: Kallimae

pages.name: Narsai
npc_lines: Issavi is this beautiful city here. It is rich and prosperous and many Kilmareshian sages hail from here. It's a good place for traders and merchants but also for scholars and scientists.
This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.
It is now separated from Kilmaresh by a strait. But once it was a part of the old empire - before Suon's Wrath, that is.
Oramond lies south of Krailos and is very different from Kilmaresh. Many minotaurs are living there as well as humans.
He is the Sun God. We also call him the Benevolent Sun or simply the King.

The sun god Suon has once smitten this continent because of the blasphemy of Fafnar's worshippers. This happened more than a thousand years ago. Since that time, Kilmaresh is separated from the rest of the continent.
I really don't think I should talk about the Feared One.
We are a small circle of chosen knights and oracles, led by the lamassu Arishum and by his locum tenens Kallimae. To honour the blinded lamassu, all of us tie gauze scarfs around our eyes. ...
All of our seers have second sight and are able to foresee certain future events or hidden secrets.

He is an old and venerable lamassu and also the founder of our order, the Midnight Flame. He lost his sight a long time ago when he was defending the ruins of Nuur against invading Fafnar cultists. ...
As a sign of gratitude and redemption the goddess Bastesh granted him the power of clairvoyance. Since then, his eyes might be clouded, but he sees far more than anyone can imagine. ...
He lives very secluded and only our leader Kallimae sees him on a regular basis.
Nuur was once the capital of the old empire, when Krailos and Kilmaresh were still a contiguous land mass. It was completely destroyed by Suon's Wrath and now Issavi is the new capital.

She is the leader of my order, the Midnight Flame. Well, actually our leader is the venerable lamassu Arishum but he rarely makes an appearance. Kallimae is in charge in his absence - which is most times.

Lamassu are benevolent towards humans - unless you disturb the peace of holy sites or graveyards. In this case they can be very unforgiving. The founder and leader of my order, the Midnight Flame, is the venerable lamassu Arishum.
Sphinxes are generally benevolent towards humans but they are also enigmatic and aloof. Make sure to treat them with all due respect at any time.

She is the Goddess of the Sea. We also call her the Keeper of Wisdom or She Who Knows. She is the patroness of our order because she blessed our founder, the lamassu Arishum with great visionary power.
pages.title: Narsai

pages.name: Guard Inurta
npc_lines: I am a member of the Sapphire Blade and thus a protector of the people of Kilmaresh.
We are a group of elite warriors. All of us carry blades made of a blue metal called tagralt. It is our holy duty to protect the city Issavi and all of Kilmaresh.

In the steppes of Kilmaresh, there are many rock formations, interveined with blue ore. This ore can be magically crafted into a rare and precious metal. The members of my order, the Sapphire Blade, use this metal for their swords.
This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.

Issavi is the capital of Kilmaresh, also called the Golden City. This city has a motto: An open gate for those of peace. This means, anyone is welcome here as long as they respect our laws, be it humans, elves, minotaurs or even a medusa.

Sheep are very important for the Kilmareshian people as they provide meat, milk and wool. It is forbidden to kill a sheep and the penalty for doing so is a considerable fine. The same applies to hunting dogs and hunting birds.
The Fafnar cultists live and act in secret but they try to exert their influence wherever possible. This can happen by violence or by intrigue. ...

Sometimes they raid the city and surrounding villages, sometimes they try to influence powerful people here in Issavi. The cult consists of two major groups: the Burning Gladiators and the Priestesses of the Wild Sun.
The Burning Gladiators are fierce warriors who seek to enforce Fafnar's will with a vengeance. If necessary they also protect the Priestesses of the Wild Sun on their rather subtle missions.
Those priestesses serve Fafnar with great devotion. Other than the Burning Gladiators they seek to restore Fafnar's worship by intrigues and scheming rather than brute force.
I really don't think I should talk about the Feared One.
He is the Sun God, we also call him the Benevolent Sun.
pages.title: Guard Inurta

pages.name: Ambassador Of Rathleton
npc_lines: There have been some unfortunate embroilments concerning my predecessor. Therefore, he was ordered back to Rathleton to answer for his misdeeds. ...

I was given the traditional vestments of an Ambassador and am now the new envoy of Oramond. My duties in Issavi include cultivating the diplomatic relations between Kilmaresh and Oramond as well as overseeing the trade between our two nations.
My name is not of importance, more so my title: Ambassador of Rathleton.
The glorious town of Rathleton is the centre of human society on Oramond. Our culture and technology has evolved separately from other realms and produced something very remarkable: glooth.
Oramond is the place where I come from - the southern region of the continent that Kilmaresh once was part of, too. ...
Only through exploitation of the small and unassuming glooth-worms, my ancestors managed to survive and even built a prospering civilization on their own.

Over a thousand years ago, Kilmaresh formed a contiguous land mass with Krailos and Oramond. It was inhabited by a human civilization that had established a thriving empire but was cut off from the rest of the landmass by Suon's Wrath. ...
In Kilmaresh, you will find mainly dry steppe regions. At the centre lies a large mountain range and you will always discover small oases and tombs scattered over the steppe. ...

A broad river, the Nykri, rises in the central mountains and forms a fork halfway to the sea. Here lies the big city Issavi, the heart of Kilmaresh. The original capital Nuur was destroyed by Suon's Wrath over a thousand years ago.
Issavi is the capital of Kilmaresh. Here, you will find magnificent temples, palaces and government buildings, five to six stories high and built up in stages.
As I learned here, Krailos and Kilmaresh were once a contiguous land mass, inhabited by a human civilization that had established a thriving empire. ...

Due to Suon's Wrath, the eastern peninsula was separated from the continent and is now cut off from the rest of the landmass by a strait. The people of Kilmaresh think this was the doing of the sun god. ...
Personally, I assume that it rather was a major natural disaster. Today, Krailos is mainly populated by ogres, a simple, warlike people, more interested in a fight and good food than in politics.

The miraculous glooth, won from unassuming, tiny glooth-worms, is the source of Rathleton's wealth and progress. Almost all of the city's amazing discoveries and inventions are based on this curious substance.
Suon is a god, one of the two suns of our world. The people of Kilmaresh also call him the Life-Bringing Sun or The King. Personally, I don't care which sun is the right one. ...
But I see that the worship of Suon and Bastesh grants Kilmaresh stability and growth right now.

Fafnar is a goddess, one of the two suns of our world. The people of Kilmaresh also call her the Scorching Sun or the Smiter. It should be mentioned that the worhip of Fafnar is forbidden in Kilmaresh since the downfall of the old empire. ...
I don't care which sun is the right one. But I know that the cult of Fafnar causes plenty of trouble here in Issavi and in all of Kilmaresh.
Bastesh is a goddess, the patron of the oceans and sea creatures. The people of Kilmaresh also call her The Mistress of the Sea or The Keeper of Wisdom. ...
After the cataclysm known as Suon's Wrath, the people of Kilmaresh adopted the world view that Suon's true sister wasn't Fafnar but Bastesh. So they started worshipping her instead of the Wild Sun.
pages.title: Ambassador Of Rathleton

pages.name: Iptar-Sin
npc_lines: Welcome to the Temple of Eternal Light! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
My name is Iptar-Sin.
I'm the high priest of Suon and in charge of this temple, together with Ninev, the high priestess of Bastesh.
You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the pilgrimage of ashes or get the protection of the twist of fate here.

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five blessings you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least forty percent of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The twist of fate will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of x gold, child?

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the spiritual shielding, the spark of the phoenix, the embrace of Tibia, the fire of the suns and the wisdom of solitude. Additionally, you can receive the twist of fate here. ...
There are also two enhanced blessings for further reduction of experience loss.
Issavi is this beautiful city here. It is rich and prosperous and many Kilmareshian sages hail from here. It's a good place for traders and merchants but also for scholars and scientists.
This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.
Once it was a part of the old empire. But now it is separated from Kilmaresh by a strait. All of this happened because of Suon's Wrath.
Oramond lies south of Krailos and is very different from Kilmaresh. Many minotaurs are living there as well as humans.
It's a big city in Oramond. They have an Ambassador here in Issavi.

Fafnar the Smiter! Beware of her and her followers! Fafnar is the wild and relentless daughter of Fardos and also called the Scorching Sun. Unlike her brother Suon, she observes creation with hate and jealousy. ...
Her worship is forbidden in Kilmaresh since the downfall of the old empire and with good reason. Her followers once caused a religious civil war that led to the old empire's destruction. ...
But the cult of Fafnar secretly survived and the cultists still plague the new empire. They cause plenty of trouble here in Issavi and in all of Kilmaresh.
Fardos is considered the creator, often called the Great Observer. We believe that it was his doing that we possess divine souls.
She Who Knows is the patron of the oceans and sea creatures. She's a calm and mystical goddess, the daughter of Uman and Sula. She is also called The Mistress of the Sea or The Keeper of Wisdom. ...
If you want to learn more about Suon you should talk to Ninev, her high priestess.

Suon the King! He is a kind and benevolent god, a son of Fardos and we also call him the Life-Bringing Sun. Unlike his sister Fafnar he observes creation with love and blesses us with warmth and growth. ...
The worship of Suon and Bastesh grants Kilmaresh stability and growth - and this is exactly what the empire needs to prosper and flourish.

The sun god Suon has once smitten this continent because of the blasphemy of Fafnar's worshippers. This happened more than thousand years ago. Since that time, Kilmaresh is separated from the rest of the continent.
The Fafnar cultists live and act in secret but they try to exert their influence wherever possible. This can happen by violence or by intrigue. ...
Sometimes they raid the city and surrounding villages, sometimes they try to influence powerful people here in Issavi.
She is the current leader of the Midnight Flame.
This group is a small circle of chosen knights and oracles, led by the lamassu Arishum.
She's an actually blind member of the Midnight Flame. There's something going on between her and Alyxo.
The Ambassador of Rathleton is an envoy of Oramond. He has a residence in the eastern part of the city.
She's running the Seaside Theatre. You should go and see one of the performances. Don't be put off by the fact that she's a medusa.
I have no idea who you are talking about.
She is the high priest of Bastesh in Issavi. We are in charge of this temple together to symbolize the duality of Sun and Sea.
She's running Issavi's tavern. I encourage you to go for a meal there. Ramina serves delicious menus.
He's the leader of the Sapphire Blade.
They are a group of elite warriors who all carry blades made of tagralt. They defend Issavi against all threats.
It is a blue metal, only to be found here in Kilmaresh.
These days we have a sphinx empress who is ruling Kilmaresh wisely and benevolently.

The Anuma are magical beings that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh. It is told that they were once created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. There are several kinds of Anuma: Sphinxes, lamassu, gryphons and manticores.
Sphinxes are generally benevolent towards humans but they are also enigmatic and aloof. Make sure to treat them with all due respect at any time.
Lamassu are benevolent towards humans - unless you disturb the peace of holy sites or graveyards. In this case they can be very unforgiving.
They don't act hostile towards humans but they are proud and withdrawn creatures. Make sure not to disturb their mountain territories.
Manticores are much less kind than sphinxes or lamassu. Your best bet would be to steer clear of them.
May Suon's light guide you into the right way!
pages.title: Iptar-Sin

pages.name: Ninos
npc_lines: I work in this post office.
Issavi is this beautiful city here. It is rich and prosperous, a good place for traders and merchants.
Once it was a part of the old empire. But now it is separated from Kilmaresh by a strait. Because of Suon's Wrath, you know.
Oramond lies south of Krailos. I heard, it's very different from Kilmaresh, but also dangerous. Many minotaurs live there.
This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.
This city is located on another continent. But if you want to send a letter or parcel, that's no problem. We have shipping traffic to many places in Tibia.
He is the Sun God, we also call him the Benevolent Sun.

The sun god Suon has once smitten this continent because of the blasphemy of Fafnar's worshippers. This happened more than thousand years ago. Since that time, Kilmaresh is separated from the rest of the continent.
I really don't think I should talk about the Feared One.
pages.title: Ninos

pages.name: Saideh
npc_lines: Welcome stranger!
In principle I have to guide people through this grave complex. But as I told you this is not possible right now. Therefore I'm jobless.
These creatures have explored this holy place for themselves. Only the bravest of the brave might be able to overcome this threat. ...

There is just one possibility to change this situation for all of us who want to worship our beloved hero: The remains must be reburied into a safe place, accessible for everyone and protected from the ogres.
His name is Dayyan the Brave. He was also called the Scorpion.
He was the bravest of the brave. Our hero!

I would like you to face the ogres and reach the grave of our beloved hero. To open it is a bit tricky. The handle in the front of the sarcophagus is just for distraction and could wound somebody who touches it. ...
The only way to open the grave is to put your left hand on the top and the right hand on the right edge at the same time. Speaking out loudly 'open scorpio ' will open it.
Dayyan was our beloved emperor many years ago. He was kindhearted to his folk and sturdy towards all threats from outside, especially the dreaded ogres.
pages.title: Saideh

pages.name: Ramina
npc_lines: I'm running this tavern.
Issavi is this beautiful city here. It is rich and prosperous and many Kilmareshian sages hail from here. It's a good place for traders and merchants but also for scholars and scientists.
It is now separated from Kilmaresh by a strait. But once it was a part of the old empire - before Suon's Wrath, that is.
Oramond lies south of Krailos and is very different from Kilmaresh. Many minotaurs are living there as well as humans.
This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.
I'm sorry but I have never heard of this place.
He is the Sun God. We also call him the Benevolent Sun or simply the King.

The sun god Suon has once smitten this continent because of the blasphemy of Fafnar's worshippers. This happened more than thousand years ago. Since that time, Kilmaresh is separated from the rest of the continent.
I really don't think I should talk about the Feared One.
pages.title: Ramina

pages.name: Xaver
npc_lines: Very well! So, do you want me to personalise a red, green or blue gingerbread heart or buy a fresh one?.
You can buy a red, green or blue gingerbread heart, it's 500 festive points each!
There you go, enjoy!
Very well! So, do you want me to personalise a red, green or blue gingerbread heart or buy a fresh one?
Excellent. I can personalise it with your own name or the name of one of your friends! Just say the keyword and a player name. What should I write? ...
'For my love, Jogador, Jogador survived the Orcsoberfest!', 'My friend Jogador went to the Orcsoberfest and this is all I got!' ...
‘Happy Birthday Jogador or 'Greetings from Orcsoberfest, Jogador
Alright, there you go!
pages.title: Xaver

pages.name: Domizian
npc_lines: Greetings, traveller!
I am Domizian.
You might deem me a sage and a scholar.
He is the governor of Edron and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood. I made his acquaintance some years ago, when he was visiting Darashia.
In case you talk about the werehyaena alpha leader: Her name is Rhargu. She lives deep down in the werehyaena lairs together with her pack.
She's a werehyaena. The leader of the pack that causes so much trouble around Darashia.
Of course, let me see what you have.

So, Daniel Steelsoul sent you? He is a most respectable man and I'm honoured to know him. It is of advantage that you have already dealt with the were-sickness so you won't hurl yourself into this adventure unprepared. ...

Listen, the curse has indeed spread to the Darama Desert - but not recently. It exists here since a long time but only few know about it. Here, it's not werewolves or werebears. The danger that plagues this region are the werehyaenas. ...
Until now they were savage and smelly beasts who hunted down a travelling merchant now and then. But mostly they stayed in their subterranean lairs and lived off carrion. ...

But a few weeks ago something changed. Suddenly they had shamans, something I never saw before. Those shamans are using bone talismans and paint their fur with runes. Runes I saw just once before ... on an artefact from Drefia. ...

I'm afraid the werehyaenas have a kind of pact with the undead of Drefia but I don't have proof. Please go to their lairs and investigate. You will find the entrance north of the town, at a large standing stone. ...
Be careful down there, though! Werehyaenas might not be the only danger you will have to face. I heard strange stories about blood pools, a talking skull and even liches.
So, the werehyaenas are indeed working together with Drefia's undead. That's very dangerous, to say the least. Please, if you can, find a way to stop this.
I guess you need something holy or at least blessed to destroy this evil site. The werelions know a ritual that allows you to bless fire in general. It should work with this torch, too. ...
But you can do that only at a special altar in our sanctum. Go to the Lion's Rock in the north-west of Darashia. Descend to the area where the most noble lions are guarding a secret entrance. ...

There is a door, you can only open if you know the right phrase. It is: 'The sun guides our hearts. The moon guards our dreams'. Down there you will find a room with a mosaic, showing a sun and a moon. ...
There is an altar where you can bless the torch. You have to find a lion mane flower and chop the petals up small. Then sprinkle the chopped petals into the flame while standing at the altar. ...
Thus, the fire will be blessed and should be able to burn down the evil bone shrine.

You destroyed the pact between the werehyaenas and the undead! You did Darashia a great favour, that's for sure. But there are still so many of them, they could be a real threat to the caravans that try to reach the city. ...
Please, kill three hundred of those ferocious werehyaenas and their shamans.
Yes, there are less of them now! What a relief for Darashia. Well, I guess, now I can trust you enough to tell you a little secret about myself. I'm actually a werelion. Don't be scared, though. ...

There's something special to the werelions: We can control the curse and don't attack people like mindless beasts. This is the reason why I can live here in the city and talk to you in such a civilized way. ...

Well, the werehyaenas were a danger to Darashia but they also caused a very personal problem for me. Look, I assumed that they are up to something and that this something could be the undead in Drefia. ...

I warned our king, Heliodor, about it but he didn't believe me. I insisted and got short-tempered - which is never a good idea in the presence of your king. He exiled me as punishment for my impudence. ...

This is the reason why I live here in Darashia. This city has its conveniences but I would like to return to my pride. Please find Heliodor and tell him about the werehyaenas' pact with the undead. ...

Take this ring, it will allow you to enter the lower part of the sanctum. Wear it while you touch one of the lion columns in the centre of the sanctum's upper floor. Then you will reach the lower part.

The werelions are special among the therianthropes. We are not weak-willed victims of the curse. We control it. That means we can change form at will and are not feral beasts as soon as the full moon rises.
Therianthropy is the ability of human beings to metamorphose into other animals. The most well known form of therianthropy is found in stories concerning werewolves. ...
But there are many others, too, like bears, hyaenas or lions.
You found Heliodor and told him about the werehyaenas? He will consider to pardon me? I don't know how I could thank you! Take this as a small compensation for your efforts!
My king will consider to pardon me! Thank you again!
Farewell.
pages.title: Domizian

pages.name: A Skull
npc_lines: *A horned skull rests on a stone pile here. Underneath the jaw bone, there are faint grinding marks on the rock, as if the skull was moved frequently.*
Greetings, traveller!
I forgot my own name a long time ago.
I consider myself a storyteller. So, if you are interested in a little story ... I also know a thing or two about the cards.
I thought so! Well, listen: The confused maiden shall defeat the forsaken wizard when the days grow long in the age of fate.
I thought so! Well, listen: The cold-hearted viper will not roam with the honest lion at the coming of death.
I know about eleven cards. ...
The Foremother, the Artist, the Gambler, the Fountain, the Ship of Emeralds, the Princess, the Heroic Monk, the Prophet, the Orphan, the Forgotten Minstrel and the Queen of Machines.
This card depicts an old woman with a scar on her face and a basket of fruit on a hill. It is associated with protection, compassion and a journey. Inverted, it represents deception and loss.
This card depicts a middle-aged woman with brushes and an owl while the sun sets. It is associated with creativity and prosperity. Inverted, it represents a breakdown or a devastating announcement.
This card depicts a middle-aged man with golden hair and an oak tree inside a walled city. It is associated with renewal and transformation. Inverted, it represents treason and death.
This card depicts an old man, sitting at a fountain. It is associated with reunion, truth and joy. Inverted, it represents tyranny and violence.
This card depicts a ship with a cargo of emeralds. It is associated with wealth and joy. Inverted, it represents financial difficulty and miscommunication.
This card depicts a young woman with copper-colored eyes, wearing a crown. It is associated with romance, opportunity and generosity. Inverted, it represents illusion and death.
This card depicts a young boy and a spider. It is associated with a heroic deed, nobility and strength. Inverted, it represents disappointment and exile.
This card depicts an old woman and a gryphon. It is associated with wisdom and prophecy. Inverted, it represents disease and a reversal of fortune.
This card depicts a small girl involved in a parting of ways. It is associated with forgiveness and kindness. Inverted, it represents surrender and disagreement.
This card depicts a tall young man with hazel eyes, holding a lute and a hawk. It is associated with willpower and royalty. Inverted, it represents grief and anger.
This card depicts a young woman and a golem near a fortress. It is associated with science, secrets and research. Inverted, it represents ignorance and fear.
The undead of Drefia are working together with the werehyaenas. I overheard a secret conversation between the werehyaena leader and a lich right here!
A fierce and cunning hyaena named Rhargu. She lives in her own cave down here.
Farewell.
pages.title: A Skull

pages.name: Rhargu
npc_lines: Grr. Intruder!
I'm Rhargu.
I'm the leader of this werehyaena pack.
Sounds like a stupid lion name.
Go away or we'll eat you!
None of your business, the undead! On the other hand .. they haven't done so much for us. Gave us some talismans for our shamans. But no food! I asked for it. They never brought it. ...

If you bring me the food I wish for, I could end this. Or tell you how to end it. But you have to bring me a boar haunch, those are so tasty! And a hard-boiled hydra egg. Always wanted to try one. ...
Also, take this cask and fill it with salted cave rats. My favourite snack! At last, bring me five lion manes. Want to decorate my cave with them, grhrr.
My best guess? Hunt down a boar.
Find a hydra, find its egg.
Catch some cave rats and salt them. It's really that simple. Use a net or something, I don't care.
Kill some lions and cut it off, huh.
Do you have my food?
Give me! And take this. A special torch, made of sandalwood. Burn down the bone shrine at the dragon skeleton with this torch. That will destroy the connection with the undead. ...
And I have a little reward for you. Take this cask. It's funny but smelly. You can have it.
Yes, go away!
pages.title: Rhargu

pages.name: Heliodor
npc_lines: Greetings!.
My name is Heliodor.
I'm the leader and king of the Daramian werelions.

He was a member of my pride, yet a very presumptuous one. He called my authority into question so I had to exile him. A pride of lions has clear and unalterable rules that every member has to adhere to. As king I can't tolerate disobedience.
pages.title: Heliodor

pages.name: Evrard The Miller
npc_lines: Greetings. Can I help you, traveller?
I am the local miller.
Well, you can make some excellent flour here. Just put your grain under the millstone and and grind.
John's been bitten by a snake as far as I heard. Hope he's alright.
Greetings. Can I help you, traveller?
Alright, look. You already know that camp to the east, with the bad guys roaming around, right? Great. ...
They have a ledger and a map there, and I want that. Both these items. The ledger is in a warehouse at the harbour. ...
I don't know where that map is, though but I am sure they have one where they've marked all the locations they've been at. ...
And most importantly: BE QUIET! Try not to be seen. Be a shadow. Got that?
Good, now go. Remember: be like a light summer breeze - quick, almost unnoticeable and most importantly QUIET!
Ah it's you, any news? If you just want to use the mill, you can do so, too.
What about the small errand I mentioned? Did you get the stuff?
You did it! Let me just take a peek... ...
What? No, no - keep them. I uhm, don't want to have anything to do with this. Just wanted to... take a quick look, you know. ...
Have you been quiet as I asked you?
Oh you have? Why did I hear screams of battle, fear and loathing from over there about the time you were gone? ...
And I really hope yours were the screams of battle and not those of fear. ...
Anyway, you did it and that's very good. I am thankful for that and I'll open up an underground route I sometimes use when I want to enter the city quickly. ...
This way you can get past any guards and find out more about the situation. And one more thing: ...
There's a passphrase: YSELDA. Remember that. Now go and the best of luck to you, traveller!
Farewell then.
pages.title: Evrard The Miller

pages.name: Flickering Soul
npc_lines: Be greeted, living soul!
It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took, when i left my mundane past behind.
I was once known as the necromant king....
For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just another stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
My ambitions were high and knew no limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood....
Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been enough. There was a hunger in me that nothing could put to rest.

Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
Necromancy was a passion at first, another tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me not have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was no time to rest....
And there was no looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever....
Now I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
My demise did not meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.

My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had not taken into consideration was peace.

Zarganash was not a place without it's dangers but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places....
And me, who had seen things that horrible, they would have obliterated a lesser man's mind, finally took the time to look back. And what I saw was frightening in its own right....
A great tiredness overcame me. With the flames of my ambitions calming down for the first time since I could remember, all my aspirations and plans seemed to petty and futile....
Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighted heavily on my soul.
I talked to other souls, lost in Zarganash and most of them seemed like mirrors to myself. Their faults, their shortcomings, the things that were important to them and the things they had lost....
It was all like miniature copies of my own grand plans and losses. It made me think. And the great tiredness weighted even more heavy on me. A weariness of the world, of the hunger that drove me.
Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did not lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments but the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot....
I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of knowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this knowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.
I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided not to return to the world of the living.
I decided to stay here, even pass on into the great beyond at some point. Yet I still feel the pull of my fetters. I can faintly hear those who think they are my followers, calling to me....
And I feel others, many others who carve for my powers and try to bring me back for their own gain.
Over my time in Zarganash I split away the parts of me that my worldly fetters where bound to. Yet I had to recognize that they are still a part of me and I'm bound to them....
The fetters and the efforts to call me back, are empowering them. I feel them growing in strength and gaining awareness on their own. ...
They are beginning to feed not only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker they grow more powerful over time.

The only way I can get rid of them is to disperse them, to 'kill' them so to say. But they are tainted parts of myself and even going near them might endanger my sanity and stability. So all I can do is to ask you to do this daunting task.
I'm aware I have no right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you nonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?
Thank you for accepting this burden.

You will have to reach each of the negative parts of my personality, I split away. They are hidden deep in the depths of Zarganash and will have corrupted and twisted their surroundings into dangerous nightmares....
Even worse you'll likely encounter minions of those who want to claim my soul as their prize, for their own, depraved reasons. You will have to destroy my shards to set me free.
You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet.
His avatar might be destroyed for now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be anihilated this easy.

My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do.
pages.title: Flickering Soul

pages.name: Wes The Blacksmith
npc_lines: Hail, customer! Welcome to Wes and son, blacksmith (and teacher). Can I do something for you?
Good! Feel free to browse my hand-made equipment then!
There you are, traveller!
My name's Wes. Pleased to meet you, traveller!
I am a smith and part-time teacher.
That ne'er-do-well. Who knows what he's currently on about. He's seems keenly interested in distance fighting, however. Which is the ONE THING I do not have any equipment for.
Ah yes, our good king Kesar. The Younger of course. To be honest, he's not that young anymore. And not actually king, really. ...
We do not actually have a king 'round here. But we give him that feeling, y'know? He's a good leader after all and keeps this lot in check.
Hail, customer! Welcome to Wes and son, blacksmith (and teacher). Can I do something for you?
Well, sorry, not at this hour. Feel free to come by my shop during daytime!
Ah yes, right. You came to the right place, ahem. ...
Well, for quite some time we are planning to help our king during this awful siege. As you know the passphrase, one of us already trusts you. ...
Outsiders are not welcome here during the siege. If you want to get into the castle, you will have to earn all our trust. ...
If you can do that, a member of the lion guard who is in contact with us, will let you in. ...
Just ask any of us the passphrase and we will see what we can do for you.
Alright then, let's see if you are really trustworthy. I need more material to forge better equipment for our men. ...
Bring me about 20 broken longbows from fallen usurpers and we will see.
Alright then, let's see if you are really trustworthy. You have about 20 broken longbows there, this is exactly what I need to fulfill my next order from the king. ...
Are you willing to hand them over to me?
Excellent, just what I needed. You have earned my trust, traveller. Good luck!
Farewell!
pages.title: Wes The Blacksmith

pages.name: Onfroi
npc_lines: Welcome, traveller! Is it tea you're looking... oh, is it still morning? Anyway, browse my stock now.
They call me TRAVELLER! Yehees! Oh, I mean, no - NO! They call me Onfroi. I am Onfroi, the wizard. Pleased to meet you, traveller!
I am the local healer Currently. Well, most of the time. I'm actually a well-known wizard, you might not know me, though.
Oh yes, that's me, indeed!
If you are hurt my child, I will heal your wounds.
We offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes: normal, strong, great and ultimate. Ask me for a trade to see my offers.
Of course, traveller. Feel free to browse!
A fine place, I absolutely love it here. Time and space for all my experiments and I'm free to do as I please.
John is not here, we had to send him out of town for medicine as even I couldn't treat his bite.
Welcome, traveller! Is it tea you're looking... oh, is it still morning? Anyway, browse my stock now.
Come to me during daytime, traveller. Unless you are in need of healing, these things can surely wait.
Welcome, traveller! Is it tea you're looking... oh, is it still morning? Anyway, browse my stock now.
You mean it, right? Where did you got that from, actually?. ...
Now, I have indeed a favour to ask. If you can accomplish that, you've earned my trust surely. ...
There is a crypt down below the town. It is old and the seismic activity has stirred up some bad energies down there. ...
I want you to venture exactly to that crypt and see if there are any powerful creatures down there. ...
And if there are... please... remove them. Rest assured that I have nothing to do with the rise of any mortally-depleted entities down there ...
At least not this time. You see, the locals are starting to suspect me. But I'm not much of a fighter or warlock. ...
So if there is indeed something below us and you can destroy let's say 20 of it, I'd be in your dept.
You did it, excellent! Most respectable, you did great! That took a load of my mind. And you've earned my trust!
Beautiful name. Mysterious and delicate. Have a fine day, my friend!
Farewell, traveller...
pages.title: Onfroi

pages.name: Fral The Butcher
npc_lines: Hello, customer! I got meat.
Sure, enjoy.
Name's Dinha. Fral Dinha. Nice to meet you, I guess.
I am a butcher. I cleave meat, among other things.
BOUNAC!
Kesar is a good ruler.
The carpenter is currently out of town.
What. Now? I got nothing here, find me in my shop during daytime if you want to buy meat.
If you want to prove trustworthy to me, I need you to bring me some raw ham, about 20 chunks if you can. Then we'll see.
Hello, customer! I got meat.
Good, I can smell about 20 pieces of raw ham there in your pockets. ...
Will you hand those over to me?
Great, thanks. And? Oh, yes. Consider my trust... earned.
Farewell.
pages.title: Fral The Butcher

pages.name: Eustacio
npc_lines: Hello my friend. What a delight to see you, even on a busy day. You can check your status or ask me about the location of the ongoing raids.
I am Eustacio. At your service.
It's just the time to make a fortune.
I am an aspiring businessman, that thrives to climb the ladder of success in the Venorean society.
I will make my own fortune and walk my way from the bottom to the top, even if it might take some decades.
As a newcomer to the Venorean trader union, it's my goal to rise in the ranks of the local traders and become a name to be reckoned with.
To reach my lofty goal though, I need some accomplishments to attach to my name.
Recently an opportunity has arisen. A new kind of pirates has shown up and is threatening our shipping routes.
Right now the other trade barons are still in denial, in fear to scare of potential investors.
That's were I can put my foot in the door by successfully fighting this new threat.
For all I know the new pirates are some Corym clans that banded together.
I do not know much about these Corym clans Pirats! ...
All I know is that they are launching attacks on our cities and coasts and that they tossed together some ship wrecks to create a small armada of ships.
They seem to employ new powerful magic to dominate our ships in sea battles. I doubt a victory on the seas can be acquired.
We have to rout out their base and strike them there, disrupt their supply lines and coordination.
The first step in our fight is to disrupt their operations, in the hopes it causes enough ruckus amongst them, ...
so my other agents might catch some vital new information about their hideouts and supply lines.
Reports came in about their attacks. Spies, small ships and one big ship with cannons. ...
I'm not too sure what to make of it but we need to stop them nevertheless. It's a mission for you!
Dealing with the trade barons can be like swimming in a pool of sharks from time to time.
They are the sharks of our society. If they notice you bleeding, you are as good as finished. ...
Business is always a difficult and dangerous field of expertise, especially in Venore. The trade barons are not too fond of competition.
I have my eyes and ears everywhere. If I had to give you points, you would have pontuação by now. ...
I might consider telling you my secrets if you gather 1500 points.
My agents didn't see anything of use yet.
It's a beautiful town on the surface. But it is ruled by business and business is a constant war.
Good bye, Jogador.
pages.title: Eustacio

pages.name: Tik'hi Tak'he
npc_lines: Hail, visitor! Welcome! You can ask me about your 'trust points'!
I am the shaman of Rascacoon.
I'm the diviner of the will of the great raccoon and keeper of wisdom.
This colony lived in peace for centuries, but this peace is now severely disrupted. The pirats became a constant threat and annoyance.
This colony is called Rascacoon. But our tribe originates from a far way rascoohan city with the name Washingstone.
When they were still known as Corym, there were only occasional clashes over loot and flotsam. But one day things changed.
It's only a place of mystery and legend. We have no contact since generations and its location was lost in time.
Our spies found out that the Corym retrieved an ancient book from a trunk in a shipwreck. It taught them about the ways of the pirates.
Their leaders were convinced that this was a description of the old and forgotten ways of their people and they adopted it.
They became the pirats that we know today. They became more organized and more aggressive.
Things escalated when they by chance discovered the explosiveness of the mold of one of their favourite cheeses.
They weaponized the mold and refined it to so called green powder to create devastating weapons.
For now they employ it to terrorize the seas and experiment with its power.
It's only a matter of time until they will come and use their weapons against us. Therefore they have to be stopped.
I fear they have yet to unleash the true destructive power of this weapon. For all what we know they keep experimenting and refining it, somewhere deep in their dens. ...
To disrupt those experiments might prove helpful.
We know many secrets and studied the pirats for a long time. Our knowledge will prove helpful in fighting them.
Before we share our knowledge you have to help us, to strengthen our position and secure our colony.
When we feel safe enough from their retribution, we can approve a strike to the heart of the pirats. Until then it will be your mission to assist our colony.
He is our creator and guide.
The mother of all gave birth to the gods. The gods immediately begun with the creation of the world, as this was their only purpose.
Their greatest accomplishment was the creation of the great raccoon. Of all of the gods creations only he was perfect and therefore he was unique.
But the great raccoon immediately felt an enormous loneliness, because all of creation had their peers to bond but the unique raccoon hadn't.
So after the gods were done with creation, the great raccoon stole the secret of life out of their trashcan and created us Rascoohans in his image.
The great raccoon looks over us and we live our life to his enjoyment.
When the gods moved on to create other world, the great raccoon stood behind and kept watching over us.
What king? We have no king or leader. We have to convince other to cooperate and don't order them.
Are you sure that you want to listen to rascoohan wisdom? It might shatter the perception of reality for the weak.
Fools rush in while the iron is still hot.
It's better to be poor and healthy than to throw stones from inside a glasshouse.
If a man fools you once, shame on him. But if you teach him how to fish, he'll probably won't bother you ever again.
Never pass on a free snack or an unsecured trashcan - which is basically the same.
Too many cooks are better than one.
The early bird gets the worm. But the worm got up even more early and what good did it do him?
pages.title: Tik'hi Tak'he

pages.name: Captain Coohan
npc_lines: Ahoy, Ahoy, Ye' Landlubber.
My name is Ca'coohan Tse, which translates to 'rides even an alligator'. But you can call me, Captain Coohan.
Me is the greatest captn' of all ye' isle.

Aye, there are rumours about a hidden treasure on a small island east of here. If you are interested, why not go on a little journey with me? I have a raft which lays at anchor in the north of the island. ...
Meet me there and we will set forth on a fantastic voyage!
Captain Coohan is afraid if no pirat. With cleverness and luck I always evaded their ships.
I don't have a boat, friend! I have a raft! I call it the Trekkie.
I worked on that raft for years. Now that it's ready to conquer the seas, I only need a decent crew.
I'm considering to hire a diverse crew, Perhaps an orc for security issues, and some soulless golem to keep all the information that we might gather. ...
I might even consider to hire an elf, because I kind of like their ears.
One day I will rediscover the fabled city of Washingstone.
pages.title: Captain Coohan

pages.name: Om'Wake Naha
npc_lines: Hello, traveller! Be welcome!
My name is Om'Wake Naha, which translates into 'has many things' in your language.
I am responsible for supplies and trade of the colony.
Pesky ratmen are constantly raiding our cheese supplies. I could use a helping hand or two, to get rid of this problem.
The pirats use transformation magic to enter my cheese cellar as rats and they devour and steal our precious cheese.
Push as many cheese as you can into the cheese larder in the center of the cellar. Use the staffs that our shaman supplied to dispel the disguise of the rats to fight the intruders.
Our town, Rascacoon, is just a colony. Our ancestors came here from a place far away on a journey to see the all wonders the world has to offer.
We face many hardships and hazards but our people are resourceful and until the pirats showed up our colony was thriving.
After several years of travel and hardships our ancestors settled here.
One day, when our colony is huge and striving, some of the young ones will go on their own journey and after a long travel will build their own colony.
This day is still far away. There is still space enough and so much to be accomplished that no one gets bored.
It's only an old story. Our tribe left that place generations ago.
pages.title: Om'Wake Naha

pages.name: Lost Traveler
npc_lines: Holy logic, it's YOU!!!
I mean it's not like you're are anyone important or I'm interfering with the time stream!
Oh, well. I might be a stranded time traveller that would appreciate your help.
My chronoflux compensator accidentality run out of charges and I'm kind of stranded here unless I find a way to recharge it.
I really need your help in locating other time travellers and extract time particles from them.
I can't tell you anything more. I really don't want to mess up with the time stream ...
again.
I'm certainly more careful ...
especially after that Ferumbras incident.
Oh, don't even ask!
I can provide you with a divining rod that should be able to locate time travellers with active particles on them.
The equipment you need will be created by the chronomatic dispenser right next to me. It works roughly only once each day, so take care with the equipment.
As we are currently in a very interesting time period of tibia there should be an abundance of other tourists that you can locate and extract time particles from.
I can provide you with a divining rod that should be able to locate time travellers with active particles on them.
I can supply you with a sophisticated device that can extract time particles from time travelling tourists and transfer them directly to my time travelling device.
The equipment you need will be created by the chronomatic dispenser right next to me. It works roughly only once each day, so take care with the equipment.
I can supply you with a sophisticated device that can extract time particles from time travelling tourists and transfer them directly to my time travelling device.
pages.title: Lost Traveler

pages.name: Theodora
npc_lines: I can see you collected some Theons. I may have something for you.
Do you want this box filled with 24 festive items and a new anniversary backpack? I will trade it for 7197 Theons. ... I also might have more items afterwards!
There you go! If you want festive items, I'm happy to trade!
Take a look at my balloons, carpets, food, fun and decorations!
Here you go!
Sure!
Some sweets!
Take your time!
Look around!
Bye.
pages.title: Theodora

pages.name: Nihaka
npc_lines: Branch-sleeping. I just don't get it ...
It's moa hunting season soon.
Ahh, sweet Candra.
Greetings, two-leg.
I'm the maharani's son, so I guess you could call me a prince.
My name is Nihaka.
I'm not sure. Is this important to you?

The asuri once lived in Marapur, but were expelled and banished from there. Since then they have been trying to return several times. Sometimes a few of them succeed, but they are usually quickly driven away by our warriors and shamans. ...

But my mother and our shaman think, that right now the asuri try to wreak havoc from the shadows by influencing nagas with dark magic so that they become increasingly animalistic and attack their fellows.
My mother is Saraki, our maharani.

The coastal nagas live in Silvertides and on the surroundings isles. At the beginning of the period we call 'the Rising', they still made great efforts to push the water back and keep it away from the island. ...
In the meantime, however, they have accepted that the water and the land coalesce more and more. They regard it as a part of their lives and even a part of themselves.
Silvertides is the city of the coast folk. You can find it in the south of Marapur, on one of the larger islands.
This is our city here in the Stardance Mountains. We built it thousands of years ago. It got its name after a story which is very well kown amongst the nagas.
A rather poetic name, yes. And with good reason. Of course, there is a story behind it.
Since the beginning of our existence, we nagas have worshipped the moon goddess Amati. She always stood high in the sky, looking down on us benevolently and lighting up the nights. ...

Although we love the warmth of the suns, it is the moon that moves the sea, creating the tides. That can charge solid water with energy. That strengthens our magical powers. We think of the moon as a queen and the stars as her many maids. ...

But once, in her wanderings across the night sky, Amati took a misstep and fell. She plummeted down, right above Marapur and landed in the Stardance Mountains. Hurt and alone, she didn't know how to get back up into the sky. ...

And the stars missed her bitterly. Moon and stars shed many tears and mourned many nights - dark nights, without Amati's light in the sky. But then the stars decided to do something they had never done before: ...

They descended from the sky and surrounded the fallen moon. Here, in these mountains, they began a magical dance. And lo and behold, Amati was healed and, with the help of the stars, was able to rise into the sky again. ...
This is why the mountains in the centre of Marapur are called the Stardance Mountains and our city Moonfall. For it was at this very spot that Amati had fallen.
That's what we call it, yes. The rising of the sea level and the flooding of Marapur began centuries ago. But it progresses very slowly, so we are not forced to flee. ...

The coast folk down there in Silvertides have strongly integrated the Rising into their culture and way of life. The so-called coastal nagas adapt to living with the water and take advantage of its benefits instead of resisting it. ...

We, the mountain nagas, live in the Stardance Mountains that have not yet been affected by the Rising. Because of this, there are some cultural differences, for example in terms of religious customs, diet and lifestyle.

Female nagas lay eggs, but they do not take care of them themselves. Instead, they give them to larger nests for breeding. There, brood helpers take care of the eggs and also of the small nagas when they hatch. ...

Our hatchlings become independent quite quickly and reach the stage of a somewhat six-year-old human child after only one year. Then they are sent back to their parents, who take care of their education. ...

Or to one of the parents in case they are no longer in a relationship. Which happens quite often, because we rarely form longer, monogamous relationships. But with Candra, it's different! We will stay together!

Our mythology knows a story, why these turtles have two heads: In the conflict between asuri and nagas, they would not choose one side. While the nagas offered wisdom to the turtles, the asuri offered them food. ...
Indecisive and hesitant, the animals turned their heads back and forth between the two parties so often that they ended up with two heads - and neither food nor wisdom.
Moas are herbivorous birds and feed mainly on buds, leaves and the fruits of jungle plants. They also have a preference for shiny or glittering objects. ...
If they spot these and can snatch them without major risk, the birds will often steal such items and hide them in their nests.
Parders are good climbers, but due to the omnipresence of water they have also developed into good swimmers and like to catch fish. For us nagas, they hardly pose a threat. ...
Be careful, though, two-leg: Parders prey on humanoid bipeds.
In earlier times, we often domesticated the makara to serve as pack and working animals. ...
However, when we discovered that the giant beavers native to Marapur were easier to tame and less costly to care for and feed, we turned away from domesticating makara.

Because of their elemental bodies, it is often difficult to distinguish foam stalkers from the water around them. As they roam the reefs, they often capture coral branches, flotsam, pearls or small fish with their swirling bodies. ...
